CREATE function [dbo].[O7REPCZCCTR_REPPARSEWO] ( @sSELJOB nvarchar(255))
RETURNS nvarchar(2000)
as

BEGIN
declare @sSelWo nvarchar(2000)
declare @sFromWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sToWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sTempWo nvarchar(100)
declare @sWoStr nvarchar(2000)
declare @sReturn nvarchar(2000)
DECLARE @rangeseparator NVARCHAR( 1 )

    SELECT @rangeseparator = COALESCE(SUBSTRING(INS_DESC,1,1),'-') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'REPRANGE'
    set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSELJOB))                
    IF (charindex( ',', @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
        begin                           
            IF len(@sSelWo) > 0  
                set @sWoStr = N' IN (' 
            
            WHILE (len(@sSelWo) > 0)
                begin
                    IF (charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1) > 0) 
                        begin 
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                            set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( N',', @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( ',', @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                        end
                    ELSE
                        begin
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSelWo)) 
                            set @sSelWo = ''
                        end
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  ' ''''' +  @sTempWo +  ''''','     
                end
            IF (len(@sWoStr) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sWoStr = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sWoStr, 1, len(@sWoStr)-1)))
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  N')'
                end
            set @sReturn = @sWoStr
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            IF (charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sFromWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                    set @sToWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                    set @sReturn = N' BETWEEN ''''' +  @sFromWO +  ''''' AND ''''' +  @sToWO +  ''''' '
                end
            ELSE
                set @sReturn = ' '
        end
    RETURN @sReturn

end

0

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPCZDEBL_FUNCGT(@sContract     nvarchar(30), 
                @sStore        nvarchar(15),
                @sSupplier     nvarchar(30), 
                @sStatus       nvarchar(15), 
                @sOrg          nvarchar(15),
                @sR5User       nvarchar(255),
                @sR5Func       nvarchar(6),
                @r5role        nvarchar(30)
              )
     RETURNS NUMERIC(36,6) AS

     BEGIN

  declare   @sCon_code           nvarchar(30)
  declare   @sCon_store          nvarchar(15)
  declare   @sCon_supplier       nvarchar(30)
  declare   @sCon_supplier_org   nvarchar(15)
  declare   @sDate_from          nvarchar(30)
  declare   @sDate_to            nvarchar(30)
  declare   @nTotal_Deb          numeric(36,6) 
  declare   @nGrand_Total        numeric(36,6) 

set @nTotal_Deb = 0
set @nGrand_Total = 0


   DECLARE Q_ALLREC CURSOR FOR
         SELECT 
           CON_CODE,
           CON_STORE,
           CON_SUPPLIER,
           CON_SUPPLIER_ORG,
           DBO.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CON_START,N'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_FROM,
           DBO.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CON_END,N'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_TO
        FROM 
           R5CONTRACTS 
        WHERE 
           CON_RSTATUS IN (N'A',N'R') 
           AND CON_CODE LIKE @sContract 
           AND CON_SUPPLIER LIKE @sSupplier 
           AND CON_STORE LIKE @sStore 
           AND CON_STATUS LIKE @sStatus 
           AND CON_ORG LIKE @sOrg 
           AND CON_ORG IN ( SELECT 
                              UOG_ORG 
                            FROM 
                              R5USERORGANIZATION,
                              R5PERMISSIONS 
                            WHERE UOG_GROUP= PRM_GROUP 
                              AND UOG_USER = @sR5User 
                              AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role
                              AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func 
                              AND PRM_SELECT = N'?' 
                            ) 
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 
                         NULL 
                       FROM 
                         R5CONDISCOUNTS 
                       WHERE 
                         CDI_CONTRACT = CON_CODE 
                         AND CDI_RTYPE IN (N'Q',N'T',N'O',N'Y') 
                      )

        OPEN Q_ALLREC
        FETCH NEXT FROM Q_ALLREC
        INTO @sCon_code,@sCon_store,@sCon_supplier,@sCon_supplier_org,@sDate_from,@sDate_to
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN


        SELECT 
            @nTotal_Deb = (ISNULL(((ISNULL(C.SUM_NET_TOTAL,0) + ISNULL(C.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL,0) - ISNULL(C.NET_DISC_REBATE,0)) * (ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CDI_DISPERC),0) 
                               FROM 
                                    R5CONDISCOUNTS D1 
                               WHERE 
                                    D1.CDI_RTYPE = N'Y' 
                                    AND D1.CDI_CONTRACT = @sCon_code
                                    AND D1.CDI_VALUE = ( SELECT 
                                    MAX(D2.CDI_VALUE) 
                                                FROM 
                                                   R5CONDISCOUNTS D2 
                                                WHERE 
                                                   D2.CDI_CONTRACT = D1.CDI_CONTRACT 
                                                   AND D2.CDI_RTYPE = N'Y' 
                                                   AND D2.CDI_VALUE < (ISNULL(C.SUM_NET_TOTAL,0) + ISNULL(C.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL,0) - ISNULL(C.NET_DISC_REBATE,0))
                                    ) ),0)) * 0.01) + ISNULL(C.NET_DISC_REBATE,0),0))  
         FROM
         (
            SELECT
                   SUM(B.NET_DISC_REBATE) NET_DISC_REBATE,
                   SUM(B.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL) SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL,
                   AVG(B.SUM_NET_TOTAL)  SUM_NET_TOTAL
            FROM
            (
                   SELECT 
                         (ISNULL((SELECT 
                            ISNULL(CDI_DISPERC ,0) CDI_DISPERC 
                                 FROM 
                                  R5CONDISCOUNTS D1 
                                 WHERE 
                                   D1.CDI_RTYPE IN (N'T',N'Y') 
                                   AND D1.CDI_CONTRACT = A.CPA_CONTRACT 
                                   AND D1.CDI_PART = A.ORL_PART 
                                   AND D1.CDI_PART_ORG = A.ORL_PART_ORG 
                                   AND (D1.CDI_VALUE <= A.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL 
                                   OR D1.CDI_PURQTY <= A.NET_QTYSUBTOTAL) 
                                   AND D1.CDI_DISPERC =(SELECT 
                                              MAX(D2.CDI_DISPERC) 
                                            FROM 
                                              R5CONDISCOUNTS D2 
                                            WHERE 
                                              D2.CDI_RTYPE IN (N'T',N'Y') 
                                              AND D2.CDI_CONTRACT = D1.CDI_CONTRACT 
                                              AND D2.CDI_PART = D1.CDI_PART 
                                              AND D2.CDI_PART_ORG = D1.CDI_PART_ORG 
                                              AND (D2.CDI_VALUE <= A.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL 
                                              OR D2.CDI_PURQTY <= A.NET_QTYSUBTOTAL) 
                                         ) ),0) * ISNULL(A.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL,0) * 0.01) NET_DISC_REBATE, 
                         A.SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL SUM_NET_SUB_TOTAL,
                         A.SUM_NET_TOTAL  SUM_NET_TOTAL
                  FROM 
                        ( SELECT 
                             CPA_CONTRACT,
                             ORL_PART,
                             ORL_PART_ORG,
                            (SELECT 
                                 SUM(ISNULL(L.ORL_ORDQTY,0)) 
                             FROM 
                                  R5ORDERS O,
                                  R5ORDERLINES L ,
                                  R5CONPARTS P 
                             WHERE 
                        O.ORD_CODE = L.ORL_ORDER 
                        AND O.ORD_ORG = L.ORL_ORDER_ORG 
                        AND O.ORD_RSTATUS IN (N'A',N'R') 
                        AND L.ORL_PART = P.CPA_PART 
                        AND L.ORL_PART_ORG = P.CPA_PART_ORG 
                        AND (L.ORL_ACTIVE = N'+' 
                                OR L.ORL_RECVQTY = L.ORL_ORDQTY) 
                        AND (@sDate_from  = N'%' 
                                OR DBO.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(O.ORD_DATE,N'YYYY-MM-DD') >= @sDate_from ) 
                        AND (@sDate_to  = N'%' 
                                OR DBO.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(O.ORD_DATE,N'YYYY-MM-DD') <= @sDate_to ) 
                        AND P.CPA_CONTRACT = @sCon_code 
                        AND O.ORD_SUPPLIER = @sCon_supplier 
                        AND O.ORD_SUPPLIER_ORG = @sCon_supplier_org 
                        AND L.ORL_PART = M.ORL_PART 
                        AND L.ORL_PART_ORG = M.ORL_PART_ORG 
                ) NET_QTYSUBTOTAL, 
                (SELECT 
                        SUM((((ISNULL(L.ORL_ORDQTY,0)/ISNULL(L.ORL_EXCH,1)/ISNULL(L.ORL_MULTIPLY,1)*ISNULL(L.ORL_PRICE,0))*(100-ISNULL(L.ORL_DISCPERC,0))*0.01)*(100-ISNULL(O.ORD_DISCPERC,0))*0.01)) 
                FROM 
                        R5ORDERS O,
                        R5ORDERLINES L ,
                        R5CONPARTS P 
                WHERE 
                        O.ORD_CODE = L.ORL_ORDER 
                        AND O.ORD_ORG = L.ORL_ORDER_ORG 
                        AND O.ORD_RSTATUS IN (N'A',N'R') 
                        AND L.ORL_PART = P.CPA_PART 
                        AND L.ORL_PART_ORG = P.CPA_PART_ORG 
                        AND (L.ORL_ACTIVE = N'+' 
                                OR L.ORL_RECVQTY = L.ORL_ORDQTY)

CREATE function O7REPEQUIPMENTHIER (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
							@sOrg	nvarchar(15),
							@sCodetype	nvarchar(15), 
							@action nvarchar(15))
RETURNS @tReturn table(	stc_parent		nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parenttype	nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parentrtype	nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child		nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_childtype	nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_childrtype	nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						nLevel			int,
						nRownum 		int)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @nRownum		int
	DECLARE @sParent		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sParenttype	nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sParentrtype	nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sChildtype	    nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sChildrtype	nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sParentorg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @tStack table (	stc_parent		nvarchar(30),
							stc_parenttype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_parentrtype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_child		nvarchar(30),
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_childrtype	nvarchar(4),
							LevelID					int )


	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT '', '', '', '', obj_code, obj_org, obj_obtype, obj_obrtype, 1
		FROM r5objects
		WHERE obj_code LIKE CASE WHEN @sCode = N'%' THEN N'$' ELSE @sCode END
			AND obj_org LIKE @sOrg
		ORDER BY obj_code, obj_org


	SET @nLevel = 1
	SET @nRownum = 1
	
	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					SELECT	TOP 1 @sCode		= stc_child,
							@sOrg		= stc_child_org,
							@sChildtype	= stc_childtype,
							@sChildrtype	= stc_childrtype,
							@sParent	= stc_parent,
							@sParenttype= stc_parenttype,
							@sParentrtype= stc_parentrtype,
							@sParentorg	= stc_parent_org
					FROM	@tStack 
					WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
					ORDER BY stc_child, stc_child_org
					
				
					INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES (@sParent, @sParenttype, @sParentrtype, @sParentorg, @sCode, @sOrg, @sChildtype, @sChildrtype, @nLevel, @nRownum )

					DELETE FROM @tStack 
					WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
					AND		stc_child 	= @sCode
					AND		stc_child_org 	= @sOrg
					AND		stc_childtype 	= @sChildtype
					AND		stc_childrtype 	= @sChildrtype
					AND		stc_parent 	= @sParent
					AND		stc_parenttype 	= @sParenttype
					AND		stc_parentrtype 	= @sParentrtype
					AND		stc_parent_org 	= @sParentorg

					-- increment row count for each @tReturn insert
					set @nRownum = @nRownum + 1

					INSERT INTO @tStack 
						SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parentrtype, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, stc_childrtype, @nLevel + 1  
						FROM	r5structures
						WHERE	stc_parent	= @sCode 
							AND		stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	
							AND		stc_rollup	= N'+'  
						ORDER BY stc_child, stc_child_org

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	RETURN
END

0

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPGETGHGFUELMIX( 
 @sSupplier    NVARCHAR(30), 
 @sSupplierOrg NVARCHAR(15), 
 @sCommodity   NVARCHAR(15), 
 @dDate        DATETIME, 
 @sGreenHouseGas NVARCHAR(30) )

RETURNS NUMERIC(24,6) AS

BEGIN
 DECLARE @nFuelMix       NUMERIC(24,6)
 DECLARE @nTotalCapacity NUMERIC(24,6)

 IF @sSupplier IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
   	-- total capacity
	SELECT 
		@nTotalCapacity = SUM( cfm_capacity )
      	FROM   
		r5compfuelmix
      	WHERE  
       		cfm_supplier = @sSupplier
		AND cfm_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		AND cfm_commodity = @sCommodity
		AND cfm_capacity > 0
		AND @dDate BETWEEN cfm_fromdate AND cfm_todate

	-- fuelmix calculation for Utility Bills
	SELECT 
		@nFuelMix = SUM( cfl_emissions * ghg_co2eratio * cfm_capacity / @nTotalCapacity )
	FROM   
		r5greenhousegases, r5cmdfueltypes, r5compfuelmix
	WHERE  
		ghg_code = cfl_ghg
		AND cfm_type = cfl_type
		AND cfm_supplier = @sSupplier
		AND cfm_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		AND cfm_commodity = @sCommodity
		AND ghg_code = @sGreenHouseGas
		AND cfm_capacity > 0
		AND cfl_commodity    = @sCommodity  
		AND @dDate BETWEEN cfm_fromdate AND cfm_todate
		AND @dDate BETWEEN cfl_fromdate AND cfl_todate
    END  
 ELSE
    BEGIN
	-- fuelmix calculation for Fuels
	SELECT 
		@nFuelMix = SUM( cfl_emissions * ghg_co2eratio )
	FROM   
		r5greenhousegases, r5cmdfueltypes
	WHERE  
		ghg_code = cfl_ghg
		AND ghg_code = @sGreenHouseGas
		AND cfl_commodity    = @sCommodity  
		AND @dDate BETWEEN cfl_fromdate AND cfl_todate
    END

RETURN @nFuelMix

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7REPGETWOCOSTPERIOD(
  @sWo                NVARCHAR(30),
  @sOrg               NVARCHAR(15),
  @nAct               NUMERIC(8,0),
  @sCosttype          NVARCHAR(5),
  @sFromdate          NVARCHAR(10),
  @sTodate            NVARCHAR(10),
  @sRepcurr           NVARCHAR(3))
  RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @nMat    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Stock Material.
  DECLARE @nDma    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Direct Material.
  DECLARE @nIdm    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Invoice Difference Direct Material.
  DECLARE @nTls    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Tool.
  DECLARE @nLab    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Internal Labor.
  DECLARE @nHir    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Hired Labor.
  DECLARE @nIhr    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Invoice Difference Hired Labor.  
  DECLARE @nFix    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Fixed Cost Labor.
  DECLARE @nIfx    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Invoice Difference Fixed Cost Labor.  
  DECLARE @nPiddma1 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPiddma2 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nActhir1 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nActhir2 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPidhir1 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPidhir2 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPidhr2 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPidfix1 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPidfix2 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sOrder   NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sOrdorg   NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nOrdline  NUMERIC(8, 0)
  DECLARE @nEvnthours NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPrice     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nHours NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nPidtot NUMERIC( 24, 6 )  

  IF @sWo IS NULL OR @sCosttype NOT IN ( N'SM', N'DM', N'MAT', N'TOOL', N'IL', N'ILH', N'FL', N'HL', N'HLH', N'EL', N'LABOR', N'TOTAL' )
    -- If the Work Order does not exist, or an invalid cost type has been specified: return NULL.
    RETURN NULL

  --  Stock Items column/Stock Material Costs
  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'SM', N'MAT', N'TOTAL' )
  BEGIN
  
	select @nMat = round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) * isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 )
	from   r5translines t  
	where ( ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR') and t.trl_io = -1 ) or
			( t.trl_rtype IN ( N'INVA' ) and t.trl_io = 0 ) ) 
		and    t.trl_event = @sWo
		and    (@nAct is null OR t.trl_act = @nAct)
		and    (@sFromdate = N'%' OR @sFromdate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.trl_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) >= @sFromdate)
		and    (@sTodate = N'%' OR @sTodate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.trl_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= @sTodate)
	
  END

  --  Direct Purchases Column/Direct Material Cost
  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'DM', N'MAT', N'TOTAL' )
  BEGIN

	select @nDma = round( sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N'RETN' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * 
		   ( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) * isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
		   dbo.O7AXTDMA( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org, t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ), 2 ) 
	from   r5transactions a, r5translines t  
	where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code           
		and    a.tra_rstatus = N'A'           
		and    t.trl_io      = 0           
		and    t.trl_rtype   IN ( N'RECV', N'RETN', N'MISC' ) 
		and    t.trl_event = @sWo
		and    (@nAct is null OR t.trl_act = @nAct)		
		and    (@sFromdate = N'%' OR @sFromdate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.trl_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) >= @sFromdate)
		and    (@sTodate = N'%' OR @sTodate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.trl_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= @sTodate)

  END

   -- Tool Cost Column 
  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'TOOL', N'TOTAL' )
  BEGIN

	select @nTls = round( sum( isnull( t.tou_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )            
	from   r5toolusage t, r5events e, r5activities a 
	where  a.act_event = t.tou_event           
		and    a.act_event = e.evt_code           
		and    a.act_act   = t.tou_act  
		and    t.tou_event = @sWo
		and    (@nAct is null OR t.tou_act = @nAct)
		and    (@sFromdate = N'%' OR @sFromdate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.tou_dateused, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) >= @sFromdate)
		and    (@sTodate = N'%' OR @sTodate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.tou_dateused, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= @sTodate)		

  END

  -- Labor Column/Internal Labor Costs
  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'IL', N'ILH', N'LABOR', N'TOTAL' )
  BEGIN

	select @nLab = round( sum( isnull( CASE WHEN @sCosttype = 'ILH' THEN b.boo_hours ELSE b.boo_cost END, 0 ) ), 2 )           
	from   r5activities a, r5bookedhours b  
  where  a.act_event = b.boo_event
         and    a.act_act   = b.boo_act
         and    b.boo_order is null
         and    b.boo_routertype is null
         and not ( b.boo_misc = N'+' and b.boo_ocrtype in ( N'O', N'X' ) )
         and   ( a.act_order is null or b.boo_misc = N'+' or b.boo_misc = N'I' ) 
		     and   b.boo_event = @sWo
		     and   (@nAct is null OR b.boo_act = @nAct)
		     and   (@sFromdate = N'%' OR @sFromdate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(b.boo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) >= @sFromdate)
		     and   (@sTodate = N'%' OR @sTodate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(b.boo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= @sTodate)	

  END

  --  Hired Labor Column
  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'HL', N'HLH', N'EL', N'LABOR', N'TOTAL' )
  BEGIN

	-- acthir
	select @nActhir1 = round( sum( isnull( CASE WHEN @sCosttype = 'HLH' THEN b.boo_hours ELSE b.boo_cost END, 0 ) ), 2 )          
	from   r5events e, r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l on 
                 (b.boo_event = l.orl_event and b.boo_act   = l.orl_act)
  where   b.boo_event = e.evt_code
					and   ((( l.orl_rtype = N'ST' or b.boo_routertype = N'ST' ) and b.boo_misc = N'-' ) or  
                                 			( b.boo_misc = N'+' and b.boo_ocrtype = N'O'  
                                 				and ISNULL( l.orl_order + N'#' + l.orl_order_org + N'#' + cast(l.orl_ordline as nvarchar(8)),N'x' ) = 
                                 				( select ISNULL(min(l2.orl_order + N'#' + l2.orl_order_org + N'#' + cast(l2.orl_ordline as nvarchar(8))),N'x') 
				   				  from r5orderlines l2 where l2.orl_event = b.boo_event and   l2.orl_act   = b.boo_act
				   				  and not (coalesce(l2.orl_rstatus, N'A') = N'C' and coalesce(l2.orl_recvqty, 0) = 0))) )
					and   not ( coalesce(l.orl_rstatus,N'A') = N'C' and coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) = 0 ) 
          and   b.boo_event = @sWo
          and   (@nAct is null OR b.boo_act = @nAct)
          and   (@sFromdate = N'%' OR @sFromdate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(b.boo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) >= @sFromdate)
          and   (@sTodate = N'%' OR @sTodate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(b.boo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= @sTodate)

	select @nActhir2 = coalesce( round( sum( isnull( CASE WHEN @sCosttype = 'HLH' THEN b.boo_hours ELSE b.boo_cost END, 0 ) ), 2 ), 0 )         
	from   r5orderlines l,r5events e, r5bookedhours b 
	where  b.boo_order     = l.orl_order         
		and    b.boo_order_org = l.orl_order_org         
		and    b.boo_ordline   = l.orl_ordline         
		and    b.boo_event     = e.evt_code         
		and    l.orl_rtype     = N'SH'          
		and    not ( l.orl_rstatus = N'C' and coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) = 0 )  
		and    b.boo_event = @sWo
		and   (@nAct is null OR b.boo_act = @nAct)
		and   (@sFromdate = N'%' OR @sFromdate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(b.boo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) >= @sFromdate)
		and   (@sTodate = N'%' OR @sTodate IS NULL OR dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(b.boo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= @sTodate)

	SET @nHir = COALESCE(@nActhir1,0) + COALESCE(@nActhir2,0)

   END

  --  Services Column/Fixed Cost Labor
  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'FL', N'EL', N'LABOR', N'TOTAL' )
  BEGIN

	select @nFix = round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )                           
	from r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l on 
               b.boo_event = l.orl_event and b.boo_act = l.orl_act

  @R5func        nvarchar(6),
  @R5lang        nvarchar(2),
  @Selproj       nvarchar(20),
  @Selorg        nvarchar(15),
  @sCurrUser     nvarchar(255),
  @r5role        nvarchar(30)

AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

declare @nReturn integer
declare @sStatement NVARCHAR(4000)
declare @nTOTREMHIR    numeric(30,6) 
declare @nTOTREMDMA    numeric(30,6) 
declare @nTOTREMFIX    numeric(30,6) 
declare @nTOTACTLAB    numeric(30,6) 
declare @nTOTACTMAT    numeric(30,6) 
declare @nTOTACTHIR    numeric(30,6) 
declare @nTOTACTDMA    numeric(30,6)

SELECT 
                P.PCL_PROJBUD, 
                P.PCL_PROJECT,
                P.PCL_CLASS,
                C.PBC_DESC,
               (CASE WHEN (PR.PRJ_ORG = @R5org ) THEN PR.PRJ_CODE ELSE PR.PRJ_CODE+ ' ('+PR.PRJ_ORG+')' END) DISP_PRJ,
                DBO.REPGETDESC(@R5lang,N'PROJ',PR.PRJ_CODE,NULL,NULL) PROJ_DESC,
                PR.PRJ_RSTATUS,
                ISNULL (C.PBC_COSTAREA,N'X') PBC_COSTAREA,
                ISNULL(P.PCL_AMOUNT, 0) PCL_AMOUNT,
                (SELECT   ( SUM ( ISNULL( I.IVL_INVVALUE, 0 ) ) )INVVALUE
                          FROM R5ORDERLINES O, R5INVOICELINES I, R5PROJBUDCLASSES PB
                          WHERE   O.ORL_ORDER = I.IVL_ORDER
                                  AND O.ORL_ORDER_ORG = I.IVL_ORDER_ORG
                                  AND O.ORL_ORDLINE = I.IVL_ORDLINE 
                                  AND O.ORL_PROJECT = PB.PCL_PROJECT

                ISNULL(P.PCL_ETC, 0) PCL_ETC                 
        FROM R5PROJBUDCLASSES P, R5PROJBUDCODES C, R5PROJECTS PR
        WHERE P.PCL_PROJECT LIKE @Selproj
           AND PR.PRJ_ORG LIKE @Selorg
                 AND P.PCL_PROJECT = PR.PRJ_CODE
                 AND C.PBC_CODE = P.PCL_PROJBUD

        open c_jzacos

        begin

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[O7REPJZPBCS]
  @R5user        nvarchar(255),
  @R5org         nvarchar(15),
  @R5func        nvarchar(6),
  @R5lang        nvarchar(2),
  @Selproj       nvarchar(20),
  @Selorg        nvarchar(15),
  @sCurrUser     nvarchar(255),
  @r5role        nvarchar(30)
  
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

declare @nReturn integer
declare @sStatement    nvarchar(4000)
declare @nREMHIR       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nREMDMA       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nREMFIX       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nACTLAB       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nACTMAT       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nACTHIR       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nACTDMA       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nACTTOOL      numeric(30,6) 
declare @nACTFIX       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPIDLAB       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPIDHIR       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPIDFIX       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPIDDMA       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nREMLAB       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nREMMAT       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nREMTOOL      numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPNOHIR       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPNOFIX       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nPNODMA       numeric(30,6) 
declare @nESTTOOL      numeric(30,6) 
 
declare @sPROJ_BUD           nvarchar(20)
declare @sPROJ_CODE          nvarchar(20)
declare @nPRJ_CODE           nvarchar(20)
declare @sPCL_CLASS          nvarchar(8) 
declare @sPBC_DESC           nvarchar(255) 
declare @sDISP_PROJ          nvarchar(40) 
declare @sPROJ_DESC          nvarchar(255) 
declare @sPROJ_STATUS        nvarchar(4)
declare @sINVVALUE           numeric(30,6)
declare @sPBC_PCLAMT         numeric(30,6)
declare @nV_PCL_ETC          numeric(30,6)
declare @nPCL_ETC            numeric(30,6)
declare @sJZPBCS_STATUS_DESC nvarchar(255)

declare   @sJZPBCS_PCLAMT         numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_ACTUAL         numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_ONORDER        numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_INVDIFFERENCE  numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_PLANNED        numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_ESTTOCOMPLETE  numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_COSTATCOMP     numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_TOTALAVAILABLE numeric(30,6)
declare   @sJZPBCS_INVVALUE       numeric(30,6)


create table #TmpJZPBCS (PROJ_BUD             nvarchar(20), 
                        PROJ_CODE             nvarchar(20), 
                        PCL_CLASS             nvarchar(8), 
                        PBC_DESC              nvarchar(255), 
                        DISP_PROJ             nvarchar(40), 
                        PROJ_DESC             nvarchar(255), 
                        PROJ_STATUS           nvarchar(4),
                        JZPBCS_PCLAMT         numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_ACTUAL         numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_ONORDER        numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_INVDIFFERENCE  numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_PLANNED        numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_ESTTOCOMPLETE  numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_COSTATCOMP     numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_TOTALAVAILABLE numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_INVVALUE       numeric(30,6),
                        JZPBCS_STATUS_DESC    nvarchar(255)
           )

declare c_JZPBCS cursor local for
SELECT P.PCL_PROJBUD, 
       P.PCL_PROJECT,
       P.PCL_CLASS,
       C.PBC_DESC,
       (CASE WHEN (PR.PRJ_ORG = @R5org ) THEN PR.PRJ_CODE ELSE PR.PRJ_CODE+ ' (' + PR.PRJ_ORG + ')' END) DISP_PRJ,
       DBO.REPGETPARAMDESC(@R5lang, N'PROJ', PR.PRJ_CODE,NULL,NULL) PROJ_DESC,
       ISNULL(P.PCL_AMOUNT, 0)PCL_AMOUNT,PR.PRJ_RSTATUS
FROM R5PROJBUDCLASSES P, R5PROJBUDCODES C, R5PROJECTS PR
WHERE P.PCL_PROJECT LIKE @Selproj
  AND PR.PRJ_ORG LIKE @Selorg
  AND P.PCL_PROJECT = PR.PRJ_CODE
  AND C.PBC_CODE = P.PCL_PROJBUD
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
               FROM R5USERORGANIZATION,R5PERMISSIONS 
                WHERE 
                UOG_ORG = PR.PRJ_ORG
                AND UOG_GROUP= PRM_GROUP 
                AND UOG_USER = @R5user
                AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role
                AND PRM_FUNCTION = @R5func 
                AND PRM_SELECT = N'?' )
  AND @R5user = UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
ORDER BY PR.PRJ_CODE,P.PCL_PROJBUD

        open c_JZPBCS
        fetch next from c_JZPBCS into   @sPROJ_BUD, 
                                        @sPROJ_CODE,
                                        @sPCL_CLASS,
                                        @sPBC_DESC, 
                                        @sDISP_PROJ,
                                        @sPROJ_DESC,
                                        @sPBC_PCLAMT,
                                        @sPROJ_STATUS 
                                        
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
        BEGIN 

        execute @nReturn = O7REMHIR N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nREMHIR OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7REMDMA N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nREMDMA OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7REMFIX N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nREMFIX OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7ACTLAB N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nACTLAB OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7ACTMAT N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nACTMAT OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7ACTHIR N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nACTHIR OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7ACTDMA N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nACTDMA OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS
             return -1
        end

        execute @nReturn = O7ACTTOOL N'PRJ', @sPROJ_CODE, @sPROJ_BUD, null, null, @nACTTOOL OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             close c_JZPBCS
             deallocate c_JZPBCS

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPLACELEVEL
  @sParent    NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sOldlevel  NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sNewlevel  NVARCHAR(30),
  @sAction    NVARCHAR(10),
  @pFormula   NVARCHAR(2000),
  @sMessage   NVARCHAR(200) OUTPUT,
  @sChk       NVARCHAR(1)   OUTPUT
AS 
  DECLARE @sString     NVARCHAR(2000)
  DECLARE @sNewstring  NVARCHAR(3000)
  DECLARE @nPos        INTEGER
  DECLARE @sPK         NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sFormula    NVARCHAR(2000)
  DECLARE @sSublevel   NVARCHAR(2000)
  DECLARE @sX          NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @nJ          INTEGER

  SET @sChk = '0'

  DECLARE c_rrl CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT rrl_pk, CASE @sACTION WHEN N'CHECK' THEN @pFormula ELSE rrl_formula END
    FROM   r5reliabilityrankinglevels
    WHERE  rrl_pk = @sParent
    AND  ( UPPER( rrl_formula ) LIKE '%:' + @sOldlevel + '%' OR @sAction = N'CHECK' )

  /* Loop through all level records with a formula containing the string to change. */
  OPEN c_rrl
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_rrl INTO @sPK, @sFormula
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @sString = @sFormula
      SET @sNewstring = ''
      WHILE CHARINDEX( ':' + @sOldlevel, UPPER( @sString ) ) > 0
        BEGIN
          SET @nPos = CHARINDEX( ':' + @sOldlevel, UPPER( @sString ) )
          IF @sAction = N'CHECK'
            BEGIN
              /* If action = 'CHECK', find the next special character, string in between should be a level. */
              SET @sSublevel = ''
              SET @nJ = 1
              WHILE @nJ <= LEN( @sString ) - @nPos
                BEGIN
                  IF ISNULL( SUBSTRING( @sString, CAST( @nPos + @nJ AS INTEGER ), 1 ), ' ' ) IN
                     ( ' ', ',', '*', ')', '(', '-', '/', '+' )
                    BREAK
                  ELSE
                    SET @sSublevel = @sSublevel + SUBSTRING( @sString, CAST( @nPos + @nJ AS INTEGER ), 1 )
                  SET @nJ = @nJ + 1  
                END
              SET @sX = NULL
              SELECT @sX = 'x'
              FROM   r5reliabilityrankinglevels
              WHERE  rrl_parent = @sParent
              AND    rrl_code = UPPER( @sSublevel )
              IF @sX IS NULL
                BEGIN
                  /* The found level does not exist, so give error. */
                  SET @sChk = N'2'
                  SET @sMessage = @sSublevel
                  RETURN
                END
              SET @sNewstring = @sNewstring + SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, @nPos - 1 ) + N'1'
              SET @sString = SUBSTRING( @sString, CAST( @nPos + LEN( @sSublevel ) + 1 AS INTEGER ), 5000 )
            END  
          ELSE          
            BEGIN 
              IF ISNULL( SUBSTRING( @sString, CAST( @nPos + LEN( @sOldlevel ) + 1 AS INTEGER ), 1 ), ' ' ) IN 
                 ( ' ', ',', '*', ')', '(', '-', '/', '+' ) 
                 BEGIN
                   SET @sNewstring = @sNewstring + SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, @nPos ) + @sNewlevel
                   SET @sString = SUBSTRING( @sString, CAST( @nPos + LEN( @sOldlevel ) + 1 AS INTEGER ), 5000 )
                 END  
              ELSE
                BEGIN
                  SET @sNewstring = @sNewstring + SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, @nPos )
                  SET @sString = SUBSTRING( @sString, @nPos + 1, 5000 )
                END  
            END
        END
        SET @sNewstring = @sNewstring + @sString
        IF @sAction = N'CHECK'
          BEGIN
            /* Dummy statement to make below execute work, unknown why this is necessary. */
            INSERT INTO r5repnum( rpn_line ) SELECT 1 FROM dual WHERE 1=2
            /* Execute statement. */
            BEGIN TRY
              EXECUTE( N'SELECT ' + @sNewstring + N' FROM dual' )
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH
              IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 8134
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @sMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE()
                  SET @sChk = N'3'
                END  
            END CATCH
          END
        ELSE
          BEGIN
            IF @sNewstring <> @sFormula 
              BEGIN
                IF @sAction = N'DELETE'
                  SET @sChk = '1'
                ELSE IF @sAction = N'UPDATE' AND LEN( @sNewstring ) <= 2000 
                  UPDATE r5reliabilityrankinglevels
                  SET    rrl_formula = @sNewstring
                  WHERE  rrl_pk = @sPK
              END 
          END   
        FETCH NEXT FROM c_rrl INTO @sPK, @sFormula
    END
  CLOSE c_rrl
  DEALLOCATE c_rrl

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPOSITORYCOLUMNS
  @code NVARCHAR( 30 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @tablename      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sysfunction    NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @tab            NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @ispopup        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @pkname         NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @fieldname      NVARCHAR( 60 )
  DECLARE @displayorder   NUMERIC( 6 )
  DECLARE @columnname     NVARCHAR( 60 )
  DECLARE @datatype       NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @maxorder       NUMERIC( 6 )
  DECLARE @cnt            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @isjspkeyfield  NVARCHAR( 1 )

  SET @maxorder = 0

  /* Get some repository header data. */
  SELECT @tablename   = ens_tablename, 
         @sysfunction = ISNULL( fun_application, fun_code ), 
         @tab         = ens_tab, 
         @ispopup     = ens_ispopup,
         @pkname      = constraint_name
  FROM   r5functions, r5iesrepositories
         LEFT OUTER JOIN information_schema.table_constraints 
              ON ( table_name collate Latin1_General_BIN = ens_tablename AND constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY' )
  WHERE  fun_code = ens_userfunction
  AND    ens_code = @code
  IF @tablename IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* First delete old/existing records. */
  DELETE FROM r5iesrepositorycolumns
  WHERE  enc_repositoryid = @code

  /* Loop through all columns of the current table. */
  DECLARE col CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT UPPER( column_name ),
           CASE data_type
                WHEN N'varchar'  THEN N'TEXT'
                WHEN N'nchar'    THEN N'TEXT'
                WHEN N'ntext'    THEN N'TEXT'
                WHEN N'nvarchar' THEN N'TEXT'
                WHEN N'datetime' THEN N'DATETIME'
                WHEN N'smallint' THEN N'INTEGER'
                WHEN N'int'      THEN N'INTEGER'
                WHEN N'bigint'   THEN N'INTEGER'
                WHEN N'real'     THEN N'LONG'
                WHEN N'float'    THEN N'LONG'
                WHEN N'numeric'  THEN CASE ISNULL( numeric_scale, 0 ) 
                                          WHEN 0 THEN N'LONG'
                                          ELSE N'DOUBLE'
                                     END 
                ELSE 'OTHER'
           END  data_type
    FROM   information_schema.columns
    WHERE  table_name = @tablename
    ORDER BY ordinal_position
  OPEN col
  FETCH NEXT FROM col INTO @columnname, @datatype
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Get the fieldname. */
      SET @fieldname = NULL
      SELECT @fieldname = pld_elementid 
      FROM   r5defaultpagelayout 
      WHERE  pld_ddtablename = @tablename
      AND    pld_ddfieldname = @columnname
      AND    pld_pagename    = CASE WHEN @tab IS NULL THEN @sysfunction ELSE @sysfunction + N'_' + @tab END

      /* Get the display order. */
      SET @displayorder = NULL
      SELECT @displayorder = ordinal_position
      FROM   information_schema.key_column_usage
      WHERE  constraint_name = @pkname
      AND    column_name     = @columnname

      IF @displayorder > @maxorder
        SET @maxorder = @displayorder

      /* Does the field exist in table r5urlparameters. */
      SET @isjspkeyfield = N'-'
      IF @fieldname IS NOT NULL AND @ispopup <> N'+' AND @tab IS NULL
        BEGIN
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
          FROM   r5urlparameters
          WHERE  url_userfunction  = @sysfunction
          AND    url_tab           = N'HDR' 
          AND    url_parametername = @fieldname
          IF @cnt > 0
            SET @isjspkeyfield = N'+'
        END
      
      /* Do the actual insert. */
      INSERT INTO r5iesrepositorycolumns( enc_repositoryid, enc_columnname, enc_fieldname, enc_alias, enc_datatype, 
             enc_displayorder, enc_facet, enc_updatecount, enc_pkorder, enc_isjspkeyfield )
      VALUES( @code, @columnname, @fieldname, NULL, @datatype,
              @displayorder, NULL, 0, @displayorder, @isjspkeyfield )

      FETCH NEXT FROM col INTO @columnname, @datatype
    END 
  CLOSE col
  DEALLOCATE col

  /* Loop through all columns that need a default order. */
  DECLARE enc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT enc_columnname
    FROM   r5iesrepositorycolumns
    WHERE  enc_repositoryid = @code
    AND    enc_displayorder IS NULL
    AND    SUBSTRING( enc_columnname, 4, 100 ) IN ( N'_DESC', N'_STATUS', N'_ORG' )
    ORDER BY CASE SUBSTRING( enc_columnname, 4, 100 ) WHEN N'_DESC' THEN 1 WHEN N'_STATUS' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
  OPEN enc
  FETCH NEXT FROM enc INTO @columnname
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @maxorder = @maxorder + 1
      UPDATE r5iesrepositorycolumns
      SET    enc_displayorder = @maxorder
      WHERE  enc_repositoryid = @code
      AND    enc_columnname   = @columnname
      FETCH NEXT FROM enc INTO @columnname
    END
  CLOSE enc
  DEALLOCATE enc

  /* Loop through all isjspkeyfield columns that need a default order. */
  DECLARE enc2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT enc_columnname
    FROM   r5iesrepositorycolumns
    WHERE  enc_repositoryid = @code
    AND    enc_displayorder IS NULL
    AND    enc_isjspkeyfield = N'+'
  OPEN enc2
  FETCH NEXT FROM enc2 INTO @columnname
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @maxorder = @maxorder + 1
      UPDATE r5iesrepositorycolumns
      SET    enc_displayorder = @maxorder
      WHERE  enc_repositoryid = @code
      AND    enc_columnname   = @columnname
      FETCH NEXT FROM enc2 INTO @columnname
    END
  CLOSE enc2
  DEALLOCATE enc2
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPOZEGHG_CO2EMISSION (
 @sCommodity NVARCHAR(15),
 @sObject NVARCHAR(30),
 @sObjectorg NVARCHAR(15),
 @sStartdate NVARCHAR(10) )

RETURNS @tEmissions TABLE (
  cce_date DATETIME,
  cce_object NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
  cce_object_org NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
  cce_commodity NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
  cce_type NVARCHAR(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL, 
  cce_ghg NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
  cce_co2emission NUMERIC(26,4) ) AS 

BEGIN

 DECLARE @sGHG NVARCHAR(30)
 
 DECLARE cGHG CURSOR LOCAL FOR
 SELECT ghg_code FROM r5greenhousegases

 OPEN cGHG
 FETCH NEXT FROM cGHG INTO @sGHG
 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
 BEGIN
 	INSERT INTO @tEmissions
 	SELECT 
		utr_date, utr_object, utr_object_org, utr_commodity, N'UB' utr_type, @sGHG,
	   	SUM( DBO.O7REPGETGHGFUELMIX( utr_supplier, utr_supplier_org, utr_commodity, utr_date, @sGHG ) * utr_avgconsumption ) 
	   		/ SUM( utr_avgconsumption ) co2_emission
	FROM   
		r5utilityrates
	WHERE  
		utr_calculatedaverage = N'-'
 		AND (@sCommodity = N'%' OR utr_commodity LIKE @sCommodity)
 		AND (@sObject = N'%' OR utr_object LIKE @sObject)
 		AND (@sObjectorg = N'%' OR utr_object_org LIKE @sObjectorg)
 		AND (@sStartdate = N'%' OR CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),utr_date,120) >= @sStartdate)
 		AND utr_date <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( NULL ), N'DD')
	GROUP BY 
		utr_date, utr_object, utr_object_org, utr_commodity
		
		
	INSERT INTO @tEmissions
	SELECT 
		dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( fli_date, N'DD') fli_date, fli_vehicle, fli_vehicle_org, fli_commodity, N'F' fli_type, @sGHG,
	        SUM( fli_qty * dbo.o7getuomconv( cmd_uom, fue_uom ) * 
	                DBO.O7REPGETGHGFUELMIX( NULL, NULL, fli_commodity, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( fli_date, N'DD' ), @sGHG  ) ) /
	           SUM( fli_qty * dbo.o7getuomconv( cmd_uom, fue_uom ) ) co2_emission 
	FROM   
		r5fuels, r5commodities, r5fuelissues
	WHERE  
	    	fli_fuel = fue_code
	    	AND fue_commodity = cmd_code
	    	AND cmd_uom IS NOT NULL
	    	AND fli_commodity IS NOT NULL
		AND (@sCommodity = N'%' OR fli_commodity LIKE @sCommodity)
		AND (@sObject = N'%' OR fli_vehicle LIKE @sObject)
		AND (@sObjectorg = N'%' OR fli_vehicle_org LIKE @sObjectorg)
		AND (@sStartdate = N'%' OR CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),fli_date,120) >= @sStartdate)
		AND fli_date <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( NULL ), N'DD')	    	
    	GROUP BY 
    		dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( fli_date, N'DD'), fli_vehicle, fli_vehicle_org, fli_commodity
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cGHG INTO @sGHG
 END
 CLOSE cGHG
 DEALLOCATE cGHG

 RETURN

END

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPOZEGHG_CO2EMISSION (
 @sCommodity NVARCHAR(15),
 @sObject NVARCHAR(30),
 @sObjectorg NVARCHAR(15),
 @sStartdate NVARCHAR(10) )

RETURNS @tEmissions TABLE (
  cce_date DATETIME,
  cce_object NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
  cce_object_org NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,

  cce_ghg NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,

BEGIN

 DECLARE @sGHG NVARCHAR(30)

 SELECT ghg_code FROM r5greenhousegases

 OPEN cGHG
 FETCH NEXT FROM cGHG INTO @sGHG

 	INSERT INTO @tEmissions

	FROM

 		AND (@sCommodity = N'%' OR utr_commodity LIKE @sCommodity)

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPOZEQPL_BYDTEQ ( 
            @R5_FUNC          NVARCHAR(6)
          , @R5_LANG          NVARCHAR(2)
          , @R5_ORG           NVARCHAR(15)
          , @R5_USER          NVARCHAR(255)
          , @SEL_ORGANIZATION NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_DEPARTMENT   NVARCHAR(15)
          , @SEL_EQUIPMENT    NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO   NVARCHAR(15)
          , @SEL_PM           NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_MP           NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_REPORTDATE   NVARCHAR(30)
          , @sCurrUser        NVARCHAR(255)
          , @r5role           NVARCHAR(30)
          )
AS
BEGIN       
    DECLARE @dtSysdateNoTime DATE, @dtReportDate DATE, @sColorCode NVARCHAR(255) 

    SELECT @dtSysdateNoTime = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GETDATE(), 'DD')
        , @dtReportDate = dbo.TO_DATE(@SEL_REPORTDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
        , @sColorCode = dbo.O7REPOZEQPL_GETCOLOR(@SEL_ORGANIZATION, @SEL_EQUIPMENT, @SEL_DEPARTMENT,
                                                 @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO, @SEL_PM, @SEL_MP, @dtReportDate)
    FROM DUAL
    WHERE 1 = 1;
                                                 ;                
    SELECT DISTINCT drvd.OBJ_CODE
        , drvd.OBJ_ORG
        , dbo.REPGETDESC(@R5_LANG, 'OBJ', drvd.obj_code + '#' + drvd.obj_org, NULL, NULL) AS OBJ_DESC
        , drvd.WO_CODE
        , drvd.WO_DESC
        , drvd.WO_STATUS
        , dbo.repgetdesc('EN', N'UCOD', drvd.WO_STATUS, 'EVST', null) AS WO_STATUS_DESC
        , drvd.MAINTCODE
        , CAST(drvd.MAINTTYPE AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS MAINTTYPE
        , drvd.MAINTREV AS MAINTREVNUM
        , dbo.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@R5_USER, @R5_ORG, @dtReportDate) AS REPORTDATEFMT
        , dbo.REPFMTWHOLENUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, @R5_ORG, drvd.MAINTREV) AS MAINTREVFMT
        , drvd.MAINTDESC                 

    FROM (
        SELECT obj.OBJ_CODE, obj.OBJ_ORG, evt.evt_code AS WO_CODE, evt.evt_DESC AS WO_DESC, evt.evt_status AS WO_STATUS
            , evt.evt_mp AS MAINTCODE, 'NM'AS MAINTTYPE, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(4, 0)) AS MAINTREV, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS MAINTDESC
        FROM R5objects obj
        INNER JOIN R5EVENTS evt
            ON obj.obj_code = evt.evt_object
            AND obj.obj_org = evt.evt_object_org
        WHERE obj.obj_code = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
            AND obj.obj_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
            AND evt.evt_TARGET = @dtReportDate
            AND evt.evt_MP IS NULL 
            AND evt.evt_PPM IS NULL 
            AND evt.evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'B', 'R')
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_MRC, obj.obj_mrc, '%') LIKE @SEL_DEPARTMENT
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_person, obj.obj_person, '%') LIKE @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO
            AND @SEL_MP = '%'
            AND @SEL_PM = '%'
            AND CHARINDEX('NM;', @sColorCode) > 0
        UNION ALL

        SELECT obj.obj_code, obj.obj_org, evt.evt_code AS WO_CODE, evt.evt_DESC AS WO_DESC, evt.evt_status AS WO_STATUS
            , evt.evt_ppm AS MAINTCODE, 'PM'AS MAINTTYPE, pm.ppm_revision AS MAINTREV, PPM_DESC AS MAINTDESC
        FROM R5objects obj
        INNER JOIN R5EVENTS evt
            ON obj.obj_code = evt.evt_object
            AND obj.obj_org = evt.evt_object_org
        INNER JOIN R5PPMS pm
            ON evt.evt_ppm = pm.ppm_code
            AND evt.evt_org = pm.ppm_org
            AND pm.ppm_revrstatus = N'A'
        WHERE obj.obj_code = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
            AND obj.obj_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
            AND evt.evt_TARGET = @dtReportDate
            AND evt.evt_MP IS NULL 
            AND evt.evt_PPM IS NOT NULL 
            AND evt.evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'B', 'R')
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_MRC, obj.obj_mrc, '%') LIKE @SEL_DEPARTMENT
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_person, obj.obj_person, '%') LIKE @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO
            AND @SEL_MP = '%'
            AND evt.evt_PPM LIKE @SEL_PM
            AND CHARINDEX('PM;', @sColorCode) > 0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT obj.obj_code, obj.obj_org, evt.evt_code AS WO_CODE, evt.evt_DESC AS WO_DESC, evt.evt_status AS WO_STATUS
            , evt.evt_mp AS MAINTCODE, 'MP'AS MAINTTYPE, mp.MTP_REVISION AS MAINTREV
            , (SELECT psq.PSQ_WODESC
               FROM R5PATTERNSEQUENCES psq
               WHERE psq.psq_mp = mp.mtp_code
                   AND psq.psq_mp_org = mp.mtp_org
                   AND psq.psq_revision = mp.mtp_revision) AS MAINTDESC
        FROM R5objects obj
        INNER JOIN R5EVENTS evt
            ON obj.obj_code = evt.evt_object
            AND obj.obj_org = evt.evt_object_org
        INNER JOIN R5MAINTENANCEPATTERNS mp
            ON evt.evt_mp = mp.mtp_code
            AND evt.evt_org = mp.mtp_org
        WHERE obj.obj_code = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
            AND obj.obj_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
            AND evt.evt_TARGET = @dtReportDate
            AND evt.evt_MP IS NOT NULL 
            AND evt.evt_PPM IS NULL 
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_MRC, obj.obj_mrc, '%') LIKE @SEL_DEPARTMENT
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_person, obj.obj_person, '%') LIKE @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO
            AND evt.evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'B', 'R')
            AND @SEL_PM = '%'
            AND evt.evt_MP LIKE @SEL_MP
            AND CHARINDEX('MP;', @sColorCode) > 0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT obj.obj_code, obj.obj_org, NULL AS WO_CODE, NULL AS WO_DESC, NULL AS WO_STATUS
            , fpm.ppm_code AS MAINTCODE, 'FP'AS MAINTTYPE, fpm.ppm_revision AS MAINTREV, fpm.ppm_desc AS MAINTDESC
        FROM R5objects obj
        INNER JOIN R5ppms ppm
            ON ppm.ppm_org = obj.obj_org
            AND ppm.ppm_revrstatus = N'A'
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM R5ppmobjects pmobj
                WHERE pmobj.ppo_object = obj.obj_code
                    AND obj.obj_org = pmobj.ppo_object_org
                    AND pmobj.ppo_revision = ppm.ppm_revision)
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(drvd_d.ppm_code, drvd_m.ppm_code) AS ppm_code
                , CASE COALESCE(drvd_d.ppm_code, drvd_m.ppm_code)
                       WHEN drvd_d.ppm_code THEN drvd_d.ppm_revision
                       ELSE drvd_m.ppm_revision
                  END AS ppm_revision
                , CASE COALESCE(drvd_d.ppm_code, drvd_m.ppm_code)
                       WHEN drvd_d.ppm_code THEN drvd_d.ppm_desc
                       ELSE drvd_m.ppm_desc
                  END AS ppm_desc
                , CASE COALESCE(drvd_d.ppm_code, drvd_m.ppm_code)
                       WHEN drvd_d.ppm_code THEN drvd_d.ppm_org
                       ELSE drvd_m.ppm_org
                  END AS ppm_org
            FROM DUAL 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT 'X' AS SCHEDEXISTS, ppm.ppm_code, ppm.ppm_org, ppm.ppm_desc, ppo.ppo_due, ppm.ppm_revision
                    , dbo.O7GTFREQ(ppm.ppm_freq, ppm.ppm_perioduom, @dtSysdateNoTime) AS EVERYNDAYS 
                    , DATEADD(d, dbo.O7GTFREQ(ppm.ppm_freq, ppm.ppm_perioduom, @dtSysdateNoTime), ppo.ppo_due) AS NEXTDUE
                FROM R5PPMOBJECTS ppo
                INNER JOIN r5PPMS ppm
                    ON ppo.ppo_ppm = ppm.ppm_code
                    AND ppo.ppo_org = ppm.ppm_org
                    AND ppo.ppo_revision = ppm.ppm_revision
                    AND ppm.ppm_revrstatus = N'A'
                WHERE ppo.ppo_object = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
                    AND ppo.ppo_object_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
                    AND ppo.ppo_deactive IS NULL
                    AND ppo.ppo_isstype IN ( 'D', 'V', 'F' )
                    AND NOT (COALESCE(ppm.ppm_class,'x') = 'TPM' AND ppo.ppo_isstype = 'D')
                    AND (ppo.ppo_freq IS NOT NULL AND ppo.ppo_perioduom IS NOT NULL)
                    AND ppm.ppm_CODE LIKE @SEL_PM

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPOZEQPL_GETCOLOR(
       @SEL_ORGANIZATION   NVARCHAR(15)
     , @SEL_EQUIPMENT      NVARCHAR(30)
     , @SEL_DEPARTMENT     NVARCHAR(15)
     , @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO     NVARCHAR(15)
     , @SEL_PM             NVARCHAR(30)
     , @SEL_MP             NVARCHAR(30)
     , @SEL_REPORTDATE     DATE)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(255) 
AS

BEGIN

    DECLARE @dtSysdateNoTime DATE, @iCount INTEGER, @iCount2 INTEGER
        , @iCountTypes INTEGER, @iTotalWOCount INTEGER, @sColorType NVARCHAR(255)
        , @sTypesFound NVARCHAR(10);
    
    SELECT @dtSysdateNoTime = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GETDATE(), 'DD')
        , @iCount = 0, @iCount2 = 0, @iCountTypes = 0, @iTotalWOCount = 0
        , @sColorType = 'NO_COLOR', @sTypesFound = ';'
    FROM DUAL
    WHERE 1 = 1;
 
 
    SELECT @iCount = COALESCE(drvd.WOCOUNT, 0)
    FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(*) AS WOCOUNT
          FROM R5EVENTS evt
          INNER JOIN R5objects obj
              ON evt.evt_object = obj.obj_code
              AND evt.evt_object_org = obj.obj_org
          WHERE evt.evt_object = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
              AND evt.evt_object_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
              AND evt.evt_MP IS NULL 
              AND evt.evt_PPM IS NULL 
              AND evt.evt_TARGET = @SEL_REPORTDATE
              AND evt.evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'B', 'R')
                AND COALESCE(evt.evt_MRC, obj.obj_mrc, '%') LIKE @SEL_DEPARTMENT
              AND COALESCE(evt.evt_person, obj.obj_person, '%') LIKE @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO
              AND @SEL_MP = '%'
              AND @SEL_PM = '%'
    ) drvd
    WHERE 1 = 1;
    
    
    IF @iCount > 0 
    BEGIN
      SET @sTypesFound = @sTypesFound + CAST(@iCount AS VARCHAR) + 'NM;';
      SET @iCountTypes = @iCountTypes + 1;
      SET @iTotalWOCount = @iTotalWOCount + @iCount;
      SET @sColorType = 'NM_COLOR';
      SET @iCount = 0;
    END;
                                   
    SELECT @iCount = COALESCE(drvd.WOCOUNT, 0)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS WOCOUNT
        FROM R5EVENTS evt
        INNER JOIN R5objects obj
            ON evt.evt_object = obj.obj_code
            AND evt.evt_object_org = obj.obj_org
        WHERE evt.evt_object = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
            AND evt.evt_object_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
            AND evt.evt_MP IS NULL 
            AND evt.evt_PPM IS NOT NULL 
            AND evt.evt_TARGET = @SEL_REPORTDATE
            AND evt.evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'B', 'R')
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_MRC, obj.obj_mrc, '%') LIKE @SEL_DEPARTMENT
            AND COALESCE(evt.evt_person, obj.obj_person, '%') LIKE @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO
            AND @SEL_MP = '%'
            AND evt.evt_PPM LIKE @SEL_PM
    ) drvd
    WHERE 1 = 1;
    
    IF @iCount > 0 
    BEGIN
        SET @sTypesFound = @sTypesFound + CAST(@iCount AS VARCHAR) + 'PM;';
        SET @iCountTypes = @iCountTypes + 1;
        SET @iTotalWOCount = @iTotalWOCount + @iCount;
        SET @sColorType = 'PM_COLOR';
        SET @iCount = 1; --setting this to one on purpose to only return a single type for PM's in case an FP is also found (see code below) 
    END
                               
    IF (@SEL_REPORTDATE > @dtSysdateNoTime) AND @SEL_MP = '%'   --check for FUTURE PM's
    BEGIN
        SELECT @iCount2 = COALESCE(drvd.WOCOUNT, 0)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(drvd_d.ppm_code, drvd_m.ppm_code)) AS WOCOUNT
            FROM DUAL 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT 'X' AS SCHEDEXISTS, ppm.ppm_code, ppm_org, ppm_desc, ppo.ppo_due
                         , dbo.O7GTFREQ(ppm.ppm_freq, ppm.ppm_perioduom, @dtSysdateNoTime) AS EVERYNDAYS 
                         , DATEADD(d, dbo.O7GTFREQ(ppm.ppm_freq, ppm.ppm_perioduom, @dtSysdateNoTime), ppo.ppo_due) AS NEXTDUE
                FROM R5PPMOBJECTS ppo
                    INNER JOIN r5PPMS ppm
                         ON ppo.ppo_ppm = ppm.ppm_code
                         AND ppo.ppo_org = ppm.ppm_org
                    WHERE ppo.ppo_object = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
                         AND ppo.ppo_object_org = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
                         AND ppo.ppo_deactive IS NULL
                         AND ppo.ppo_isstype IN ( 'D', 'V', 'F' )
                         AND NOT (COALESCE(ppm.ppm_class,'x') = 'TPM' AND ppo.ppo_isstype = 'D')
                         AND (ppo.ppo_freq IS NOT NULL
                                   AND ppo.ppo_perioduom IS NOT NULL)
                         AND ppm.ppm_CODE LIKE @SEL_PM
                         AND ((@SEL_DEPARTMENT = '%' AND @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO = '%') OR EXISTS (
                                   SELECT 1 
                                   FROM R5OBJECTS
                                   WHERE obj_code = @SEL_EQUIPMENT
                                        AND OBJ_ORG = @SEL_ORGANIZATION
                                        AND COALESCE(OBJ_MRC, '%') LIKE @SEL_DEPARTMENT
                                        AND COALESCE(OBJ_PERSON, '%') LIKE @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO))
                         AND NOT EXISTS(
                             SELECT 1
                             FROM R5EVENTS
                             WHERE evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'B', 'R')
                                 AND evt_ppm = ppm.ppm_code
                                 AND evt_org = ppm.ppm_org
                                 AND evt_target = @SEL_REPORTDATE)
               ) drvd_d
                    ON upper(DUMMY) = drvd_d.SCHEDEXISTS
                    AND ((drvd_d.ppo_due = @SEL_REPORTDATE)
                         OR (drvd_d.NEXTDUE = @SEL_REPORTDATE)
                         OR 0 = (DATEDIFF(d, drvd_d.NEXTDUE, @SEL_REPORTDATE) % drvd_d.EVERYNDAYS))
               LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT 'X' AS SCHEDEXISTS, ppm.ppm_code, ppm.ppm_org, ppm.ppm_desc, ppo.ppo_meterdue
                         , ppo.ppo_meter / COALESCE(oud.OUD_CALCDAILYUSG, oud.OUD_DFLTDAILYUSG, 1) AS EVERYNDAYS
                         , CASE 
						WHEN COALESCE(dbo.O7GTLASTREAD(@SEL_EQUIPMENT, @SEL_ORGANIZATION, ppo.ppo_metuom), 0) > COALESCE(ppo.ppo_meterdue, 0) 
							THEN DATEADD(d
									, (COALESCE(ppo.ppo_meterdue, 0) - COALESCE(dbo.O7GTLASTREAD(@SEL_EQUIPMENT, @SEL_ORGANIZATION, ppo.ppo_metuom), 0))
										/COALESCE(oud.OUD_CALCDAILYUSG, oud.OUD_DFLTDAILYUSG, 1)
									, @dtSysdateNoTime)                                                                                          
						WHEN COALESCE(ppo.ppo_meterdue, 0) < dbo.O7GTLASTREAD(@SEL_EQUIPMENT, @SEL_ORGANIZATION, ppo.ppo_metuom) 
                                    THEN @dtSysdateNoTime
                              ELSE @dtSysdateNoTime
                           END AS NEXTDUE
                         , dbo.O7GTLASTREAD(ppo.ppo_object, ppo.ppo_object_org, ppo.ppo_metuom) AS LASTREADING
                    FROM R5PPMOBJECTS ppo

name: O7REPOZEQPL_OZEQPL

body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPOZEQPL_OZEQPL ( 
            @R5_FUNC          NVARCHAR(6)
          , @R5_LANG          NVARCHAR(2)
          , @R5_ORG           NVARCHAR(15)
          , @R5_USER          NVARCHAR(255)
          , @SEL_ORGANIZATION NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_DEPARTMENT   NVARCHAR(15)
          , @SEL_EQUIPMENT    NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO   NVARCHAR(15)
          , @SEL_PM           NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_MP           NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_START        NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_END          NVARCHAR(30)
          , @sCurrUser        NVARCHAR(255)
          , @r5role           NVARCHAR(30)
          )
AS
BEGIN       

    DECLARE @dtStart DATE, @dtEnd DATE; 
	declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'
    
    SELECT @dtStart = dbo.TO_DATE(@SEL_START, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), @dtEnd = dbo.TO_DATE(@SEL_END, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    FROM DUAL
    WHERE 1 = 1;

    WITH NbrReportDates AS (
        SELECT 0 as Nbr
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Nbr+1
        FROM NbrReportDates
        WHERE Nbr < datediff(d, @dtStart, @dtEnd)
        )
    
    SELECT drvd2.REPORTDATE
        , drvd2.REPORTDOW
        , drvd2.OBJ_CODE
        , drvd2.OBJ_ORG
        , drvd2.COLORCODE
        , drvd2.REPORTDATEFMT
        , drvd2.REPORTDATE_RPTFMT
    FROM (
        SELECT drvd.REPORTDATE
            , CAST(drvd.REPORTDOW AS VARCHAR(3)) AS REPORTDOW
            , drvd.OBJ_CODE
            , drvd.OBJ_ORG
            , drvd.COLORCODE
            , dbo.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@R5_USER, @R5_ORG, drvd.REPORTDATE) AS REPORTDATEFMT
            , dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(drvd.REPORTDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS REPORTDATE_RPTFMT
            , MIN(COLORCODE) OVER (PARTITION BY drvd.OBJ_ORG, drvd.OBJ_CODE) AS MINCOLORCODE
            , MAX(COLORCODE) OVER (PARTITION BY drvd.OBJ_ORG, drvd.OBJ_CODE) AS MAXCOLORCODE
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT rptdts.REPORTDATE
                , UPPER(LEFT(DATENAME(dw, REPORTDATE), 3)) AS REPORTDOW
                , obj.OBJ_CODE
                , obj.OBJ_ORG
                , dbo.O7REPOZEQPL_GETCOLOR(obj.obj_org, obj.obj_code, @SEL_DEPARTMENT, @SEL_ASSIGNEDTO, @SEL_PM, @SEL_MP, rptdts.REPORTDATE) AS COLORCODE
            FROM (
                SELECT DATEADD(d, Nbr, @dtStart) AS REPORTDATE
                FROM NbrReportDates
            ) rptdts
            INNER JOIN r5objects obj
                ON obj.obj_ORG LIKE @SEL_ORGANIZATION
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT e.evt_object AS obj_code, e.evt_object_org AS obj_org
                FROM R5EVENTS e
                WHERE e.evt_rstatus = 'R'
                    AND e.evt_target BETWEEN @dtStart AND @dtEnd                    
                UNION ALL
                SELECT DISTINCT ppo_object  AS obj_code, ppo_object_org AS obj_org
                FROM R5PPMOBJECTS ppo
                INNER JOIN r5PPMS ppm
                    ON ppo.ppo_ppm = ppm.ppm_code
                    AND ppo.ppo_org = ppm.ppm_org
                WHERE ppo.ppo_deactive IS NULL
                    AND ppo.ppo_isstype IN ( 'D', 'V', 'F' )
                    AND ((ppo.ppo_metuom IS NOT NULL
                        AND ppo.ppo_meter IS NOT NULL
                        AND ppo.ppo_meterdue IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (ppo.ppo_freq IS NOT NULL
                        AND ppo.ppo_perioduom IS NOT NULL))
                    AND NOT (COALESCE(ppm.ppm_class,'x') = 'TPM' AND ppo.ppo_isstype = 'D')    
                UNION ALL
                SELECT DISTINCT peq_object AS obj_code, peq_object_org AS obj_org
                FROM R5patternequipment peq
                INNER JOIN r5maintenancepatterns mtp
                    ON peq.peq_mp = mtp.mtp_code
                    AND peq.peq_mp_org = mtp.mtp_org
                INNER JOIN r5patternsequences psq
                    ON mtp.mtp_code = psq.psq_mp
                    AND mtp.mtp_org = psq.psq_mp_org 
                    AND mtp.mtp_revision = psq.psq_revision
                WHERE peq.peq_deactive IS NULL
                    AND psq.psq_notused = '-'
                    AND ((mtp.mtp_metuom IS NOT NULL
                        AND psq.psq_meter IS NOT NULL
                        AND EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM r5events e_mp
                            WHERE e_mp.evt_object = peq.peq_object
                                AND e_mp.evt_object_org = peq.peq_object_org
                                AND e_mp.evt_mp = peq.peq_mp
                                AND e_mp.evt_rstatus IN ('A', 'R'))
                     )
                     OR (psq.psq_freq IS NOT NULL
                            AND psq.psq_perioduom IS NOT NULL))
            ) eqp
                ON obj.obj_code = eqp.obj_code
                AND obj.obj_org = eqp.obj_org                      
            WHERE obj.obj_code LIKE @SEL_EQUIPMENT  
		    AND ( ( @deptsec  = N'ON' 
			AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = @R5_USER   
					AND dse_mrc = (SELECT dep.obj_mrc FROM r5objects dep WHERE dep.obj_code = obj.obj_code AND dep.obj_org = obj.obj_org ) ) )
			OR	( @deptsec  = N'OFF'))			
        ) drvd
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM R5USERORGANIZATION uog
            INNER JOIN R5PERMISSIONS prm
                ON uog.uog_group = prm.prm_group
                AND prm.prm_function = @R5_FUNC
                AND prm.prm_select = '?'
            WHERE uog.uog_user = @R5_USER
            AND uog.uog_role = @r5role
            AND uog.uog_org = drvd.OBJ_ORG
        )
    )drvd2
    WHERE NOT (MINCOLORCODE = 'NO_COLOR;0;' AND MAXCOLORCODE = 'NO_COLOR;0;')
    AND @R5_USER = UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
    ORDER BY 4, 3, 1;
  
END

body:
create procedure dbo.O7REPOZRCMS_OZRCMS (
            @R5_FUNC NVARCHAR(6)
          , @R5_LANG NVARCHAR(2)
          , @R5_USER NVARCHAR(255)
          , @SEL_ORGANIZATION NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_PROJECT NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_MAXRISKLEVEL NVARCHAR(6)
          , @SEL_EQUIPMENT NVARCHAR(30)
          , @SEL_YEARSINAVG NVARCHAR(9)
          , @SEL_INCLCHILDREN NVARCHAR(1)
          , @sCurrUser NVARCHAR( 255 )
          , @r5role NVARCHAR(30)
) as
BEGIN
	declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'

     SELECT drvd2.OBJ_CODE AS EQUIP_CODE
          , drvd2.OBJ_ORG AS EQUIP_ORG
          , dbo.REPGETDESC(@R5_LANG, 'OBJ', drvd2.obj_code + '#' + drvd2.obj_org, NULL, NULL) AS EQUIP_DESC 
          , drvd2.OBJ_RISKLEVEL AS RISKLEVEL
          , drvd2.OBJ_RCMLEVEL AS RCMLEVEL
          , CASE drvd2.MAINTTYPE WHEN 'PPM' THEN drvd2.MAINTCODE ELSE NULL END AS WO_PPM
          , CASE drvd2.MAINTTYPE WHEN 'MTP' THEN drvd2.MAINTCODE ELSE NULL END AS WO_MP
          , drvd2.MAINTDESC AS WO_DESC
          , dbo.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, drvd2.OBJ_ORG, drvd2.ESTYRLYCOST_NUM) AS TOTALESTIMATEDYRLY
          , dbo.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, drvd2.OBJ_ORG, drvd2.TOTALACTUALYRLY_NUM) AS TOTALACTUALYRLY
          , dbo.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, drvd2.OBJ_ORG, SUM(COALESCE(drvd2.ESTYRLYCOST_NUM, 0)) 
               OVER (PARTITION BY drvd2.OBJ_ORG, drvd2.OBJ_CODE, drvd2.OBJ_RISKLEVEL, drvd2.OBJ_RCMLEVEL)) AS OBJTOTALESTIMATEDYRLY
          , dbo.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, drvd2.OBJ_ORG, SUM(COALESCE(drvd2.TOTALACTUALYRLY_NUM, 0)) 
               OVER (PARTITION BY drvd2.OBJ_ORG, drvd2.OBJ_CODE, drvd2.OBJ_RISKLEVEL, drvd2.OBJ_RCMLEVEL)) AS OBJTOTALACTUALYRLY
     FROM (
          SELECT drvd.OBJ_CODE
              , drvd.OBJ_ORG
              , o.OBJ_RISKLEVEL
              , o.OBJ_RCMLEVEL
              , drvd.MAINTTYPE
              , drvd.MAINTCODE
              , drvd.MAINTDESC
              , drvd.MAINTORG
              , SUM(COALESCE(drvd.ACTIVITY_ESTLABRCOST * NBRPPMSPERYEAR, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(drvd.ACTIVITY_ESTMATLCOST * NBRPPMSPERYEAR, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(drvd.ACTIVITY_ESTTOOLCOST * NBRPPMSPERYEAR, 0)) AS ESTYRLYCOST_NUM
              , SUM(COALESCE(evt.ACTMAT, 0) + COALESCE(evt.ACTLAB, 0) + COALESCE(evt.ACTTOOL, 0)) / CASE WHEN MAX(evt.YEARSAGOCOMPLETED)< 1 THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(MAX(evt.YEARSAGOCOMPLETED), 1) END AS TOTALACTUALYRLY_NUM
          FROM (
               SELECT drv.OBJ_CODE
                    , drv.OBJ_ORG
                    , drv.MAINTTYPE
                    , drv.MAINTCODE
                    , drv.MAINTDESC
                    , drv.MAINTORG
                    , drv.ACTIVITY_LINE
                    , COALESCE(drv.ACTIVITY_EST, 0) * COALESCE(trr.trr_NTRATE, 0) AS ACTIVITY_ESTLABRCOST
                    , COALESCE(
					(SELECT SUM(mat.ACTIVITY_PARTESTCOST) AS ACTMATESTCOST
					FROM (
						SELECT COALESCE(dbo.o7getprc(COALESCE(pp.sto_store,c.mrc_store, '*'), mlp.mlp_part, mlp.mlp_part_org, mtl.mtl_org, 'B', i_pl.ins_desc, org.org_common), 0) AS ACTIVITY_PARTESTCOST
						FROM R5MATLISTS mtl
						LEFT OUTER JOIN R5MATLPARTS mlp
							ON mtl.mtl_code = mlp.mlp_matlist
							AND mtl.mtl_revision = mlp.mlp_matlrev
						LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock pp
							ON mlp.mlp_part = pp.sto_part
							AND mlp.mlp_part_org = pp.sto_part_org
						WHERE mtl.mtl_code = drv.ACTIVITY_MATLIST 
							AND mtl.mtl_org = drv.MAINTORG
							AND mtl.mtl_revrstatus = 'A'
					) mat
					), 0) AS ACTIVITY_ESTMATLCOST
                    , COALESCE(
                         (SELECT SUM( COALESCE(ppt_hours, 0) * COALESCE(ppt_qty, 0) * COALESCE(mrt_tariff, 0) )
                         FROM r5organization, r5tools, r5mrctools, r5ppmtools
                         WHERE too_code = ppt_tool
								AND org_code = too_org
								AND mrt_mrc = drv.MAINTMRC
								AND mrt_tool = ppt_tool
								AND mrt_org = drv.MAINTORG
								AND ppt_ppm       = drv.MAINTCODE
								AND ppt_revision  = drv.MAINTREV
								AND ppt_act       = drv.ACTIVITY_LINE
								AND  ( too_org = drv.MAINTORG OR org_common = N'+' ))
                         , 0) AS ACTIVITY_ESTTOOLCOST
                    , ROUND(CASE COALESCE(EVERYNDAYS_METER1, EVERYNDAYS_METER2, EVERYNDAYS_DATEPPMS) 
                              WHEN NULL THEN 1
                              WHEN EVERYNDAYS_DATEPPMS THEN 365.00 / EVERYNDAYS_DATEPPMS 
                              WHEN EVERYNDAYS_METER2 THEN 365.00 / dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER_SHORT(EVERYNDAYS_METER2, COALESCE(EVERYNDAYS_DATEPPMS, 365)) 
                              WHEN EVERYNDAYS_METER1 THEN 365.00 / dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER_SHORT(EVERYNDAYS_METER1,  dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER_SHORT(COALESCE(EVERYNDAYS_METER2, 365), COALESCE(EVERYNDAYS_DATEPPMS, 365))) 
                         ELSE 1
                         END, 0) AS NBRPPMSPERYEAR
               FROM (
                    SELECT o.obj_code
                         , o.obj_org
                         , ppm.ppm_code AS MAINTCODE
                         , ppa.ppa_act AS ACTIVITY_LINE
                         , ppm.ppm_desc AS MAINTDESC
                         , 'PPM' AS MAINTTYPE
                         , ppm.ppm_org AS MAINTORG
                         , ppm.ppm_revision AS MAINTREV
                         , COALESCE(ppo.ppo_mrc, o.obj_pmwodept, o.obj_mrc) AS MAINTMRC
                         , COALESCE(ppo.ppo_meter, ppm.ppm_meter) / COALESCE(oud.OUD_CALCDAILYUSG, oud.OUD_DFLTDAILYUSG, 1) as EVERYNDAYS_METER1
                         , COALESCE(ppo.ppo_meter2, ppm.ppm_meter2) / COALESCE(oud2.OUD_CALCDAILYUSG, oud2.OUD_DFLTDAILYUSG, 1) as EVERYNDAYS_METER2
                         , COALESCE(dbo.O7GTFREQ(ppo.ppo_freq, ppo.ppo_perioduom, GETDATE()), 365) AS EVERYNDAYS_DATEPPMS
                         , ppa.ppa_trade AS ACTIVITY_TRADE
                         , COALESCE(ppa.ppa_est, 0) AS ACTIVITY_EST
                         , ppa.ppa_matlist AS ACTIVITY_MATLIST
                         , COALESCE(ppt.ppt_hours, 0) AS TOOL_HOURS
                         , COALESCE(ppt.ppt_qty, 0) AS TOOL_QTY
                         , ppt.ppt_tool AS ACTIVITY_TOOL
                         , ppa.ppa_task AS ACTIVITY_TASK
                    FROM R5ppms ppm
                    INNER JOIN R5ppmacts ppa
                         ON ppm.ppm_code = ppa.ppa_ppm
                         AND ppm.ppm_revision = ppa.ppa_revision
                    INNER JOIN r5ppmobjects ppo
                         ON ppm.ppm_code = ppo.ppo_ppm
                         AND ppm.ppm_revision = ppo.ppo_revision
                    INNER JOIN r5objects o
                         ON ppo.ppo_object = o.obj_code
                         AND ppo.ppo_object_org = o.obj_org
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs oud
                         ON o.obj_code = oud.oud_object
                         AND o.obj_org = oud.oud_object_org
                         AND ppo.ppo_metuom = oud.oud_uom
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs oud2
                         ON o.obj_code = oud.oud_object
                         AND o.obj_org = oud.oud_object_org
                         AND ppo.ppo_metuom2 = oud.oud_uom 
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppmtools ppt
                         ON ppm.ppm_code = ppt.ppt_ppm
                         AND ppm.ppm_revision = ppt.ppt_revision
                         AND ppa.ppa_act = ppt.ppt_act
                    WHERE ppm.ppm_revrstatus = 'A'
                         AND COALESCE(ppm.ppm_notused, '-') = '-'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT o.obj_code
                         , o.obj_org
                         , mtp.mtp_code AS MAINTCODE
                         , swa.wac_act AS ACTIVITY_LINE
                         , mtp.mtp_desc AS MAINTDESC
                         , 'MTP' AS MAINTTYPE

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPOZRMSO_ASSETCOUNT(
      @project NVARCHAR(8),
      @consequencecategory NVARCHAR(30),
      @probability NVARCHAR(30),
      @consequence NVARCHAR(30),
      @equipment NVARCHAR(30),
      @equipmentorg NVARCHAR(15),
      @includechildren NVARCHAR(1),
      @r5user NVARCHAR(255),
      @r5func NVARCHAR(6),
      @r5role NVARCHAR(30) )
RETURNS NUMERIC
AS

BEGIN
   DECLARE @nReturn NUMERIC(5);

   SELECT 
      @nReturn = COUNT(*)
   FROM
      r5equipfunctionlevels ff, r5equipfunctionlevels fc, r5objects o
   WHERE 
      ff.efl_code = fc.efl_parent
      AND o.obj_code = ff.efl_object
      AND o.obj_org = ff.efl_object_org
      AND ff.efl_leveltype = N'FUNF'
      AND fc.efl_leveltype = N'FUNC'
      AND ff.efl_project = @project
      AND ff.efl_probability = @probability
      AND fc.efl_consequence = @consequence
      AND fc.efl_consequencecategory = @consequencecategory
      AND ((@equipment = N'%' AND @equipmentorg = N'%') OR 
            ((ff.efl_object + N'#' + ff.efl_object_org) IN 
                           (
                              SELECT stc_child + N'#' + stc_child_org 
                              FROM dbo.O7REPEQUIPMENTHIER(@equipment,@equipmentorg,NULL,NULL)
                              WHERE @includechildren = N'+'
                              -- stop wildcards
                              AND CHARINDEX(N'%',@equipment) = 0
                              AND CHARINDEX(N'%',@equipmentorg) = 0
                              AND CHARINDEX(N'_',@equipment) = 0
                              AND CHARINDEX(N'_',@equipmentorg) = 0
                              UNION 
                              SELECT obj_code + N'#' + obj_org
                              FROM r5objects
                              WHERE
                              NOT(@equipment = N'%' AND @equipmentorg = N'%')
                              AND obj_code LIKE @equipment
                              AND obj_org LIKE @equipmentorg)))
      AND EXISTS (   
            SELECT 'X' 
            FROM 
               r5userorganization u, r5permissions p
            WHERE 
               u.uog_group = p.prm_group
               AND u.uog_org = ff.efl_object_org
               AND u.uog_user = @r5user
               AND u.uog_role = @r5role
               AND p.prm_function = @r5func
               AND p.prm_select = N'?')
      AND ( ( UPPER(dbo.o7cv_getinstallparam('DEPTSEC'))  = N'ON'
                        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 
                                 FROM    r5departmentsecurity
                                 WHERE dse_user =@r5user   AND dse_mrc = o.obj_mrc))
           OR
           ( UPPER(dbo.o7cv_getinstallparam('DEPTSEC'))  = N'OFF'))

  
  RETURN @nReturn
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPOZRMSO_MATRIXCELLHEXCOLOR ( @severitythreshold NUMERIC, @project NVARCHAR(8))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(6)

BEGIN
   DECLARE @sReturn NVARCHAR(6)

   FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rms_threshold DESC, rms_code) rms_rank, rms_color FROM r5riskmatrixsetup WHERE rms_type = N'RISK' AND rms_threshold <= @severitythreshold AND rms_project = @project) c WHERE c.rms_rank = 1

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[O7REPPZORDF_BARCODEDPOPARTREV] (@sPO nvarchar(30),       
                                                       @sORG nvarchar(15),
                                                       @sRevision nvarchar(4) )
RETURNS nvarchar(250) AS        
BEGIN

        DECLARE @sStr nvarchar(250)
        DECLARE @sFiller nvarchar(200)
        DECLARE @sBarcodeOption nvarchar(200)
        DECLARE @sBarSymb nvarchar(200)         
        
        set @sStr = ''  
        set @sBarcodeOption = dbo.o7dflt2(N'OPT_BARC') 
        
        if @@ERROR <> 0 
           RETURN @sStr
                
                                set @sFiller = dbo.o7dflt2(N'BARFILL') 
                                set @sBarSymb = dbo.o7dflt2(N'BARSYMB')                                 
                                
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                   return @sStr                            

                                IF @sBarSymb LIKE 'C128%' 
                                        BEGIN
                                                IF (@sRevision IS NOT NULL ) 
                                                        set @sStr = @sPO + @sFiller + @sORG + @sFiller + @sRevision
                                                ELSE
                                                        set @sStr = @sPO + @sFiller + @sORG

                                                set @sStr = dbo.IDAUTOMATION_CODE128(@sStr,0)
                                        END
                                ELSE
                                        BEGIN
                                                IF (@sRevision IS NOT NULL)      
                                                        set @sStr = @sPO + '/C' + @sORG + '/C' + @sRevision          
                                                ELSE
                                                        set @sStr = @sPO + '/C' + @sORG                                                                         

                                                set @sStr = dbo.CODE3OF9STR(@sStr)
                                        END
              RETURN @sStr            
        
END

as

    declare @sSelect2           nvarchar(MAX)
    declare @sSelect3           nvarchar(MAX)
	DECLARE @sSelect4           NVARCHAR(MAX)
    declare @sFrom              nvarchar(MAX) 
    declare @sWhereClause       nvarchar(MAX)

CREATE function [dbo].[O7REPPZORDF_REPPARSEPO] ( @sSel_Order nvarchar(1000))
RETURNS nvarchar(4000)
as

BEGIN
declare @sSelWo nvarchar(4000)
declare @sFromWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sToWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sTempWo nvarchar(100)
declare @sWoStr nvarchar(4000)
declare @sReturn nvarchar(4000)
DECLARE @rangeseparator NVARCHAR( 1 )

    SELECT @rangeseparator = COALESCE(SUBSTRING(INS_DESC,1,1),'-') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'REPRANGE'
    set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSel_Order))                
    IF (charindex( ',', @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
        begin                           
            IF len(@sSelWo) > 0  
                set @sWoStr = N' AND ORD_CODE IN (' 
            
            WHILE (len(@sSelWo) > 0)
                begin
                    IF (charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1) > 0) 
                        begin 
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                            set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( N',', @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( ',', @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                        end
                    ELSE
                        begin
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSelWo)) 
                            set @sSelWo = ''
                        end
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  '''''' +  @sTempWo +  ''''','     
                end
            IF (len(@sWoStr) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sWoStr = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sWoStr, 1, len(@sWoStr)-1)))
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  N')'
                end
            set @sReturn = @sWoStr
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            IF (charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sFromWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                    set @sToWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                    set @sReturn = N' AND ORD_CODE BETWEEN ''''' +  @sFromWO +  ''''' AND ''''' +  @sToWO +  ''''' '
                end
            ELSE
                set @sReturn = ' '
        end
    RETURN @sReturn

end
