create procedure O7REPRUNSQL
AS
    declare @sCode      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sUser      nvarchar(255)
    declare @sSQL       nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sSQLId     numeric(38,0)
    declare @nError     nvarchar(255)
    declare @nReturn    int

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare c_results cursor local for select TRS_CODE, TRS_USER, TRS_SQL, TRS_SQLIDENTITY FROM R5TEMPRUNSQL (UPDLOCK) WHERE TRS_RETRY < 5 ORDER BY TRS_RETRY, TRS_CODE 
	open c_results
	fetch next from c_results into 	@sCode, @sUser, @sSQL, @sSQLId
									
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			-- Set the report user as the current user on the database connection
			EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7SESS_INIT_SESS @sUser, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL

            begin try
			   execute sp_executesql @sSQL
               delete from R5TEMPRUNSQL WHERE  TRS_SQLIDENTITY = @sSQLId
			end try
			begin catch
				select @nError = substring( ERROR_MESSAGE(), 1, 250)
				update R5TEMPRUNSQL set trs_errortext = @nError , trs_retry = trs_retry + 1 WHERE  TRS_SQLIDENTITY = @sSQLId
			end catch

            fetch next from c_results into 	@sCode, @sUser, @sSQL, @sSQLId
		end
	close c_results
	deallocate c_results

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPSZREQF_GETREQTOTAL(@sReqcode nvarchar(30)) RETURNS NUMERIC(30,6)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @reqTotal	numeric(30,6)
	DECLARE @reqLines	int

	SELECT	@reqLines = count(*) 
	FROM  
		r5requislines e
	WHERE  
		e.rql_req    = @sReqcode
		AND e.rql_rstatus not in ('J','C')

	IF @reqLines = 0
		SET @reqTotal = 0
	ELSE
		SELECT	@reqTotal = ROUND( SUM( (CASE e.rql_rtype 
						 WHEN 'SF' THEN e.rql_price 
						 ELSE e.rql_price * e.rql_qty
						 END) / COALESCE( e.rql_exch, 1 ) ), 2 )
		FROM  
			r5requislines e
	     	WHERE  
	     		e.rql_req    = @sReqcode
			AND e.rql_rstatus not in ('J','C')
	
	RETURN (@reqTotal)
END

'
          
          IF @sR5User <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )

        end
    ELSE
        begin
            set @sFrom = ' R5REQUISITIONS R '
            set @sWhereClause = ' EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS WHERE UOG_USER = ''' + @sR5USER + ''' AND UOG_ROLE = ''' + @r5role + ''' AND UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND PRM_FUNCTION = ''' + @sR5FUNC + ''' AND PRM_SELECT = ''?'') '

CREATE function [dbo].[O7REPSZREQF_REPPARSERQ] ( @sSELREQ nvarchar(255))
RETURNS nvarchar(2000)
as

BEGIN
declare @sSelWo nvarchar(2000)
declare @sFromWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sToWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sTempWo nvarchar(100)
declare @sWoStr nvarchar(2000)
declare @sReturn nvarchar(2000)
DECLARE @rangeseparator NVARCHAR( 1 )

    SELECT @rangeseparator = COALESCE(SUBSTRING(INS_DESC,1,1),'-') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'REPRANGE'
    set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSELREQ))                
    IF (charindex( ',', @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
        begin                           
            IF len(@sSelWo) > 0  
                set @sWoStr = N' AND R.REQ_CODE IN (' 
            
            WHILE (len(@sSelWo) > 0)
                begin
                    IF (charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1) > 0) 
                        begin 
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                            set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( N',', @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( ',', @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                        end
                    ELSE
                        begin
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSelWo)) 
                            set @sSelWo = ''
                        end
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  ' ''' +  @sTempWo +  ''','     
                end
            IF (len(@sWoStr) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sWoStr = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sWoStr, 1, len(@sWoStr)-1)))
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  N')'
                end
            set @sReturn = @sWoStr
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            IF (charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sFromWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                    set @sToWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                    set @sReturn = N' AND R.REQ_CODE BETWEEN ''' +  @sFromWO +  ''' AND ''' +  @sToWO +  ''' '
                end
            ELSE
                set @sReturn = ' '
        end
    RETURN @sReturn

end

  			  		'''X'' AS DUMMY ' 	   
				   
        set @sFrom = ' R5TRANSACTIONS T  '          	

		IF @sR5DESTYPE = N'PRINT' 
			begin

				set @sSQL2 = N' FROM ' + coalesce(@sFrom,'') + 'WHERE '+ coalesce(@sWhereClause, '')

										TRAPRINTED nvarchar(1) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,

create function O7REPUZBANA_GETBDS_HIERARCHY1 ( @sBuscode       nvarchar(17) )
returns @tReturn table( buscode nvarchar(17)            COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                                buslevel        numeric(1),
                                                nLevel          int )
as
begin
        declare @nLevel                 int
        declare @sParent                nvarchar(17)
        declare @sCode                  nvarchar(17)
        declare @sOrg                   nvarchar(15)
        declare @nBuslevel                      numeric(1)

        declare @tStack table ( buscode         nvarchar(17),
                                                        buslevel        numeric(1),
                                                busparent       nvarchar(17),
                                                        LevelID int )

        INSERT INTO @tStack
                select  s.bus_code,
                                s.bus_level,
                                s.bus_parent,
                                1
                  from  r5budgetstructure s
                 where  s.bus_code              = @sBuscode

        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select  @sParent        = busparent,
                                                        @sCode  = buscode,
                                                        @nBuslevel = buslevel
                                          from  @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                                        insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @nBuslevel, @nLevel)
                                        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND buscode = @sCode
                                        insert into @tStack     select  s.bus_code,
                                                                                                s.bus_level,
                                                                                                s.bus_parent,
                                                                                                @nLevel + 1
                                                                                  from  r5budgetstructure s
                                                                                 where  s.bus_parent    = @sCode

                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END

        return
end

create procedure O7REPUZBANA_GET_DATES @sBudget nvarchar(17),
                    @sYear nvarchar(8),
                    @sPeriod_from nvarchar(4),
                    @sPeriod_to nvarchar(4),
                    @sSELORG nvarchar(15),
                    @sR5ORG nvarchar(15),
                    @dSEL_STARTDATE DATETIME OUTPUT,
                    @dSEL_ENDDATE DATETIME OUTPUT ,
                    @nSEL_SEQ_START INTEGER OUTPUT,
                    @nSEL_SEQ_END INTEGER OUTPUT

AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @dDummydate     DATETIME
    declare @dYear_start    DATETIME
    declare @dYear_end      DATETIME
    declare @nPeriods       INTEGER
    declare @dSys_date      DATETIME
    declare @sStmt          nvarchar(200)

    IF @sSELORG IS NOT NULL AND @sSELORG <> N'%'
        set @dSys_date = dbo.REPUZBANA_REPGETTIME(@sSELORG)
    ELSE
        set @dSys_date = dbo.REPUZBANA_REPGETTIME(@sR5ORG)



    IF @sPeriod_from IS NULL OR @sPeriod_to IS NULL
        begin
            SELECT @dYear_start = acy_start, @dYear_end = acy_end, @nPeriods = cal_periods FROM r5calendars, r5years WHERE acy_cal = cal_code AND acy_year = @sYear

            IF @sBudget IS NOT NULL
                begin
                    SELECT @dSEL_STARTDATE = coalesce( min(p.acp_start), @dSys_date ), @dSEL_ENDDATE = coalesce( max(p.acp_end), @dSys_date ),
                           @nSEL_SEQ_START = min(p.acp_seqno), @nSEL_SEQ_END = max(p.acp_seqno)
                    FROM r5periods p
                    WHERE p.acp_year = @sYear
                    AND p.acp_period IN (
                      SELECT bd.bdt_period
                      FROM r5budgetdetails bd
                      WHERE bd.bdt_period = p.acp_period
                      AND   bd.bdt_budget IN
                        (SELECT buscode FROM dbo.O7REPUZBANA_GETBDS_HIERARCHY1(@sBudget))
                      )
                end
                END

   -- Retrieve the start date of the start period.
    IF @sPeriod_from IS NOT NULL
        SELECT @dSEL_STARTDATE = acp_start,
              @dDummydate = acp_end,
              @nSEL_SEQ_START = acp_seqno
        FROM   r5periods
        WHERE  acp_year   = @sYear
        AND    acp_period = @sPeriod_from
    ELSE
        begin
            IF @sBudget IS  NULL OR @dSEL_STARTDATE IS NULL
                begin
                    set @dSEL_STARTDATE = @dYear_start
                    set @nSEL_SEQ_START = 1
                end
        end


   -- Retrieve the end date of the end period.
    IF @sPeriod_to IS NOT NULL
        SELECT @dDummydate = acp_start,
              @dSEL_ENDDATE = acp_end,
              @nSEL_SEQ_END = acp_seqno
        FROM   r5periods
        WHERE  acp_year   = @sYear
        AND    acp_period = @sPeriod_to
    ELSE
        begin
            IF @sBudget IS  NULL OR @dSEL_ENDDATE IS NULL
                begin
                    set @dSEL_ENDDATE = @dYear_end
                    set @nSEL_SEQ_END = @nPeriods
                end
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPWCV
    @sOldobject    nvarchar(30),
    @sNewobject    nvarchar(30),
    @sNewobjectorg nvarchar(15),
    @sUsername     nvarchar(255),
    @sWarranty     nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
    @sChk          nvarchar(5) OUTPUT 
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare  @nDuration      		numeric(9,2)
    declare  @nTotalusage    		numeric(18,0)
    declare  @nDailyusage    		numeric(18,0)
    declare  @nNewtotalusage 		numeric(24,6)
    declare  @nNewdailyusage 		numeric(18,0)
    declare  @dPredicted     		datetime
    declare  @sNdeforg       		nvarchar(200)          /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = o7dflt('DEFORG', @sChk) */
	declare  @sWcv_warranty			nvarchar(30)
	declare  @nDoc_threshold		numeric(18,0)
	declare  @nWcv_expiration		numeric(9,2)
	declare  @dWcv_expirationdate	datetime
	declare  @dWcv_startdate		datetime
	declare  @sWcv_uom				nvarchar(30)
	declare  @nWcv_startusage		numeric(24,6)
	declare  @sWcv_user				nvarchar(255)
	declare  @nWcv_duration			numeric(9,2)
	declare  @nAdd_Sqlidentity		int
	declare  @nOud_calcdailyusg		numeric(18, 0)
	declare  @nOud_totalusage		numeric(18, 0)
	declare  @nReturn				int	    
BEGIN
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sNdeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk	OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0  OR @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @sWarranty = null
    set @sChk = N'0'
	DECLARE cWcv CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT w.wcv_warranty,
           d.doc_threshold,
           w.wcv_expiration,
           w.wcv_expirationdate,
           w.wcv_startdate,
           w.wcv_uom,
           w.wcv_startusage,
           w.wcv_user,
           w.wcv_duration,
           w.wcv_sqlidentity wcvrowid
    FROM   r5warcoverages w,
           r5documents d
    WHERE  d.doc_code       = w.wcv_warranty
    AND    w.wcv_object     = @sOldobject
    AND    w.wcv_active     = N'+'
    OPEN cWcv
    FETCH NEXT FROM cWcv INTO @sWcv_warranty, @nDoc_threshold, @nWcv_expiration, @dWcv_expirationdate,
							@dWcv_startdate, @sWcv_uom, @nWcv_startusage, @sWcv_user, @nWcv_duration,
							@nAdd_Sqlidentity
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
	    IF @sWcv_uom IS NULL
		begin
	        /* Calendar based coverage */
	        IF @dWcv_expirationdate < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' )
			begin
	            set @sChk = N'1'
	            set @sWarranty = @sWcv_uom
	            RETURN
	        end
	        IF @nDoc_threshold IS NULL 
	            set @nDuration = @nWcv_duration
	        ELSE
			begin
				/* PVCS-4968 Pvg 02-Mar-1999 added a isnull around the expiration date */
	            IF @dWcv_expirationdate IS NOT NULL
				begin
	            	if @nDoc_threshold  > DATEDIFF(Day, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' ), @dWcv_expirationdate)
						set @nDuration = @nDoc_threshold
					else
						set @nDuration = DATEDIFF(Day, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' ), @dWcv_expirationdate)
				end
				ELSE
	                set @nDuration = @nWcv_duration
	        end
	
	        UPDATE r5warcoverages
	        SET    wcv_active = N'-'
	        WHERE  wcv_sqlidentity = @nAdd_Sqlidentity
	
			/* PVCS-4968-1 Pvg 02-May-1999 - The replacement warranty will show no start date */
			/* when there was no on the old warranty                                          */
	
	        IF @dWcv_startdate IS NULL AND @dWcv_expirationdate IS NULL
			begin
	            INSERT INTO r5warcoverages ( wcv_warranty, wcv_object, wcv_object_org,
	            wcv_obtype, wcv_obrtype, wcv_duration, wcv_recorded, wcv_user, wcv_active )
	            SELECT @sWcv_uom, o.obj_code, o.obj_org, o.obj_obtype, o.obj_obrtype,
	                   @nDuration,  dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), isnull( @sUsername, @sWcv_user ), N'+'
	            FROM   r5objects o
	            WHERE  obj_code = @sNewobject
	            AND    obj_org  = @sNewobjectorg
			end
	        ELSE
			begin
	            INSERT INTO r5warcoverages ( wcv_warranty, wcv_object, wcv_object_org,
	            wcv_obtype, wcv_obrtype, wcv_duration, wcv_startdate,
	            wcv_expirationdate, wcv_recorded, wcv_user, wcv_active )
	            SELECT @sWcv_uom, o.obj_code, o.obj_org, o.obj_obtype, o.obj_obrtype,
	                   @nDuration, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' ), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' )  +
	                   @nDuration, dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), isnull( @sUsername, @sWcv_user ), N'+'
	            FROM   r5objects o
	            WHERE  obj_code = @sNewobject
	            AND    obj_org  = @sNewobjectorg
	        end
		 end
	    ELSE
		begin
	        /* Meter based coverages */
			DECLARE cOud CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    		SELECT isnull( isnull( oud_calcdailyusg, oud_dfltdailyusg ), 0 ),
           		   isnull( oud_totalusage, 0 )
    		FROM   r5objusagedefs
    		WHERE  oud_object     = @sOldobject
    		AND    oud_object_org = @sNdeforg
    		AND    oud_uom        = @sWcv_uom

	        OPEN  cOud 
	        FETCH NEXT FROM cOud INTO @nDailyusage, @nTotalusage
	        CLOSE cOud
			DEALLOCATE cOud
	        IF @nTotalusage > @nWcv_expiration 
			begin
	            set @sChk = N'1'
	            set @sWarranty = @sWcv_uom
	            RETURN
	        end
	        IF @nDoc_threshold IS NULL
	            set @nDuration = @nWcv_duration
	        ELSE
			begin
	            IF @nDailyusage > 0
				 begin
	                 set @dPredicted = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg) +
	                           ( ( @nWcv_expiration - isnull( @nTotalusage, @nWcv_startusage ) ) /
	                               @nDailyusage ), N'DD' )
					if @nDoc_threshold  > DATEDIFF(Day, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' ), @dPredicted)
						set @nDuration = @nDoc_threshold
					else
						set @nDuration = DATEDIFF(Day, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), N'DD' ), @dPredicted)
				 end
	             ELSE
	                 set @nDuration = @nWcv_duration
	        end
			DECLARE cOud CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    		SELECT isnull( isnull( oud_calcdailyusg, oud_dfltdailyusg ), 0 ),
           		isnull( oud_totalusage, 0 )
    		FROM   r5objusagedefs
    		WHERE  oud_object     = @sNewobject
    		AND    oud_object_org = @sNewobjectorg
    		AND    oud_uom        = @sWcv_uom
	        OPEN  cOud 
	        FETCH NEXT FROM cOud INTO @nNewdailyusage, @nNewtotalusage
	        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			begin
	            set @nNewtotalusage = 0
	            INSERT INTO r5objusagedefs ( oud_object, oud_object_org,
	             oud_uom, oud_totalusage, oud_child, oud_parent )
	            VALUES( @sNewobject, @sNewobjectorg, @sWcv_uom, 0, N'-', N'-' )
	        end
	        CLOSE cOud
			DEALLOCATE cOud
	        UPDATE r5warcoverages
	        SET    wcv_active = N'-'
	        WHERE  wcv_sqlidentity = @nAdd_Sqlidentity
	        INSERT INTO r5warcoverages ( wcv_warranty, wcv_object, wcv_object_org,
	          wcv_obtype, wcv_obrtype, wcv_duration, wcv_startusage, wcv_expiration,
	          wcv_recorded, wcv_user, wcv_active, wcv_uom )
	        SELECT @sWcv_uom, o.obj_code, o.obj_org, o.obj_obtype, o.obj_obrtype,
	               @nDuration, @nNewtotalusage, @nNewtotalusage + @nDuration,
	               dbo.o7gttime2(@sNewobjectorg), isnull( @sUsername, @sWcv_user ), N'+', @sWcv_uom
	        FROM   r5objects o
	        WHERE  obj_code = @sNewobject
	        AND    obj_org  = @sNewobjectorg
	     end
	FETCH NEXT FROM cWcv INTO @sWcv_warranty, @nDoc_threshold, @nWcv_expiration, @dWcv_expirationdate,
							@dWcv_startdate, @sWcv_uom, @nWcv_startusage, @sWcv_user, @nWcv_duration,
							@nAdd_Sqlidentity
    end  
END

create function O7REPWZCALR_REPWZCALR_EXISTS(   @sObjcode   nvarchar(30),
													@sObjorg    nvarchar(15),
													@sEvtobject nvarchar(30),
													@sEvtobjorg nvarchar(15))
	returns bit
	as
	begin
		declare @bReturn            bit
		declare @sCurrentCode	    nvarchar(30)
		declare @sCurrentOrg	    nvarchar(15)
		declare @nLevel			    int
		declare @tStack             table ( stc_parent      nvarchar(30), 
											stc_parent_org  nvarchar(15),
											LevelID int )
		insert into @tStack select stc_parent, stc_parent_org, 1
							from r5structures
							where stc_child     = @sEvtobject  
							and   stc_child_org = @sEvtobjorg

		set @bReturn = 0

		SET @nLevel = 1

		WHILE @nLevel > 0
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
					BEGIN
						select @sCurrentCode        = stc_parent, 
							   @sCurrentOrg         = stc_parent_org
						from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

						if @sCurrentCode = @sObjcode and @sCurrentOrg = @sObjorg
							begin
								--found the pair we are looking for.  Set return value and leave.
								set @bReturn = 1
								break
							end

						delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCurrentCode AND stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
						INSERT INTO @tStack select stc_parent, stc_parent_org, @nLevel + 1
											  from r5structures 
											 where stc_child        = @sCurrentCode
											 and   stc_child_org    = @sCurrentOrg
						IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
							SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
					END
				ELSE
					SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
			END

		return @bReturn
	end

create function O7REPWZCALR_REPWZCALR_LOC_HEIR ( @sSelLoc    nvarchar(30), 
													 @sSelOrg	nvarchar(15) )
	returns @tReturn table( loc_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
							loc_org  nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
	as
	begin
		DECLARE @nLevel			    int
		DECLARE @sCurrentCode	    nvarchar(30)
		DECLARE @sCurrentOrg	    nvarchar(15)
		DECLARE @sCurrentParent	    nvarchar(30)
		DECLARE @sCurrentParentOrg	nvarchar(15)

		declare @tStack table ( loc_code nvarchar(30), 
								loc_org nvarchar(15),
								LevelID int )

		INSERT INTO @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, 1 
							  from r5locations 
							 where loc_code like @sSelLoc and loc_org like @sSelOrg

		SET @nLevel = 1

		WHILE @nLevel > 0
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
					BEGIN
						select @sCurrentCode        = loc_code, 
							   @sCurrentOrg         = loc_org
						from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

						insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sCurrentOrg )

						delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND loc_code = @sCurrentCode AND loc_org = @sCurrentOrg
						INSERT INTO @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, @nLevel + 1
											  from r5locations 
											 where loc_parent = @sCurrentCode
											 and   loc_parent_org  = @sCurrentOrg
						IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
							SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
					END
				ELSE
					SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
			END

		return
	end

CREATE procedure O7REPWZINVS_REPWZINVS  @P_SEL_INVOICE        nvarchar(30),
                                        @P_SEL_DEBTOR         nvarchar(30),
                                        @P_SEL_EVENT          nvarchar(30),
                                        @P_SEL_STATUS         nvarchar(30),
                                        @P_SEL_ORG            nvarchar(15),
                                        @P_R5_USER            nvarchar(255),
                                        @P_R5_ORG             nvarchar(15),
                                        @P_R5_DEFORG          nvarchar(15),
                                        @P_R5_FUNC            nvarchar(6),
                                        @P_R5_DESTYPE         nvarchar(16),
                                        @P_R5_LANG            nvarchar(2),
                                        @sCurrUser            nvarchar(255),
                                        @r5role               nvarchar(30)

as

BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @s_sysdate           datetime
  declare @s_StartDate         datetime
  declare @s_EndDate           datetime

  declare @s_Select            nvarchar(4000) 
  declare @s_Select_Union      nvarchar(4000) 
  declare @s_Select2           nvarchar(4000) 
  declare @s_From              nvarchar(1000) 
  declare @s_WhereClause       nvarchar(2000) 
  declare @s_WhereClause1      nvarchar(2000) 
  declare @s_WhereCL1          nvarchar(1000) 
  declare @s_WhereCL2          nvarchar(1000) 
  declare @s_WhereCL3          nvarchar(1000) 
  declare @s_WhereCL4          nvarchar(1000) 
  declare @s_WhereCL5          nvarchar(1000) 
  declare @s_OrderBy           nvarchar(200) 
  declare @s_R5Value           nvarchar(255) 
  declare @s_selorg            nvarchar(15) 
  declare @s_Ustatus           nvarchar(15)
  declare @chk                 nvarchar(4)
  declare @nReturn             int

  declare @s_Update1           nvarchar(2000) 

  declare @sSQL                nvarchar(4000)
  declare @sSQL1               nvarchar(4000)
  declare @sSQL2               nvarchar(4000)
  declare @sSQL3               nvarchar(4000)

  set @s_Select                = ''
  set @s_Select2               = ''
  set @s_From                  = ''
  set @s_WhereClause           = ''
  set @s_WhereCL1              = ''
  set @s_WhereCL2              = ''
  set @s_WhereCL3              = ''
  set @s_WhereCL4              = ''
  set @s_WhereCL5              = ''
  set @s_Select_Union          = ''
  set @s_OrderBy               = ''
  set @s_selorg                = ''
  set @s_Ustatus               = ''
  set @s_R5Value               = ''

  set @sSQL                    = ''
  set @sSQL1                   = ''
  set @sSQL2                   = ''
  set @sSQL3                   = ''

  declare @stmt                nvarchar(3000)

  declare @s_eiv_code          nvarchar(30)
  declare @s_eiv_org           nvarchar(15)
  declare @s_Code              nvarchar(2000)
  declare @s_count             integer


    
  set @s_From = 'R5EXTINVOICES E, R5DEBTORS D ' 

  set @s_WhereClause = 'E.EIV_DEBTOR = D.DEB_CODE ' +
                       'AND EXISTS ( SELECT ''''X'''' ' +
                                   ' FROM   R5USERORGANIZATION U, ' +
                                          ' R5PERMISSIONS P ' +
                                   ' WHERE U.UOG_ORG = E.EIV_ORG ' +
                                   ' AND U.UOG_GROUP = P.PRM_GROUP ' +
                                   ' AND U.UOG_USER = @P_R5_USER ' +
                                   ' AND U.UOG_ROLE = @r5role ' +
                                   ' AND P.PRM_FUNCTION = @P_R5_FUNC ' +
                                   ' AND P.PRM_SELECT = ''''?'''') ' 
                                   
  IF @P_R5_USER <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
     SET @s_WhereClause = @s_WhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '

  IF @P_SEL_ORG <> N'%' 
     set @s_WhereCL1 = @s_WhereCL1 + ' AND E.EIV_ORG LIKE @P_SEL_ORG '

  IF @P_SEL_DEBTOR <> N'%' 
     set @s_WhereCL1 = @s_WhereCL1 + ' AND E.EIV_DEBTOR LIKE @P_SEL_DEBTOR  '
        
  IF @P_SEL_INVOICE <> N'%' 
     set @s_WhereCL2 = @s_WhereCL2 + ' AND E.EIV_CODE LIKE @P_SEL_INVOICE  '

  IF @P_SEL_STATUS <> N'%' 
     set @s_WhereCL2 = @s_WhereCL2 + ' AND E.EIV_RSTATUS LIKE @P_SEL_STATUS  '
        
  IF @P_SEL_EVENT <> N'%' 
     begin
           set @s_WhereCL2 = @s_WhereCL2 + ' AND EXISTS (SELECT ''''X''''  '
           set @s_WhereCL2 = @s_WhereCL2 + '            FROM   R5EXTINVLINES IL '
           set @s_WhereCL2 = @s_WhereCL2 + '            WHERE  IL.EIL_INVOICE = E.EIV_CODE '
           set @s_WhereCL2 = @s_WhereCL2 + '            AND    IL.EIL_EVENTCODE LIKE @P_SEL_EVENT ) '
     end

  IF @P_SEL_EVENT = N'%' AND @P_SEL_INVOICE = N'%' 
     set @s_WhereCL3 = @s_WhereCL3 + ' AND E.EIV_RSTATUS = ''''R'''' '
        
  set @s_Select = 'E.EIV_CODE INVOICE, ' +
                  'E.EIV_ORG INVOICE_ORG, ' +
                  '(CASE WHEN E.EIV_ORG = @P_R5_ORG THEN E.EIV_CODE ELSE E.EIV_CODE + '''' ( '''' + E.EIV_ORG + '''' )'''' END)  INV_ORG, ' +
                  'E.EIV_CODE + ''''#'''' + E.EIV_ORG INV_POUND_ORG, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETDESC( @P_R5_LANG, ''''UCOD'''', E.EIV_STATUS, ''''EIST'''', NULL) STATUS, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETDESC( @P_R5_LANG, ''''CURR'''', (SELECT I.ORG_CURR FROM R5ORGANIZATION I WHERE I.ORG_CODE = E.EIV_ORG), NULL, NULL) CURR_DESC, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETDESC( @P_R5_LANG, ''''CURR'''', D.DEB_CURR, NULL, NULL) DEB_CURR, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, DBO.REPGETSYSDATE(@P_R5_ORG)) PRINT_DATE, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, DBO.REPGETSYSDATE(@P_R5_ORG)) CURDATETIME, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_DATE) INVDATE, ' +
                  'E.EIV_DEBTOR EIV_DEBTOR, ' +
                  'DBO.REPGETDESC( @P_R5_LANG, ''''DEB'''', E.EIV_DEBTOR, NULL, NULL) DEBTOR, ' +
                  '(SELECT A1.ADR_TEXT ' +
                  ' FROM   R5ADDRESS A1 ' +
                  ' WHERE  A1.ADR_RENTITY = ''''DEB'''' ' +
                  ' AND    A1.ADR_RTYPE IN (SELECT MIN(A2.ADR_RTYPE) ' +
                  '                         FROM   R5ADDRESS A2 ' +
                  '                         WHERE  A2.ADR_RENTITY = A1.ADR_RENTITY ' +
                  '                         AND    A2.ADR_CODE = A1.ADR_CODE ' +
                  '                         AND    A2.ADR_RTYPE IN (''''I'''', ''''M'''') ' +
                  '                        ) AND A1.ADR_CODE = E.EIV_DEBTOR ' + 
                  ' ) DEBINVADDRESS, ' +
                  'DBO.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE ( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_PRICE) INVPRICE, ' +
                  'DBO.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE ( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_TAX) INVTAX, ' +
                  'DBO.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE ( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_TAXED) INVTAXED, ' +
                  'DBO.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE ( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_EXCH) INVEXCH, ' +
                  'DBO.REPFMTMONNUMLOCALE ( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_EXCHANGED) INVECHANGED, ' +
                  'E.EIV_ORIGIN INVORIGIN, ' +
                  'DBO.REPFMTNUMLOCALE ( @P_R5_USER, @P_R5_ORG, E.EIV_TAXPERC) TAXPERCENTAGE, ' +
                  'D.DEB_CLASS DEBCLASS, ' +
                  'D.DEB_CURR DEBCURR, ' +
                  'D.DEB_TAX DEBTAX, ' +

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPWZJOBF_BARCODEDEVTACT (@sEvent nvarchar(30),       
                                                         @sActivity nvarchar(8))
RETURNS nvarchar(250) AS        
BEGIN
        DECLARE @nReturn INTEGER
    DECLARE @sStr nvarchar(250)
        DECLARE @sChk nvarchar(16)
        DECLARE @sFiller nvarchar(200)
        DECLARE @sBarcodeOption nvarchar(200)
        DECLARE @sPrefix nvarchar(200)
        DECLARE @sBarSymb nvarchar(200)         
        
        set @sStr = ''  
        set @sBarcodeOption = dbo.o7dflt2(N'OPT_BARC') 
        
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return @sStr
                
                                set @sFiller = coalesce(dbo.o7dflt2(N'BARFILL'),'') 
                                set @sPrefix = coalesce(dbo.o7dflt2(N'BARCODW'),'') 
                                set @sBarSymb =coalesce(dbo.o7dflt2(N'BARSYMB'),'')                                 
                                
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        return @sStr                            

                                IF @sBarSymb LIKE 'C128%' 
                                        BEGIN
                                                IF (@sActivity IS NOT NULL ) 
                                                        set @sStr = @sPrefix + @sEvent + @sFiller + @sActivity 
                                                ELSE
                                                        set @sStr = @sPrefix + @sEvent                                          

                                                set @sStr = dbo.IDAUTOMATION_CODE128(@sStr,0)
                                        END
                                ELSE
                                        BEGIN
                                                IF (@sActivity IS NOT NULL)             
                                                        set @sStr = @sPrefix +  @sEvent + '/C' + @sActivity 
                                                ELSE
                                                        set @sStr = @sPrefix +  @sEvent                                                                         

                                                set @sStr = dbo.CODE3OF9STR(@sStr)
                                        END
        RETURN @sStr            
        
END

create function O7REPWZJOBF_EVT_LOC_HEIR ( @sSelLoc    nvarchar(30), 
                                                                                        @sSelOrg        nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( loc_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_org  nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
        DECLARE @nLevel                     int
        DECLARE @sCurrentCode       nvarchar(30)
        DECLARE @sCurrentOrg        nvarchar(15)
        DECLARE @sCurrentParent     nvarchar(30)
        DECLARE @sCurrentParentOrg      nvarchar(15)
                
        declare @tStack table ( loc_code nvarchar(30), 
                            loc_org nvarchar(15),
                            LevelID int )
        
        INSERT INTO @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, 1 
                          from r5locations 
                         where loc_code like @sSelLoc and loc_org like @sSelOrg

        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select @sCurrentCode        = loc_code, 
                           @sCurrentOrg         = loc_org
                    from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

                                        insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sCurrentOrg )
                                        
                                        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND loc_code = @sCurrentCode AND loc_org = @sCurrentOrg
                        INSERT INTO @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, @nLevel + 1
                                          from r5locations 
                                         where loc_parent = @sCurrentCode
                                         and   loc_parent_org  = @sCurrentOrg
                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END

        return
end

CREATE function O7REPWZJOBF_REPGETOBJTEXT ( @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                                @sLang nvarchar(2),
                                @sCategory nvarchar(100),
                                @sCode nvarchar(100))
RETURNS nvarchar(4000)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sText      nvarchar(4000)
    DECLARE @sReturn      nvarchar(4000)

    SET @sText = ''
    SET @sReturn = ''

    DECLARE c_text CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT SUBSTRING(a.add_text,1,4000) 
                                        FROM    r5addetails a
                                        WHERE   a.add_rentity    = @sRentity AND
                                                        a.add_lang  = @sLang AND
                                                        a.add_print = N'+' AND
                                                        ((a.add_code  = @sCode ) or (a.add_code = @sCategory and a.add_rtype = N'C'))
                                        ORDER BY a.add_line

    OPEN c_text
    FETCH NEXT FROM c_text INTO  @sText 
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
          BEGIN
            SET @sReturn = SUBSTRING(@sReturn + N' ' + @sText,1,4000) 
            IF len(@sReturn) >= 4000
                BREAK
            FETCH NEXT FROM c_text INTO  @sText
          END
    CLOSE c_text
    DEALLOCATE c_text

    RETURN @sReturn
end

                end
            set @sReturn = @sWoStr
        end
    ELSE
        begin

                end

                set @sReturn = ' '

    RETURN @sReturn

create procedure O7REPWZJOBQ_Q_EVENTS

				@sSelEnd            nvarchar(50),

                @sCurrUser          NVARCHAR(255),
                @r5role             NVARCHAR( 30 )
as
	set nocount on
	declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)
	declare @nCount         integer	
	declare @sUpdate1       nvarchar(MAX)
	declare @sCodeString    nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sResult_code   nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPrinted       nvarchar(1)	
    DECLARE @rangeseparator NVARCHAR( 1 )
	
	declare @sSQL nvarchar(max)
	declare @sSQLinsert nvarchar(max)
	declare @sSelect nvarchar(max) 
    declare @sWhereClause nvarchar(max) 
    declare @sFrom nvarchar(1000)
	
	declare @sSQL1 nvarchar(MAX)
	declare @sSQL2 nvarchar(MAX)
	declare @sSQL3 nvarchar(MAX)
	
	set @sSQL = ''
	set @sSQLinsert = ''
	set @sSelect = ''
	set @sWhereClause = ''
	set @sFrom = ''
	
	SELECT @deptsec = INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'
    SELECT @rangeseparator = COALESCE(SUBSTRING(INS_DESC,1,1),'-') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'REPRANGE'	
	
	IF @sSession <> '0'
	BEGIN
			SET @sFrom = @sFrom + ' R5TEMPWMBWOG W, R5EVENTS E LEFT OUTER JOIN R5OBJECTS O ON (E.EVT_OBJECT = O.OBJ_CODE AND E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG = O.OBJ_ORG) '
			SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' W.TEV_SESSIONID = @sSession ' + 
								' AND W.TEV_CODE = E.EVT_CODE AND ' +
								' W.TEV_PRINTSUBID = @sR5Printsubid AND '
    END								
	ELSE
			SET @sFrom = @sFrom + ' R5EVENTS E LEFT OUTER JOIN R5OBJECTS O ON (E.EVT_OBJECT = O.OBJ_CODE AND E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG = O.OBJ_ORG) '
			
	SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + 
						'E.EVT_RTYPE in (N''JOB'',N''PPM'') AND ' +
						'( ( ''' + @deptsec + '''= ''ON'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY WHERE DSE_USER = @sR5User AND DSE_MRC = E.EVT_MRC ) ) OR ( ''' + @deptsec + '''= ''OFF'')) AND ' +
						'E.EVT_ORG IN (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS WHERE UOG_USER = @sR5User AND UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func AND PRM_SELECT = N''?'') '
                        
    IF @sR5User <> UPPER( @sCurrUser )
       SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '
						
	IF  @sSelJob <> N'%'
	BEGIN
			IF ((charindex(@rangeseparator,@sSelJob, 1) > 0) OR (charindex(N',',@sSelJob, 1) > 0)) 
				SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + dbo.O7REPWZJOBQ_REPPARSEWO(@sSelJob)
			ELSE
				SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_CODE like @sSelJob '
	END 
	
	IF  @sSelStatus <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_STATUS LIKE @sSelStatus '
	ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @sSession <> '0'
                SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_RSTATUS <> N''B'''
			ELSE IF (@sSession = '0' AND @sSelJob = '%')
				SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_RSTATUS = N''R'''
        END

	IF  @sSelorg <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_ORG like @sSelorg '

	IF  @sSelPpm <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_PPM like @sSelPpm '

	IF  @sSelmrc <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_MRC like @sSelmrc '

	IF  @sSelprior <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_PRIORITY like @sSelprior '

	IF  @sSeljobtyp <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_JOBTYPE like @sSeljobtyp '

	IF  @sSelobjcrit <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_OBJCRITICALITY like @sSelobjcrit '

	IF  @sSelSchgrp <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_SCHEDGRP like @sSelSchgrp '

	IF  @sSelObj <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_OBJECT like @sSelObj '

	IF  @sSelObtp <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_OBTYPE like @sSelObtp '
	
	IF  @sSelPerson <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_PERSON like @sSelPerson ';

	IF  @sSelTrad <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_CODE IN (SELECT ACT_EVENT FROM R5ACTIVITIES WHERE ACT_TRADE like @sSelTrad ) '

	IF  @sSelLoc <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND E.EVT_LOCATION LIKE @sSelLoc '

	IF  @sSelStart <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(COALESCE(E.EVT_TARGET, E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE),''YYYY-MM-DD'') >= @sSelStart '

	IF @sSelEnd <> N'%'
		SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(COALESCE(E.EVT_TARGET, E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE),''YYYY-MM-DD'') <= @sSelEnd '
		
    IF (@sSelReprint <> '+') AND (@sSelJob = '%') AND @sSession = N'0'
        SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause +  ' AND E.EVT_PRINT = N''+'' '

    IF (@sSelReprint = '+') AND (@sSelJob = '%') AND @sSession = N'0'
        SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause +  ' AND (E.EVT_PRINTED = N''+'' OR E.EVT_PRINT = N''+'') '	
		
	SET @sSelect =	@sSelect + 'E.EVT_CODE,' +
					'E.EVT_ORG,' +
					'CASE WHEN @sR5Org = E.EVT_ORG THEN '' '' ELSE '' ('' + E.EVT_ORG + '')'' END EVT_ORG_FMT,' +
					'DBO.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@sR5Lang,''EVNT'', E.EVT_CODE, NULL,NULL) EVT_DESC,' +
					'DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@sR5User,@sR5Org, E.EVT_CREATED) EVT_CREATED,' +
                    'E.EVT_CREATEDBY,' +

name: O7REPWZJOBQ_REPPARSEWO
body:
CREATE function O7REPWZJOBQ_REPPARSEWO ( @sSELJOB nvarchar(255))
RETURNS nvarchar(2000)
as

BEGIN
declare @sSelWo nvarchar(2000)
declare @sFromWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sToWO nvarchar(100)
declare @sTempWo nvarchar(100)
declare @sWoStr nvarchar(2000)
declare @sReturn nvarchar(2000)
DECLARE @rangeseparator NVARCHAR( 1 )

    SELECT @rangeseparator = COALESCE(SUBSTRING(INS_DESC,1,1),'-') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'REPRANGE'
    set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSELJOB))                
    IF (charindex( ',', @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
        begin                           
            IF len(@sSelWo) > 0  
                set @sWoStr = N' AND E.EVT_CODE IN (' 
            
            WHILE (len(@sSelWo) > 0)
                begin
                    IF (charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1) > 0) 
                        begin 
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(N',', @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                            set @sSelWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( N',', @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( ',', @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                        end
                    ELSE
                        begin
                            set @sTempWo = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSelWo)) 
                            set @sSelWo = ''
                        end
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  ' ''' +  @sTempWo +  ''','     
                end
            IF (len(@sWoStr) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sWoStr = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sWoStr, 1, len(@sWoStr)-1)))
                    set @sWoStr = @sWoStr +  N')'
                end
            set @sReturn = @sWoStr
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            IF (charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo,1) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sFromWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, 1,charindex(@rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)-1)))
                    set @sToWO = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelWo, charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1,len(@sSelWo)-charindex( @rangeseparator, @sSelWo, 1)+1)))
                    set @sReturn = N' AND E.EVT_CODE BETWEEN ''' +  @sFromWO +  ''' AND ''' +  @sToWO +  ''' '
                end
            ELSE
                set @sReturn = ' '
        end
    RETURN @sReturn

end 
0

	IF @sSession <> '0'

	IF  @sSelJob <> N'%'

					'E.EVT_OBJECT,' +

					'CASE WHEN @sR5Org = E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG THEN '' '' ELSE '' ('' + E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG + '')'' END EVT_OBJECT_ORG_FMT,' +
					'DBO.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@sR5Lang,''OBJ'', E.EVT_OBJECT + ''#'' + E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG, NULL,NULL) EVT_OBJECT_DESC,' +
					'O.OBJ_MANUFACT,' +

name: O7REPWZJSIRINSPECT
body:
CREATE FUNCTION O7REPWZJSIRINSPECT(
  @wo      NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @act     NVARCHAR( 8 ), 
  @aspect  NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @inspect NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @r5func  NVARCHAR( 6 ), 
  @r5lang  NVARCHAR( 2 ), 
  @r5user  NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @r5org   NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
RETURNS    NVARCHAR( 1000 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @inspectvalue NVARCHAR( 1000 );
 
  IF @inspect IS NULL RETURN NULL;

  SELECT
    TOP 1
	@inspectvalue = 
    CASE
      WHEN @inspect = 'COMPGOOD'
        THEN ack_good
      WHEN @inspect = 'COMPPOOR'
        THEN ack_poor
      WHEN @inspect = 'COMPDEFECT'
        THEN ack_nonconformitytype
      WHEN @inspect = 'COMPREMARKS'
        THEN RTRIM( LTRIM( COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_condition_as_found IS NOT NULL
                                     THEN dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @r5lang, 'UCOD', ack_condition_as_found, 'CFOP', '' ) END, '' ) +
                           COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_notes IS NOT NULL
                                     THEN ' ' + COALESCE( COALESCE( ack_notes, '' ), '' ) END, '' ) ) )
      WHEN @inspect = 'TESTOK' OR @inspect = 'MW1NODEFECT'
        THEN ack_ok
      WHEN @inspect = 'TESTADJ'
        THEN ack_adjusted
      WHEN @inspect = 'TESTMEASUREMENT'
        THEN RTRIM( LTRIM( COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_direction IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE( ack_direction, '' ) + ' ' END, '' ) +
                           COALESCE( dbo.repdecimaltofraction( ack_value, @r5func, @r5user, @r5org ), '' ) ) )
      WHEN @inspect = 'TESTREMARKS' OR @inspect ='MW1GEOREMARKS'
        THEN RTRIM( LTRIM( COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_condition_as_found IS NOT NULL
                                          THEN dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @r5lang, 'UCOD', ack_condition_as_found, 'CFOP', '' ) END, '' ) +
                                     COALESCE( CASE WHEN tch_equipfilter IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX( ',', tch_equipfilter ) = 0
                                                    THEN ' ' + COALESCE( dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @r5lang, 'UCOD', tch_equipfilter, 'ECFC', '' ), '' ) END, '' ) +
                                     COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_notes IS NOT NULL
                                                    THEN ' ' + COALESCE( COALESCE( ack_notes, '' ), '' ) END, '' ) ) )
      WHEN @inspect = 'COMPNA'
        THEN ack_not_applicable
      WHEN @inspect = 'MW1PRIORITY'
        THEN ack_severity
      WHEN @inspect = 'MW1REMARKS'
        THEN RTRIM( LTRIM( CASE WHEN ack_type = 12
                                THEN RTRIM( LTRIM( COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_direction IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE( ack_direction, '' ) + ' '  END, '' ) +
                                                   COALESCE( dbo.repdecimaltofraction( ack_value, @r5func, @r5user, @r5org ), '' ) +
                                                   COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_value IS NOT NULL THEN ' in.' END, '' ) ) ) END +
                           COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_condition_as_found IS NOT NULL
                                          THEN ' ' + COALESCE( dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @r5lang, 'UCOD', ack_condition_as_found, 'CFOP', '' ), '' ) END, '' ) +
                           COALESCE( CASE WHEN tch_equipfilter IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX( ',', tch_equipfilter ) = 0
                                          THEN ' ' + COALESCE( dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @r5lang, 'UCOD', tch_equipfilter, 'ECFC', '' ), '' ) END, '' ) +
                           COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_notes IS NOT NULL
                                          THEN ' ' + COALESCE( COALESCE( ack_notes, '' ), '' ) END, '' ) ) )
      WHEN @inspect = 'MW1GEOMEASURE'
        THEN CASE WHEN ack_type = 12
                  THEN RTRIM( LTRIM( COALESCE( CASE WHEN ack_direction IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE( ack_direction, '' ) + ' '  END, '' ) +
                                       COALESCE( dbo.repdecimaltofraction( ack_value, @r5func, @r5user, @r5org ), '' ) ) ) END
    END
  FROM  r5actchecklists
        LEFT JOIN r5taskchecklists ON ack_taskchecklistcode = tch_code
  WHERE ack_event  = @wo
  AND   ack_act    = @act
  AND   ack_aspect = @aspect

  RETURN @inspectvalue
  
END

create procedure O7REPWZMPAT_Q_DETAILS
										@R5_USER nvarchar(255),
										@R5_FUNC nvarchar(6),
										@R5_LANG nvarchar(2),
										@R5_ORG nvarchar(15),
										@SEL_MPAT nvarchar(4000),
										@SEL_ORG nvarchar(15),
										@SEL_CLASS nvarchar(8),
										@SEL_OBJ nvarchar(30),
										@SEL_OBJTYPE nvarchar(4),
										@SEL_OBJMRC nvarchar(15),
										@SEL_OBJCLASS nvarchar(8),
										@SEL_OBJCAT nvarchar(30),
										@SEL_OBJCC nvarchar(30),
										@SEL_OBJPERSON nvarchar(15),
										@sCurrUser nvarchar(255),
										@r5role nvarchar(30)
as
    set nocount on
	
	declare @sSQL nvarchar(max)	
    	declare @sSelect nvarchar(max) 
    	declare @sWhereClause nvarchar(max) 
    	declare @sFrom nvarchar(1000)
	
	set @sSQL = ''
	set @sSelect = ''
	set @sWhereClause = ''
	set @sFrom = ''

	set @sSelect =  @sSelect + 'mtp_code + ''#'' + mtp_org + ''#'' + convert(varchar(20),mtp_revision) MTP_PK, ' +
					' MTP_CODE, ' + 
					' DBO.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@R5_LANG,''MPAT'',mtp_code + ''#'' + mtp_org,'''','''') MTP_DESC, ' +
					' MTP_REVISION, ' +
					' MTP_ORG, ' +
					' CASE WHEN @R5_ORG = mtp_org THEN '''' ELSE '' ('' + COALESCE(mtp_org,'''') + '')'' END MTP_ORG_FMT, ' +
					' DBO.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@R5_LANG,''UCOD'', mtp_mptype,''MPTP'', '''') MTP_MPTYPE_DESC, ' +
					' MTP_CLASS, ' +
					' CASE WHEN @R5_ORG = mtp_class_org OR mtp_class_org IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE '' ('' + COALESCE(mtp_class_org,'''') + '')'' END MTP_CLASS_ORG, ' +
					' DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@R5_USER,@R5_ORG,mtp_startdate) MTP_STARTDATE_FMT, ' +
					' MTP_METUOM, ' +
					' DBO.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@R5_LANG,''UCOD'', mtp_releasetype,''RLTP'', '''') MTP_RELEASETYPE_DESC, ' +
					' MTP_METUOM2, ' +
					' DBO.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@R5_LANG,''UCOD'', mtp_releasetype2,''RLTP'', '''') MTP_RELEASETYPE2_DESC, ' +
					' MTP_SCHEDGRP, ' +
					' MTP_CREATEDBY, ' +
					' DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@R5_USER,@R5_ORG,mtp_created) MTP_CREATED_FMT '

	set	@sFrom =  @sFrom + ' r5maintenancepatterns ' +
				  ' LEFT JOIN r5patternequipment ON mtp_code = peq_mp AND mtp_org = peq_mp_org AND mtp_revision = peq_revision ' +
				  ' LEFT JOIN r5objects ON peq_object = obj_code AND peq_object_org = obj_org '		

	set @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause +  ' EXISTS (	SELECT ''X'' ' +
						' FROM R5USERORGANIZATION U, R5PERMISSIONS P ' +
						' WHERE U.UOG_GROUP = P.PRM_GROUP AND U.UOG_ORG = mtp_org AND U.UOG_USER = @R5_USER AND U.UOG_ROLE = @r5role AND P.PRM_FUNCTION = @R5_FUNC AND P.PRM_SELECT = ''?'') '
                        
    IF @R5_USER <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
       SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '

	IF  @SEL_MPAT <> N'%' 
    begin
			if (charindex(N',',@SEL_MPAT, 1) > 0)
					set @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause +  dbo.O7REPWZMPAT_REPPARSEMP(@SEL_MPAT)
			else            
					set @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND mtp_code LIKE @SEL_MPAT '
    end 

	set @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + 
						' AND (@SEL_ORG = ''%'' OR mtp_org LIKE @SEL_ORG) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_CLASS = ''%'' OR mtp_class LIKE @SEL_CLASS) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJ = ''%'' OR obj_code LIKE @SEL_OBJ) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJTYPE = ''%'' OR obj_obtype LIKE @SEL_OBJTYPE) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJMRC = ''%'' OR obj_mrc LIKE @SEL_OBJMRC) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJCLASS = ''%'' OR obj_class LIKE @SEL_OBJCLASS) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJCAT = ''%'' OR obj_category LIKE @SEL_OBJCAT) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJCC = ''%'' OR obj_costcode LIKE @SEL_OBJCC) ' +
						' AND (@SEL_OBJPERSON = ''%'' OR obj_person LIKE @SEL_OBJPERSON) '
						
	set @sSQL = @sSQL + 'SELECT ' + coalesce(@sSelect,'') + 'FROM '+ coalesce(@sFrom,'') + 'WHERE '+ coalesce(@sWhereClause, '') 
	
	execute sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@R5_USER nvarchar(255), @R5_FUNC nvarchar(6), @R5_LANG nvarchar(2), @R5_ORG nvarchar(15), @SEL_MPAT nvarchar(30), @SEL_ORG nvarchar(15), @SEL_CLASS nvarchar(8), @SEL_OBJ nvarchar(30), @SEL_OBJTYPE nvarchar(4), @SEL_OBJMRC nvarchar(15), @SEL_OBJCLASS nvarchar(8), @SEL_OBJCAT nvarchar(30), @SEL_OBJCC nvarchar(30), @SEL_OBJPERSON nvarchar(15), @r5role nvarchar(30)', @R5_USER, @R5_FUNC, @R5_LANG, @R5_ORG, @SEL_MPAT, @SEL_ORG, @SEL_CLASS, @SEL_OBJ, @SEL_OBJTYPE, @SEL_OBJMRC, @SEL_OBJCLASS, @SEL_OBJCAT, @SEL_OBJCC, @SEL_OBJPERSON, @r5role
		if @@ERROR <> 0
			return -1

name: O7REPWZMPAT_REPPARSEMP
body:
CREATE function O7REPWZMPAT_REPPARSEMP ( @SEL_MPAT nvarchar(4000))
RETURNS nvarchar(4000)
as

BEGIN
declare @sSelMP nvarchar(4000)
declare @sTempMP nvarchar(100)
declare @sMPStr nvarchar(4000)
declare @sReturn nvarchar(4000)


    set @sSelMP = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SEL_MPAT))                
    IF (charindex( ',', @sSelMP,1) > 0) 
        begin                           
            IF len(@sSelMP) > 0  
                set @sMPStr = N' AND mtp_code IN (' 
            
            WHILE (len(@sSelMP) > 0)
                begin
                    IF (charindex(N',', @sSelMP, 1) > 0) 
                        begin 
                            set @sTempMP = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelMP, 1,charindex(N',', @sSelMP, 1)-1)))
                            set @sSelMP = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sSelMP, charindex( N',', @sSelMP, 1)+1,len(@sSelMP)-charindex( ',', @sSelMP, 1)+1)))
                        end
                    ELSE
                        begin
                            set @sTempMP = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSelMP)) 
                            set @sSelMP = ''
                        end
                    set @sMPStr = @sMPStr +  'N''' +  @sTempMP +  ''','     
                end
            IF (len(@sMPStr) > 0) 
                begin
                    set @sMPStr = LTRIM(RTRIM(substring(@sMPStr, 1, len(@sMPStr)-1)))
                    set @sMPStr = @sMPStr +  N')'
                end
            set @sReturn = @sMPStr
        end
    ELSE
        set @sReturn = ' '

    RETURN @sReturn

end 
0

            if @@ERROR <> 0

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[O7REPWZPMFC_GET_COUNT](@LINE INTEGER,@DUEDATE DATETIME,@WEEKEND DATETIME)
RETURNS INTEGER AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @COUNT INTEGER
	DECLARE @C INTEGER
	DECLARE @D DATETIME
	DECLARE @L INTEGER
	SET @COUNT=0
	DECLARE  SS CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT PPD_DUEDATE,PPD_LINE FROM R5PMPSESSIONDATES WHERE PPD_LINE=@LINE AND (PPD_DUEDATE BETWEEN @WEEKEND-6 AND @WEEKEND) ORDER BY PPD_DUEDATE  
	OPEN SS
	FETCH NEXT FROM SS INTO @D,@L
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		
			SET @COUNT=@COUNT+1
			IF (@DUEDATE = @D) 
			BEGIN
						RETURN @COUNT
			END
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM SS INTO @D,@L
	END
	CLOSE SS
	
	
	RETURN @COUNT
END

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[O7REPWZPMFC_GET_VALUE](@LINE INTEGER,@DUEDATE DATETIME,@UOM NVARCHAR,@FREQ INTEGER,@LOCKED NVARCHAR) RETURNS INTEGER 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @VAL INTEGER
	DECLARE @ACTDATE DATETIME
	DECLARE @WO INTEGER
	DECLARE @ISACTUAL INTEGER
	
	SET @VAL=@FREQ
	IF(@UOM='D') SET @VAL= @VAL*10+1
	IF(@UOM='W') SET @VAL= @VAL*10+2
	IF(@UOM='M') SET @VAL= @VAL*10+3
	IF(@UOM='Q') SET @VAL= @VAL*10+4
	IF(@UOM='Y') SET @VAL= @VAL*10+5
	SET @VAL= @VAL*10+DATEPART(DW,@DUEDATE)
        SELECT @ISACTUAL=COUNT(*) FROM R5PMPSESSIONDATES WHERE PPD_LINE= @LINE AND PPD_WORKORDER IS NULL AND PPD_DUEDATE = @DUEDATE AND PPD_ISPROJECTED = '-' 
        SELECT @WO=COUNT(*)  FROM R5PMPSESSIONDATES WHERE PPD_LINE= @LINE AND PPD_WORKORDER IS NOT NULL AND PPD_DUEDATE = @DUEDATE
	IF(@WO=1) SET @VAL= @VAL*10+1
	ELSE IF(@ISACTUAL=1) SET @VAL= @VAL*10+2
	ELSE SET @VAL= @VAL*10+3
	IF (@LOCKED = '+') SET @VAL= @VAL*10+1
	ELSE		   SET @VAL= @VAL*10
	RETURN @VAL
END

 BEGIN

name: O7REPWZPTWR_REPPARSEPTW
body:
CREATE FUNCTION O7REPWZPTWR_REPPARSEPTW ( @SEL_PTW NVARCHAR(4000))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
AS

BEGIN
DECLARE @sSelPTW NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @sTempPTW NVARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @sPTWStr NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @sReturn NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @sFromPTW NVARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @sToPTW NVARCHAR(100)


    SET @sSelPTW = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SEL_PTW))                
    IF (CHARINDEX( ',', @sSelPTW,1) > 0) 
        BEGIN                           
            IF LEN(@sSelPTW) > 0  
                SET @sPTWStr = N' AND p.ptw_code IN (' 
            
            WHILE (LEN(@sSelPTW) > 0)
                BEGIN
                    IF (CHARINDEX(N',', @sSelPTW, 1) > 0) 
                        BEGIN 
                            SET @sTempPTW = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@sSelPTW, 1,CHARINDEX(N',', @sSelPTW, 1)-1)))
                            SET @sSelPTW = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@sSelPTW, CHARINDEX( N',', @sSelPTW, 1)+1,LEN(@sSelPTW)-CHARINDEX( ',', @sSelPTW, 1)+1)))
                        END
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SET @sTempPTW = LTRIM(RTRIM(@sSelPTW)) 
                            SET @sSelPTW = ''
                        END
                    SET @sPTWStr = @sPTWStr +  'N''' +  @sTempPTW +  ''','     
                END
            IF (LEN(@sPTWStr) > 0) 
                BEGIN
                    SET @sPTWStr = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@sPTWStr, 1, LEN(@sPTWStr)-1)))
                    SET @sPTWStr = @sPTWStr +  N')'
                END
            SET @sReturn = @sPTWStr
        END
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (CHARINDEX('-', @sSelPTW,1) > 0) 
                BEGIN
                    set @sFromPTW = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@sSelPTW, 1,CHARINDEX(N'-', @sSelPTW, 1)-1)))
                    set @sToPTW = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@sSelPTW, CHARINDEX( N'-', @sSelPTW, 1)+1,len(@sSelPTW)-CHARINDEX( N'-', @sSelPTW, 1)+1)))
                    set @sReturn = N' AND p.ptw_code BETWEEN ''' +  @sFromPTW +  ''' AND ''' +  @sToPTW +  ''' '
                END
            ELSE
				SET @sReturn = ' '
        END
    RETURN @sReturn

END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7REPWZVRHS_WZVRHS (
       @R5_FUNC NVARCHAR(6)
     , @R5_LANG NVARCHAR(2)
     , @R5_USER NVARCHAR(255)
     , @SEL_ORGANIZATION NVARCHAR(15)  
     , @SEL_VEHICLE NVARCHAR(30) 
     , @SEL_VEHICLETYPE NVARCHAR(8) 
     , @SEL_CLASS NVARCHAR(8) 
     , @SEL_ISSUETO NVARCHAR(15) 
     , @SEL_CREATEDBY NVARCHAR(255) 
     , @SEL_CUSTOMER NVARCHAR(30) 
     , @SEL_LOCATION NVARCHAR(50) 
     , @SEL_STATUS NVARCHAR(4) 
     , @SEL_START NVARCHAR(11) 
     , @SEL_END NVARCHAR(11) 
     , @SEL_INCLUDE NVARCHAR(3) 
     , @SEL_OVERDUEISSUEBUF NVARCHAR(10)
     , @SEL_OVERDUERETURNBUF NVARCHAR(10)
     , @SEL_GROUPBY NVARCHAR(1)
     , @sCurrUser NVARCHAR(255)
     , @r5role NVARCHAR(30)
)

AS 
BEGIN

    declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'
     
     SELECT cr.CRT_ORG AS ORGANIZATION
          , cr.CRT_CODE AS CUSTOMERRENTAL
          , cr.CRT_TYPE AS RENTALTYPE
          , cr.CRT_STATUS AS RENTALSTATUS
          , cr.CRT_OBJECT AS VEHICLE
          , cr.CRT_VEHICLETYPE AS VEHICLETYPE
          , cr.CRT_CLASS AS CLASS
          , cr.CRT_ISSUEDTO AS ISSUETO
          , cr.CRT_CUSTOMER AS CUSTOMER
          , cr.CRT_CONTACT AS CUSTOMERCONTACT
          , cr.CRT_PHONE AS PHONENUMBER
          , cr.CRT_PHONE2 AS WORKPHONENO
          , cr.CRT_EMAIL AS EMAILADDRESS
          , cr.CRT_REFERENCE AS REFERENCE
          , cr.CRT_LICENSE AS DRIVERSLICENCENO
          , cr.CRT_COSTCODE AS COSTCODE 
          , cr.CRT_CREATEDBY AS CREATEDBY
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_CREATED) AS DATECREATED
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_COMPLETED) AS COMPLETED
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ISSUEDATE) AS ISSUEDATETIME
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ESTIMATEDISSUEDATE) AS ESTIMATEDISSUEDATETIME
          , dbo.REPFMTNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ISSUEREADING) AS ISSUEREADING
          , cr.CRT_ISSUEREADINGUOM AS ISSUEREADINGUOM
          , dbo.REPFMTNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ISSUEFUELLEVEL) AS ISSUEFUELLEVEL
          , cr.CRT_ISSUELOCATION AS ISSUELOCATION
          , cr.CRT_ISSUEDBY AS ISSUEDBY
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_RETURNDATE) AS RETURNDATETIME
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ESTIMATEDRETURNDATE) AS ESTIMATEDRETURNDATETIME
          , dbo.REPFMTNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_RETURNREADING) AS RETURNREADING
          , dbo.REPFMTNUMLOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_RETURNFUELLEVEL) AS RETURNFUELLEVEL
          , cr.CRT_RETURNLOCATION AS RETURNLOCATION
          , cr.CRT_RETURNEDTO AS RETURNEDTO
          , dbo.REPGETDESC(@R5_LANG, 'ORG', cr.CRT_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS ORGDESC
          , cr.CRT_DESC AS CUSTOMERRENTALDESC
	      , dbo.REPGETDESC(@R5_LANG, 'UCOD', cr.CRT_STATUS, 'RNST', NULL) AS RENTALSTATUSDESC
          , dbo.REPGETDESC(@R5_LANG, 'OBJ', cr.CRT_OBJECT + '#' + cr.CRT_OBJECT_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS VEHICLEDESC
          , dbo.REPGETDESC(@R5_LANG, 'CLAS', cr.CRT_CLASS + '#' + cr.CRT_CLASS_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS CLASSDESC
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ESTIMATEDISSUEDATE) AS ESTIMATEDISSUEDATE
          , dbo.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@R5_USER, cr.CRT_ORG, cr.CRT_ESTIMATEDRETURNDATE) AS ESTIMATEDRETURNDATE
          

     FROM R5CUSTOMERRENTALS cr
     WHERE EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM R5USERORGANIZATION uog
               INNER JOIN R5PERMISSIONS prm
                    ON uog.uog_group = prm.prm_group
                    AND prm.prm_function = @R5_FUNC
                    AND prm.prm_select = '?'
               WHERE uog.uog_user = @R5_USER
                    AND uog.uog_role = @r5role
                    AND uog.uog_org = cr.CRT_ORG
          )
		  AND ( ( @deptsec  = N'ON' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 
		  FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY WHERE DSE_USER = @R5_USER  AND DSE_MRC = (SELECT obj_mrc FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = cr.CRT_OBJECT AND obj_org = cr.CRT_OBJECT_ORG )  ) )  OR  ( @deptsec  = N'OFF'))
          AND @R5_USER = UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
		  AND cr.CRT_OBJECT IS NOT NULL
          AND ((@SEL_ORGANIZATION = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_ORG, '%') LIKE @SEL_ORGANIZATION))
          AND ((@SEL_VEHICLE = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_OBJECT, '%') LIKE @SEL_VEHICLE))
          AND ((@SEL_VEHICLETYPE = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_VEHICLETYPE, '%') LIKE @SEL_VEHICLETYPE))
          AND ((@SEL_CLASS = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_CLASS, '%') LIKE @SEL_CLASS))
          AND ((@SEL_ISSUETO = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_ISSUEDTO, '%') LIKE @SEL_ISSUETO))
          AND ((@SEL_CREATEDBY = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_CREATEDBY, '%') LIKE @SEL_CREATEDBY))
          AND ((@SEL_CUSTOMER = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_CUSTOMER, '%') LIKE @SEL_CUSTOMER))
          AND ((@SEL_LOCATION = '%') OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_ISSUELOCATION, '%') LIKE @SEL_LOCATION))
          AND ((@SEL_STATUS = '%' AND cr.CRT_RSTATUS IN ('U', 'I', 'R', 'COM')) OR (COALESCE(cr.CRT_STATUS, '%') LIKE @SEL_STATUS))
          AND ((@SEL_START = '%') OR (dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CRT_ESTIMATEDISSUEDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= @SEL_START))
          AND ((@SEL_END = '%') OR (dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CRT_ESTIMATEDISSUEDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= @SEL_END))
          AND ((COALESCE(NULLIF(@SEL_INCLUDE, '%'),'A') = 'A')
               OR ((@SEL_INCLUDE = 'O')
                    AND (cr.CRT_RSTATUS IN ('I', 'R', 'COM'))
                    AND ((DATEADD(hh, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(@SEL_OVERDUEISSUEBUF, '%'), '0') AS NUMERIC), CRT_ESTIMATEDISSUEDATE) < COALESCE(CRT_ISSUEDATE, GETDATE()))
                         OR (DATEADD(hh, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(@SEL_OVERDUERETURNBUF, '%'), '0') AS NUMERIC), CRT_ESTIMATEDRETURNDATE) < COALESCE(CRT_RETURNDATE, GETDATE())))
                    )
               )

END

CREATE  FUNCTION O7REPWZVRSL_GET_DATES (@sSESSIONID   INTEGER, @sGROUPBY   nvarchar(5))
RETURNS @tReturn table(wzvrsl_sdate   DATETIME,
				       wzvrsl_edate   DATETIME) AS
 BEGIN
 declare @sdate1 DATETIME
 declare @edate1 DATETIME
 declare @startday INTEGER
 declare @grp_startdate DATETIME
 declare @grp_enddate DATETIME
 declare @N INTEGER

    SELECT @startday=ISNULL(LOC_STARTDAY,0) 
    FROM R5LOCALE 
    WHERE LOC_CODE = (SELECT INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE='LOCALE')

    SELECT @sdate1=PFP_STARTDATE ,@edate1=PFP_ENDDATE
    FROM R5PMFORECASTPARAMS
    WHERE PFP_SESSIONID=@sSESSIONID

IF @sGROUPBY = 'W' 
  BEGIN
    
		SET @startday = @startday+1 
		SET @N = DATEPART(Dw,@sdate1)-@startday

		 IF @N=0  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+6
		 IF @N=1  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+5
		 IF @N=2  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+4
		 IF @N=3  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+3
		 IF @N=4  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+2
		 IF @N=5  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+1
		 IF @N=6  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1
		 IF @N=-1  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1
		 IF @N=-2  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+1
		 IF @N=-3  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+2
		 IF @N=-4  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+3
		 IF @N=-5  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+4
		 IF @N=-6  SET @grp_enddate = @sdate1+5

		SET @grp_startdate =  @sdate1

		 WHILE @grp_enddate <= @edate1+6
		 BEGIN

			IF @grp_enddate < @edate1			
				INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@grp_startdate,@grp_enddate)
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@grp_startdate,@edate1)

			 SET @grp_startdate = @grp_enddate+1
			 SET @grp_enddate   = @grp_enddate+7
	     
		  END
  END

ELSE IF @sGROUPBY = 'M' 
  BEGIN

	  SET @grp_startdate =  @sdate1;
	  SET @grp_enddate   =  dateadd(d,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,@grp_startdate)+1,0))

		WHILE @grp_enddate <= DATEADD(month,1,@edate1)-1
			BEGIN
				IF @grp_enddate < @edate1
					INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@grp_startdate,@grp_enddate)
				ELSE
					INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@grp_startdate,@edate1) 

				 SET @grp_startdate = @grp_enddate+1;
				 SET @grp_enddate   = dateadd(d,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,@grp_startdate)+1,0))
		    END
  END

ELSE
  BEGIN
		
		DECLARE @D DATETIME	
		DECLARE SS CURSOR LOCAL FOR select distinct pft_date from r5pmforecastresload

			 OPEN SS
			 FETCH NEXT FROM SS INTO @D
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
 				   INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@D,@D)
				   FETCH NEXT FROM SS INTO @D
				END
			 CLOSE SS
  END

     RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPWZVRSL_WZVRSL
                @sSESSIONID  nvarchar(10),
                @sGROUPBY    nvarchar(5),
                @sTRADE      nvarchar(30),
                @sR5USER     nvarchar(255),
                @sR5ORG      nvarchar(15),
                @sCurrUser NVARCHAR( 255 )

AS
	   SET NOCOUNT ON

       declare @sSelect           nvarchar(4000) 
       declare @sSelectUnion      nvarchar(4000) 
       declare @sFrom             nvarchar(4000) 
       declare @sWhereClause      nvarchar(2000) 
       declare @sGroupByS         nvarchar(2000) 
       declare @sOrderBy          nvarchar(2000) 

       declare @sSQL		  nvarchar(4000)

       declare @schk NVARCHAR(4) 
       declare @sSD datetime
       declare @sED datetime
	   declare @deptsec  nvarchar(400)

       SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'


		SET @schk = '0'


		SET @sFrom = ' r5pmforecastparams, R5PMFORECASTRESLOAD, DBO.O7REPWZVRSL_GET_DATES(''' + @sSESSIONID + ''',''' + @sGROUPBY + ''') '

		SET @sWhereClause = ' PFT_SESSIONID = PFP_SESSIONID ' +
						 ' AND PFP_SESSIONID = ''' + @sSESSIONID + ''' ' +
						 ' AND PFT_DATE BETWEEN WZVRSL_SDATE AND WZVRSL_EDATE '
						 +' AND ( ('''+ @deptsec +''' = N''ON'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY WHERE DSE_USER = '''+@sR5USER+'''    AND DSE_MRC = pfp_mrcs ) ) OR ( '''+ @deptsec  +'''= N''OFF'')) '
                         
        IF @sR5User <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
           SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '

		SET @sGroupByS = ' PFT_TRADE, PFP_WORKHOURS, WZVRSL_SDATE, WZVRSL_EDATE '

		SET @sOrderBy = ' PFT_TRADE, WZVRSL_SDATE '

SELECT DISTINCT @sSD=PFP_STARTDATE, @sED=PFP_ENDDATE  
								FROM R5PMFORECASTPARAMS
								WHERE PFP_SESSIONID = '' + @sSESSIONID + ''
 
	execute O7GENRESLOAD   @sSESSIONID , @sSD, @sED, @sCHK		  -- CALL PROCEDURE TO REFRESH TABLE

        IF (@sTRADE <> '%') 
            SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND PFT_TRADE LIKE ''' + @sTRADE + '''' 


SET @sSelect = ' PFP_WORKHOURS , ' +
                      'PFT_TRADE, ' +
                      'WZVRSL_SDATE, ' +
                      'WZVRSL_EDATE, ' +
                      'dbo.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(''' + @sR5USER + ''',  ''' + @sR5ORG + ''',WZVRSL_EDATE) AS WZVRSL_EDATE_FMT, ' +
                      'CONVERT(INTEGER, SUM(PFT_HOURS)) AS ESTIMATED_HOURS, ' +
                      'CONVERT(NUMERIC(8,2), (SUM(PFT_HOURS)/PFP_WORKHOURS)) AS RDAYS_REQD ' 

SET @sSelectUnion = ' 0  PFP_WORKHOURS, ' +
                      ''' ''  PFT_TRADE, ' +
                      'NULL WZVRSL_SDATE, ' +
                      'NULL WZVRSL_EDATE, ' +
                      '''X''  WZVRSL_EDATE_FMT, ' +
                      '0  ESTIMATED_HOURS, ' +
                      '0.0  RDAYS_REQD ' 

set @sSQL = ' SELECT '+ coalesce(@sSelect,'') + 
			' FROM '+ coalesce(@sFrom,'') + 
			' WHERE '+ coalesce(@sWhereClause, '') + 
			' GROUP BY '+ coalesce(@sGroupByS, '') +
			' UNION ALL SELECT ' + @sSelectUnion + 
			' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ' + coalesce(@sFrom,'') + 
			' WHERE '+ coalesce(@sWhereClause, '')  + ')' +
			' ORDER BY '+ coalesce(@sOrderBy, '')


		execute sp_executesql @sSQL 
                if @@ERROR <> 0
	                return -1

CREATE function [dbo].[O7REPWZWFMC_CURCOSTS] (@sCode nvarchar(30),
                                 @sCosttype nvarchar(20),
                                 @sStartdate nvarchar(10),
                                 @sEnddate   nvarchar(10))
 RETURNS numeric(30,6)
as
begin
declare @sRouteparent	nvarchar(30)		
declare @nCost          numeric (30,6)
declare @nAmount        numeric (30,6)
declare @nTotcost       numeric (30,6)
declare @nEstcost	numeric(30,6)
declare @nActcost		numeric(30,6)
declare @nEvents        numeric(10)
declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
declare @sDforgwo   	nvarchar(30)
declare @sDfrelwo   	nvarchar(30)

select @sRouteparent=evt_routeparent 
    from r5events 
    where evt_code =@sCode
  if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
    	set @sRouteparent = null
select @nEvents=count(*) 
    from r5events 
    where evt_routeparent=@sRouteparent
   if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
    	set @sRouteparent = null
set @nTotcost=0

/* To calculate the Remaining Labor */
if @sCosttype = N'RL'
   begin
 /* Estimated Labor */
     set @nCost=0
     set @nAmount=0
     if  @sRouteParent is null
     begin
     select @nCost = round( sum( coalesce( a.act_est, 0 )* coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
				 from  r5events e, r5activities a 
				 where  a.act_hire  = N'-'
                 and    a.act_event = e.evt_code
				 and    a.act_order is null 
                 and    a.act_defermaintenance =N'-'
                 and    evt_routeparent IS NULL
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate    
                 and    a.act_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )
      set @nEstcost= (coalesce(@nCost,0))
      end
      else
      begin  
      set  @nAmount = (select sum( b.est* coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) )
				 from   r5activities a ,( select coalesce ( act_est/@nEvents, 0 )est,act_act
                           from r5activities 
                           where act_event=@sRouteparent) b
				 where  a.act_hire  = N'-'
                 and    a.act_act=b.act_act
                 and    a.act_order is null 
                 and    a.act_defermaintenance =N'-'
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate
                 and    a.act_event = @sCode)    
      set @nEstcost= (coalesce(@nAmount,0))   
      end
          
 /* Actual Labor */
   set @nCost = 0
   select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
				 from r5activities a, r5bookedhours b 
				 where  a.act_event = b.boo_event
				 and    a.act_act   = b.boo_act
                 and    a.act_defermaintenance =N'-'
				 and    b.boo_order is null
				 and    b.boo_routertype is null
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate
                 AND    NOT ( b.boo_misc = '+' AND b.boo_ocrtype IN ( 'O', 'X' ) )
                 AND    ( a.act_order IS NULL OR b.boo_misc = '+' OR b.boo_misc = 'I' )
                 and   b.boo_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))
    set  @nActCost = coalesce(@nCost,0)

set @nTotcost=coalesce((@nEstcost-@nActcost),0)
 if @nTotcost<0
     return (0)
 else
     return (@nTotcost)
end

/* To calculate the Remaining Service Cost*/
if @sCosttype = N'RS'
   begin
 /* Estimated Service Cost*/   
   set @nCost = 0
   set @nAmount=0
   if @sRouteParent is null
   begin
   select @nCost = round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END  *
											coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 1 )  ), 2 ) 
				 from  r5events e, r5activities a 
				 where a.act_hire  = N'+'
				 and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
                 and    a.act_defermaintenance =N'-' 
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate
				 and   coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N'ST' ) = N'SF'
                 and evt_routeparent IS NULL  
                 and a.act_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))
   set @nEstcost = coalesce(@nCost,0)
   end
   else
   begin
   set @nAmount = ( select sum(b.amt)
                 from  r5activities a ,(select  (( CASE WHEN (act_order IS NULL AND act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END  *
											            coalesce( act_ntrate, 1 ))/@nEvents)amt,act_act
                                                from r5activities
                                                where act_hire = N'+'
                                                and act_event=@sRouteparent
                                                and   coalesce( act_ordrtype, N'ST' ) = N'SF')b
				 where a.act_act=b.act_act
                 and a.act_hire  = N'+'
				 and   a.act_defermaintenance =N'-' 
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate
				 and a.act_event = @sCode)
    set @nEstcost = coalesce( @nAmount, 0 )
    end
    
 /* Actual Service Cost*/
   set @nCost = 0
   select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
	             from  r5activities a, r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l
                 on   b.boo_event = l.orl_event and b.boo_act = l.orl_act 
                 where a.act_event = b.boo_event
                 and   a.act_act = b.boo_act
                 and   a.act_defermaintenance =N'-'
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate
                AND   ( ( b.boo_misc = '+' and b.boo_ocrtype = 'X' ) 
                          OR ( b.boo_misc = '-' 
                               AND ( ( l.orl_rtype = 'SF' AND NOT ( l.orl_rstatus = 'C' AND COALESCE( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) = 0 ) ) 
                                     OR b.boo_routertype = 'SF' ) ) )
                 and b.boo_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))
    set @nActCost = coalesce(@nCost,0)

set @nTotcost=coalesce((@nEstcost-@nActcost),0)
 if @nTotcost<0
     return (0)
 else
     return (@nTotcost)
 
 end

/*To calculate the Remaining Tool Cost*/
if @sCosttype = N'RT'
Begin
/*Estimated tool cost*/
    set @nCost = 0
    set @nAmount=0
    if @sRouteParent is null
    begin
    select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( t.tor_qty, 0 ) *
								isnull( t.tor_hours, 0 ) * m.mrt_tariff ) ,2) 
               	 from  r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5events e
				 where  a.act_event = t.tor_event
                 and    a.act_act = t.tor_act
                 and    m.mrt_mrc = t.tor_mrc
                 and    m.mrt_tool = t.tor_tool
                 and    m.mrt_org  = e.evt_org
                 and    a.act_event = e.evt_code
                 and    a.act_defermaintenance =N'-'
                 and    substring(convert(varchar(30), a.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddate
                 and    evt_routeparent IS NULL 
                 and    a.act_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode )) 
     set @nEstcost = coalesce (@nCost,0)
     end
     else
     begin
     set @nAmount = (select sum(b.amt)
        from r5activities c, (select (( isnull( t.tor_qty, 0 ) *
								isnull( t.tor_hours, 0 ) * m.mrt_tariff )/@nEvents)amt,a.act_act 
               	 from  r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m 
				 where  a.act_event = t.tor_event
                 and    a.act_act = t.tor_act
                 and    m.mrt_mrc = t.tor_mrc
                 and    m.mrt_tool = t.tor_tool
                 and    a.act_event =@sRouteparent)b
        where c.act_act=b.act_act
        and   c.act_defermaintenance=N'-'
        and    substring(convert(varchar(30), c.act_start, 120), 1, 10) between @sStartdate and @sEnddat
