CREATE function [dbo].[O7REPWZWFMC_FUTCOSTS](@sMrc  nvarchar(30),
                                    @nEst  numeric(10),
                                    @sTrade  nvarchar(10),
                                    @sHire  nvarchar(10),
                                    @sTool  nvarchar(30),
                                    @nQty  numeric(10),
                                    @nHour  numeric(10),
                                    @sDuedate  datetime,
                                    @sCosttype  nvarchar(20),
                                    @sMatlist  nvarchar(30),
                                    @sPmorg  nvarchar(30))                                                        
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin

declare @nCost numeric(30,6)
declare @nNtrate numeric(30,6)
declare @nTariff numeric(30,6)
declare @sCpricelevel nvarchar(200);

/* To calculate the Estimated  labor for Future Pm's*/

if @sCosttype ='FEL' 
begin
   SET @nNtrate= isnull(isnull((select trr_ntrate
           from r5traderates
           where trr_trade=@sTrade
           and   trr_mrc=@sMrc
           and   trr_person ='*'
           and   trr_supplier = '*'
           and   trr_supplier_org = '*'
           AND   trr_org = @sPmorg
           and   trr_octype = (SELECT  uco_code
                    FROM   r5ucodes s
                    WHERE   s.uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                    AND     s.uco_rcode = N'N'
                    AND     s.uco_system  = N'+')
           and   @sDuedate >=trr_start
           and   @sDuedate <=trr_end),(select trr_ntrate 
                                         from r5traderates 
                                         where trr_trade=@sTrade
                                         and   trr_mrc=@sMrc
                                         and   trr_person ='*'
                                         and   trr_supplier = '*'
                                         and   trr_supplier_org = '*'
                                         AND   trr_org = @sPmorg
                                         and   trr_octype = (SELECT  uco_code
                                                                FROM   r5ucodes s
                                                                WHERE   s.uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                                                                AND     s.uco_rcode = N'N'
                                                                AND     s.uco_system  = N'+')
                                         and   trr_end in (select max(trr_end) 
                                                                from r5traderates 
                                                                where trr_trade=@sTrade
                                                                  and   trr_mrc=@sMrc
                                                                  and   trr_person ='*'
                                                                  and   trr_supplier = '*'
                                                                  and   trr_supplier_org = '*'
                                                                  AND   trr_org = @sPmorg
                                                                  and   trr_octype = (SELECT  uco_code
                                                                            FROM   r5ucodes s
                                                                            WHERE   s.uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                                                                            AND     s.uco_rcode = N'N'
                                                                            AND     s.uco_system  = N'+')))),0)
   if @sHire='-' 
          return (coalesce((@nEst*@nNtrate),0))
   else
          return (0)
end 

/* To calculate the Estimated  Service  for Future Pm's*/

if @sCosttype ='FES'
begin
       SET @nNtrate= isnull(isnull((select trr_ntrate
           from r5traderates
           where trr_trade=@sTrade
           and   trr_mrc=@sMrc
           and   trr_person ='*'
           and   trr_supplier = '*'
           and   trr_supplier_org = '*'
           AND   trr_org = @sPmorg
           and   trr_octype = (SELECT  uco_code
                                FROM   r5ucodes s
                                WHERE   s.uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                                AND     s.uco_rcode = N'N'
                                AND     s.uco_system  = N'+')
           and   @sDuedate >=trr_start
           and   @sDuedate <=trr_end),(select trr_ntrate 
                                         from r5traderates 
                                         where trr_trade=@sTrade
                                         and   trr_mrc=@sMrc
                                         and   trr_person ='*'
                                         and   trr_supplier = '*'
                                         and   trr_supplier_org = '*'
                                         AND   trr_org = @sPmorg
                                         and   trr_octype = (SELECT  uco_code
                                                            FROM   r5ucodes s
                                                            WHERE   s.uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                                                            AND     s.uco_rcode = N'N'
                                                            AND     s.uco_system  = N'+')
                                         and   trr_end in (select max(trr_end) 
                                                                        from r5traderates 
                                                                        where trr_trade=@sTrade
                                                                          and   trr_mrc=@sMrc
                                                                          and   trr_person ='*'
                                                                          and   trr_supplier = '*'
                                                                          and   trr_supplier_org = '*'
                                                                          AND   trr_org = @sPmorg
                                                                          and   trr_octype = (SELECT  uco_code
                                                                                    FROM   r5ucodes s
                                                                                    WHERE   s.uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                                                                                    AND     s.uco_rcode = N'N'
                                                                                    AND     s.uco_system  = N'+')))),0)
   if @sHire='+' 
          return (coalesce((@nEst*@nNtrate),0))
   else
          return (0)
end 

/* To calculate the Estimated  Tools  for Future Pm's*/

if @sCosttype ='FET'
begin

     select @nTariff=mrt_tariff 
            from r5mrctools
            where mrt_tool = @sTool
            and  mrt_mrc=@sMrc

return (coalesce((@nQty*@nHour*@nTariff),0))
end

/* To calculate the Estimated  Materials for Future Pm's*/

if @sCosttype ='FEM'
begin
    set @nCost=0
    select @sCpricelevel= coalesce( i.ins_desc, 'P' )
           from    r5install  i
           where  i.ins_code = 'PRICELEV';

    select @nCost=round( coalesce( sum( coalesce(dbo.o7getprc( ' ', m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,@sPmorg,'B',@sCpricelevel,' ' ), 0 ) *
                  coalesce( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) 
           from  r5matlparts m
           where  m.mlp_matlist =@sMatlist

    return(coalesce(@nCost,0))
 end
return(0)
 
end

CREATE function [dbo].[O7REPWZWFMC_GETNOFOCCUR](@sFunc nvarchar(6),

                                     @sobj nvarchar(30),
                                     @Startdate nvarchar(10),

create function O7REPWZWOLM_MULTIPARAM ( 
     @sEvent nvarchar(30),
     @sOrg nvarchar(30),
     @sIncident nvarchar(4000),
     @sCompliance nvarchar(4000)
)
RETURNS nvarchar(1)
AS
BEGIN

     DECLARE @sReturn nvarchar(1)
     
     SET @sReturn= '-'
     
     SELECT @sReturn = '+'
	FROM DUAL 
	WHERE EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM R5EVENTS evt
          WHERE evt_code = @sEvent
               AND evt_org = @sOrg
               AND ((@sIncident = '%') OR ((@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_FIREINCIDENT%' AND  EVT_FIREINCIDENT = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_HAZMATINCIDENT%' AND EVT_HAZMATINCIDENT = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_MEDICEQUIPINCIDENT%' AND EVT_MEDICEQUIPINCIDENT = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_PROPERTYDAMAGE%' AND EVT_PROPERTYDAMAGE = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_SECURITYINCIDENT%' AND EVT_SECURITYINCIDENT = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_STAFFINJURY%' AND EVT_STAFFINJURY = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_UTILITYINCIDENT%' AND EVT_UTILITYINCIDENT = '+')
                              OR (@sIncident LIKE '%EVT_VISITORINJURY%' AND EVT_VISITORINJURY = '+')))
               AND ((@sCompliance= '%') OR ((@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_CEILPERMIT%' AND EVT_CEILPERMIT = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_LIFESAFETY%' AND EVT_HAZMATINCIDENT = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_INFECTCONTROL%' AND EVT_INFECTCONTROL = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_PCRA%' AND EVT_PCRA = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_PFI%' AND EVT_PFI = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_BURNPERMIT%' AND EVT_BURNPERMIT = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_PATIENTSAFETY%' AND EVT_PATIENTSAFETY = '+')
                              OR (@sCompliance LIKE '%EVT_RECALLNOTICE%' AND EVT_RECALLNOTICE = '+'))

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPWZWOSHCOST ( 
    @ctype      NVARCHAR( 16 ),
    @incode     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
    @wocost     NUMERIC( 30, 6 ) OUTPUT )
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @actlab     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @actmat     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @actdma     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @acthir     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @actfix     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @acttool    NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @estlab     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @estmat     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @estdma     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @esthir     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @estfix     NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @esttool    NUMERIC( 30, 6 )
    DECLARE @stmt       NVARCHAR( 4000 )
    DECLARE @return     INT


    IF @ctype = N'PLHRS' 
        BEGIN
           SELECT @wocost   = SUM( act_est )
           FROM   r5activities
           WHERE  act_event = @incode
        END

    IF @ctype = N'ACTUAL'
        BEGIN
           SET @actlab  = 0.0
           SET @actmat  = 0.0
           SET @actdma  = 0.0
           SET @acthir  = 0.0
           SET @actfix  = 0.0
           SET @acttool = 0.0
           SET @stmt    = ''

           EXECUTE @return = o7actlab N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @actlab OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
                IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7actmat N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @actmat OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7actdma N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @actdma OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7acthir N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @acthir OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7actfix N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @actfix OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7acttool N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @acttool OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           SET @wocost = ( COALESCE(@actlab, 0.0) + COALESCE(@actmat, 0.0) + COALESCE(@actdma, 0.0) + COALESCE(@acthir, 0.0) + COALESCE(@actfix, 0.0) + COALESCE(@acttool, 0.0) )
        END

    IF @ctype = N'ESTIMATED'
        BEGIN
           SET @estlab  = 0.0
           SET @estmat  = 0.0
           SET @estdma  = 0.0
           SET @esthir  = 0.0
           SET @estfix  = 0.0
           SET @esttool = 0.0
           SET @stmt    = ''
           
           EXECUTE @return = o7estlab N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @estlab OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7estmat N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @estmat OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7estdma N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @estdma OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7esthir N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @esthir OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7estfix N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @estfix OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           EXECUTE @return = o7esttool N'EVT', @incode, null, null, null, @esttool OUTPUT, @stmt OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                   RETURN -1

           SET @wocost = ( COALESCE(@estlab, 0.0) + COALESCE(@estmat, 0.0) + COALESCE(@estdma, 0.0) + COALESCE(@esthir, 0.0) + COALESCE(@estfix, 0.0) + COALESCE(@esttool, 0.0) )

        END

returns numeric(24,6)
as
	begin

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REVISI
    @sCorder       nvarchar(30),
    @sCorg         nvarchar(30),
    @nNrevision    int,
    @sCuser        nvarchar(255),
    @sChk          nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCorder    IS NULL
    OR @nNrevision IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
	end

	DELETE FROM r5ordrevisions
	WHERE  ORR_REVISION = @nNrevision
	AND    ORR_ORDER    = @sCorder
	AND    ORR_ORDER_ORG = @sCorg

	DELETE FROM r5orlrevisions
	WHERE  OLR_REVISION = @nNrevision
	AND    OLR_ORDER    = @sCorder
	AND    OLR_ORDER_ORG = @sCorg

	DELETE FROM r5ordclauserevs
	WHERE  OCR_REVISION = @nNrevision
	AND    OCR_ORDER    = @sCorder
	AND    OCR_ORDER_ORG = @sCorg

	DELETE FROM r5addetails
	WHERE  ADD_RENTITY = N'PORD'
	AND    ADD_CODE    = @sCorder + N'#' + @sCorg + N'R' + cast(@nNrevision as nvarchar(38))

	DELETE FROM r5addetails
	WHERE  ADD_RENTITY = N'PORL'
	AND    ADD_CODE    LIKE @sCorder + N'#' + @sCorg + N'#%R' + cast(@nNrevision as nvarchar(38))


	/* Do actual insert into revision tables, first order. */
    INSERT INTO r5ordrevisions (
          ORR_REVISION,
          ORR_REVISED,
          ORR_REVISEDORDER,
          ORR_REVISEDBY,
          ORR_ORDER,
          ORR_ORDER_ORG,
          ORR_DESC,
          ORR_CLASS,
          ORR_CLASS_ORG,
          ORR_TYPE,
          ORR_RTYPE,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ROLLBACKUDSTABLE @sScreenName     NVARCHAR(6) 
AS
BEGIN

    declare @sDropTableSql        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sDropSequence        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sTableName           nvarchar(20)
    
    SET @sDropTableSql = 'DROP TABLE '
    SET @sDropSequence = 'DROP TABLE '
    
    DECLARE cursor_udsscreen CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT  usc_tablename
    FROM    r5udfscreens
    WHERE   usc_screenname = @sScreenName
    
    OPEN cursor_udsscreen
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_udsscreen INTO @sTableName
    CLOSE cursor_udsscreen
    
    SET @sDropTableSql =  @sDropTableSql + 'U5' + @sTableName
    -- now drop the table
    IF OBJECT_ID('U5' + @sTableName) IS NOT NULL 
      EXEC (@sDropTableSql)
    
    -- Drop sequence table
    SET @sDropSequence =  @sDropSequence + 'SEQ_U5' + @sTableName
    IF OBJECT_ID('SEQ_U5' + @sTableName) IS NOT NULL 
      EXEC (@sDropSequence)
    
    -- first set generated flag to false
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
        update r5udfscreens set usc_generated = '-' where usc_screenname = @sScreenName
    COMMIT TRANSACTION


END

create function O7RPCSTL ( @sType nvarchar(16),
                           @sEvtcode  nvarchar(30),
                           @sEvtorg   nvarchar(15),
                           @nActivity numeric(8),
                           @sRepCurr  nvarchar(3),
                           @sActCurr  nvarchar(1) )
returns numeric(30,6)

as
begin
   declare @nCurrency    numeric(30,6)
   declare @nRetvalue    numeric(30,6)
   declare @sRepCurrency nvarchar(3)

   SET @nRetvalue = 0

   IF @sRepCurr = N'%'
      SET @sRepCurrency = null
   ELSE
      SET @sRepCurrency = @sRepCurr
   IF @sRepCurr = (select dbo.reporgdefcur(@sEvtorg))
      SET @nCurrency = 1
   ELSE
      SET @nCurrency = (select dbo.repexch(@sEvtcode, @sRepCurrency, @sActCurr))

   IF @sType = N'LHRS'
       BEGIN
          SELECT @nRetvalue = 
                isnull((select sum(isnull(b.boo_hours,0)) hours
                     from   r5activities a, r5bookedhours b 
                     where  a.act_event = b.boo_event and
                            a.act_act   = b.boo_act   and 
                            b.boo_order is null and
                            b.boo_routertype is null and
                            a.act_order is null and   
                            b.boo_event in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) and 
                            b.boo_act   = @nActivity ),0)+
                isnull((select sum( isnull(b.boo_hours,0)) hours
                     from   r5bookedhours b LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines l ON  b.boo_event = l.orl_event  and  b.boo_act   = l.orl_act 
                     where  ( l.orl_rtype = N'ST' or b.boo_routertype = N'ST' ) and 
                            not ( isnull( l.orl_rstatus, N'A' ) = N'C' and isnull( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) = 0 ) and 
                            b.boo_act   = @nActivity and
                            b.boo_event in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) ),0)+
                isnull((select sum( b.boo_hours ) hours
                     from   r5orderlines l,r5bookedhours b 
                    where   b.boo_order     = l.orl_order and 
                            b.boo_order_org = l.orl_order_org and 
                            b.boo_ordline   = l.orl_ordline and
                            l.orl_rtype     = N'SH' and
                            not ( l.orl_rstatus = N'C' and isnull( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) = 0 ) and 
                            b.boo_act       = @nActivity and
                            b.boo_event     in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) ),0)
          RETURN @nRetvalue
       END
   
   IF @sType = N'LCOST' 
      BEGIN
          SELECT @nRetvalue = 
                isnull((select round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs
                     from   r5activities a, r5bookedhours b 
                     where  a.act_event = b.boo_event and
                            a.act_act   = b.boo_act   and 
                            b.boo_order is null and
                            b.boo_routertype is null and
                            NOT ( b.boo_misc = '+' AND b.boo_ocrtype IN ( 'O', 'X' ) ) AND 
                            ( a.act_order IS NULL OR b.boo_misc = '+' OR b.boo_misc = 'I' ) AND  
                            b.boo_event in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) and 
                            b.boo_act   = @nActivity ),0) 
          RETURN @nRetvalue*@nCurrency
      END

   IF @sType = N'MCOST' 
      BEGIN
          SELECT @nRetvalue = 
                isnull((select round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
                                   isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs
                     from r5translines t
                     where  t.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR') and 
                            t.trl_io    = -1  and
                            t.trl_event in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) and
                            (@nActivity is null OR t.trl_act = @nActivity)),0)
                            
          RETURN @nRetvalue*@nCurrency
      END

   IF @sType = N'DCOST' 
      BEGIN
          SELECT @nRetvalue = 
                isnull((select round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
                                   isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs
                     from r5translines t
                     where  t.trl_rtype IN ( N'MISC') and 
                            t.trl_io    = 0  and
                            t.trl_event in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) and
                            (@nActivity is null OR t.trl_act = @nActivity)),0)+
                isnull((select round( sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END *
                                    ( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
                                        isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
                                       dbo.o7axtdma( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org,
                                        t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ), 2 ) costs
                     from   r5transactions a, r5translines t
                     where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code and
                            a.tra_rstatus = N'A' and
                            t.trl_io      = 0 and
                            t.trl_rtype   IN ( N'RECV', N'RETN' ) and
                            t.trl_event   in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode ))  and
                            (@nActivity is null OR t.trl_act = @nActivity)),0) +
                            
                -- Add Invoice Differences Material            
                isnull((select (( ROUND( SUM( (((isnull(i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) * isnull( i.ivl_price, 0 ) + isnull(i.ivl_tottaxamount,0 )
                            + isnull(i.ivl_totextra, 0 )) /  isnull(i.ivl_invqty, 0))
                            * CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N'I' THEN 1 WHEN N'C' THEN -1  WHEN N'D' THEN -1 END * i.ivl_invqty ) /
                            isnull( i.ivl_exch, 1 )), 2 ))) invcosts
                     from r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v 
                     where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order and
                            o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org and 
                            i.ivl_order = l.orl_order and 
                            i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org and 
                            i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline and 
                            i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code and 
                            i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org and 
                            v.inv_rstatus = N'A' and 
                            o.ord_rstatus = N'A' and 
                            l.orl_rtype   = N'PD' and 
                            isnull(i.ivl_invqty, 0) > 0 and 
                            l.orl_event in ( select evt_code from DBO.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvtcode )) and 
                            (@nActivity is null OR l.orl_act = @nActivity)),0) -
                isnull((select ( ROUND( SUM(((( isnull( l.orl_recvqty, 0 )*isnull( l.orl_price, 0 ) + isnull(l.orl_tottaxamount,0 ) ) )
                              / isnull( l.orl_exch, 1 )) / isnull( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) ) orlcosts
                     from r5orderlines l, r5orders o
                     where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order and 
                            o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org and 
                            exists (select 'X'
                                    from  r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                                    where i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                                          and   i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                                          and   i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
                                          and   i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code

   SELECT @sEvtObject = evt_object FROM r5events WHERE evt_code = @sEvtcode

								(	SELECT evt_code

   IF @sType = N'LCOST'

                     from   r5activities a, r5bookedhours b

                            a.act_act   = b.boo_act   and

   IF @sType = N'DCOST'

                                   isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs
                     from r5translines t
                     where  t.trl_rtype IN ( N'MISC') and 
                            t.trl_io    = 0  and
                            t.trl_event in 
								(	SELECT evt_code

							and

                                        isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
                                       dbo.o7axtdma( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org,

create PROCEDURE O7SBEOQA 
  @sStore        nvarchar(15),
  @sPart         nvarchar(30),
  @sPartorg      nvarchar(15),
  @sPartclass    nvarchar(8),
  @sStockclass   nvarchar(8),
  @sAbcclass     nvarchar(1),
  @nHoldingcost  numeric(24,6),
  @nOrdercost    numeric(24,6),
  @sHoldingtype  nvarchar(4),
  @sOrg          nvarchar(15),
  @sUsr          nvarchar(255),
  @dDatefrom     datetime,
  @dDateto       datetime,
  @sR5org        nvarchar(15),
  @nSessionid    numeric(24,6),
  @sRole         nvarchar(30) = '*'

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@nAnnualdemand	numeric(26,8)
	declare @nEoq			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sStopart		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sStopartorg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStostore		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nAvgprice		numeric(24,6)

	/* Delete all old records ( for Extended ). */
	IF @nSessionid <> -1 
		DELETE FROM r5eoqtemp
		WHERE  eoq_sessionid = @nSessionid


	/* Delete all records older than 5 days ( for Extended ). */
	IF @nSessionid <> -1 
		DELETE FROM r5eoqtemp
		WHERE  eoq_sessionid <> -1
		AND    eoq_date < getdate() - 5

	/* Loop through all stock records. */
	declare c_sto cursor local for SELECT sto_part, sto_part_org, sto_store,
											 dbo.o7getprc( sto_store, sto_part, sto_part_org, @sR5org, N'A', null, null )  par_avgprice
									  FROM   r5parts, r5stores, r5userorganization, r5stock
									  WHERE  sto_part = par_code
									  AND    sto_part_org = par_org
									  AND    str_code = sto_store
									  AND    str_org = uog_org
									  AND    uog_user = @sUsr
									  AND    uog_role = @sRole
									  AND    sto_store LIKE @sStore
									  AND    str_org LIKE @sOrg
									  AND    sto_part LIKE @sPart
									  AND    sto_part_org LIKE @sPartorg
									  AND    coalesce( sto_abcclass, 'a' ) LIKE @sAbcclass
									  AND    coalesce( par_class, 'a' ) LIKE @sPartclass
									  AND    coalesce( sto_class, 'a' ) LIKE @sStockclass
	open c_sto
	fetch next from c_sto into	@sStopart, @sStopartorg, @sStostore, @nAvgprice
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin

			IF @nSessionid = -1 
				/* Delete old record ( for Forms ). */
				DELETE FROM r5eoqtemp
				WHERE  eoq_part      = @sStopart
				AND    eoq_part_org  = @sStopartorg
				AND    eoq_store     = @sStostore
				AND    eoq_sessionid = -1
			

			/* Determine annual demand. */
			set @nAnnualdemand = null 

			SELECT @nAnnualdemand = CASE SIGN( SUM ( coalesce( trl_qty, 0.00 ) ) ) WHEN -1 THEN 0.00 ELSE cast(SUM( coalesce( trl_qty, 0.00 ) ) as numeric(26,8)) / ( ( cast(DATEDIFF ( dd , @dDatefrom , @dDateto ) as numeric(26,8)) + 1.00000000 ) / 365.00000000 ) END
			FROM   r5translines
			WHERE  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( trl_date, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @dDatefrom AND @dDateto
			AND    trl_rtype = N'I'
			AND    trl_part = @sStopart
			AND    trl_part_org = @sStopartorg
			AND    trl_store = @sStostore
			AND    not exists (SELECT 'X' FROM r5transactions 
			                   WHERE tra_code        = trl_trans 
							   AND   tra_fromentity  = tra_toentity
			                   AND   tra_fromrentity = 'STOR' 
							   AND   tra_fromcode    = tra_tocode)
			GROUP BY trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store;


			IF @nAnnualdemand IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					/* Only calculate EOQ when there is an annual demand. */

					IF @sHoldingtype = 'P' 
						begin
						/* @nEoq uses holding costs as a Percentage. */
							IF @nAvgprice = 0 
								set @nEoq = 0.00
							ELSE
								SELECT @nEoq = ROUND( SQRT( ( 2 * @nAnnualdemand * @nOrdercost ) / (  cast( @nAvgprice * @nHoldingcost as numeric(38,12)) / 100.00 ) ) ,6 )
							
						end
					ELSE
					/* @nEoq uses absolute holding costs. */
						select @nEoq = ROUND(SQRT( ( 2 * @nAnnualdemand * @nOrdercost ) / @nHoldingcost ), 6 )

					INSERT INTO r5eoqtemp( eoq_sessionid, eoq_part, eoq_part_org, eoq_store,
					eoq_calquantity, eoq_newquantity, eoq_flag, eoq_annualdemand, eoq_date )
					VALUES( @nSessionid, @sStopart, @sStopartorg, @sStostore, @nEoq, CEILING(@nEoq), 'Y', @nAnnualdemand, getdate() )

				end


		fetch next from c_sto into	@sStopart, @sStopartorg, @sStostore, @nAvgprice
		end
	close c_sto
	deallocate c_sto

create function O7SESDMA(   @sParent nvarchar(30),
                            @sEvent  nvarchar(30),
                            @sPricelev nvarchar(200))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nReturn        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount2        numeric(30,6)
        declare @nCount 		integer
        declare @nEvents        integer
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

        /* Retrieve number of children. */
        SELECT @nEvents = count(*)
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sParent

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */
                SELECT @nAmount = ROUND( coalesce( SUM( coalesce( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N'B', @sPricelev, null ), 0 ) * 
                            coalesce( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) 
                FROM   r5parts      p,
                     r5matlparts  m,
                     r5activities a,
                     r5events     e  left outer join r5objects    o on (o.obj_code = e.evt_object AND    o.obj_org  = e.evt_object_org)  
                                     left outer join r5mrcs       c on (e.evt_mrc      = c.mrc_code) 
                WHERE  a.act_event    = e.evt_code
                AND    p.par_code     = m.mlp_part
                AND    p.par_org      = m.mlp_part_org
                AND    m.mlp_direct   = N'+'
                AND    a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
                AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
                AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
                AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null then coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' ) WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N'C' when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' )
                AND    a.act_event = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo IS NULL

                set @nAmount = ROUND( @nAmount / @nEvents, 2 )

                /* Retrieve amount on po's specifically on current child. */
                SELECT @nAmount2 = ROUND( coalesce( SUM( coalesce( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N'B', @sPricelev, null ), 0 ) *
                            coalesce( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) 
                FROM   r5parts      p,
                     r5matlparts  m,
                     r5activities a,
                     r5events     e  left outer join r5objects    o on (o.obj_code = e.evt_object AND    o.obj_org  = e.evt_object_org)  
                                     left outer join r5mrcs       c on (e.evt_mrc      = c.mrc_code) 
                WHERE  a.act_event    = e.evt_code
                AND    p.par_code     = m.mlp_part
                AND    p.par_org      = m.mlp_part_org
                AND    m.mlp_direct   = N'+'
                AND    a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
                AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
                AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
                AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null then coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' ) WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N'C' when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' )
                AND    a.act_event = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0.00 ) + coalesce( @nAmount2, 0.00 )
            end
        ELSE
            set @nAmount = 0.00


		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end

                SELECT @nAmount2 = ROUND( SUM( coalesce( a.act_est, 0.00 ) * coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0.00 ) ), 2 )  
                FROM   r5activities a
                WHERE  a.act_hire  = N'+'
                AND    coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N'ST' ) = N'ST'
                AND    a.act_event     = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0.00 ) + coalesce( @nAmount2, 0.00 )
            end
        ELSE
            set @nAmount = 0.00


		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end

create function O7SESMAT(   @sParent nvarchar(30),
                            @sEvent  nvarchar(30),
                            @sPricelev nvarchar(200))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nReturn        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount2        numeric(30,6)
        declare @nCount 		integer
        declare @nEvents        integer
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

        /* Retrieve number of children. */
        SELECT @nEvents = count(*)
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sParent

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */
                SELECT @nAmount = ROUND( coalesce( SUM( coalesce( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N'B', @sPricelev, null ), 0 ) *
                            coalesce( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) 
                FROM   r5parts      p,
                     r5matlparts  m,
                     r5activities a,
                     r5events     e  left outer join r5objects    o on (o.obj_code = e.evt_object AND    o.obj_org  = e.evt_object_org)  
                                     left outer join r5mrcs       c on (e.evt_mrc      = c.mrc_code) 
                WHERE  a.act_event    = e.evt_code
                AND    p.par_code     = m.mlp_part
                AND    p.par_org      = m.mlp_part_org
                AND    m.mlp_direct   = N'-'
                AND    a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
                AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
                AND    p.par_tool IS NULL 
                AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
                AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null then coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' ) WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N'C' when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' )
                AND    a.act_event = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo IS NULL



                set @nAmount = ROUND( @nAmount / @nEvents, 2 )

                /* Retrieve amount on po's specifically on current child. */
                SELECT @nAmount2 = ROUND( coalesce( SUM( coalesce( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N'B', @sPricelev, null ), 0 ) *
                            coalesce( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) 
                FROM   r5parts      p,
                     r5matlparts  m,
                     r5activities a,
                     r5events     e  left outer join r5objects    o on (o.obj_code = e.evt_object AND    o.obj_org  = e.evt_object_org)  
                                     left outer join r5mrcs       c on (e.evt_mrc      = c.mrc_code) 
                WHERE  a.act_event    = e.evt_code
                AND    p.par_code     = m.mlp_part
                AND    p.par_org      = m.mlp_part_org
                AND    m.mlp_direct   = N'-'
                AND    a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
                AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
                AND    p.par_tool IS NULL 
                AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
                AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null then coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' ) WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N'C' when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' )
                AND    a.act_event = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0.00 ) + coalesce( @nAmount2, 0.00 )
            end
        ELSE
            set @nAmount = 0.00


		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SESSIONSTRUCTURE
  @session     NUMERIC,
  @lang        NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @parent      NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @parentorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @parenttype  NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @nodelete    NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-',
  @loginuser   NVARCHAR( 255 ) 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @equipstr         NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @mosobj           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @mospart          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @return           INT
  DECLARE @parentstring     NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @childstring      NVARCHAR( 200 )

  DECLARE @ecschild         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecschildorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ecssyslevel      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecsasmlevel      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecscomplevel     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecscomplocation  NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ecsrollup        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @type             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @kit              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @qty              NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  DECLARE @epapart          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @epapartorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @epaqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  
  DECLARE @kttpart          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @kttpartorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @kttqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @icon             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @iconpath         NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @rentity          NVARCHAR( 4 )

  DECLARE @structprefuser        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @userstructpref        NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-'
  
  SET @equipstr = dbo.o7dflt2( N'EQUIPSTR' )
  SET @mosobj   = dbo.o7getmos( N'OBJ' )
  SET @mospart  = dbo.o7getmos( N'PART' )

  DECLARE cur_check_usp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ust_usercode
    FROM r5userstructurepreferences
    WHERE ust_usercode = @loginuser
  
  OPEN cur_check_usp
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_check_usp INTO @structprefuser
    IF @structprefuser IS NOT NULL
      SET @userstructpref = N'+'
  CLOSE cur_check_usp
  DEALLOCATE cur_check_usp

  IF @nodelete = N'-'
    BEGIN
      /* Delete data older than 1 day. */
      DELETE FROM r5sessionstructures
      WHERE  sss_date < getdate() - 1 
      /* Delete old records first. */
      DELETE FROM r5sessionstructures
      WHERE  sss_session = @session
      /* Also, insert top @parent. */
      EXECUTE @return = o7getclassicon N'OBJ',@parent, @parentorg, @icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
      EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @session, N'*', N'*', @parent, @parentorg, @parenttype, 
                        N'+', NULL, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart, @icon, @iconpath, @loginuser, @userstructpref
    END 

  /* Loop through all equip config structure records. */
  DECLARE ecs CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ecs_child, ecs_child_org, ecs_syslevel, ecs_asmlevel, ecs_complevel, ecs_complocation, ecs_rollup, N'E', NULL, NULL
    FROM   r5equipconfigstructures
    WHERE  ecs_parent     = @parent
    AND    ecs_parent_org = @parentorg
    UNION
    SELECT epa_part, epa_part_org, epa_syslevel, epa_asmlevel, epa_complevel, epa_partlocation, N'+', N'P', par_kit, epa_qty
    FROM   r5parts, r5entityparts o
    WHERE  par_code    = epa_part
    AND    par_org     = epa_part_org
    AND    epa_rentity = N'OBJ'
    AND    (epa_code   = @parent + '#' + @parentorg OR (epa_code = (SELECT OBJ_CATEGORY FROM R5OBJECTS 
                                                        WHERE  obj_code = @parent
                                                        AND    obj_org  = @parentorg)
                                                        AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT  1 from R5ENTITYPARTS a WHERE a.epa_part= o.epa_part 
                                                        AND    a.epa_part_org=o.epa_part_org 
                                                        AND    a.epa_code= @parent + '#' + @parentorg  
                                                        AND    a.epa_rentity='OBJ')))
  OPEN ecs
  FETCH NEXT FROM ecs INTO @ecschild, @ecschildorg, @ecssyslevel, @ecsasmlevel, @ecscomplevel, @ecscomplocation, @ecsrollup, @type, @kit, @qty
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      IF @ecssyslevel IS NULL AND @ecscomplocation IS NULL
        BEGIN
            /* If there is no inner structures, insert actual structure. */
            SET @rentity = CASE @type WHEN 'P' THEN 'PART' ELSE 'OBJ' END
            EXECUTE @return = o7getclassicon @rentity,@ecschild, @ecschildorg, @icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
            EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @parent, @parentorg, @parenttype, @ecschild, @ecschildorg, @type, 
                              @ecsrollup, @qty, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart, @icon, @iconpath, @loginuser, @userstructpref
        END
      ELSE IF @ecssyslevel IS NULL AND @ecscomplocation IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          /* If there is only a coomp location, use that as child of the actual @parent. */
          SET @childstring = @parent+ N'#'+@ecscomplocation
          EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @parent, @parentorg, @parenttype, @childstring, N'*', N'L', N'+',
                            NULL, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart,NULL,NULL, @loginuser, @userstructpref
          /* Also add comp location to actual child. */
          SET @parentstring = @parent+ N'#'+ @ecscomplocation
          SET @rentity = CASE @type WHEN 'P' THEN 'PART' ELSE 'OBJ' END
          EXECUTE @return = o7getclassicon @rentity, @ecschild, @ecschildorg, @icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
          EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @parentstring, N'*', N'L', @ecschild, @ecschildorg, @type, 
                            @ecsrollup, @qty, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart, @icon, @iconpath, @loginuser, @userstructpref
        END  
      ELSE -- sys level has a value
        BEGIN
          /* Sys has a value, so add it as child of actual @parent. */
          EXECUTE @return = O7GETCODESTRUCTUREICON @ecssyslevel, NULL,NULL,@icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
          SET @childstring = @parent+ N'#'+@ecssyslevel
          EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @parent, @parentorg, @parenttype, @childstring, N'*', N'S', N'+', NULL, 
                            @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart,@icon, @iconpath, @loginuser, @userstructpref
          IF @ecsasmlevel IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
              /* Assembly has a value, so add it as child of sys. */
              EXECUTE @return = O7GETCODESTRUCTUREICON @ecssyslevel, @ecsasmlevel,NULL,@icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
              SET @childstring = @parent+ N'#'+ @ecssyslevel+'.'+@ecsasmlevel
              SET @parentstring = @parent+ N'#'+ @ecssyslevel
              EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @parentstring, N'*', N'S', @childstring, 
                                N'*', N'A', N'+', NULL, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart,@icon, @iconpath, @loginuser, @userstructpref
              IF @ecscomplevel IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  /* Comp has a value, so add it as child of assembly. */
                  EXECUTE @return = O7GETCODESTRUCTUREICON @ecssyslevel, @ecsasmlevel,@ecscomplevel,@icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
                  SET @parentstring = @parent+ N'#'+ @ecssyslevel+'.'+@ecsasmlevel
                  SET @childstring  = @parent+ N'#'+ @ecssyslevel+'.'+@ecsasmlevel+'.'+@ecscomplevel
                  EXECUTE @return = o7sessionstructure_inssss @session, @lang, @parentstring, N'*', N'A', @childstring, N'*', N'C', N'+', NULL, 
                                    @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart,@icon, @iconpath, @loginuser, @userstructpref
                  IF @ecscomplocation IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                      /* Comp location has a value, so add it as child of comp. */
                      SET @parentstring = @parent+ N'#'+ @ecssyslevel+'.'+@ecsasmlevel+'.'+@ecscomplevel


-- ========================================

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SESSIONSTRUCTURE_INSSSS
  @session    NUMERIC,
  @lang       NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @par        NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @parorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @partype    NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @child      NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @childorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @childtype  NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @rollup     NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @qty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @equipstr   NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @mosobj     NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @mospart    NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @icon       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @iconpath   NVARCHAR( 1000 ),
  @loginuser        NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @userstructpref   NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @configcode NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @configrev  NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @obrtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @obtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @kit        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @uom        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @descrleft  NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @descrright NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @childdescr NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @childcode  NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @string     NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @pos        NUMERIC
  DECLARE @postot     NUMERIC

  DECLARE @showicons             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @showparts             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @showvmrs              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @showworkspaces        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sortoption            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipcodeseq          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipdescseq          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equiporgseq           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equiptypeseq          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equiptypedescseq      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @fieldValue            NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @fieldSeq              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldcode        NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfielddesc        NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldorg         NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldtype        NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldtypedesc    NVARCHAR( 200 )

  IF  @userstructpref = N'+'
    BEGIN
      DECLARE cur_usp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT ust_equipcode, ust_equipdesc, ust_equiporg, ust_equiptypecode, ust_equiptypedesc, ust_sortoption, ust_show_icon, ust_show_vmrs, ust_show_part, ust_show_workspace
        FROM r5userstructurepreferences
        WHERE ust_usercode = @loginuser 
        
      OPEN cur_usp
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur_usp INTO @equipcodeseq, @equipdescseq, @equiporgseq, @equiptypeseq, @equiptypedescseq, @sortoption, @showicons, @showvmrs, @showparts, @showworkspaces
      CLOSE cur_usp
      DEALLOCATE cur_usp
    END

  SET @descrleft  =''
  SET @descrright =''
  SET @childcode = SUBSTRING( @child, CHARINDEX( N'#', @child) + 1, 200 )
  IF @childtype = N'E' 
    /* Get object type. */
    SELECT @configcode = obj_configcode, 
           @configrev  = obj_configrevision, 
           @obrtype    = uco_rcode,
           @obtype     = uco_code
    FROM   r5ucodes, r5objects
    WHERE  uco_code    = obj_configtype
    AND    uco_rentity = N'OBTP'
    AND    obj_code    = @child
    AND    obj_org     = @childorg
  ELSE IF @childtype = N'P'
    /* Get part data. */
    SELECT @kit = par_kit, 
           @uom = par_uom
    FROM   r5parts
    WHERE  par_code = @child
    AND    par_org  = @childorg
    
  /* Set description. */
  IF @childtype IN ( N'E', N'P' )
    BEGIN
    IF @userstructpref = N'-' OR (@userstructpref = N'+' AND @childtype <> N'E')
     BEGIN
      IF @equipstr = N'B'
        BEGIN
          IF @childtype = N'E'
            SET @descrleft = @configcode + N' - '
          ELSE
            SET @descrleft = @child + N' - '
        END
      ELSE IF @equipstr <> N'D'
        BEGIN
          IF @childtype = N'E'
            SET @descrleft = @configcode
          ELSE
            SET @descrleft = @child
        END
      ELSE
        SET @descrleft = N''
        
      /* Get description. */
      IF @childtype = N'E'
        SET @childdescr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'OBJ', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL )
      ELSE
        SET @childdescr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'PART', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL )
        
      IF @equipstr IN ( N'B', N'D' )
        BEGIN
          /* Get description. */
          SET @descrleft = @descrleft+ @childdescr
        END
      IF @childtype <> N'E'
        BEGIN
            SET @descrleft  = @descrleft + N'(' 
            SET @descrright = N' ' + @uom + N')' 
        END

      IF ( @childtype = N'E' AND @mosobj = N'+' ) OR ( @childtype = N'P' AND @mospart = N'+' )
        BEGIN
          SET @descrright = @descrright + N'(' + @childorg
          IF @childtype = N'E'
            SET @descrright = @descrright + N'/'
        END
      ELSE IF ( @childtype = N'E')
        SET @descrright = @descrright + N'('

      IF @childtype = N'E'
        SET @descrright = @descrright + CAST( @configrev AS NVARCHAR ) + N')'
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          IF @mospart = N'+'
            SET @descrright = @descrright + N')'
        END
     END
     ELSE IF @userstructpref = N'+' AND  @childtype  = N'E'
       BEGIN
         SET @equipfieldorg = @childorg
         SET @equipfieldcode = @configcode
         SET @childdescr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'OBJ', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL )
         SET @equipfielddesc = @childdescr
         SET @equipfieldtype = @obtype
         SET @equipfieldtypedesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'UCOD', @obtype, 'OBTP', NULL )
         IF ( @mosobj = N'+' )
           SET @equipfieldorg = N'(' + @equipfieldorg + N'/' + CAST( @configrev AS NVARCHAR ) + N')'
         ELSE 
           SET @equipfieldorg =  N'(' + CAST( @configrev AS NVARCHAR ) + N')'

        DECLARE cur_strcut_order CURSOR  LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT CASE 
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPCODE' THEN @equipfieldcode
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPDESC' THEN @equipfielddesc
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPORG' THEN @equipfieldorg
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPTYPECODE' THEN @equipfieldtype
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPTYPEDESC' THEN @equipfieldtypedesc
           END equipfieldvalue, structorder 
        FROM (SELECT 
               ust_equipcode AS EQUIPCODE, 
               ust_equipdesc     AS EQUIPDESC,
               ust_equiporg      AS EQUIPORG,
               ust_equiptypecode AS EQUIPTYPECODE,
               ust_equiptypedesc AS EQUIPTYPEDESC
               FROM R5USERSTRUCTUREPREFERENCES
               WHERE ust_usercode = @loginuser) stu
               UNPIVOT(structorder FOR fieldname IN(EQUIPCODE,EQUIPDESC,EQUIPORG,EQUIPTYPECODE,EQUIPTYPEDESC)) AS DispOrder
        WHERE  structorder IS NOT NULL  
        ORDER BY structorder
       
        OPEN cur_strcut_order
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur_strcut_order INTO @fieldValue, @fieldSeq
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
         BEGIN
            IF @fieldSeq < 4
                SET @descrleft  = @descrleft + @fieldValue + '-'
            ELSE
                SET @descrright = @descrright + @fieldValue + '-'
         FETCH NEXT FROM cur_strcut_order INTO  @fieldValue, @fieldSeq
         END
         CLOSE cur_strcut_order
         DEALLOCATE cur_strcut_order
         
         IF LEN(@descrleft) > 0  AND LEN(@descrright) > 0
           SET @descrright = SUBSTRING(@descrright, 1, LEN(@descrright)-1)
         ELSE IF LEN(@descrleft) > 0 
           SET @descrleft = SUBSTRING(@descrleft, 1, LEN(@descrleft)-1)
         ELSE IF LEN(@descrright) > 0 
           SET @descrright = SUBSTRING(@descrright, 1, LEN(@descrright)-1)
     END
    END

  ELSE IF @childtype IN ( N'S', N'A', N'C' )
    BEGIN
        /* get code structure description. */
        SELECT @descrleft = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'CLVL', csr_code, NULL, NULL )
        FROM   r5codestructure
        WHERE  csr_rentity   = 'ACT'
        AND    csr_structure = @childcode
        
        SET @childdescr = @descrleft
    END

  ELSE IF @childtype = N'L'
    BEGIN
      SET @string = @childcode
      SET @

name: O7SESS_PACKAGE_INIT
body:
create procedure O7SESS_PACKAGE_INIT
as
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'R5VERSION', N'8.5'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'CUSTOMVERSION', null
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			--N_OPENFORMS will be calculated by count in temp table

			--N_ENTVALS is no longer used and isn't accessed from the outside

			--N_FUNCSTACK will be calculated by max in temp table

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'MAX_OPENFORMS', N'15'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'WIN_X', N'0'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'WIN_Y', N'0'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'G_MESSAGE_ID', null
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'INOBJECTUPDATE', N'FALSE'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'INPERSONORGUPDATE', N'FALSE'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'INFORGETME', N'FALSE'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			--create temporary package tables
			execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7SESS_FORM_TMP_TABLE
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7SESS_LAST_TMP_TABLE
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7SESS_FUNC_TMP_TABLE
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'InitHasRun', N'true'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

create procedure O7SESS_PUT_STACK	@sFunction	nvarchar(6)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sSql			nvarchar(500)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @nIdx			int
	declare @nOldIdx		int

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7SESS_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sTable = dbo.GET_O7SESS_FUNC_TEMP_TBLNAME()

	set @sSql = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sTable + N' where func_stack = @sFunc'
	execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nCount int OUTPUT, @sFunc nvarchar(6)', @nCount OUTPUT, @sFunction
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	set @sSql = N'select @nIdx = isnull(max(nIndex), 0) + 1 from ' + @sTable
	execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nIdx int OUTPUT', @nIdx OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nCount = 0
		begin
			set @sSql = N'insert into ' + @sTable + N' values ( @nIdx, @sFunc )'
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nIdx int, @sFunc nvarchar(6)', @nIdx, @sFunction
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				return -1
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sSql = N'select @nOld = nIndex from ' + @sTable + N' where func_stack = @sFunc'
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nOld int OUTPUT, @sFunc nvarchar(6)', @nOldIdx OUTPUT, @sFunction
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				return -1

			set @sSql = N'update ' + @sTable + N' set nIndex = nIndex - 1 where nIndex > @nOld'
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nOld int', @nOldIdx
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				return -1

			set @nIdx = @nIdx - 1

			set @sSql = N'update ' + @sTable + N' set nIndex = @nIdx where func_stack = @sFunc'
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nIdx int, @sFunc nvarchar(6)', @nIdx, @sFunction
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				return -1
		end

create procedure O7SESS_START_FORM	@nRowidx	int			OUTPUT,
									@sFormid	nvarchar(30),
									@sFunction	nvarchar(30)

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sValue			nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @nMaxopenforms	int
	declare @nOpenforms		int
	declare @sSql			nvarchar(500)

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7SESS_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nRowidx = 0
	set @sTable = dbo.GET_O7SESS_FORM_TEMP_TBLNAME()

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'MAX_OPENFORMS', @sValue OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nMaxopenforms = cast( @sValue as int )

	set @sSql = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sTable

	execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nCount int OUTPUT', @nOpenforms OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nOpenforms > @nMaxopenforms
		begin
			set @nRowidx = 0
			return
		end

	if @nOpenforms = 0
		set @nRowidx = 1
	else
		begin
			set @sSql = N'select @nMax = max(nIndex) from ' + @sTable
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nMax int OUTPUT', @nRowidx OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				return -1

			set @nRowidx = @nRowidx + 1
		end

	set @sSql = N'insert into ' + @sTable + N' values( @nIdx, @sForm, @sFunc )'
	execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nIdx int, @sForm nvarchar(30), @sFunc nvarchar(30)', @nRowidx, @sFormid, @sFunction
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

create function O7SESTL(   @sParent nvarchar(30),
                            @sEvent  nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nReturn        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount2        numeric(30,6)
        declare @nCount 		integer
        declare @nEvents        integer
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

        /* Retrieve number of children. */
        SELECT @nEvents = count(*)
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sParent

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */
                SELECT @nAmount = ROUND( SUM( coalesce( t.tor_qty, 0 ) * coalesce( t.tor_hours, 0 ) *  m.mrt_tariff ) ,2)  
                FROM   r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5events e
                WHERE  a.act_event = t.tor_event
                AND    a.act_act   = t.tor_act 
                AND    m.mrt_mrc   = t.tor_mrc
                AND    m.mrt_tool  = t.tor_tool
                AND    m.mrt_org   = e.evt_org
                AND    a.act_event = e.evt_code
                AND    a.act_event = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo IS NULL

                set @nAmount = ROUND( @nAmount / @nEvents, 2 )

                /* Retrieve amount on po's specifically on current child. */
                SELECT @nAmount2 = ROUND( SUM( coalesce( t.tor_qty, 0 ) * coalesce( t.tor_hours, 0 ) *  m.mrt_tariff ) ,2)  
                FROM   r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5events e
                WHERE  a.act_event = t.tor_event
                AND    a.act_act   = t.tor_act 
                AND    m.mrt_mrc   = t.tor_mrc
                AND    m.mrt_tool  = t.tor_tool
                AND    m.mrt_org   = e.evt_org
                AND    a.act_event = e.evt_code
                AND    a.act_event = @sParent
                AND    a.act_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0.00 ) + coalesce( @nAmount2, 0.00 )
            end
        ELSE
            set @nAmount = 0.00


		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end

AS
BEGIN

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SETVIOLATION
	@sUser		nvarchar(255), 
	@sPass		nvarchar(12), 
	@nLocksys	integer
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @sOs_user		nvarchar(255)	--v$session.osuser%type
	declare @sOs_machine	nvarchar(64)	--v$session.machine%type

	if @nLocksys <> 0 
		begin
			SELECT  @sOs_user = osuser, 
			@sOs_machine = machine
			FROM    v$session
			WHERE    audsid = @@SPID
			If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
				begin
					set @sOs_user = null
					set @sOs_machine = null
				end

			INSERT INTO r5violations
			(vio_user, vio_password, vio_date, vio_osuser, vio_osmachine)
			VALUES (@sUser, @sPass, dbo.o7gttime2(null), @sOs_user, @sOs_machine)

			UPDATE r5users
			SET usr_violations = coalesce(usr_violations, 0) + 1
			WHERE usr_code = @sUser
		
		end
	else
	   UPDATE R5USERS SET USR_DATELOCKED = dbo.o7gttime2(null)
	   WHERE usr_code = @sUser

	COMMIT

create function O7SIDDMA(   @sParent nvarchar(30),
                            @sEvent  nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nReturn        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount2       numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount3       numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount4       numeric(30,6)

        declare @nCount 		integer
        declare @nEvents        integer
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

        /* Retrieve number of children. */
        SELECT @nEvents = count(*)
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sParent

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */

                SELECT @nAmount = ( ( ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) * coalesce( i.ivl_price, 0 ) + coalesce( i.ivl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) 
		                 + coalesce( i.ivl_totextra, 0 ) ) /  coalesce( i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) ) * CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N'I'  THEN 1  WHEN N'C' THEN -1 WHEN  N'D' THEN -1  END * i.ivl_invqty ) / coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1 ) ), 2 ) ) )
                FROM   r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_order   = l.orl_order
                AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_ordline   = l.orl_ordline
                AND    i.ivl_invoice   = v.inv_code
                AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                AND    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
                AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'PD'
                AND    coalesce( i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) > 0
                AND    l.orl_event = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo IS NULL

                SELECT @nAmount2 = ( ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) * coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) + coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) ) )
                                   / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ) / coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) )
                FROM   r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o
                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                AND    e.evt_code    = l.orl_event
                AND EXISTS( SELECT 'X'
                          FROM   r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                          WHERE  i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                          AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                          AND    i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
                          AND    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
                          AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                          AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A')
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'PD'
                AND    l.orl_event = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo IS NULL


                set @nAmount = ROUND( ( @nAmount - @nAmount2 ) / @nEvents, 2 )

                /* Retrieve amount on po's specifically on current child. */
                SELECT @nAmount3 = ( ( ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) * coalesce( i.ivl_price, 0 ) + coalesce( i.ivl_invcalctaxamount, 0 )
		                             + coalesce( i.ivl_totextra, 0 ) ) /  coalesce( i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) )* CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN  N'I'  THEN 1  WHEN N'C' THEN  -1 WHEN  N'D' THEN -1  END * i.ivl_invqty ) /
                                     coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1 ) ), 2 ) ) )
                FROM   r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_order   = l.orl_order
                AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_ordline   = l.orl_ordline
                AND    i.ivl_invoice   = v.inv_code
                AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                AND    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
                AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'PD'
                AND    coalesce( i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) > 0
                AND    l.orl_event   = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo = @sEvent

                SELECT @nAmount4 = ( ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) * coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) + coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) ) ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ) / coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) )
                FROM   r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o
                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                AND    e.evt_code    = l.orl_event
                AND EXISTS( SELECT 'X'
                          FROM   r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                          WHERE  i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                          AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                          AND    i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
                          AND    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
                          AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                          AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A')
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'PD'
                AND    l.orl_event   = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0.00 ) + ROUND( coalesce( @nAmount3 - @nAmount4, 0.00 ), 2 );
            end
        ELSE
            set @nAmount = 0.00


		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end

create function O7SIDHIR(   @sParent nvarchar(30),
                            @sEvent  nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nReturn        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount2       numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount3       numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount4       numeric(30,6)

        declare @nCount 		integer
        declare @nEvents        integer
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

        /* Retrieve number of children. */
        SELECT @nEvents = count(*)
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sParent

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */

            SELECT @nAmount = ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END, 0.00 ) * coalesce( i.ivl_price, 0.00 ) + 
									coalesce( i.ivl_invcalctaxamount, 0.00 ) + coalesce( i.ivl_totextra, 0.00 ) ) / coalesce( CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END, 0.00 ) )
									* CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N'I' THEN 1 WHEN N'C' THEN  -1 WHEN  N'D' THEN -1 END * CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END ) /
                coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1.00 ) ), 2 )
                FROM   r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                WHERE  o.ord_code = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_ordline = l.orl_ordline
                AND    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
                AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype = N'ST'
                AND    l.orl_event = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo IS NULL

                SELECT @nAmount2 = ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) * coalesce( l.orl_price, 0.00 ) 
                                     + ( coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0.00 ) * coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) / coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0.00 ) ) ) ) /
                                       coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1.00 ) ) /
                                       coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1.00 ) ), 2 ) 
                FROM r5orderlines l, r5orders o 
                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org 
                AND EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                           FROM   r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                           WHERE  i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                           AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                           AND    i.ivl_ordline = l.orl_ordline
                           AND    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
                           AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                           AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A' )
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'ST'
                AND    l.orl_event = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo IS NULL

                set @nAmount = ROUND( ( @nAmount - @nAmount2 ) / @nEvents, 2 )

                /* Retrieve amount on po's specifically on current child. */

             SELECT @nAmount3 = ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END, 0.00 ) * coalesce(    	i.ivl_price, 0.00 ) + 
                                coalesce( i.ivl_invcalctaxamount, 0.00 ) + coalesce( i.ivl_totextra, 0.00 ) ) / coalesce( CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END, 0.00 ) )
                                * CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N'I' THEN 1 WHEN N'C' THEN -1 WHEN N'D' THEN -1 END * CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END ) /
                                       coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1.00 ) ), 2 )
                FROM   r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                WHERE  o.ord_code = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                AND    i.ivl_ordline = l.orl_ordline
                AND    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
                AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype = N'ST'
                AND    l.orl_event   = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo = @sEvent

                SELECT @nAmount4 = ROUND( SUM( ( ( ( coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) * coalesce( l.orl_price, 0.00 ) 
                                     + ( coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0.00 ) * coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) / coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0.00 ) ) ) ) /
                                       coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1.00 ) ) /
                                       coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1.00 ) ), 2 ) 
                FROM r5orderlines l, r5orders o 
                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org 
                AND EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                           FROM   r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
                           WHERE  i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
                           AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
                           AND    i.ivl_ordline = l.orl_ordline
                           AND    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
                           AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                           AND    v.inv_rstatus = N'A' )
                AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'ST'
                AND    l.orl_event   = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0.00 ) + ROUND( coalesce( @nAmount3 - @nAmount4, 0.00 ), 2 );
            end
        ELSE
            set @nAmount = 0.00


		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end
