create PROCEDURE O7SKIINT 
   @nSkitransid      numeric(38,0),
   @nNnttransid			numeric(38,0) 
   
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @sCstno			nvarchar(8)		--r5stocktakeinterface.ski_sttno%TYPE
	declare @nCstqty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sCstpart		nvarchar(30)	--r5parts.par_code%TYPE
	declare @sCstpartorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5parts.par_org%TYPE
	declare @sCstoreorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_org%TYPE
	declare @sCstore		nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_code%TYPE
	declare @sError			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCstbin		nvarchar(15)	--r5stocktakeinterface.ski_bin%TYPE
	declare @sCstlot		nvarchar(12)	--r5stocktakeinterface.ski_lot%TYPE
	declare @sCstuser		nvarchar(255)	--r5stocktakeinterface.ski_user%TYPE

	declare @sStore_stk		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sPart			nvarchar(30)	--r5parts.par_code%TYPE
	declare @sPartorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5parts.par_org%TYPE
	declare @sBin			nvarchar(15)	--r5binstock.bis_bin%TYPE
	declare @sLot			nvarchar(12)	--r5binstock.bis_lot%TYPE
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(5)
	declare @sPart_mos		nvarchar(1)  
	declare @sCheck			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDfltorg		nvarchar(200)
	declare @sMultiorg		nvarchar(200)
	declare @nReturn		integer

begin
	set @sDfltorg		=  dbo.o7dflt2(N'DEFORG')
	set @sMultiorg		= dbo.o7dflt2(N'MULTIORG')
	set @sPart_mos		= dbo.o7getmos(N'PART')


	DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
	WHERE  ine_transid = @nSkitransid


	SELECT @sCstore = ski_store,
		@sCstoreorg = ski_store_org, 
		@sCstno = ski_sttno, 
		@sCstpart = ski_part, 
		@sCstpartorg = ski_part_org,
		@nCstqty = ski_phyqty, 
		@sCstbin = ski_bin,
		@sCstlot =  ski_lot, 
		@sCstuser = ski_user, 
		@sError = ski_error
	FROM   r5stocktakeinterface
	WHERE  ski_transid = @nSkitransid
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
		RETURN

	begin
		if @sCstuser IS NULL  -- user code must be provided
			begin
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'11', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end
		else
			begin
				SELECT 1
				FROM   r5users
				WHERE  usr_code = @sCstuser
				AND    coalesce( usr_login, N'+' ) = N'+'
				if @@ROWCOUNT = 0  -- invalid user code
					begin
						EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'12', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, @sCstuser, NULL, NULL
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
					end
			end

		if @nCstqty < 0 
			begin
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'14', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end


		if ( @sError NOT IN (N'+', N'-')) OR ( @sError IS NULL ) 
			set @sError = N'-'

		if @sCstore IS NULL AND @sCstno IS NULL 
			begin
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'2', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				RETURN
			end
		ELSE
			begin
				if @sCstore IS NULL AND @sCstno IS NOT NULL  -- get store code
					begin
						SELECT @sCstore = stl_store
						FROM   r5stocktakelines
						WHERE  stl_trans = @sCstno

						IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
							begin
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'15', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									return -1
								RETURN
							end
					end
				ELSE
					begin
						if @sCstore IS NOT NULL AND @sCstno IS NULL 
							begin
								SELECT @sCstno = stl_trans
								FROM   r5stocktakelines
								WHERE  stl_store    = @sCstore
								AND    stl_part     = @sCstpart
								AND    stl_part_org = @sCstpartorg

								IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'15', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											return -1
										RETURN
									end
							end
						else
							begin
								SELECT 1
								FROM   r5stocktakelines
								WHERE  stl_trans = @sCstno
								IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid,  N'15', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											return -1
										RETURN
									end
							end
					end
			end

		if @sCstpart IS NULL 
			begin
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'1', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end


		if @sCstpartorg IS NULL AND @sPart_mos = N'+' 
			begin
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'9', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end
		else
			begin
				if @sCstpartorg IS NULL AND @sPart_mos = N'-' 
					set @sCstpartorg = @sDfltorg
			end

		if @sCstbin IS NULL 
			begin
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'6', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end
		else
		if @sCstore IS NOT NULL
			begin 
				SELECT 1
				FROM   r5bins
				WHERE  bin_store = @sCstore
				AND    bin_code  = @sCstbin
				if @@ROWCOUNT  = 0 
					begin
						EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'7', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, @sCstbin, NULL, NULL
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
					end

			end

		if @sCstlot IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				SELECT 1
				FROM   r5lots
				WHERE  lot_code = @sCstlot
				if @@ROWCOUNT  = 0 
					begin
						EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'8', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, @sCstlot, NULL, NULL
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
					end
			end

		if @sMultiorg = N'YES' 
			begin
				if @sPart_mos = N'+' 
					begin
						SELECT @sCheck = org_common
						FROM   r5organization
						WHERE  org_code = @sCstpartorg
						If @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 
							set @sCheck = N'-'

						if @sCheck = N'-'
							begin 
								SELECT 1
								WHERE  @sCstpartorg NOT IN ( SELECT uog_org
											 FROM   r5userorganization
											 WHERE  uog_user = @sCstuser )
								if @@ROWCOUNT <> 0  -- invalid org, or user doesnot have access to this org
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'10', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, @sCstpartorg, NULL, NULL
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											return -1
										RETURN
									end
							end
					end
			end

		SELECT 1
		FROM   r5interfaceerrors
		WHERE  ine_transid = @nNnttransid
		If @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
			RETURN

		if @sError = N'-'  /* default: overwrite */
			UPDATE r5stocktakelines
			SET    stl_phyqty   = @nCstqty
			WHERE  stl_part     = @sCstpart
			AND    stl_part_org = @sCstpartorg
			AND    stl_bin      = coalesce(@sCstbin,'*')
			AND    stl_lot      = coalesce(@sCstlot,'*')
			AND    ( (stl_store = @sCstore) OR (stl_trans = @sCstno) )
		else
			UPDATE r5stocktakelines
			SET    stl_phyqty   = @nCstqty
			WHERE  stl_part     = @sCstpart
			AND    stl_part_org = @sCstpartorg
			AND    stl_bin      = coalesce(@sCstbin,'*')
			AND    stl_lot      = coalesce(@sCstlot,'*')
			AND    stl_phyqty IS NULL
			AND    ( (stl_store = @sCstore) OR (stl_trans = @sCstno) )

		if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			begin
				SELECT 1
				FROM   r5stocktakelines
				WHERE  ((stl_store = @sCstore) OR (stl_trans = @sCstno))


				if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
					begin
						EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNnttransid, N'3', N'O7SKIINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
					end
				else
					begin
						SELECT @sPart = stl_part, @sPartorg = stl_part_org, @sBin = stl_bin, @sLot = stl_lot
						FROM   r5stocktakelines
						WHERE  stl_trans = @sCstno
						AND    stl_part = @sCstpart
						AND    stl_part_org = @sCstpartorg

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SMSUPP(
		@sLang              nvarchar(2),
		@sClass             nvarchar(80) OUTPUT,
		@sCom_class         nvarchar(20),
		@sCom_class_org     nvarchar(15),
		@sCurr              nvarchar(80) OUTPUT,
		@sCom_curr          nvarchar(40),
		@sLangdesc          nvarchar(80) OUTPUT,
		@sCom_lang          nvarchar(40),
		@sMinoritygroup     nvarchar(80) OUTPUT,
		@sCom_minoritygroup nvarchar(40),
		@sParam_dualcurr    nvarchar(15),
		@sCatexists         nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
		@sCom_code          nvarchar(30),
		@sCom_org           nvarchar(15),
		@sOrg               nvarchar(80) OUTPUT,
		@sControl_org       nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
		@sGlobal_org        nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
		@sGlobal_basecurr   nvarchar(3) OUTPUT
                                     ) 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sClasstemp		nvarchar(40)
	declare @nCount			integer
BEGIN
	set @sClasstemp = @sCom_class + N'#' + @sCom_class_org

	set @sClass = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'CLAS', @sClasstemp, N'COMP', null )

	set @sCurr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'CURR', @sCom_curr, null, null )
	set @sLangdesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'LANG', @sCom_lang, null, null )
	set @sMinoritygroup = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'MINO', @sCom_minoritygroup, null, null )



	IF @sParam_dualcurr IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5currencies c1,
				r5catalogue c
			WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sCom_code
				AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sCom_org
				AND  ( c.cat_purprice  IS NOT NULL OR
				c.cat_quotprice IS NOT NULL OR
				c.cat_gross     IS NOT NULL )
				AND    c1.cur_code = c.cat_curr
				AND    c1.cur_dual IS NOT NULL

			if @nCount > 0
				SELECT @sCatexists = N'+'
				FROM   r5currencies c1,
					r5catalogue c
				WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sCom_code
					AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sCom_org
					AND  ( c.cat_purprice  IS NOT NULL OR
					c.cat_quotprice IS NOT NULL OR
					c.cat_gross     IS NOT NULL )
					AND    c1.cur_code = c.cat_curr
					AND    c1.cur_dual IS NOT NULL
			else
				set @sCatexists = N'-'
		end
	ELSE
		set @sCatexists = N'-'
		
	IF @sCom_org IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			set @sOrg = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'ORG', @sCom_org, null, null )
			set @sControl_org = @sCom_org
			set @sGlobal_org  = @sCom_org
			IF ( @sCom_org IS NOT NULL ) 
			begin
				select @nCount = count(*)
				FROM   r5organization
				WHERE  org_code = @sCom_org
				if @nCount > 0 
					SELECT @sGlobal_basecurr = org_curr
					FROM   r5organization
					WHERE  org_code = @sCom_org
				else
					set @sGlobal_basecurr = null
			end
		end

END

CREATE FUNCTION o7splitgisobjids
(
    @sStr NVARCHAR( MAX )
)
RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (gisobjid NUMERIC)
AS
BEGIN
      DECLARE @nStartIndex INT, @nEndIndex INT
 
      SET @nStartIndex = 1
      IF SUBSTRING(@sStr, LEN(@sStr) - 1, LEN(@sStr)) <> ','
      BEGIN
            SET @sStr = @sStr + ','
      END
 
      WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @sStr) > 0
      BEGIN
            SET @nEndIndex = CHARINDEX(',', @sStr)
           
            INSERT INTO @tReturn(gisobjid)
            SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(@sStr, @nStartIndex, @nEndIndex - 1) AS NUMERIC)
           
            SET @sStr = SUBSTRING(@sStr, @nEndIndex + 1, LEN(@sStr))
      END
 
      RETURN
END

CREATE FUNCTION o7splitin_o7aliasfn( @sPstring varchar(3000), @sTable nvarchar(256) )
returns VARCHAR(3000) as
 begin
     declare @sLstring        varchar(3000)
     declare @sData           varchar(3000)
     declare @sTemp            varchar(3000)
     declare @n               int
     declare @sTablename 	     varchar(128) 
 
     set @sLstring=upper(@sPstring) +',' 
     set @sData = ''
 
     while @sLstring != ''
         begin
             set @n = charindex( ',', @sLstring)
             set @sTemp = ltrim( rtrim( substring( @sLstring, 1, @n -1 ))) + ' ' 
             set @sTablename = substring(@sTemp, 1, charindex( ' ', @sTemp ) - 1 )
             set @sTemp = ltrim( substring(@sTemp, charindex( ' ', @sTemp ) + 1, @n ))
 			
            if @sTablename = UPPER(@sTable)
                 begin
                     if @sTemp != '' 
                         begin
                            set @sTemp = ',' + substring(@sTemp, 1, charindex( ' ', @sTemp ) - 1 ) + ','
                             set @sData = @sData + @sTemp
                         end
                 end
 
             set @sLstring = substring( @sLstring, @n + 1, len( @sLstring) )
         end
 
     set @n = len( @sData )
     set @sData = substring( @sData, 1, @n )
 
     return @sData
 END

CREATE FUNCTION o7splitin_o7splitfn( @p_string varchar(3000) )
returns VARCHAR(3000) as
  begin
    declare @l_string        varchar(3000)
    declare @l_data          varchar(3000)
    declare @temp            varchar(3000)
    declare @n               int
    declare @size            int
    declare @fieldlist 	     varchar(20) 
	declare @dual			 varchar(20)
    set @l_string=UPPER(@p_string) +',' 
    set @l_data   = ''''+','
    set @fieldlist = '<FIELDLIST'
	set @dual		='DUAL'
    set @l_string =  case when patindex(@fieldlist,@l_string)>0 then null else @l_string end  	
	set @l_string =  case when patindex(@dual,@l_string)>0 then null else @l_string end  	
    while datalength(@l_string) > 0
    begin
		set @n = charindex( ',',UPPER(@l_string))
		set @temp   = ltrim( rtrim( substring(@l_string, 1, @n-1 )) )+ ' '
		set @temp   = substring(@temp,1,charindex(' ',@temp)-1)
		set @temp   =   @temp   + ','
		set @l_data = @l_data + @temp
		set @l_string = substring( @l_string, @n+1,(datalength(@l_string)-@n) )
     end 
		return @l_data +''''
	 
END

CREATE FUNCTION o7splitstring( @string NVARCHAR( 1000 ) )
RETURNS @t TABLE( code  NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @s NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  SET @s = @string
  WHILE CHARINDEX( ',', @s ) > 0 
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @t VALUES( SUBSTRING( @s, 1, CHARINDEX( ',', @s ) - 1 ) )
         SET @s = SUBSTRING( @s, CHARINDEX( ',', @s ) + 1, 1000 )
         INSERT INTO @t VALUES( @s )
    END  
  RETURN
END

create function O7SPODMA(   @sParent nvarchar(30),
                            @sEvent  nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nReturn        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount2        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount3        numeric(30,6)
		declare @nAmount4        numeric(30,6)
        declare @nCount 		integer
        declare @nEvents        integer
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

        /* Retrieve number of children. */
        SELECT @nEvents = count(*)
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sParent

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */
                SELECT @nAmount = ROUND( SUM( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) -
                                              coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) -
                                              coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0.00 ), 0.00 ) *
                                   coalesce( l.orl_price, 0.00 ) /
                                   coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1.00 ) /
                                   coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1.00 ) ) +
                                 ( ( coalesce( l.orl_totextra, 0.00 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1.00 ) ) * 
                                   dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0.00 ) -
                                             coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) -
                                             coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0.00 ), 0.00 ) / 
                                   l.orl_ordqty ) ), 2 ) 
                FROM   r5orders o, r5orderlines l
                WHERE  o.ord_code = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org  = l.orl_order_org
                AND    o.ord_rstatus IN  ( 'U', 'R' )
                AND    l.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J' ) 
                AND    coalesce( l.orl_rtype, 'PS' ) = 'PD'
                AND    l.orl_active = '+'
                AND    l.orl_event = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo IS NULL

                set @nAmount = ROUND( @nAmount / @nEvents, 2 )

                /* Retrieve amount on po's specifically on current child. */
                SELECT @nAmount2 = ROUND( SUM( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0.00 ) -
                                              coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) -
                                              coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0.00 ), 0.00 ) *
                                   coalesce( l.orl_price, 0.00 ) /
                                   coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1.00 ) /
                                   coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1.00 ) ) +
                                 ( ( coalesce( l.orl_totextra, 0.00 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1.00 ) ) * 
                                   dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0.00 ) -
                                             coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0.00 ) -
                                             coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0.00 ), 0.00 ) / 
                                   l.orl_ordqty ) ), 2 ) 
                FROM   r5orders o, r5orderlines l
                WHERE  o.ord_code = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org  = l.orl_order_org
                AND    o.ord_rstatus IN  ( 'U', 'R' )
                AND    l.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J' ) 
                AND    coalesce( l.orl_rtype, 'PS' ) = 'PD'
                AND    l.orl_active = '+'
                AND    l.orl_event = @sParent
                AND    l.orl_relatedwo = @sEvent

                set @nAmount =  coalesce( @nAmount, 0 ) + coalesce( @nAmount2, 0 )

                /* retrieve amount on reqs that need to be split evenly. */
                SELECT @nAmount3 = ROUND( SUM( ( coalesce( l.rql_qty, 0.00 ) - coalesce( l.rql_recvqty, 0.00 ) -
                   coalesce( l.rql_scrapqty, 0.00 ) ) *
                   coalesce( l.rql_price, 0.00 ) /
                   coalesce( l.rql_exch, 1.00 ) ), 2 ) 
                FROM   r5requisitions r, r5requislines l
                WHERE  r.req_code  = l.rql_req
                AND    r.req_rstatus IN ( 'U', 'R', 'A' )
                AND    l.rql_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J' ) 
                AND    coalesce( l.rql_rtype, 'PS' ) = 'PD'
                AND    l.rql_active = '+'
                AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                              FROM   r5orderlines
                              WHERE  orl_req     = l.rql_req
                              AND    orl_reqline = l.rql_reqline )
                AND    l.rql_event = @sParent
                AND    l.rql_relatedwo IS NULL

                set @nAmount =  coalesce( @nAmount, 0 ) + coalesce(ROUND( @nAmount3 / @nEvents, 2 ), 0)

                /* Retrieve amount on reqs specifically on current child. */
                SELECT @nAmount4 = ROUND( SUM( ( coalesce( l.rql_qty, 0.00 ) - coalesce( l.rql_recvqty, 0.00 ) -
                                   coalesce( l.rql_scrapqty, 0.00 ) ) *
                                   coalesce( l.rql_price, 0.00 ) /
                                   coalesce( l.rql_exch, 1.00) ), 2 ) 
                FROM   r5requisitions r, r5requislines l
                WHERE  r.req_code  = l.rql_req
                AND    r.req_rstatus IN ( 'U', 'R', 'A' )
                AND    l.rql_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J' ) 
                AND    coalesce( l.rql_rtype, 'PS' ) = 'PD'
                AND    l.rql_active = '+'
                AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                              FROM   r5orderlines
                              WHERE  orl_req     = l.rql_req
                              AND    orl_reqline = l.rql_reqline )
                AND    l.rql_event = @sParent
                AND    l.rql_relatedwo = @sEvent

                      
                set @nAmount = coalesce( @nAmount, 0 ) + coalesce( @nAmount4, 0 )
            end
        else
            set @nAmount = 0.00
                        
		return coalesce(@nAmount, 0.00)
	end

                WHERE  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
                AND    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                AND    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
                AND    l.orl_rtype   = N'PD'

                AND    l.orl_ordqty  > 0

create function O7SRMMAT(   @sParent nvarchar(30),

as
	begin

        FROM   r5events

        IF @nEvents > 0 
            begin
                /* retrieve amount on po's that need to be split evenly. */
                SELECT @nAmount = ROUND( SUM( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N'B', @sPricelevel, null ), 0 ) * ( coalesce( m.mlp_qty,   0 ) - 
                                    coalesce( dbo.o7getpartissued( a.act_event , a.act_act , m.mlp_part , m.mlp_part_org), 0 ) )

				AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null then coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' ) WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N'C' when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N' ' )
                AND    a.act_event   = @sParent

create procedure O7SRVCAT	@nRate			numeric(24,6)				OUTPUT,
							@sTask			nvarchar(20),
							@nTaskrev		numeric(4),
							@sSupplier		nvarchar(30),
							@sSupplierorg	nvarchar(15),
							@sTrade			nvarchar(15),
							@sOrg			nvarchar(15),
							@sStartdate		DATETIME,
							@sRtype			nvarchar(3),
							@nQty			numeric(10,2)

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nPrice			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTaskprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours			numeric(14,4)
	declare @nExch			numeric(24,12)
	declare @nConv			numeric(10,4)
	declare @nCurr			nvarchar(3)--r5servicecatalogue.sca_curr%type
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @sTask IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			SELECT @nTaskprice = tpr_price,
				 @nHours = tsk_hours
			From r5tasks LEFT OUTER JOIN r5Taskprices ON tsk_code = tpr_task and tsk_revision = tpr_revision and tpr_org = @sOrg 
			WHERE tsk_code = @sTask and tsk_revision = @nTaskrev

			if coalesce( @sSupplier, N'*' ) <> N'*' 
				begin
					/* Retrieve catalogue @nPrice */
					SELECT @nPrice = sca_price,
						 @nCurr = sca_curr,
						 @nConv = coalesce( sca_multiply, 1 )
					FROM   r5servicecatalogue
					WHERE  sca_Task         = @sTask
					AND    sca_Supplier     = @sSupplier
					AND    sca_Supplier_Org = @sSupplierorg

					execute @nReturn = O7GTEXCH @nExch OUTPUT, @nCurr, @sOrg, @sStartdate
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if coalesce( @sRtype, N'ST' ) = N'ST' 
						set @nRate = ROUND( @nPrice / @nExch / @nConv / @nHours, 2 )
					ELSE
						set @nRate = ROUND( @nPrice / @nExch / @nConv * @nQty, 2 )
				end

			 if @nRate IS NULL 
				begin
					/* if no catalogue @nPrice,  try default @sTask @nPrice. */
					if coalesce( @sRtype, N'ST' ) = N'ST' 
					  set @nRate = ROUND( @nTaskprice / @nHours, 2 )
					else
					  set @nRate = ROUND( @nTaskprice * @nQty, 2 )
				end
		  end

	if @nRate is NULL AND coalesce( @sSupplier, N'*' ) <> N'*' 
		 /* Try to retrieve @sSupplier/@sTrade @nPrice */
		SELECT @nRate = t.trr_ntRate
		FROM   r5TradeRates t
		WHERE  t.trr_mrc          = N'*'
		AND    t.trr_Trade        = @sTrade
		AND    t.trr_Org          = @sOrg
		AND    t.trr_Supplier     = @sSupplier
		AND    t.trr_Supplier_Org = @sSupplierorg
		AND    t.trr_start       <= @sStartdate
		AND    t.trr_end         >  @sStartdate
		AND    t.trr_octype   IN ( SELECT uco_code
								 FROM r5ucodes

create PROCEDURE O7STCDEL   
   @nInttransid      bigint,
   @sChildtype       nvarchar(4),
   @sChild           nvarchar(30),
   @sChildorg        nvarchar(15),
   @sParenttype      nvarchar(4),
   @sMrc             nvarchar(15),
   @sUsrlang         nvarchar(30),
   @dTrackdate       datetime,
   @sUser            nvarchar(255),
   @nTransorgid      numeric(38,0),
   @sTranscode       nvarchar(4),
   @nTransgroup      numeric(38,0),
   @sErrsource       nvarchar(16) OUTPUT,
   @sErrtype         nvarchar(8) OUTPUT,
   @sErrchk          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

   declare @sEvtcode          nvarchar(30)   --r5events.evt_code%TYPE
   declare @sEvttype          nvarchar(4)    --r5events.evt_type%TYPE
   declare @sEvtrtype         nvarchar(4)    --r5events.evt_rtype%TYPE
   declare @sEvtstat          nvarchar(4)    --r5events.evt_status%TYPE
   declare @sEvtrstat         nvarchar(4)    --r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE
   declare @sEvtparent        nvarchar(30)   --r5structures.stc_parent%TYPE
   declare @sEvtparentorg     nvarchar(15)   --r5structures.stc_parent_org%TYPE
   declare @sEvtparenttype    nvarchar(4)    --r5structures.stc_parenttype%TYPE
   declare @sEvtparentrtype   nvarchar(4)    --r5structures.stc_parentrtype%TYPE
   declare @sEvtobcode        nvarchar(30)   --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
   declare @sEvtobcodeorg     nvarchar(15)   --r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
   declare @sEvtobtype        nvarchar(4)    --r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE
   declare @sEvtobrtype       nvarchar(4)    --r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE
   declare @sErrfunc          nvarchar(80)
   declare @sErrparm1         nvarchar(80)
   declare @sErrparm2         nvarchar(80)
   declare @sErrmsg           nvarchar(250) 
   declare @nReturn           integer
   declare @nError            integer
   declare @sError            nvarchar(38)

   declare @sChildtype_stc    nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sChildrtype_stc   nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sChild_stc        nvarchar(30)        
   declare @sParenttype_stc   nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sParentrtype_stc  nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sParent_stc       nvarchar(30)        
   declare @sRolldown_stc     nvarchar(1)         
   declare @sRollup_stc       nvarchar(1)         
   declare @sEquivalent_stc   nvarchar(1)         
   declare @sDowntime_stc     nvarchar(1)         
   declare @sChild_org_stc    nvarchar(15)        
   declare @sParent_org_stc   nvarchar(15)        
   declare @nUpdatecount_stc  numeric(38,0)       
   declare @nSqlidentity_stc  integer  

begin
   set @sErrsource     = N'O7STCDEL'
   set @sErrtype       = N'PROC'
   set @sErrchk        = N'0'

   declare c_structures cursor local for select STC_CHILDTYPE, STC_CHILDRTYPE,   STC_CHILD,  STC_PARENTTYPE,   STC_PARENTRTYPE,
                                       STC_PARENT, STC_ROLLDOWN,  STC_ROLLUP, STC_EQUIVALENT,   STC_DOWNTIME,
                                       STC_CHILD_ORG, STC_PARENT_ORG,   STC_UPDATECOUNT,  STC_SQLIDENTITY
                                          from r5structures
                                          WHERE stc_childtype  = @sChildtype
                                          AND   stc_child      = @sChild
                                          AND   stc_child_org  = @sChildorg
                                          AND   stc_parenttype = coalesce( @sParenttype, stc_parenttype )
   
   open c_structures
   fetch next from c_structures into   @sChildtype_stc,  @sChildrtype_stc, @sChild_stc,   @sParenttype_stc, @sParentrtype_stc,
                                       @sParent_stc,  @sRolldown_stc,   @sRollup_stc,  @sEquivalent_stc, @sDowntime_stc,
                                       @sChild_org_stc,  @sParent_org_stc, @nUpdatecount_stc,   @nSqlidentity_stc
   while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
         if @sParentrtype_stc = N'L' 
            begin
               if @sChildrtype_stc = N'L' 
                  set @sEvtrtype = N'LL'
               else
                  set @sEvtrtype = N'RL'
            end
         else
            set @sEvtrtype = N'DO'

         set @sErrchk         = N'0'
         set @sEvtcode        = NULL
         set @sEvttype        = NULL
         set @sEvtstat        = NULL
         set @sEvtrstat       = N'C'
         set @sEvtparent      = @sParent_stc
         set @sEvtparentorg   = @sParent_org_stc
         set @sEvtparenttype  = @sParenttype_stc
         set @sEvtparentrtype = @sParentrtype_stc
         set @sEvtobcode      = @sChild_stc
         set @sEvtobcodeorg   = @sChild_org_stc
         set @sEvtobtype      = @sChildtype_stc
         set @sEvtobrtype     = @sChildrtype_stc


         set @sMrc = coalesce (@sMrc, N'*')
         EXECUTE @nReturn = o7crevtx @sEvtcode OUTPUT,@dTrackdate,@sUser,@sEvttype OUTPUT,@sEvtrtype OUTPUT,@sEvtstat OUTPUT,
                                          @sEvtrstat OUTPUT,NULL, @sMrc,NULL,NULL,NULL,@sUsrlang,@sEvtparent OUTPUT,
                                          @sEvtparenttype OUTPUT,@sEvtparentrtype OUTPUT, @sEvtobcode,@sEvtobcodeorg,@sEvtobtype OUTPUT,
                                          @sEvtobrtype OUTPUT,1,N'+',@nTransorgid,@sTranscode,@nTransgroup,@sErrchk OUTPUT
         
         set @nError = @@ERROR
         if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            begin
               set @sError = convert(nvarchar(38),@nError)
               close c_structures
               deallocate c_structures
               EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nInttransid,  @sError, N'O7STCDEL', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
                  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                     return -1
                  RETURN
            end

         

         if @sErrchk <> N'0' 
            begin
               set @sErrsource = N'O7CREVT1'
               set @sErrtype   = N'PROC'
               EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nInttransid, @sErrchk, @sErrsource, @sErrtype, @sErrfunc, @sErrparm1, @sErrparm2, @sErrmsg
               if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                  begin
                     close c_structures
                     deallocate c_structures
                     return -1
                  end
            end

         /* Insert record into r5eventobjects parent using o7creob1 procedure */
         set @sErrchk       = N'0'
         set @sEvtobcode    = @sParent_stc
         set @sEvtobcodeorg = @sParent_org_stc
         set @sEvtobtype    = @sParenttype_stc
         set @sEvtobrtype   = @sParentrtype_stc

         execute @nReturn = O7CREOB1 @sEvtcode,@sEvtrtype,@sEvtobcode,@sEvtobcodeorg, @sEvtobtype OUTPUT , @sEvtobrtype OUTPUT, @sErrchk OUTPUT
         set @nError = @@ERROR
         if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            begin
               set @sError = convert(nvarchar(38),@nError)
               close c_structures
               deallocate c_structures
               EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nInttransid,  @sError, N'O7STCDEL', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
                  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                     return -1
                  RETURN
            end

         if @sErrchk <> N'0' 
            begin
               set @sErrsource = N'O7CREOB1'
               set @sErrtype   = N'PROC'
               EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nInttransid, @sErrchk, @sErrsource, @sErrtype, @sErrfunc, @sErrparm1, @sErrparm2, @sErrmsg
               if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                  begin
                     close c_structures
                     deallocate c_structures
                     return -1
                  end
            end

        /* Insert record into r5eventobjects child using o7creob1 procedure */
         set @sErrchk       = N'0'
         set @sEvtobcode    = @sChild_stc
         set @sEvtobcodeorg = @sChild_org_stc
         set @sEvtobtype    = @sChildtype_s

create PROCEDURE O7STCINT   
   @nIinttransid     numeric(38,0),
   @sCchildtype      nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sCcchildrtype    nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sCchild          nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sCchildorg       nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
   @sCparenttype     nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sCparent         nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sCparentorg      nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
   @sCmrc            nvarchar(15),
   @sCusrlang        nvarchar(200),
   @dTrackdate       DATETIME,
   @sCuser           nvarchar(255),
   @sCdpnd           nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
   @sCcost           nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
   @nTransorgid      numeric(38,0),
   @sTranscode       nvarchar(4),
   @nTransgroup      numeric(38,0),
   @sCerrsource      nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
   @sCerrtype        nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
   @sCerrchk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @sCparentrtype        nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @nCount               integer
   declare @sCevtcode            nvarchar(30)   --r5events.evt_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevttype            nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtrtype           nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtstat            nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtrstat           nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtparent          nvarchar(30)   --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtparentorg       nvarchar(15)   --r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
   declare @sCevtparenttype      nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtparentrtype     nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtobcode          nvarchar(30)   --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtobcodeorg       nvarchar(15)   --r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
   declare @sCevtobtype          nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCevtobrtype         nvarchar(8)    --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
   declare @sCerrfunc            nvarchar(40)
   declare @sCerrparm1           nvarchar(40)
   declare @sCerrparm2           nvarchar(40)
   declare @sCerrmsg             nvarchar(250)
   declare @sCparentlocation     nvarchar(30)   --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
   declare @sCparentlocationorg  nvarchar(15)   --r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
   declare @sDeforg              nvarchar(200)  --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
   declare @sChk                 nvarchar(4)
   declare @sTempChildOrg        nvarchar(200)
   declare @sTempOrg             nvarchar(200)
   declare @sTempMRC             nvarchar(200)
   declare @sTempCodeOrg         nvarchar(200)
   declare @sTempParentOrg       nvarchar(200)
   declare @nReturn              integer
   declare @nError               integer
   declare @sError               nvarchar(38)

begin    
   set @sDeforg        = dbo.o7dflt2(N'DEFORG')
   set @sCparentrtype   = NULL
   set @nCount         = 0
   set @sCerrsource     = N'O7STCINT'
   set @sCerrtype       = N'PROC'
   set @sCerrchk        = N'0'
   
   if @sCdpnd is null 
      set @sCdpnd = N'+'
   if @sCcost is null 
      set @sCcost = N'+'
   
   execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sCparentrtype OUTPUT, @sCparenttype, N'OBTP', @sCerrchk OUTPUT
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      begin
      set @sError = convert(nvarchar(38),@nError)
      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nIinttransid,  @sError, N'O7STCINT', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
         RETURN
      end

   if @sCerrchk <> N'0' 
      begin
         set @sCerrsource     = N'O7STCINT'
         set @sCerrtype       = N'PROC'
         set @sCerrchk        = N'1'
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nIinttransid,  @sCerrchk, @sCerrsource, @sCerrtype, N'O7STCINT', @sCparenttype, NULL, NULL
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
         RETURN
      end

   SELECT 1
   FROM   r5structures s
   WHERE  s.stc_childtype  = @sCchildtype
   AND    s.stc_child      = @sCchild
   AND    s.stc_child_org  = coalesce( @sCchildorg, @sDeforg )
   AND    s.stc_parenttype = @sCparenttype
   AND    s.stc_parent     = @sCparent
   AND    s.stc_parent_org = coalesce( @sCparentorg, @sDeforg )
   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
      begin
         set @sCerrchk = N'0'
         RETURN
      end
        
        /* if the same type of parent exists, delete it first. */
   SELECT 1
   FROM   r5structures s
   WHERE  s.stc_childtype  = @sCchildtype
   AND    s.stc_child      = @sCchild
   AND    s.stc_child_org  = coalesce( @sCchildorg, @sDeforg )
   AND    s.stc_parentrtype = @sCparentrtype
   AND    s.stc_parentrtype <> N'S'
   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
      begin
         DELETE   r5structures
         WHERE  stc_childtype  = @sCchildtype
         AND    stc_child      = @sCchild
         AND    stc_child_org  = coalesce( @sCchildorg, @sDeforg )
         AND    stc_parentrtype = @sCparentrtype
         AND    stc_parentrtype <> N'S'
      end
      
   set @sTempChildOrg = coalesce( @sCchildorg, @sDeforg )
   set @sTempOrg = coalesce( @sCparentorg, @sDeforg )

   execute @nReturn = o7prestc N'INS', @sCcchildrtype OUTPUT, @sCchildtype OUTPUT, @sCchild, @sTempChildOrg,@sCparentrtype OUTPUT, @sCparenttype OUTPUT, 
                              @sCparent, @sTempOrg, @sCdpnd, @sCcost, N'-', N'-', @sCerrchk OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      begin
      set @sError = convert(nvarchar(38),@nError)
      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nIinttransid,  @sError, N'O7STCINT', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
         RETURN
      end

   if @sCerrchk <> N'0' 
      begin
         set @sCerrsource     = N'O7PRESTC'
         set @sCerrtype       = N'PROC'
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nIinttransid,  @sCerrchk, @sCerrsource, @sCerrtype, N'O7STCINT', NULL, NULL, NULL
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
         RETURN
      end 

   INSERT INTO r5structures
      (
         stc_childtype,
         stc_childrtype,
         stc_child,
         stc_child_org,
         stc_parenttype,
         stc_parentrtype,
         stc_parent,
         stc_parent_org,
         stc_rolldown,
         stc_rollup,
         stc_equivalent,
         stc_downtime
      )
   VALUES
      (
         @sCchildtype,
         @sCcchildrtype,
         @sCchild,
         coalesce( @sCchildorg, @sDeforg ),
         @sCparenttype,
         @sCparentrtype,
         @sCparent,
         coalesce( @sCparentorg, @sDeforg ),
         coalesce(@sCdpnd,'+'),
         coalesce(@sCcost,'+'),
         N'-',
         N'-'
      )
    set @nError = @@ERROR       --Patch for bug #12564
   if @nError <> 0 
      begin
      set @sError = convert(nvarchar(38),@nError)
      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nIinttransid,  @sError, N'O7STCINT', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
         RETURN
      end

   if @sCparentrtype = N'L' 
      begin
         if @sCcchildrtype = N'L' 
            set @sCevtrtype = N'LL'
         else
            set @sCevtrtype = N'PL'
      end
   else
      set @sCevtrtype = N'AO'


   set @sCerrchk         = N'0'
   set @sCevtcode        = NULL
   set @sCevttype        = NULL
   set @sCevtstat        = NULL
   set @sCevtrstat       = N'C'
   set @sCevtparent      = @sCparent
   set @sCevtparentorg   = coalesce( @sCparentorg, @sDeforg )
   set @sCevtparenttype  = @sCparenttype
   set @sCevtparentrtype = @sCparentrtype
   set @sCevtobcode      = @sCchild
   set @sCevtobcodeorg   = coalesce( @sCchildorg, @sDeforg )
   set @sCevtobtype      = @sCchildtype
   set @sCevtobrtype     = @sCcchildrtype

   set @sTempMRC = coalesce( @sCmrc, N'*' )

body:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7STIINT @nTRNTransId NUMERIC(18, 0)
                             ,@nINTTransId NUMERIC(18, 0)
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @nReturn      INT
       ,@nError       INT
       ,@sCheck       NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sOrg         NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sDefOrg      NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sMultiOrg    NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@nCount       INT
       ,@sDummy       NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sErrCheck    NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sErrSource   NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrType     NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrFunc     NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrParm1    NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrParm2    NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrMsg      NVARCHAR(240)
       ,@sUser        NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@nQty         NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sParam1      NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sPart        NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sPartOrg     NVARCHAR(15)

       ,@sTRNCode     NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sTRNAuth     NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sTRNOrg      NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sTRNPart     NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sTRNPartOrg  NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sTRNStore    NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@nTRNQty      NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sTRNBin      NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sTRNLot      NVARCHAR(12)

       ,@sTRACode     NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sTRARType    NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sTRARStatus  NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sTRAFromCode NVARCHAR(30)
	   ,@nTempRowCount integer

SELECT @sErrCheck  = N'0'
      ,@sErrSource = N'O7STIINT'
      ,@sErrType   = N'PROC'
      ,@sErrFunc   = N'MAIN'
      ,@sErrParm1  = NULL
      ,@sErrParm2  = NULL
      ,@sErrMsg    = NULL
      ,@sDefOrg    = UPPER(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'DEFORG'))
      ,@sMultiOrg  = UPPER(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'MULTIORG'))

DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
 WHERE ine_transid = @nTRNTransId

SELECT @sTRNCode    = trn_code
      ,@sTRNAuth    = trn_auth
      ,@sTRNOrg     = trn_org
      ,@sTRNPart    = trn_part
      ,@sTRNPartOrg = trn_part_org
      ,@sTRNStore   = trn_store
      ,@nTRNQty     = trn_qty
      ,@sTRNBin     = trn_bin
      ,@sTRNLot     = trn_lot
  FROM r5transinterface
 WHERE trn_transid = @nTRNTransId

IF @sTRNCode IS NULL
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'8', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNCode, NULL, NULL
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1
   RETURN
   END

SELECT @sTRACode = tra_code
      ,@sTRARType = tra_rtype
      ,@sTRARStatus = tra_rstatus
      ,@sTRAFromCode = tra_fromcode
  FROM r5transactions
 WHERE tra_code = @sTRNCode
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'16', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNCode, NULL, NULL
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1
   RETURN
   END

IF @sTRNAuth IS NULL
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'2', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1
   RETURN
   END
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5users WHERE usr_code = @sTRNAuth AND ISNULL(usr_login, N'+') = N'+')
   SET @sUser = @sTRNAuth
ELSE
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'15', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNAuth, NULL, NULL
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1
   RETURN
   END

IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
   BEGIN
   IF @sTRNOrg IS NULL
      BEGIN
      SELECT @sOrg = tra_org
        FROM r5transactions
            ,r5userorganization
       WHERE tra_code = @sTRNCode
         AND tra_org = uog_org
         AND uog_user = @sUser
         AND uog_common = N'-'
      IF @sOrg IS NULL
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'3', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
		   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         RETURN
         END
      END
   ELSE
      BEGIN
      IF dbo.O7CHECKORG(@sTRNOrg, @sUser, N'-') != 1
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'4', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNOrg, @sTRNAuth, NULL
		   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         RETURN
         END
      SET @sOrg = @sTRNOrg
      END
   IF @sTRNPart IS NOT NULL
      IF dbo.O7CHECKORG(@sTRNPartOrg, @sUser, N'+') != 1
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'5', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNPartOrg, @sTRNPart, NULL
	     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         END
   END
ELSE
   SET @sOrg = @sDefOrg

IF @sTRACode = @sTRNCode
   BEGIN
   IF @sTRARType = N'STTK'
      IF @sTRARStatus = N'U'
         BEGIN
         IF @sTRNStore IS NOT NULL
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5stores WHERE str_code = @sTRNStore AND    coalesce( str_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
               BEGIN
               EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'7', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNStore, NULL, NULL
			   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				  return -1
               RETURN
               END
         IF (@sTRAFromCode = @sTRNStore AND @sTRACode = @sTRNCode)
            IF @nTRNQty >= 0
               SET @nQty = @nTRNQty
            ELSE
               BEGIN
               SET @sParam1 = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nTRNQty)
               EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'14', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sParam1, NULL, NULL
			   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				  return -1
               RETURN
               END
         ELSE
            BEGIN
            EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'9', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRACode, NULL, NULL
			   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				  return -1
            RETURN
            END
         END
      ELSE
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'12', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNCode, NULL, NULL
		   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         RETURN
         END
   ELSE
      BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'13', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNCode, NULL, NULL
	   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		  return -1
      RETURN
      END
   IF @sTRNBin IS NOT NULL
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5bins WHERE bin_store = @sTRNStore AND bin_code = @sTRNBin AND ISNULL(bin_notused, N'-') = N'-')
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'10', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNBin, NULL, NULL
		   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         RETURN
         END
   IF @sTRNLot IS NOT NULL
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5lots WHERE lot_code = @sTRNLot)
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'11', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNLot, NULL, NULL
		   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         RETURN
         END
   IF @sTRNPart IS NOT NULL
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5parts WHERE par_code = @sTRNPart AND par_org = ISNULL(@sTRNPartOrg, @sOrg))
         SELECT @sPart = @sTRNPart, @sPartOrg = ISNULL(@sTRNPartOrg, @sOrg)
      ELSE
         BEGIN
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'6', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNPart, NULL, NULL
		   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
         RETURN
         END
   UPDATE r5stocktakelines
      SET stl_phyqty = @nQty
    WHERE stl_part   = @sTRNPart
      AND stl_bin    = @sTRNBin
      AND stl_lot    = @sTRNLot
      AND stl_store  = @sTRNStore
      AND stl_trans  = @sTRNCode
   SELECT @nError = @@ERROR, @nTempRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT
   IF @nError != 0
      GOTO EXCEPTION_HANDLER
   IF @nTempRowCount = 0
      BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'1', @sErrSource, @sErrType, NULL, @sTRNCode, NULL, NULL
	   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		  return -1
      RETURN
      END
   END

DELETE FROM r5transinterface
 WHERE trn_transid = @nTRNTransId

create function O7STOQTY(	@sEevent	NVARCHAR(30),
  							@nAct     	INT,
  							@sPart     	NVARCHAR(30),
 	 						@sPartorg 	NVARCHAR(15),
  							@sStore   	NVARCHAR(15) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
    declare @nResult numeric(24,6)
  	declare @nQtyinstore numeric(24,6)
  	declare @nQtyallocated numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCount	int
	begin
		SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	    FROM   r5reservations r
	    WHERE  r.res_part     = @sPart
	    AND    r.res_part_org = @sPartorg
	    AND    r.res_store    = @sStore
	    AND    ( r.res_event <> @sEevent
	             OR r.res_act <> @nAct )
        IF @nCount > 0
		begin
		    SELECT @nQtyallocated = ISNULL(SUM( r.res_allqty), 0)
		    FROM   r5reservations r
		    WHERE  r.res_part     = @sPart
		    AND    r.res_part_org = @sPartorg
		    AND    r.res_store    = @sStore
		    AND    ( r.res_event <> @sEevent
		             OR r.res_act <> @nAct )
        end
        IF @nCount = 0
			set @nQtyallocated = 0 
	end
	
	begin
		SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	    FROM   r5stock s
	    WHERE  s.sto_part      = @sPart
	    AND    s.sto_part_org  = @sPartorg
	    AND    s.sto_store     = @sStore
		
		IF @nCount > 0
		begin
		    SELECT @nQtyinstore = ISNULL(s.sto_qty,0)
		    FROM   r5stock s
		    WHERE  s.sto_part      = @sPart
		    AND    s.sto_part_org  = @sPartorg
		    AND    s.sto_store     = @sStore
		end
		IF @nCount = 0
			set @nQtyinstore = 0
    end

    IF @nQtyallocated <= @nQtyinstore 
        set @nResult = @nQtyinstore - @nQtyallocated
    ELSE
        set @nResult = 0
RETURN @nResult
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7STRIP_SPACES(@str varchar(2000))
RETURNS varchar(2000) AS
BEGIN 
    --remove space after comma
    WHILE CHARINDEX(', ', @str) > 0 
        SET @str = REPLACE(@str, ', ', ',')

    --remove space before comma
    WHILE CHARINDEX(' ,', @str) > 0 
        SET @str = REPLACE(@str, ' ,', ',')
    
    RETURN @str

CREATE FUNCTION O7STRUCTURES_GET_HIER_1 (	@cobject	NVARCHAR(30),
						@cobjectorg	NVARCHAR(15))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (stc_child		NVARCHAR(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel				INTEGER
	DECLARE @currentchild		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @currentchildorg	NVARCHAR(15)

	DECLARE @tStack	TABLE ( stc_child		NVARCHAR(30), 
							stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15),
							LevelID 		INTEGER )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				@nLevel
		FROM	r5structures
		WHERE	stc_parent     = @cobject
			AND	stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					IF @nLevel >= 1
						BEGIN
							SELECT	@currentchild		= stc_child,
									@currentchildorg	= stc_child_org
							FROM	@tStack
							WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							INSERT INTO @tReturn
									VALUES ( @currentchild, @currentchildorg)
						END

					DELETE FROM @tStack
						WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							AND stc_child		= @currentchild
							AND stc_child_org	= @currentchildorg

					INSERT INTO @tStack
						SELECT	stc_child,
								stc_child_org,
								@nLevel + 1
						FROM	r5structures
						WHERE	stc_parent		= @currentchild
							AND	stc_parent_org	= @currentchildorg

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	RETURN 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SXIRWO
   @sEvent          nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sOrg            nvarchar(15),
   @sReq            nvarchar(30),
   @nReqline        numeric(8),
   @sMrc            nvarchar(15),
   @sObject         nvarchar(30),
   @sObjectorg      nvarchar(15),
   @sStwo           nvarchar(20),
   @sUser           nvarchar(255),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sDeforg		nvarchar(200)	/*r5organization.org_code%TYPE = o7dflt( N'DEFORG', @sChk )*/
	declare @sObtype		nvarchar(4)	/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE*/
	declare @sObrtype		nvarchar(4)	/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE*/
	declare @Sstw_desc		nvarchar(80)	/*r5standworks.stw_desc%TYPE*/
	declare @nStw_duration	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)	 /*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE*/
	declare @sStw_priority	nvarchar(8)	/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE*/
	declare @sStw_reqm		nvarchar(8)	/*r5events.evt_reqm%TYPE*/

	declare @sTempreq			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nTempreqline		numeric(8)
	declare @sTempstore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTemppart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTemppart_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempbin			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTemplot			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sTempobject		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTempobject_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nTempqty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nSQLIDENTITY		numeric(38)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sX			nvarchar(1)
	declare @dTempdate		datetime
	declare @nAcd			bigint
	

BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'

	set @dTempdate  = dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sOrg)

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


   IF @sEvent IS NULL 
	   begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sEvent OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5objects
			WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
			AND    obj_org  = @sObjectorg

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sObtype = obj_obtype,
					 @sObrtype = obj_obrtype
				FROM   r5objects
				WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
				AND    obj_org  = @sObjectorg
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = 2
					RETURN
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sJobtype OUTPUT, N'RP', N'JBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sStwo IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5standworks
					WHERE  stw_code = @sStwo

					if @nCount > 0 
						SELECT @Sstw_desc = stw_desc,  @nStw_duration = stw_duration,  @sStw_priority = stw_priority,  @sStw_reqm = stw_reqm
						FROM   r5standworks
						WHERE  stw_code = @sStwo
					else
						set @sX = null
				end
    
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		
			INSERT INTO r5events ( evt_code, evt_org, evt_desc, evt_rtype,
				evt_obtype, evt_obrtype, evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_rstatus,
				evt_standwork, evt_location, evt_location_org, evt_mrc, evt_date,
				evt_duration, evt_fixed, evt_Jobtype, evt_priority, evt_reqm,
				evt_enteredby, evt_target, evt_reported, evt_warranty,
				evt_objcriticality, evt_costcode, evt_schedend, evt_acd )
				SELECT @sEvent,
					@sOrg,
					coalesce( @Sstw_desc, N'-' ),
					N'JOB',
					o.obj_obtype,
					o.obj_obrtype,
					@sObject,
					@sObjectorg,
					N'R',
					@sStwo,
					o.obj_location,
					o.obj_location_org,
					@sMrc,
					@dTempdate,
					coalesce( @nStw_duration, 1 ),
					N'V',
					@sJobtype,
					@sStw_priority,
					@sStw_reqm,
					@sUser,
					dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,N'DD' ),
					@dTempdate,
					N'-',
					obj_criticality,
					obj_costcode,
					DATEADD(dd, @nStw_duration - 1, @dTempdate),
					@nAcd
				FROM   r5objects o
				WHERE  o.obj_code     = @sObject
				AND    o.obj_org      = @sObjectorg

			execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sEvent, N'RP', @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sObtype OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			IF @sStwo IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @dTempdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dTempdate, N'DD' ) 

					execute @nReturn = o7cract1 @sEvent, null, @sStwo, N'*', @sDeforg, N'0', @dTempdate, N'R', N'-', N'-', null, null, @sMrc, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

				end

		end

	INSERT INTO r5joblines ( jbl_event, jbl_part, jbl_part_org,
					jbl_req, jbl_reqline, jbl_qty, jbl_active )
		SELECT @sEvent,
		rql_part,
		rql_part_org,
		rql_req,
		rql_reqline,
		rql_qty - coalesce( rql_recvqty, 0 ),
		N'+'
		FROM   r5requislines
		WHERE  rql_req     = @sReq
		AND    rql_reqline = @nReqline





	declare c_rpb cursor local for SELECT	rpb_req, rpb_reqline, rpb_store, rpb_part, rpb_part_org, rpb_bin,
											rpb_lot, rpb_object, rpb_object_org, rpb_qty, RPB_SQLIDENTITY
									   FROM   r5repairbins
									   WHERE  rpb_req     = @sReq
									   AND    rpb_reqline = @nReqline

	
	open c_rpb
	fetch next from c_rpb into 	@sTempreq, @nTempreqline, @sTempstore, @sTemppart, @sTemppart_org, @sTempbin,
											@sTemplot, @sTempobject, @sTempobject_org, @nTempqty, @nSQLIDENTITY
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			UPDATE r5stock
			SET    sto_shopqty   = coalesce( sto_shopqty, 0 ) + @nTempqty
			WHERE  sto_store     = @sTempstore
			AND    sto_part      = @sTemppart
			AND    sto_part_org  = @sTemppart_org

			UPDATE r5binstock
			SET    bis_repairqty = bis_repairqty - @nTempqty
			WHERE  bis_store     = @sTempstore
			AND    bis_part      = @sTemppart
			AND    bis_part_org  = @sTemppart_org
			AND    bis_bin       = @sTempbin
			AND    bis_lot       = @sTemplot

			IF @sTempobject IS NOT NULL 
				UPDATE r5objects
				SET    obj_rstatus = N'CIR',
						obj_status  = null
				WHERE  obj_code = @sTempobject
				AND    obj_org  = @sTempobject_org

			UPDATE r5repairbins
			SET    rpb_event = @sEvent
			WHERE  rpb_sqlidentity     = @nSQLIDENTITY


			fetch next from c_rpb into		@sTempreq, @nTempreqline, @sTempstore, @sTemppart, @sTemppart_org, @sTempbin,
											@sTemplot, @sTempobject, @sTempobject_org, @nTempqty, @nSQLIDENTITY
		end
	close c_rpb
	deallocate c_rpb

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SYNCWSP
  @trantable   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @action      NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @abb         NVARCHAR( 3 ),
  @sqlidentity NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @func        NVARCHAR( 6 ) = NULL,
  @tab         NVARCHAR( 3 ) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @statement       NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @kf1             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf2             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf3             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf4             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf5             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf6             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf7             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kf8             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @kfd1            DATETIME
  DECLARE @kfd2            DATETIME
  DECLARE @trailer1        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer2        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer3        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer4        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer5        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer6        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer7        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailer8        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailerd1       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @trailerd2       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @wsptra          NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @keyfield1       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @keyfield2       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @keyfield3       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @keyfield4       NVARCHAR( 80 )

  DECLARE @swstable        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swsaction       NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @swsactive       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @swsprompt       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swsprompt2      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8seq   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8dt    NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd1     NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd1seq  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd2     NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd2seq  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swscondition    NVARCHAR( 4000 )
  DECLARE @swssqlidentity  INT
  DECLARE @messageid       NVARCHAR( 256 )
  DECLARE @flds            INT

  SET @wsptra = dbo.o7dflt2( '@WSPTRA' )
  IF ISNULL( @wsptra, 'N' ) <> 'Y' 
    RETURN

  SET @flds = 0

  /* Retrieve data from the setup table. */
  SELECT @swstable       = sws_table,
         @swsaction      = sws_action,
         @swsactive      = sws_active,
         @swsprompt      = sws_prompt,
         @swsprompt2     = sws_prompt2,
         @swskeyfld1     = sws_keyfld1,
         @swskeyfld1seq  = sws_keyfld1_seq,
         @swskeyfld1dt   = sws_keyfld1_dt,
         @swskeyfld2     = sws_keyfld2,
         @swskeyfld2seq  = sws_keyfld2_seq,
         @swskeyfld2dt   = sws_keyfld2_dt,
         @swskeyfld3     = sws_keyfld3,
         @swskeyfld3seq  = sws_keyfld3_seq,
         @swskeyfld3dt   = sws_keyfld3_dt,
         @swskeyfld4     = sws_keyfld4,
         @swskeyfld4seq  = sws_keyfld4_seq,
         @swskeyfld4dt   = sws_keyfld4_dt,
         @swskeyfld5     = sws_keyfld5,
         @swskeyfld5seq  = sws_keyfld5_seq,
         @swskeyfld5dt   = sws_keyfld5_dt,
         @swskeyfld6     = sws_keyfld6,
         @swskeyfld6seq  = sws_keyfld6_seq,
         @swskeyfld6dt   = sws_keyfld6_dt,
         @swskeyfld7     = sws_keyfld7,
         @swskeyfld7seq  = sws_keyfld7_seq,
         @swskeyfld7dt   = sws_keyfld7_dt,
         @swskeyfld8     = sws_keyfld8,
         @swskeyfld8seq  = sws_keyfld8_seq,
         @swskeyfld8dt   = sws_keyfld8_dt,
         @swskeyfldd1    = sws_keyflddate1,
         @swskeyfldd1seq = sws_keyflddate1_seq,
         @swskeyfldd2    = sws_keyflddate2,
         @swskeyfldd2seq = sws_keyflddate2_seq,
         @swscondition   = sws_condition,
         @swssqlidentity = sws_sqlidentity
  FROM   r5syncwspsetup
  WHERE  sws_table  = @trantable
  AND    sws_action = @action
  AND    sws_function = COALESCE( @func, sws_function )
  AND    COALESCE( sws_tab, N'x' ) = COALESCE( @tab, sws_tab, N'x' )
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN sws_tab IS NULL THEN '2' ELSE '1' END
  IF @swskeyfld1 IS NULL AND @swskeyfldd1 IS NULL
    /* Return if no setup found. */
    RETURN

  /* Construct statement to retrieve necessary columns from current record just inserted/updated/deleted. */
  SET @statement = 'SELECT '

  SET @statement = @statement + '@kf1 = ' + ISNULL( @swskeyfld1, 'CAST( NULL AS NVARCHAR( 80 ) )' )
  IF @swskeyfld1 IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @trailer1  = '#' + CAST( @swskeyfld1seq AS NVARCHAR ) + '#' + @swskeyfld1dt

CREATE PROCEDURE O7SYNCWSPTRIGGER
  @tabname NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @action  NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @active  NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @insstat NVARCHAR( 1000 ),
  @abb     NVARCHAR( 3 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @statement NVARCHAR( 4000 )
  DECLARE @trigname  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tablename NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @verb      NVARCHAR( 6 )

  /* Set some variables, depending on the action (Add, Sync or Delete). */
  IF @action = 'ADD' 
    BEGIN
      SET @verb      = 'INSERT'
      SET @trigname  = 'WSP_INS_' + @abb
      SET @tablename = 'inserted'
    END
  ELSE IF @action = 'SYNC' 
    BEGIN
      SET @verb      = 'UPDATE'
      SET @trigname  = 'WSP_UPD_' + @abb
      SET @tablename = 'inserted'
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      SET @verb      = 'DELETE'
      SET @trigname  = 'WSP_DEL_' + @abb
      SET @tablename = 'deleted'
    END

  IF EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' 
              FROM   sysobjects 
              WHERE  name = @trigname
              AND    type = 'TR' )
    BEGIN
      /* Always drop trigger, if it exists. */
      SET @statement = 'DROP TRIGGER ' + @trigname
      EXECUTE sp_executesql @statement
    END
  
  IF @active = '+'
    /* Create trigger, if record is active. */
    BEGIN
      IF @action IN ( 'ADD', 'SYNC' )
        BEGIN
          SET @statement = 
'CREATE TRIGGER ' + @trigname + CHAR( 10 ) +
'ON ' + @tabname + CHAR( 10 ) +
'FOR ' + @verb + CHAR( 10 ) +
'NOT FOR REPLICATION ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'AS ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'  DECLARE @sqlidentity INTEGER ' + CHAR( 10 )
          
          /* Specific code per table. */
          IF @tabname IN ( 'R5HOME', 'R5ENTITYSAFETY', 'R5TASKS', 'R5PSCATEGORIES', 'R5OBJECTS', 'R5TASKTRADES', 'R5COMPANIES', 'R5DEVICES', 'R5DOCUMENTS', 'R5FUNCTIONS', 'R5OBJDEPTYPES', 'R5OBJECTCAPACITIES',
                           'R5OBJECTLOTO', 'R5OBJLINEARREF', 'R5OBJTESTPOINTS', 'R5REQUISITIONS', 'R5SERVICECATALOGUE', 'R5TASKCHECKLISTS', 'R5TASKTOOLS', 'R5WORKSAFETY', 'R5TRANSACTIONS' )
            SET @statement = @statement +
'  DECLARE @func NVARCHAR( 6 ) ' + CHAR( 10 )

          IF ( @tabname IN ( 'R5FUNCTIONS', 'R5OBJECTS' ) AND @action = 'SYNC' ) OR @tabname = 'R5OBJLINEARREF'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'  DECLARE @tab NVARCHAR( 3 ) ' + CHAR( 10 )


          SET @statement = @statement +
'  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'    BEGIN ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'      SET NOCOUNT ON ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'      DECLARE c_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR ' + CHAR( 10 )

          /* More specific code per table. */
          IF @tabname = 'R5HOME'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE hom_type WHEN ''C'' THEN ''BSCHRT'' WHEN ''+'' THEN ''BSKPIC'' ELSE ''BSINBX'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5ENTITYSAFETY'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE esf_rentity WHEN ''STWO'' THEN ''WSSTWO'' WHEN ''PPM'' THEN ''WSPPMS'' WHEN ''PART'' THEN ''SSPART'' ELSE ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = SUBSTRING( esf_code, 1, CHARINDEX( ''#'', esf_code ) - 1 ) AND obj_org = SUBSTRING( esf_code, CHARINDEX( ''#'', esf_code ) + 1, 100 ) ) END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )          
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJDEPTYPES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN ''I'' THEN ''OSECON'' ELSE ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype END FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = obd_object AND obj_org = obd_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJTESTPOINTS'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN ''I'' THEN ''OSECON'' ELSE ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype END FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = otp_object AND obj_org = otp_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJECTCAPACITIES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = ocp_object AND obj_org = ocp_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJECTLOTO'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = olo_object AND obj_org = olo_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJLINEARREF'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = lrf_objcode AND obj_org = lrf_objorg ), CASE lrf_linear_reftype WHEN ''O'' THEN ''LRF'' WHEN ''R'' THEN ''RUT'' ELSE ''SGM'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5TASKS'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE tsk_jobplan WHEN ''+'' THEN ''WSJBPL'' ELSE ''WSTASK'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5COMPANIES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE com_customer WHEN ''+'' THEN ''SSSUPC'' ELSE ''SSSUPP'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5DEVICES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE dev_rtype WHEN ''PRNT'' THEN ''BSDEVS'' ELSE ''BSMDEV'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5DOCUMENTS'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE doc_warranty WHEN ''-'' THEN ''BSDOCU'' ELSE ''OSWARR'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5FUNCTIONS' AND @action = 'SYNC'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT i.fun_sqlidentity,' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'               CASE WHEN (    COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltertype, ''x'' )          <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltertype, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfilterclass, ''x'' )         <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfilterclass, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfilterwoobjtype, ''x'' )     <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfilterwoobjtype, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfilterchecklist, ''x'' )     <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfilterchecklist, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltercfclass, ''x'' )       <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltercfclass, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltercfclass_org, ''x'' )   <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltercfclass_org, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltercforg, ''x'' )         <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltercforg, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_reservationcalendar, ''x'' )      <> COALESCE( d.fun_reservationcalendar, ''x'' ) ) THEN ''BSFFSP''' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                    ELSE CASE WHEN (    COALESCE( i.fun_schedulerview, ''x'' )            <> COALESCE( d.fun_schedulerview, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_blockduration, ''x'' )            <> COALESCE( d.fun_blockduration, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingstarttimehours, ''x'' )    <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingstarttimehours, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingstarttimeminutes, ''x'' )  <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingstarttimeminutes, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingendtimehours, ''x'' )      <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingendtimehours, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingendtimeminutes, ''x'' )    <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingendtimeminutes, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'

CREATE FUNCTION DBO.O7SZRCVF(@sLANG    nvarchar(2),
                             @sDESTYPE nvarchar(16),
                             @sUSER    nvarchar(255),
                             @sRSTATUS nvarchar(4),
                             @sSTATUS  nvarchar(4),
                             @sCODE    nvarchar(30))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

   declare @sUstatus   nvarchar(4)
   declare @sIstatus   nvarchar(4)
   declare @sUsrgroup  nvarchar(12)
   declare @sChk       nvarchar(16)
   declare @nErec      int
   declare @nReturn    int
   declare @sDatabase  varchar(128)

   set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )
   set @sIstatus = @sSTATUS

   if @sRSTATUS = N'R' 
   begin
      if upper(@sDESTYPE) = N'PRINT' 
         begin
            SELECT @sUstatus = s.uco_code
            FROM  r5ucodes s
            WHERE s.uco_rcode       = N'A'
                  AND s.uco_rentity = N'DOST'
                  AND s.uco_system  = N'+'

            set @nErec = 0
            execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7ERECORD', @nErec OUTPUT, @sSTATUS, @sUstatus
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
               begin
                    set @sIstatus = @sSTATUS
                    GOTO PostException
               end

            -- If electronic signature is required for this status change,
            -- do not update the status.

            if @nErec = 2
              begin
                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7SZRCVF_PRINTED', @sUSER, @sCODE
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       begin
                            set @sIstatus = @sSTATUS
                            GOTO PostException
                       end
               end

            else
               begin
                  SELECT @sUsrgroup = usr_group 
                  FROM   r5users
                  WHERE  usr_code = @sUSER

                  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 
                  FROM   r5auth a
                  WHERE (a.aut_user       = @sUSER
                        OR  (a.aut_group  = @sUsrgroup
                        AND a.aut_user    = N'*' ))
                        AND a.aut_rentity = N'RECV'
                        AND (a.aut_status = N'*' OR a.aut_status  = @sSTATUS)
                        AND a.aut_statnew = @sUstatus
                        AND a.aut_type    = N'+'
                        AND NOT EXISTS  (SELECT *
                                          FROM  r5auth a
                                          WHERE a.aut_user  = @sUSER
                                          AND a.aut_group   = @sUsrgroup
                                          AND a.aut_rentity = N'RECV'
                                          AND (a.aut_status = N'*' OR a.aut_status = @sSTATUS)
                                          AND a.aut_type    = N'-' ) )
                     begin
                        set @sIstatus = @sUstatus
                        execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7SZRCVF_STATUS', @sUSER, @sCODE, @sUstatus
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                           set @sIstatus = @sSTATUS
                     end
               end
         end
         PostException:
   end
   
   return @sIstatus + N' [' + DBO.REPGETDESC(@sLANG,N'UCOD',@sIstatus,N'DOST',NULL) + N']'

end
