create function O7SZSTOL ( @sR5User             nvarchar(255),
                           @sR5Func             nvarchar(6),
                           @sR5Lang             nvarchar(2),
                           @sR5Org              nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelPart            nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelStor            nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelParttp          nvarchar(8),
                           @sSelStocktp         nvarchar(8),
                           @sSelSupplier        nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelCommodity       nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelManupart        nvarchar(50),
                           @sSelManufact        nvarchar(24),
                           @sSelCategory        nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelReportingcurr   nvarchar(3),
                           @sSelInclparts       nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelNoncons         nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelCons            nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelDisplay         nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelGroupby         nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelOrg             nvarchar(15),
                           @r5role              nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( SZSTOL_TMPROWID      int identity PRIMARY KEY,
                        SZSTOL_GROUPCODE     nvarchar(60) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_GROUPDESC     nvarchar(255) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_GROUPLEBEL    nvarchar(80) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_STOSTORE      nvarchar(60) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_STOREDESC     nvarchar(255) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_STOPART       nvarchar(60) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_PARTDESC      nvarchar(255) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_PARCLASS      nvarchar(8)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_STOCLASS      nvarchar(8)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_PARUOM        nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_DATERECEIVED  nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_BISBIN        nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_BISLOT        nvarchar(12) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_STOQUANTITY   numeric(30,6),
                        SZSTOL_STOPRICE      numeric(30,6),
                        SZSTOL_EXCHRATE      numeric(30,6),
                        SZSTOL_CUMMTOTAL     nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        SZSTOL_SHOWERR       int,
                        SZSTOL_PARCONDITION  nvarchar(80) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                        )

as
begin

    INSERT INTO @tReturn 
    SELECT 
          CASE WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'S' THEN
                    STO_STORE + CASE WHEN STR_ORG = @sR5Org THEN ' ' ELSE ' (' + STR_ORG + ')' END 
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'T' THEN
                    ISNULL(PAR_TRACKTYPE,' ')
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'L' THEN
                    ISNULL(STO_PREFSUP,' ')
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'C' THEN
                    ISNULL(PAR_CATEGORY,' ')
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'M' THEN
                    ISNULL(PAR_COMMODITY,' ')
          ELSE
                    STO_PART + CASE WHEN STO_PART_ORG = @sR5Org THEN ' ' ELSE ' (' + STO_PART_ORG + ')' END
          END  GROUPCODE,
          CASE WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'S' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang,N'STOR',STO_STORE,NULL,NULL) 
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'T' THEN
                    ' '
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'L' THEN
                    (SELECT COM_DESC FROM R5COMPANIES WHERE COM_CODE = STO_PREFSUP AND COM_ORG = STO_PREFSUP_ORG)
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'C' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang,N'OBJ',PAR_CATEGORY,N'C',NULL)
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'M' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang,N'COMM',PAR_COMMODITY,NULL,NULL)
          ELSE
                    DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang ,N'PART',STO_PART + '#' + STO_PART_ORG,NULL,NULL)
          END  GROUPDESC,
          CASE WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'S' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func,@sR5Lang,22)
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'T' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func,@sR5Lang,23)
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'L' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func,@sR5Lang,24)
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'C' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func,@sR5Lang,25)
               WHEN @sSelGroupby = N'M' THEN
                    DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func,@sR5Lang,26)
          ELSE
                    DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func,@sR5Lang,2)
          END  GROUPLEBEL,
          STO_STORE + CASE WHEN STR_ORG = @sR5Org THEN ' ' ELSE ' (' + STR_ORG + ')' END   STO_STORE,
          DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang,N'STOR',STO_STORE,NULL,NULL)  STORE_DESC,       
          STO_PART  + CASE WHEN STO_PART_ORG = @sR5Org THEN ' ' ELSE ' (' + STO_PART_ORG + ')' END  STO_PART,
          DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang ,N'PART',STO_PART + '#' + STO_PART_ORG,NULL,NULL)  PART_DESC,
          PAR_CLASS,
          STO_CLASS,
          PAR_UOM,
          DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@sR5User, @sR5Org, (SELECT MAX(TRL_DATE) FROM R5TRANSLINES WHERE TRL_RTYPE = N'RECV' AND TRL_PART = STO_PART AND TRL_PART_ORG = STO_PART_ORG
          AND TRL_STORE = STO_STORE AND TRL_LOT = BIS_LOT AND TRL_BIN = BIS_BIN )) DATE_RECEIVED,  
          BIS_BIN, 
          BIS_LOT,
          CASE WHEN @sSelDisplay = N'+' THEN BIS_REPAIRQTY ELSE BIS_QTY END STO_QUANTITY,
          CASE WHEN @sSelDisplay <> N'+' THEN 
                    CASE WHEN (SELECT INS_DESC FROM R5INSTAll WHERE INS_CODE = N'PRICELEV') = N'S' THEN
                               ISNULL( DBO.O7GETPRC(STO_STORE,STO_PART,STO_PART_ORG,@sR5Org, N'B', N'S', NULL ),0)
                    ELSE
                               ISNULL( DBO.O7GETPRC(STO_STORE,STO_PART,STO_PART_ORG,STR_ORG, N'B', N'P', NULL ),0)
                    END  
          ELSE
                    CASE WHEN (SELECT INS_DESC FROM R5INSTAll WHERE INS_CODE = N'PRICELEV') = N'S' THEN
                               ISNULL( DBO.O7GTCORE2(STO_STORE,STO_PART,STO_PART_ORG, @sR5Org , N'S', NULL),0)
                    ELSE
                               ISNULL( DBO.O7GTCORE2(STO_STORE,STO_PART,STO_PART_ORG, STR_ORG , N'P', NULL),0)
                    END 
          END STO_PRICE,
          CASE WHEN (@sSelReportingcurr = DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(STO_PART_ORG)) THEN 1 
          ELSE ISNULL(DBO.REPGTEXCH(CASE WHEN @sSelReportingcurr = N'%' THEN 
                                       (SELECT INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'DEFCURR') 
                                   ELSE @sSelReportingcurr END, STO_PART_ORG, NULL),1) 
          END  EXCH_RATE,0,
          DBO.REPGETVALIDEXCH(@sSelReportingcurr, STO_PART_ORG) SHOW_ERR,
	  PAR_CONDITION
    FROM  R5BINSTOCK,R5STOCK,R5PARTS , R5STORES 
    WHERE STR_ORG IN (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION , R5PERMISSIONS  
                      WHERE UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND 
                            PRM_SELECT = N'?' AND 
                            UOG_USER = @sR5User AND 
                            UOG_ROLE = @r5role AND 
                            PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func) AND 
          STO_PART = PAR_CODE AND STO_PART_ORG = PAR_ORG AND 
          BIS_STORE = STO_STORE AND BIS_STORE = STR_CODE AND 
          BIS_PART = STO_PART AND BIS_PART_ORG = STO_PART_ORG AND  
          (@sSelDisplay <> N'+' OR PAR_REPAIRABLE = N'+') AND
          ( 
               (@sSelNoncons =  @sSelCons) OR
               (@sSelNoncons <> @sSelCons  AND STO_CONSIGNMENT = @sSelCons)

                                @sStoreclasscode    nvarchar(8),
                                @sR5User            nvarchar(255),
                                @sR5Fun             nvarchar(6),
                                @sR5Lang            nvarchar(2),
                                @sDesc              nvarchar(255),
                                @r5role             nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( sto_store               nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        sto_part                nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        sto_part_org            nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        sto_prefstore           nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        sto_prefsup             nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        sto_leadtime            numeric(4,1) )
as
begin
        declare @nLevel               int
        declare @sStore               nvarchar(15)
        declare @sPart                nvarchar(30)
        declare @sPartorg             nvarchar(15)
        declare @sPrefstore           nvarchar(15)
        declare @sPrefsupplier        nvarchar(30)
        declare @nLeadtime            numeric(4,1)
	declare @curpart              nvarchar(30)
	declare @curpartorg           nvarchar(15)
	declare @curstore			 nvarchar(15)

        declare @tStack table ( sto_store               nvarchar(15),
                                sto_part                nvarchar(30),
                                sto_part_org            nvarchar(15),
                                sto_prefstore           nvarchar(15),
                                sto_prefsup             nvarchar(30),
                                sto_leadtime            numeric(4,1),
                                LevelID                 int )


       DECLARE  PARTCUR CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT  P.PAR_CODE,P.PAR_ORG,O.STR_CODE 
										FROM    R5PARTS P,
									    R5STORES O,
										R5STOCK S
										WHERE   S.STO_PART               = P.PAR_CODE AND 
										S.STO_STORE              = O.STR_CODE AND
										S.STO_PART_ORG           = P.PAR_ORG AND
													( @sStorecode    = '%' OR S.STO_STORE LIKE  @sStorecode) AND
													( @sPrefsuppliercode = '%' OR S.STO_PREFSUP LIKE  @sPrefsuppliercode) AND
													( @sStoreclasscode   = '%' OR S.STO_CLASS LIKE  @sStoreclasscode) AND
													O.STR_ORG IN  (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION,R5PERMISSIONS 
		               												WHERE UOG_GROUP   = PRM_GROUP AND 
		       													PRM_SELECT  ='?'AND 
		       													UOG_USER    = @sR5User AND 
		       													UOG_ROLE    = @r5role AND 
		       													PRM_FUNCTION= @sR5Fun)AND
													( @sOrg     = '%' OR O.STR_ORG LIKE  @sOrg)		       		               		       		               
												 AND
										( @sPartcode   = '%' OR P.PAR_CODE LIKE  @sPartcode) AND
										( @sDesc   = '%' OR DBO.REPGETDESC( @sR5Lang,'PART',P.PAR_CODE+'#'+P.PAR_ORG,NULL, NULL) LIKE  @sDesc)


	OPEN PARTCUR
FETCH NEXT FROM PARTCUR INTO @curpart, @curpartorg, @curstore
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

     INSERT INTO @tStack 
                select  sto_store,
                        sto_part,
                        sto_part_org,
                        sto_prefstore,
                        sto_prefsup,
                        sto_leadtime,
                        1 
                  from  r5stock
                  where  sto_prefstore IS NULL and
                         sto_part        = @curpart and
                         sto_part_org    = @curpartorg and 
                          sto_store =@curstore
        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select  @sStore          = sto_store,
                                                @sPart           = sto_part,
                                                @sPartorg        = sto_part_org,
                                                @sPrefstore      = sto_prefstore,
                                                @sPrefsupplier   = sto_prefsup,
                                                @nLeadtime       = sto_leadtime
                                          from  @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                                        insert into @tReturn values ( @sStore, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPrefstore, @sPrefsupplier, @nLeadtime)
                                        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel and sto_store = @sStore and sto_part = @sPart and sto_part_org = @sPartorg and sto_prefstore = @sPrefstore and sto_prefsup = @sPrefsupplier and sto_leadtime = @nLeadtime
                                        insert into @tStack                     select  sto_store,
                                                                                        sto_part,
                                                                                        sto_part_org,
                                                                                        sto_prefstore,
                                                                                        sto_prefsup,
                                                                                        sto_leadtime,
                                                                                        @nLevel + 1
                                                                                 from   r5stock
                                                                                 where  sto_part      = @sPart and
                                                                                        sto_part_org  = @sPartorg and
                                                                                        sto_prefstore = @sStore 

                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END
		FETCH NEXT FROM PARTCUR INTO @curpart, @curpartorg, @curstore
END
        return
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7TABPERM(
    @sFunc nvarchar(6),
    @sTab  nvarchar(6),
    @sUsr  nvarchar(255),
    @sOrg  nvarchar(15))
RETURNS nvarchar(4) 
as
BEGIN
    declare @sCperm nvarchar( 4 )
    declare @sCvisible  nvarchar( 1 )  /* r5tabpermissions.trp_visible%type */
 
	set @sCperm = N'-'
    IF @sOrg IS NULL
	begin
		DECLARE cNuog CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    	SELECT MAX(CASE isnull( trp_select, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'Q' END) +
		   MAX(CASE isnull( trp_insert, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'I' END) +
		   MAX(CASE isnull( trp_update, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'U' END) +
		   MAX(CASE isnull( trp_delete, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'D' END),
           MIN(trp_visible)
    	FROM   r5userorganization,
           r5tabpermissions
    	WHERE  uog_user     = @sUsr
    	AND    trp_group    = uog_group
    	AND    trp_function = @sFunc
    	AND    trp_tab      = @sTab
        OPEN  cNuog
        FETCH NEXT FROM cNuog INTO @sCperm, @sCvisible
        CLOSE cNuog
		DEALLOCATE cNuog
	end
    ELSE
	begin
		DECLARE cUog CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    	SELECT CASE isnull( trp_select, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'Q' END +
		   CASE isnull( trp_insert, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'I' END +
		   CASE isnull( trp_update, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'U' END +
		   CASE isnull( trp_delete, N'-' ) WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'D' END,
           trp_visible
    	FROM   r5userorganization,
           r5tabpermissions
    	WHERE  uog_user     = @sUsr
    	AND    uog_org      = @sOrg
    	AND    trp_group    = uog_group
    	AND    trp_function = @sFunc
    	AND    trp_tab      = @sTab
        OPEN  cUog
        FETCH NEXT FROM cUog INTO @sCperm, @sCvisible
        CLOSE cUog
		DEALLOCATE cUog
    end

/* If the user not allowed to visible the tab then its not allowed to do any thing with this tab*/
    IF @sCvisible = N'-'
        set @sCperm = N'-'
    RETURN @sCperm
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TASKPLANESTCOST(
  @task        NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @taskrev     NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @job         NVARCHAR( 20 ), 
  @org         NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @mrc         NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @store       NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @supplier    NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @supplierorg NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @labor       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @hiredlabor  NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @stock       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @direct      NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @tool        NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @total       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @stwo        NVARCHAR( 20 ) = NULL,
  @ppm         NVARCHAR( 20 ) = NULL,
  @ppmrev      NUMERIC( 4 )   = NULL,
  @act         NUMERIC( 8 )   = NULL )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @currency       NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @supcurrency    NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @realjob        NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @cost           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @alabor         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ahiredlabor    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @astock         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @adirect        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @atool          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @atotal         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @return         INT

  DECLARE @date           DATETIME
 
  DECLARE @tskcode        NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @tskrevision    NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @tskorg         NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @tskhours       NUMERIC( 14, 4 )
  DECLARE @tskmatlist     NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @tskplanlevel   NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @orgcurr        NVARCHAR( 3 )
  
  DECLARE @tattrade       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tathours       NUMERIC( 14, 4 )

  DECLARE @wacact         NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @wactrade       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @wacest         NUMERIC
  DECLARE @wactask        NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @wacmatlist     NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @wachire        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @tskenhanced    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @tskprefsup     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tskprefsuporg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @actsupplier    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @actsupplierorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @mtlrevision    NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @waclabor       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  IF @stwo IS NULL AND @ppm IS NULL
    BEGIN
      IF @task IS NULL OR @taskrev IS NULL OR @org IS NULL
        /* If no task or organization defined, return. */
        RETURN
    END 

  SET @date = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' )

  /* Initialize costs. */
  SET @labor      = 0
  SET @hiredlabor = 0
  SET @stock      = 0
  SET @direct     = 0
  SET @tool       = 0

  /* Get currency. */
  SELECT @currency = org_curr
  FROM   r5organization
  WHERE  org_code = @org
  
  IF @stwo IS NULL AND @ppm IS NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Loop through all task records. */
      DECLARE tsk CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT tsk_code, tsk_revision, tsk_org, tsk_hours, tsk_matlist, org_curr
        FROM   r5organization, r5tasks
        WHERE  tsk_code     = @task
        AND    tsk_revision = @taskrev
        AND    org_code     = tsk_org
        AND    @job IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT tsk_code, tsk_revision, tsk_org, tsk_hours, tsk_matlist, org_curr
        FROM   r5organization, r5tasks, r5taskplanjobs
        WHERE  tsk_code       = tpj_jobplan
        AND    tpj_task       = @task
        AND    tpj_taskrev    = @taskrev
        AND    org_code       = tsk_org
        AND    tsk_reusable   = N'+'
        AND    tsk_revrstatus = N'A'
        AND  ( tpj_jobplan = @job OR @job = N'#ALL#' )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT tsk_code, tsk_revision, tsk_org, tsk_hours, tsk_matlist, org_curr
        FROM   r5organization, r5tasks, r5taskplanjobs
        WHERE  tsk_code       = tpj_jobplan
        AND    org_code       = tsk_org
        AND    tpj_task       = @task
        AND    tpj_taskrev    = @taskrev
        AND    tsk_reusable   = N'-'
        AND    tsk_revision   = ( SELECT MAX( tsk_revision )
                                  FROM   r5tasks
                                  WHERE  tsk_code = tpj_jobplan )
        AND  ( tpj_jobplan = @job OR @job = N'#ALL#' )
      OPEN tsk
      FETCH NEXT FROM tsk INTO @tskcode, @tskrevision, @tskorg, @tskhours, @tskmatlist, @orgcurr
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          /* Internal labor cost. */
          SET @cost = NULL
          SELECT @cost = SUM( tat_hours * dbo.o7gettraderate( ISNULL( @mrc, N'*' ), tat_trade, @date, @org ) )
          FROM   r5organization, r5trades, r5tasktrades
          WHERE  trd_code     = tat_trade
          AND    org_code     = trd_org
          AND    tat_task     = @tskcode
          AND    tat_revision = @tskrevision
          AND    tat_hire     = N'-'
          AND  ( trd_org = @org OR org_common = N'+' )
          SET @labor = @labor + ISNULL( @cost, 0 )
        
          /* External labor cost. */
          SET @cost = NULL
          IF @supplier IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
              /* Get price from service catalogue. */
              SELECT @cost = sca_price / ISNULL( sca_multiply, 1 ), 
                     @supcurrency = ISNULL( sca_curr, com_curr )
              FROM   r5companies, r5servicecatalogue
              WHERE  com_code         = sca_supplier
              AND    com_org          = sca_supplier_org
              AND    com_notused      = N'-'
              AND    sca_task         = @tskcode
              AND    sca_supplier     = @supplier
              AND    sca_supplier_org = @supplierorg
    
              IF @cost IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  IF @supcurrency <> @currency 
                    /* Use exchange rate. */
                    SET @cost = @cost / ISNULL( dbo.o7gtexch2( @supcurrency, @org, @date ), 1 )
                END
            END
          IF @cost IS NULL
            /* Try task prices. */
            SELECT @cost = tpr_price
            FROM   r5taskprices
            WHERE  tpr_task     = @tskcode
            AND    tpr_revision = @tskrevision
            AND    tpr_org      = @org
    
          SET @hiredlabor = @hiredlabor + ISNULL( @cost, 0 )
      
          IF @cost IS NULL
            BEGIN
              /* Try trade rates. */
              DECLARE tat2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
                SELECT tat_trade, tat_hours 
                FROM   r5organization, r5trades, r5tasktrades
                WHERE  trd_code     = tat_trade
                AND    org_code     = trd_org
                AND    tat_task     = @tskcode
                AND    tat_revision = @tskrevision
                AND    tat_hire     = N'+'
                AND  ( trd_org = @org OR org_common = N'+' )
              OPEN tat2
              FETCH NEXT FROM tat2 INTO @tattrade, @tathours
              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                BEGIN
                  SELECT   TOP 1 @cost = t.trr_ntrate
                  FROM     r5traderates t
                  WHERE    t.trr_mrc      IN ( N'*', @mrc )
                  AND      t.trr_trade    = @tattrade
                  AND      t.trr_org      = @org
                  AND      t.trr_supplier IN ( N'*', @supplier )
                  AND      t.trr_supplier_org IN ( N'*', @supplierorg )
                  AND      t.trr_person    = N'*'
                  AND      t.trr_start    <= @date
                  AND      t.trr_end      >= @date
                  AND      t.trr_octype   IN ( SELECT uco_code 
                                               FROM r5ucodes
                                               WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                                               AND   uco_rcode   = N'N'
                                               AND   uco_system  = N'+') 
                  ORDER BY CASE t.trr_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END,
                           CASE t.trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END
                  SET @hiredlabor = @hiredlabor + ISNULL( @cost * @tathours, 0 )
                  FETCH NEXT FROM tat2 INTO @tattrade,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TCHINT 
    @nNinttransid      numeric(18, 0),
    @sCrentity         nvarchar(4),
    @sCclass           nvarchar(8),
    @sCclsorg          nvarchar(15),
    @sCcode            nvarchar(100),
    @sCprompt          nvarchar(8),
    @sCvalue           nvarchar(40) OUTPUT,
    @sCerrchk          nvarchar(30) OUTPUT  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare  @sCerrsource	   nvarchar(40)
    declare  @sCerrtype		   nvarchar(40)
    declare  @sCerrfunc        nvarchar(100)
    declare  @sCerrparm1       nvarchar(40)
    declare  @sCerrparm2       nvarchar(40)
    declare  @sCerrmsg		   nvarchar(250)
    declare  @nNcount          int
    declare  @sCtype           nvarchar(8)		/* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE */
    declare  @nNvalue          numeric(24,6)
    declare  @dDvalue          datetime
    declare  @sChk             nvarchar(4)
    declare  @sCformdate       nvarchar(200)	/* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = o7dflt( 'FORMDATE', @sChk ) */
    declare  @sCformdati       nvarchar(200)	/* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = o7dflt( 'FORMDATI', @sChk ) */
	declare @nReturn 		   int
	declare @nError				int

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sCformdate OUTPUT, N'FORMDATE', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @nReturn <> 0 or @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sCformdati OUTPUT, N'FORMDATI', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @nReturn <> 0 or @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	set @nNcount = 0
    set @nNvalue = NULL
    set @dDvalue = NULL

    SELECT @nNcount = COUNT(*)
    FROM   r5propertyvalues
    WHERE  prv_rentity   = @sCrentity
    AND    prv_code      = @sCcode
    AND    prv_property  = @sCprompt

    SELECT @sCtype  = pro_type
    FROM   r5properties
    WHERE  pro_code = @sCprompt

    IF @sCtype = N'NUM'
	begin
        --prevent conversion error
        if @sCvalue is not null and isnumeric( @sCvalue ) = 0
	        begin
	            set @sCerrchk    = N'8114'
	            set @sCerrsource = N'O7TCHINT'
	            set @sCerrtype   = N'ORACLE'
	            set @sCerrfunc   = N'TCH IN/UPD'
	            set @sCerrparm1  = null
	            set @sCerrparm2  = null
	            set @sCerrmsg    = N'Error converting data type varchar to numeric.'
	            execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNinttransid
	                                   ,@sCerrchk
	                                   ,@sCerrsource
	                                   ,@sCerrtype
	                                   ,@sCerrfunc
	                                   ,@sCerrparm1
	                                   ,@sCerrparm2
	                                   ,@sCerrmsg
		        if @nReturn <> 0 or @@ERROR <> 0
			        return -1
                return
            end
        set @nNvalue = cast(@sCvalue as numeric(24,6))
        set @sCvalue = null
    end

    IF @sCtype in ( N'DATE', N'DATI' )
	begin
        --prevent conversion error
        if @sCvalue is not null and isdate( @sCvalue ) = 0
	        begin
	            set @sCerrchk    = N'241'
	            set @sCerrsource = N'O7TCHINT'
	            set @sCerrtype   = N'ORACLE'
	            set @sCerrfunc   = N'TCH IN/UPD'
	            set @sCerrparm1  = null
	            set @sCerrparm2  = null
	            set @sCerrmsg    = N'Syntax error converting datetime from character string.'
	            execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNinttransid
	                                   ,@sCerrchk
	                                   ,@sCerrsource
	                                   ,@sCerrtype
	                                   ,@sCerrfunc
	                                   ,@sCerrparm1
	                                   ,@sCerrparm2
	                                   ,@sCerrmsg
		        if @nReturn <> 0 or @@ERROR <> 0
			        return -1
                return
            end
        set @dDvalue = cast(@sCvalue as datetime)
        set @sCvalue = null
    end

	/* If not found then insert technical details record else update the */
	/* existing record                                                   */
    IF @nNcount = 0 
	begin
        INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues
            ( prv_property
             ,prv_rentity
             ,prv_class
	         ,prv_class_org
             ,prv_code
             ,prv_seqno
             ,prv_value
             ,prv_nvalue
             ,prv_dvalue
            )
        VALUES
            ( @sCprompt
             ,@sCrentity
             ,@sCclass
	         ,@sCclsorg
             ,@sCcode
             ,1
             ,@sCvalue
             ,@nNvalue
             ,@dDvalue
            )
	end
    ELSE
	begin
        UPDATE r5propertyvalues
        SET    prv_value  = @sCvalue
              ,prv_nvalue = @nNvalue
              ,prv_dvalue = @dDvalue
        WHERE  prv_rentity   = @sCrentity
        AND    prv_code      = @sCcode
        AND    prv_property  = @sCprompt
    end

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	IF @nError <> 0
	begin
	    set @sCerrchk    = cast( @nError as nvarchar(38) )
	    set @sCerrsource = N'O7TCHINT'
	    set @sCerrtype   = N'ORACLE'
	    set @sCerrfunc   = N'TCH IN/UPD'
	    set @sCerrparm1  = null
	    set @sCerrparm2  = null
	    set @sCerrmsg    = null
	    execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nNinttransid
	                           ,@sCerrchk
	                           ,@sCerrsource
	                           ,@sCerrtype
	                           ,@sCerrfunc
	                           ,@sCerrparm1
	                           ,@sCerrparm2
	                           ,@sCerrmsg
		if @nReturn <> 0 or @@ERROR <> 0
			return -1
    end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TDRV  @nNqueue int 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

    declare  @sCerrmsg    		nvarchar(240)	/* r5interfaceerrors.ine_error%TYPE */
    declare  @sCqueue     		nvarchar(1)
    declare  @sChk        		nvarchar(10)
    declare  @nIstat      		int
    declare  @sVtenant    		nvarchar(50)
    declare  @nVtimeout   		int 
    declare  @nNstop      		int
    declare  @nJobid      		int  -- Unique number for the job
	declare  @sDflt				nvarchar(200)
	declare  @bLock_exclusive 	bit
	declare  @bThere_are_errors bit
    declare  @sCdesc    		nvarchar(200) /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE */
	declare  @ins_error 		int
	declare  @nReturn			int
	declare  @nLvar				int
	declare  @sTempvar			nvarchar(2000)
	declare  @dNextdate			datetime
	/* declare cursor variable */
	declare  @nInt_sqlidentity  int
    declare  @nInt_transid		bigint
    declare  @sInt_action		nvarchar(30)
    declare  @sInt_keyfld1		nvarchar(80)
    declare  @sInt_keyfld2		nvarchar(80)
    declare  @sInt_keyfld3		nvarchar(80)
    declare  @nInt_transorgid		bigint
    declare  @nInt_group		int
    declare  @sInt_status		nvarchar(30)
    declare  @sInt_table		nvarchar(32)
    declare  @nInt_queue		int
	declare  @nError			int
    declare @sProducts          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sAspjobs           nvarchar(200)

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sProducts OUTPUT, N'PRODUCTS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAspjobs OUTPUT, N'ASPJOBS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    set @sProducts = upper(@sProducts)
    set @sAspjobs = coalesce(upper(@sAspjobs), N'OFF')

    set @sVtenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() 
    set @sCqueue = cast(@nNqueue as nvarchar(50) )
	set @sTempvar = N'TDRV' + @sCqueue

	IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
	begin
	    execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_Set_Module @sTempvar, N'Starting' 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		/* registers the batch driver in r5install, returning 0 when successful */
		IF @nNqueue = 0 
	        set @sCdesc = N'Tracking Data Error Driver'
	    ELSE
	        set @sCdesc = N'Tracking Data Driver ' + @sCqueue
	     
	    INSERT INTO r5install
	                ( ins_code,
	                  ins_desc,
	                  ins_comment,
	                  ins_fixed )
	    VALUES    ( N'~TDRV' + @sCqueue + '~',
	                N'RUNNING ' + cast( dbo.o7gttime2(null) as nvarchar(80) ),
	                @sCdesc,
	                N'-' )
		SELECT @ins_error = @@ERROR
	    COMMIT
		set @bLock_exclusive = 1
		if @ins_error = 0 or @ins_error = 2601 or @ins_error = 2627
			set @bLock_exclusive = 0
	
	    IF @bLock_exclusive = 0
		begin
		    IF @sCqueue = N'0' 
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDflt OUTPUT, N'~SLEEPT0', @sChk OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
		        set @nVtimeout = cast( isnull( @sDflt, '3600' ) as int )
			end
		    ELSE
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDflt OUTPUT, N'~SLEEP~', @sChk OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
		        set @nVtimeout = cast( isnull( @sDflt, '300' ) as int )
		    end
		    set @nNstop = 0
			set @sTempvar = N'TDRV' + @sCqueue
		    execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_Set_Module @sTempvar, N'Processing' 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			set @nNstop = 0
			declare cC1 cursor local for
	        SELECT i.int_sqlidentity,
	               i.int_transid,
	               i.int_action,
	               i.int_keyfld1,
	               i.int_keyfld2,
	               i.int_keyfld3,
	               i.int_transorgid,
	               i.int_group,
	               i.int_status,
	               i.int_table,
	               i.int_queue
	        FROM  r5interface i, r5trackingdata t
	        WHERE i.int_table   = N'R5TRACKINGDATA'
	        AND   i.int_transid = t.tkd_transid
	        AND   t.tkd_rstatus = CASE @nNqueue WHEN 0 THEN N'R' ELSE N'N' END
	        AND   i.int_queue   = @nNqueue
	        ORDER BY i.int_transid
			
			open cC1
			fetch next from cC1 into @nInt_sqlidentity, @nInt_transid, @sInt_action, @sInt_keyfld1, @sInt_keyfld2, @sInt_keyfld3,
		    						 @nInt_transorgid, @nInt_group, @sInt_status, @sInt_table, @nInt_queue	
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
				begin
			        SELECT @nNstop = COUNT (*)
			        FROM   r5install
			        WHERE  ins_code = '~STDRV' + @sCqueue + '~'
			         /* check whether a stop signal has been sent for this queue */
			        IF @nNstop <> 0 
						break
				end
		        DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
		        WHERE ine_transid = @nInt_transid
		        COMMIT
		        /*  Update trackingdata status to P at start of processing  */
		        execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_TKDSTA @nInt_transorgid, N'P' 
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cC1
					deallocate cC1
					rollback 
					Return -1
				end
		        if @@TRANCOUNT > 0 
					COMMIT
		        
				set @sChk = N'0'
		        set @sCerrmsg = null
		        IF @sInt_table = N'R5TRACKINGDATA'
				begin		
		            execute @nReturn = O7TKDINT @sInt_keyfld1, @nInt_transid, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						/* switch transactions in error to queue 0 to have TDRV0 process them */
		             	set @sCerrmsg = null
		             	UPDATE r5interface
		             	SET    int_status = N'+',
		                       int_retries = isnull(int_retries, 0) + 1,
		                       int_process = dbo.o7gttime2(null),
		                       int_queue = 0
		             	WHERE  int_sqlidentity = @nInt_sqlidentity
		             	INSERT INTO r5interfaceerrors( ine_transid, ine_error, ine_create )
		             	VALUES (@nInt_transid, @sCerrmsg, dbo.o7gttime2(null))
		             	/*  Update trackingdata status to E on error   */
						execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_TKDSTA @nInt_transorgid, N'E' 
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close cC1
							deallocate cC1
							rollback
							Return -1
						end
				        if @@TRANCOUNT > 0 
							COMMIT
					end
		        end
	
				SELECT 1
	            FROM   r5interfaceerrors
	            WHERE  ine_transid = @nInt_transid
	        	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
					set @bThere_are_errors = 0
	        	ELSE
	           		set @bThere_are_errors = 1
	
		        IF @bThere_are_errors = 0
				begin
					/* switch transactions in error to queue 0 to have TDRV0 process them */
		         	UPDATE r5interface
		         	SET    int_status = N'+',
		                   int_retries = isnull(int_retries, 0) + 1,
		                   int_process = dbo.o7gttime2(null),
		                   int_queue = 0
		         	WHERE  int_sqlidentity = @nInt_sqlidentity
		         	/*  Update trackingdata status to E on error   */
					execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_TKDSTA @nInt_transorgid, N'E' 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						close cC1
						deallocate cC1
						rollback
						Return -1
					end
			        if @@TRANCOUNT > 0 
						COMMIT
		        end
				if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					COMMIT
				fetch next from cC1 into @nInt_sqlidentity, @nInt_transid, @sInt_action, @sInt_keyfld1, @sInt_keyfld2, @sInt_keyfld3,
		    						 @nInt_transorgid, @nInt_group, @sInt_status, @sInt_table, @nInt_queue	
			end /* end of while */
			close cC1
			deallocate cC1
	
		    IF @nNstop <> 0 
			begin
				/* removes the batch driver entry from r5install */
	        	if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					ROLLBACK
	      		DELETE FROM r5install
	      		WHERE  ins_code LIKE N'%TDRV' + @sCqueue + '%'
	      		COMMIT
			end
		    ELSE
			begin
				set @sTempvar = N'TDRV' + @sCqueue + '(''' + isnull(@sVtenant, N'') + ''')' + ''
				set @dNextdate = getdate() + (@nVtimeout/86400)
		        execute @nRet

  DELETE FROM r5tempreqsfororder

  DELETE FROM r5tempssabca

  DELETE FROM r5eoqtemp

  DELETE FROM r5tempimpentity

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TEXTS_RESET_TEXTS @sPool nvarchar(12)  
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCtt_origtext  nvarchar(255)
	declare @sCtt_pool	nvarchar(12)
	declare @nCtt_length	int
	declare @sCtt_lang	nvarchar(2)
    DECLARE  cCustboil CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT ctt_origtext, ctt_pool, ctt_length, ctt_lang
    FROM r5customtexts
    WHERE ctt_pool LIKE @sPool

	OPEN cCustboil
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCustboil INTO @sCtt_origtext, @sCtt_pool, @nCtt_length, @sCtt_lang  
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
        UPDATE r5boilertexts
        SET bot_text = @sCtt_origtext,
            bot_changed = N'-'
        WHERE bot_pool = @sCtt_pool
        AND   bot_lang = @sCtt_lang
        AND bot_length <= @nCtt_length
        AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT NULL FROM r5customtexts c2
        WHERE c2.ctt_pool = @sCtt_pool
        AND   c2.ctt_lang = @sCtt_lang
        AND   c2.ctt_length < @nCtt_length
        AND   c2.ctt_length >= bot_length )
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCustboil INTO @sCtt_origtext, @sCtt_pool, @nCtt_length, @sCtt_lang 
    END
	CLOSE cCustboil
	DEALLOCATE cCustboil
END

	       AND   c2.ctt_lang = @sCtt_lang 
	       AND   c2.ctt_length < @nCtt_length
	       AND   c2.ctt_length >= bot_length )
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCustboil INTO @sCtt_text, @sCtt_pool, @nCtt_length, @sCtt_lang 
	END
	CLOSE cCustboil
	DEALLOCATE cCustboil

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TKPVAL
    @sCuserlang        nvarchar(2),
	@sCtkptrans        nvarchar(4),		
    @sCerrormessage    nvarchar(255) OUTPUT,
    @sChk              nvarchar(5) 	 OUTPUT  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCtrans            	nvarchar(4) /* r5trackingprompts.tkp_trans%TYPE; */
    declare @nNprompt           	numeric(18,0)
    declare @nNcount            	int
    declare @nNctr              	numeric(18,0)
	declare @sTkp_trans				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sTkr_trans				nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sTkr_promptseq			numeric(18,0)
	declare	@sTkr_targetprompt		numeric(18,0)
	declare @bRet 					Bit
	declare @nVcount 				int
	declare @sVret					nvarchar(4)
	declare @nTkp_promptseq 		numeric(18,0)
	declare @nTkp_branchgoto		numeric(18,0)
	declare @nTkp_returntoprompt	numeric(18,0)
	declare @nTkp_transgroup		numeric(18,0)
	declare @sTkp_obtranstype		nvarchar(4)
   
	DECLARE cCursor_prompts CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT p.tkp_trans
    FROM   r5trackingprompts p
	WHERE  p.tkp_trans = @sCtkptrans
    GROUP  BY p.tkp_trans

	
BEGIN
	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	OPEN cCursor_prompts
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCursor_prompts INTO @sTkp_trans
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
	    DECLARE
	    cCursor_trackingprompts CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	    SELECT Tkp_promptseq, Tkp_branchgoto, Tkp_returntoprompt, Tkp_transgroup, Tkp_obtranstype 
	    FROM   r5trackingprompts t
	    WHERE  t.tkp_trans = @sTkp_trans
	    AND    t.tkp_datartype IN ( N'A', N'N', N'D' )
	    ORDER  BY t.tkp_promptseq
        set @nNcount = 0
        set @nNctr   = 0
        set @sChk    = N'0'
        set @sCtrans = @sTkp_trans
		OPEN cCursor_trackingprompts
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCursor_trackingprompts INTO @nTkp_promptseq, @nTkp_branchgoto, @nTkp_returntoprompt,
														@nTkp_transgroup, @sTkp_obtranstype
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =  0
		BEGIN
            set @nNprompt = @nTkp_promptseq
            set @nNctr = @nNctr + 1

            IF @nTkp_branchgoto IS NOT NULL
			begin
                set @nNcount = 0
                SELECT @nNcount = COUNT(*)
                FROM   r5trackingprompts
                WHERE  tkp_trans     = @sCtrans
                AND    tkp_promptseq = @nTkp_branchgoto
                IF @nNcount = 0
				begin
                    set @sChk = N'8'
                    GOTO trans_loop
                end
            end
            IF @nTkp_returntoprompt IS NOT NULL
			begin
                set @nNcount = 0
                SELECT @nNcount = COUNT(*)
                FROM   r5trackingprompts
                WHERE  tkp_trans     = @sCtrans
                AND    tkp_promptseq = @nTkp_returntoprompt
                IF @nNcount = 0 
				begin
                    set @sChk = N'9'
                    GOTO trans_loop
                end
            end
            set @nNcount = 0
            SELECT @nNcount = COUNT(*)
            FROM   r5trackingprompts
            WHERE  tkp_trans      = @sCtrans
            AND    tkp_transgroup = @nTkp_transgroup
            AND    isnull(tkp_obtranstype,@sTkp_obtranstype) != @sTkp_obtranstype
            IF @nNcount <> 0
			begin
                set @sChk = N'14'
                GOTO trans_loop
            end
			FETCH NEXT FROM cCursor_trackingprompts INTO @nTkp_promptseq, @nTkp_branchgoto, @nTkp_returntoprompt,
														@nTkp_transgroup, @sTkp_obtranstype
		END  /* END OF INSIDE CURSOR */
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCursor_prompts INTO @sTkp_trans
	END /* END  OF  OUTSIDE  CURSOR */
	trans_loop:
	/* Code added by Muthu for the tab Return Prompts */
    IF @sChk = N'0'
    begin
		DECLARE cCur_ret CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT tkr_trans, tkr_promptseq, tkr_targetprompt
		FROM   R5trackreturnprompts
		WHERE  tkr_trans = @sCtkptrans

		OPEN cCur_ret
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCur_ret INTO @sTkr_trans, @sTkr_promptseq, @sTkr_targetprompt
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =  0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sVret = tkp_datartype
			FROM r5trackingprompts
			WHERE tkp_trans = @sTkr_trans AND
				tkp_promptseq = @sTkr_promptseq AND
				tkp_datartype NOT IN (N'F', N'C')
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @bRet=0
			else
				set @bRet=1
			IF @bRet=0 
			begin
		        set @sCtrans = @sTkr_trans 
				set @nNprompt = @sTkr_promptseq
				set @sChk = N'26'
				BREAK
		    end
			SELECT @sVret = tkp_datartype
			FROM r5trackingprompts
			WHERE tkp_trans = @sTkr_trans AND
				tkp_promptseq = @sTkr_targetprompt AND
				tkp_datartype NOT IN (N'F', N'C')
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @bRet=0
			else
				set @bRet=1
			IF @bRet=0 
			begin
		        set @sCtrans = @sTkr_trans
				set @nNprompt = @sTkr_targetprompt
				set @sChk = N'28'
				BREAK
			end
			SELECT @nVcount = count(*)
			FROM r5trackreturnprompts
			WHERE tkr_trans = @sTkr_trans AND
		        tkr_targetprompt = @sTkr_targetprompt
			IF @nVcount > 1
			begin
		        set @sCtrans = @sTkr_trans
				set @nNprompt = @sTkr_targetprompt
				set @sChk = N'29'
				BREAK
			end
			FETCH NEXT FROM cCur_ret INTO @sTkr_trans, @sTkr_promptseq, @sTkr_targetprompt
		end /* end of while */
    end

    IF @sChk = N'0'
        set @sChk = N'10'

    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
        SELECT @sCerrormessage = t.ert_text
        FROM   r5errtexts t,
               r5errsource s
        WHERE  s.ers_source = N'TMASTP'
        AND    s.ers_type   = N'FORM'
        AND    s.ers_number = cast(@sChk as numeric(3,0) )
        AND    t.ert_code   = s.ers_code
        AND    t.ert_lang   = @sCuserlang
        set @sCerrormessage = REPLACE( @sCerrormessage, N':PARM2', cast( @nNprompt as nvarchar(30) ) )
        set @sCerrormessage = REPLACE( @sCerrormessage, N':PARM1', @sCtrans )
    end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TOPKBA

AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nLookBackDay   numeric(38,0)
    declare @nRanking       numeric(38,0)
    declare @nCurrentCount  numeric(38,0)
    declare @nPreviousCount numeric(38,0)
    declare @nRecordCount   numeric(38,0)
    declare @dToday         datetime 
    declare @sChk           nvarchar(3) 
    declare @sArticleTitle  nvarchar(80) --r5kbarticles.kba_desc%TYPE;
    declare @sKbarticle     nvarchar(30) 
    declare @sKbarticle_org nvarchar(15) 
    declare @nSearchcount   numeric(38,0) 
    declare @sLinCode       nvarchar(2) 
	declare @nReturn		numeric(38,0)

    set @nLookBackDay    = 5
    set @nRanking        = 0
    set @nCurrentCount   = -1
    set @nPreviousCount  = -1
    set @nRecordCount    = 0
    set @sChk            = '0'


    SELECT @nLookBackDay = cop_toptenlookback FROM r5contactcenteroptions;
	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dToday OUTPUT, null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    DELETE FROM r5topkbarticles


	declare c_langhist cursor local for  SELECT  lin_code FROM r5langinst ORDER BY lin_code
	open c_langhist
	fetch next from c_langhist into	@sLinCode

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
	        declare c_top10 cursor local for   SELECT ctr_kbarticle, ctr_kbarticle_org, COUNT(*) searchcount
                                                FROM r5contactrecords, r5kbarticledetails
                                                WHERE ctr_kbarticle IS NOT NULL
                                                AND ctr_kbarticle_org IS NOT NULL
                                                AND (ctr_created BETWEEN @dToday - @nLookBackDay AND @dToday)
                                                AND ctr_kbarticle = kbd_kbarticle
                                                AND ctr_kbarticle = kbd_kbarticle
                                                AND kbd_lang = @sLinCode
                                                GROUP BY ctr_kbarticle, ctr_kbarticle_org
                                                ORDER BY searchcount DESC, ctr_kbarticle, ctr_kbarticle_org
	        open c_top10
	        fetch next from c_top10 into	@sKbarticle, @sKbarticle_org, @nSearchcount
	        
	        set @nRanking        = 0
			set @nCurrentCount   = -1
			set @nPreviousCount  = -1
            set @nRecordCount    = 0

	        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		        begin
                    set @nRecordCount  = @nRecordCount + 1
                    set @nCurrentCount = @nSearchcount

                    IF (@nCurrentCount != @nPreviousCount) AND @nRecordCount > 10 
                        break

                    IF (@nCurrentCount != @nPreviousCount) 
                        set @nRanking = @nRecordCount

                    SELECT @sArticleTitle  = kba_desc
                    FROM r5kbarticles
                    WHERE kba_code = @sKbarticle
                    AND kba_org = @sKbarticle_org
            
                    INSERT INTO r5topkbarticles
                        (tka_kbarticle,
                        tka_kbarticle_org,
                        tka_kbarticle_title,
                        tka_lang,
                        tka_searchcount,
                        tka_ranking)
                    VALUES
                        (@sKbarticle,
                        @sKbarticle_org,
                        @sArticleTitle,
                        @sLinCode,
                        @nSearchcount,
                        @nRanking)

                    set @nPreviousCount = @nCurrentCount
			        fetch next from c_top10 into	@sKbarticle, @sKbarticle_org, @nSearchcount
		        end
	        close c_top10
	        deallocate c_top10
			fetch next from c_langhist into	@sLinCode
		end
	close c_langhist
	deallocate c_langhist

create function O7TOTALAVAILABLEQTY (
  @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
  @nAct     numeric(8,0),
  @sPart    nvarchar(30),
  @sPartorg nvarchar(15),
  @sStore   nvarchar(15)
  )
  returns numeric(32,6)
as
begin

    declare @nStockqty              numeric(24,6)
    declare @nResallqty             numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTotalavaiableqty      numeric(24,6)
    set @nStockqty = 0 
    set @nResallqty = 0 
    set @nTotalavaiableqty = 0 

    SELECT @nStockqty = coalesce(SUM( coalesce( s.sto_qty, 0 ) ), 0)
    FROM   r5stock s
    WHERE  s.sto_part_org  = @sPartorg
    AND    s.sto_part      = @sPart
    AND    s.sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code from dbo.O7TOTALAVAILABLEQTY_HIER_1 (@sStore)  )
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set @nStockqty = null

    SELECT @nResallqty = coalesce( SUM( r.res_allqty ), 0 )
    FROM   r5reservations r
    WHERE  r.res_part_org  = @sPartorg
    AND    r.res_part      = @sPart
    AND    r.res_store IN ( SELECT str_code from dbo.O7TOTALAVAILABLEQTY_HIER_1 (@sStore)  )
    AND ( @sEvent IS NULL  OR r.res_event <> @sEvent) 
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set @nResallqty = null
  

    set @nTotalavaiableqty = (@nStockqty - @nResallqty)

    IF @nTotalavaiableqty = 0  
        set @nTotalavaiableqty = null

    RETURN (@nTotalavaiableqty) 
end

create function O7TOTALAVAILABLEQTY_HIER_1 ( @sStore nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table( str_code nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN) 
as
begin
    DECLARE @nLevel             int
    DECLARE @sCurrentChild      nvarchar(15)
   
    DECLARE @tStack table ( str_code nvarchar(15), LevelID int )

    INSERT INTO @tReturn values ( @sStore)

    INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, 1 
            FROM    r5stores s
            WHERE   s.str_code = @sStore

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @sCurrentChild = str_code
                    FROM   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

                    INSERT INTO @tReturn values ( @sCurrentChild)
                    DELETE FROM @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND str_code = @sCurrentChild 
                    INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, @nLevel + 1 
                    FROM r5stores s
                    WHERE s.str_parent = @sCurrentChild

                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        END
    return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANSPAR 
  @part              NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @partorg           NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @partloc           NVARCHAR( 80 ),
  @object            NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @objectorg         NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @issuedate         DATETIME,
  @storeorg          NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @wardays           NUMERIC  OUTPUT,
  @maxdate           DATETIME OUTPUT,
  @warranty          NVARCHAR( 1 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @pwardays  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @wwardays  NUMERIC

  SET @warranty = N'-'

  SELECT @pwardays = ISNULL( par_wardays, 0 )
  FROM   r5parts
  WHERE  par_code = @part
  AND    par_org  = @partorg
  
  SELECT @wwardays = MAX( wrp_wardays )
  FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warrantyparts
  WHERE  doc_code     = wrp_warranty
  AND    org_code     = doc_org
  AND    wrp_part     = @part
  AND    wrp_part_org = @partorg
  AND    wrp_active   = N'+'
  AND    ( doc_org = @storeorg OR org_common = '+' );
  
  SET @wardays = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @pwardays, ISNULL( @wwardays, 0 ) )

  IF @wardays > 0 
    BEGIN
      SELECT @maxdate = MAX( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( trl_date, N'DD' ) )
      FROM   r5events, r5translines
      WHERE  evt_code       = trl_event
      AND    trl_part       = @part
      AND    trl_part_org   = @partorg
      AND    evt_object     = @object
      AND    evt_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    trl_rtype      = N'I'
      AND    trl_io         = -1
      AND    trl_qty        > 0
      AND    trl_date      >= getdate() - @wardays
      AND    trl_date       < ISNULL( @issuedate, getdate() + 100 )
      AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( trl_date, N'DD' ) >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) - @wardays
      AND    ISNULL( trl_partlocation, N'@$#!' ) = ISNULL( @partloc, N'@$#!' )
      
      IF @maxdate IS NOT NULL
        SET @warranty = N'+'
    END    
END

AS
BEGIN
	declare @sObject		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nDays			numeric(5)
	declare @nWardays		numeric(5)
	declare @dMaxdate		datetime
	declare @sWarranty              nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sPk			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sWOorg		        nvarchar(15)

	SELECT @sObject = evt_object, 
			@sObjectorg = evt_object_org, @sWOorg = evt_org
	FROM   r5events
	WHERE  evt_code = @sTrlevent

	IF @sObject IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7transpar @sTrlpart, @sTrlpartorg, @sTrlpartloc, @sObject, @sObjectorg, @dTrldate, @sWOorg, @nWardays OUTPUT, @dMaxdate OUTPUT, @sWarranty OUTPUT
			IF @dmaxdate IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @ndays = DATEDIFF( Day, @dMaxdate, @dTrldate )
					/* Retrieve PK. */
					EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sPk OUTPUT, N'WCP', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
					INSERT INTO r5partsunderwarranty( puw_pk, puw_part, puw_part_org, puw_trans, puw_transline, puw_days, puw_wardays, puw_active )
					VALUES( CAST( @sPk AS NUMERIC ), @sTrlpart, @sTrlpartorg, @sTracode, @nTrlline, @nDays, @nWardays, N'+' )
				END
		END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_DO_TRANSACTION(@RetCode			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@ctrlpart		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlpartorg		NVARCHAR(15),
										@cissuedpart		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrllot		NVARCHAR(12),
										@ctrlbinparam		NVARCHAR(15),
										@ntrlqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ntrlprice		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ntrlio			NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ninout			NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ctrlfromrentity	NVARCHAR(4),
										@ctrltorentity		NVARCHAR(4),
										@ctrlotherstore		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlrtype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@ctrlreq		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ntrlreqline		int,
										@ctrlorder		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlorderorg		NVARCHAR(15),
										@ntrlordline		int,
										@corlrtype		NVARCHAR(8),
										@ctrlstore		NVARCHAR(15),
										@ctrlevent		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ntrlact		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ctrlobject		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlobjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),
										@ctrlobjtype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@ctrlobjrtype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@ntrlscrapqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ctracode		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ntrlline		int,
										@norigtrlqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@crouterec		nvarchar(1),
										@sAttach		nvarchar(1),
										@sAttachto		nvarchar(30),
										@sAttachtoorg		nvarchar(15),
										@sScrapobject		nvarchar(30),
										@sScrapobjectorg	nvarchar(15),
										@ctrlmanufacturer	nvarchar(24),
										@ctrlmanufactpart	nvarchar(50),
										@ctrafromcode		nvarchar(30) = null,
										@ctrlwarranty		nvarchar(1) = null,
										@ctrlpartloc		nvarchar(80) = null,
										@dtrldate		datetime = null,
										@ctrlsourcesystem	NVARCHAR(45) = NULL,
										@ctrlsourcecode		NVARCHAR(45) = NULL,
										@ctrlsupplier		NVARCHAR(30) = NULL,
										@ctrlsupplierorg	NVARCHAR(15) = NULL)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--New Variables
	DECLARE @nReturn		INTEGER
	DECLARE @sTempDflt		NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @TempValue		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @IsNullValue	INTEGER
	DECLARE @nCount			int

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @checkresult	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @ctoentity		NVARCHAR(4)		/*r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @cobjstatus		NVARCHAR(8)		/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @vobjrstatus		NVARCHAR(8)		/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @vobjstatus		NVARCHAR(8)		/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @nsign			INTEGER
	DECLARE @x				NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @corlrtype2		NVARCHAR(8)		/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @corg			NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5organization.org_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @clot			NVARCHAR(12)	/*r5lots.lot_code%TYPE :=  N'';*/
	DECLARE @cbin			NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5bins.bin_code%TYPE :=  N'';*/
	DECLARE @cpricelev		NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := o7dflt(N'PRICELEV', checkresult );*/
	DECLARE @cpricetype		NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @cpricetype2	NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @cststfifo      NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;*/

   -- PVCS#18065
	DECLARE @childpart		NVARCHAR(30)	/*r5parts.par_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @childpartorg	NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5parts.par_org%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @childstore		NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5stores.str_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @nninout        NUMERIC(24,6)	

	-- Cursor c_objecthierarchy Cursor
	DECLARE @stc_child		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15)

	-- Cursor c_ordline Cursor
	DECLARE @orl_req		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @orl_reqline	NUMERIC(8,0)
	DECLARE @strlact 		NVARCHAR(30)

	declare @ctrlact nvarchar(8)
	declare @cact nvarchar(8)

	declare @ctrlbin     nvarchar(15)
	declare @ctrlbinretn nvarchar(15)

    declare @creq       nvarchar(30)    --r5requisitions.req_code%TYPE;
    declare @nreqline   numeric(8)
    declare @ntodo      numeric(38,12)
    declare @nrpb_qty   numeric(24,6)
    declare @crpb_lot   nvarchar(12)    --r5binstock.bis_lot%TYPE;
    declare @nscrapqty  numeric(24,6)
    declare @nrecvqty   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nscrapnow  numeric(24,6)
    declare @nrecvnow   numeric(24,6)
	declare @ntrlprice2     numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTempQty	numeric(30,6)
	declare @nTempqty2	numeric(30,6)
	declare @nTempqty3	numeric(30,6)

    declare @sChildlot  nvarchar(12)
    declare @sChildbin  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTemplot  nvarchar(12)
    declare @sTempbin  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sScrapobjtype nvarchar(4)
    declare @sCancelreqstore nvarchar(15)
    declare @sKit nvarchar(1)
	declare @ntstpk numeric(20,0)
	declare @sParamstore nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRepairable nvarchar(1)
	declare @sPart nvarchar(30)

	set @ntrlprice2 = @ntrlprice
	SET @clot = null
	SET @cbin = null
	SET @sChildlot = null
	SET @sChildbin = null
	set @nninout = @ninout	
	set @sKit = N'-'	

	IF @ctrlbinparam = N'nullbin'
		BEGIN
			SET @ctrlbin     = N'*'
			IF @ctrlrtype = N'RETN' AND @ctrltorentity = N'COMP'
				BEGIN
					/* Special case for nullbin and 'RETN'/'COMP', leave bin NULL in call to from_transit. */
					SET @ctrlbinretn = NULL
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @ctrlbinretn = N'*'
				END  
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @ctrlbin     = @ctrlbinparam
			SET @ctrlbinretn = @ctrlbinparam 
		END  

	SELECT	@corg = str_org
	FROM	r5stores
	WHERE	str_code = @ctrlstore

	/* Check for bin to bin transfer. */
	IF @ctrlstore = ISNULL( @ctrlotherstore, N'x' ) AND @ctrlfromrentity = N'STOR' AND @ctrltorentity = N'STOR' AND
		( ( @ctrlrtype = N'I' AND @ntrlio = -1 ) OR ( @ctrlrtype = N'RECV' AND @ntrlio = 1 ) )
		BEGIN
			/* Bin to bin transfer. */
			/* First take care of actual part. */
			SET @TempValue = @ntrlqty * @ntrlio
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7trans_update_stock	@checkresult OUTPUT, @ctrlrtype, @corlrtype2, @ctrlstore, @ctrlpart, @ctrlpartorg, @cissuedpart,
									@ctrlbin, @ctrllot, @TempValue,	@ntrlscrapqty, @ntrlprice2, @ctrlevent, @ntrlact, @cpricetype, @corg,
									@ctracode, @ntrlline, @ctrlorder, @ctrlorderorg, @ntrlordline, N'P',@ctrlobject, @ctrlobjectorg, @ntstpk, N'+'
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			IF @checkresult <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = N'2' + LEFT( @checkresult, 3 )
					RETURN
				END
			IF @ctrlrtype = N'RECV' AND @ctrlobject IS NOT NULL
				UPDATE r5objects
				SET    obj_bin  = @ctrlbin
				WHERE  obj_code = @ctrlobject
				AND    obj_org  = @ctrlobjectorg
			/* Then take care of actual all dependent children. */
			DECLARE c_objecthierarchy CURSOR LOCAL FOR
				SELECT	stc_child,
						stc_child_org
				FROM    dbo.O7TRANS_DO_TRANS_GET_HIER( @ctrlobject, @ctrlobjectorg )
			OPEN c_objecthierarchy
			FETCH NEXT FROM c_objecthierarchy INTO @stc_child, @stc_child_org
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = count(*)
					FROM	r5objects
					WHERE	obj_code = @stc_child
					AND		obj_org  = @stc_child_org

					IF @nCount <> 1
						BREAK

					SELECT	@childpart    = obj_part,
							@childpartorg = obj_part_org,
							@childstore   = obj_store, 
							@sChildbin    = obj_bin,
							@sChildlot    = obj_lot
					FROM	r5objects
					WHERE	obj_code = @stc_child
					AND		obj_org  = @stc_child_org

					IF @childpart IS NOT NULL
						BEGIN
							IF @ctrlrtype = N'RECV' AND @ctrlotherstore IS NULL
								BEGIN
									/* For receipts use lot of parent. */
									SET @sChildlot = @ctrllot
								END
							SET @sTemplot = COALESCE( @sChildlot, @ctrllot )
							SET @TempValue = @ntrlqty * @ntrlio
							EXECUTE @nReturn = o7trans_update_stock	@checkresult OUTPUT, @ctrlrtype, @corlrtype2, @ctrlstore, @childpart, @childpartorg,
													NULL, @ctrlbin, @sTemplot, @TempValue, @ntrlscrapqty, @ntrlprice2, @ctrlevent, @ntrlact, 
													@cpricetype, @corg, @ctracode, @ntrlline, @ctrlorder, @ctrlorderorg, @ntrlordline, 
													N'C', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'+'
							IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_objecthierarchy
									DEALLOCATE c_objecthierarchy
									RETURN -1
								END
			             	IF @c

CREATE FUNCTION O7TRANS_DO_TRANS_GET_HIER (	@cobject	NVARCHAR(30),
											@cobjectorg	NVARCHAR(15))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (stc_child		NVARCHAR(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel				INTEGER
	DECLARE @currentchild		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @currentchildorg	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @currentrolldown	NVARCHAR(1)

	DECLARE @tStack	TABLE ( stc_child		NVARCHAR(30), 
							stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15),
							stc_rolldown	NVARCHAR(1),
							LevelID 		INTEGER )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				stc_rolldown,
				@nLevel
		FROM	r5structures
		WHERE	stc_rolldown = N'+'
			AND	stc_parent     = @cobject
			AND	stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					IF @nLevel >= 1
						BEGIN
							SELECT	@currentchild		= stc_child,
									@currentchildorg	= stc_child_org,
									@currentrolldown	= stc_rolldown
							FROM	@tStack
							WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							INSERT INTO @tReturn
									VALUES ( @currentchild, @currentchildorg)
						END

					DELETE FROM @tStack
						WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							AND stc_child		= @currentchild
							AND stc_child_org	= @currentchildorg
							AND stc_rolldown	= N'+'

					INSERT INTO @tStack
						SELECT	stc_child,
								stc_child_org,
								stc_rolldown,
								@nLevel + 1
						FROM	r5structures
						WHERE	stc_parent		= @currentchild
							AND	stc_parent_org	= @currentchildorg
							AND stc_rolldown	= N'+'

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	RETURN 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_GET_FROM_TRANSIT(	@RetCode		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
											@cpart			NVARCHAR(30),
											@cpartorg		NVARCHAR(15),
											@nqty			NUMERIC(24,6),
											@cbin			NVARCHAR(15),
											@clot			NVARCHAR(12),
											@cstore			NVARCHAR(15),
											@ctorentity		NVARCHAR(4),
											@ctoentity		NVARCHAR(4),
											@ctocode		NVARCHAR(30),
											@ctoact			NVARCHAR(8),
											@corder			NVARCHAR(30),
											@corderorg		NVARCHAR(15),
											@nordline		int,
											@creq			NVARCHAR(30),
											@nreqline		int,
											@ctrlobject		NVARCHAR(30),
											@ctrlobjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),
											@ctrlrtype		NVARCHAR(4),
											@ctrlmanufacturer	NVARCHAR(24),
											@ctrlmanufactpart	NVARCHAR(50),
											@cobjstatus		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
											@cgetpk			NVARCHAR(1),
											@npk			NUMERIC(20,0) OUTPUT,
											@ctrlsupplier		NVARCHAR(30),
											@ctrlsupplierorg	NVARCHAR(15))
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @nReturn	INTEGER

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @navailable		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @nrepavailable	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @cobjrstatus	NVARCHAR(8)		/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @chk			NVARCHAR(4)

	SET @navailable = 0
	SET @nrepavailable = 0

	SELECT	@navailable		= ISNULL( MAX( tst_qty ), 0),
			@nrepavailable	= ISNULL( MAX( tst_repairqty ), 0 ),
			@npk			= MAX( tst_pk ),
			@cobjstatus		= tst_objstatus /* #6936 */
	FROM	r5transtock
	WHERE	tst_part      = @cpart
		AND	tst_part_org  = @cpartorg
		AND	tst_store     = @cstore
		AND	tst_lot       = @clot
		AND	tst_torentity = @ctorentity
		AND	tst_tocode    = @ctocode
		AND	ISNULL(ISNULL(tst_act, @ctoact), N'*') = ISNULL(@ctoact, N'*')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_order, N'a') = ISNULL(@corder, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_order_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@corderorg, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_ordline, -1) = ISNULL(@nordline, -1)
		AND	ISNULL(tst_req, N'a') = ISNULL(@creq, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_reqline,-1) = ISNULL(@nreqline, -1)
		AND	ISNULL(tst_object, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobject, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_object_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobjectorg, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_bin, N'a') = ISNULL(@cbin, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_manufacturer, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufacturer, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_manufactpart, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufactpart, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_supplier, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplier, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_supplier_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplierorg, N'a')
		AND  ( tst_qty > 0 AND @ctrlrtype <> N'RREC' OR tst_repairqty > 0 AND @ctrlrtype = N'RREC' )
		AND  ISNULL( tst_pk, '0' ) = ISNULL( @npk, ISNULL( tst_pk, '0' ) )
	GROUP BY tst_objstatus /* #6936 added as object status is now selected */

	IF @cgetpk = N'+'
		BEGIN
			SET @RetCode = N'0'
			RETURN
		END

	IF (@ctrlrtype  = N'RREC' AND @nqty > @nrepavailable ) OR (@ctrlrtype <> N'RREC' AND @nqty > @navailable )
		BEGIN
			IF @ctorentity = N'STOR'
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = N'14'
					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = N'13'
					RETURN
				END
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @ctrlrtype = N'RREC'
				BEGIN
					UPDATE r5transtock
					SET    tst_repairqty = tst_repairqty - @nqty
					where tst_sqlidentity  = (SELECT TOP 1 tst_sqlidentity  
												FROM r5transtock
												WHERE  tst_part      = @cpart
												AND    tst_part_org  = @cpartorg
												AND    tst_store     = @cstore
												AND    coalesce( tst_lot, N'*' ) = coalesce( @clot, N'*')
												AND    tst_torentity = @ctorentity
												AND    tst_tocode    = @ctocode
												AND    coalesce(coalesce(tst_act, @ctoact), '*') = coalesce(@ctoact,N'*')
												AND    coalesce( tst_order, N'a' )          = coalesce( @corder, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_order_org, N'a' )      = coalesce( @corderorg, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_ordline, -1 )          = coalesce( @nordline, -1 )
												AND    coalesce( tst_req, N'a' )            = coalesce( @creq, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_reqline, -1 )          = coalesce( @nreqline, -1 )
												AND    coalesce( tst_object, N'a' )         = coalesce( @ctrlobject, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_object_org, N'a' )     = coalesce( @ctrlobjectorg, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_bin, N'a' )            = coalesce( @cbin, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_manufacturer, N'a' )   = coalesce( @ctrlmanufacturer, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce( tst_manufactpart, N'a' )   = coalesce( @ctrlmanufactpart, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce(tst_supplier, N'a' )        = coalesce( @ctrlsupplier, N'a' )
												AND    coalesce(tst_supplier_org, N'a' )    = coalesce( @ctrlsupplierorg, N'a' )
												AND    ISNULL( tst_pk, 0 )                  = ISNULL( @npk, 0 )
												AND    tst_repairqty = @nrepavailable ) 
					IF @@ERROR <> 0
						BEGIN
							SET @RetCode = N'12'
							RETURN
						END
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE r5transtock
						SET    tst_qty       = tst_qty - @nqty
						where tst_sqlidentity  = (SELECT TOP 1 tst_sqlidentity
													FROM r5transtock
													WHERE	tst_part = @cpart
														AND	tst_part_org = @cpartorg
														AND	tst_store = @cstore
														AND	ISNULL(tst_lot,N'*') = ISNULL(@clot,N'*')
														AND	tst_torentity = @ctorentity
														AND	tst_tocode = @ctocode
														AND	ISNULL(ISNULL(tst_act, @ctoact), N'*') = ISNULL(@ctoact,N'*')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_order, N'a') = ISNULL(@corder, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_order_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@corderorg, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_ordline, -1) = ISNULL(@nordline, -1)
														AND	ISNULL( tst_req, N'a') = ISNULL(@creq, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_reqline, -1) = ISNULL(@nreqline, -1)
														AND	ISNULL( tst_object, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobject, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_object_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobjectorg, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_bin, N'a') = ISNULL(@cbin, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_manufacturer, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufacturer, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_manufactpart, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufactpart, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_supplier, N'a')     = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplier, N'a')
														AND	ISNULL( tst_supplier_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplierorg, N'a')
														AND ISNULL( tst_pk, 0 ) = ISNULL( @npk, 0 )
														AND tst_qty = @navailable )
					IF @@ERROR <> 0
						BEGIN
							SET @RetCode = N'12'
							RETURN
						END
				END
		END

	DELETE FROM r5transtock
	WHERE  tst_part      = @cpart
	AND    tst_part_org  = @cpartorg
	AND    tst_store     = @cstore
	AND    tst_repairqty = 0
	AND    tst_qty       = 0 

  -- #6936 Update status in R5OBJECTS
  --       with the status before putting in transit
	IF @ctrlobject IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			if @cobjstatus is null
				set @cobjrstatus = N'I'
			else
				SET @cobjrstatus = NULL

			EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @cobjrstatus OUTPUT, @cobjstatus OUTPUT, N'OBST', @chk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @chk <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = N'1'
					RETURN
				END

			UPDATE r5objects
				SET		obj_rstatus = @cobjrstatus,
						obj_status  = @cobjstatus
				WHERE	obj_code = @ctrlobject
					AND	obj_org = @ctrlobjectorg


			UPDATE r5objects
				SET		obj_rstatus = @cobjrstatus,
						obj_status  = @cobjstatus
				WHERE	( obj_code + N'#' +  obj_org ) IN (
						SELECT stc_object + N'#' + stc_object_org
						FROM   dbo.O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER( @ctrlobject, @ctrlobjectorg, N'+' )
						)
		END

	SET @RetCode = N'0'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_GET_STORE(	@RetCode		NVARCHAR(4) 	OUTPUT,
									@ninout			NUMERIC(24,6)	OUTPUT,
									@cstore			NVARCHAR(15)	OUTPUT,
									@crtype			NVARCHAR(8),
									@cfromrentity	NVARCHAR(4),
									@cfromcode		NVARCHAR(30),
									@ctorentity		NVARCHAR(4),
									@ctocode		NVARCHAR(30))
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @crtype = N'I'
		BEGIN
			SET @cstore = @cfromcode
			SET @ninout = -1
		END
	ELSE
		IF @crtype = N'RECV'
			IF @ctorentity = N'STOR'
				BEGIN
					SET @cstore = @ctocode
					SET @ninout = 1
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @ninout = 0
					SET @cstore = NULL
				END
		ELSE
			IF @crtype = N'RETN'
				IF @cfromrentity = N'STOR'
					BEGIN
						SET @cstore = @cfromcode
						SET @ninout = -1
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @ninout = 0
						SET @cstore = NULL
					END
			ELSE
				IF @crtype IN ( N'STTK', N'IHI' )
					BEGIN
						SET @cstore = @cfromcode
						SET @ninout = -1
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @ninout = 0
						SET @cstore = NULL
					END
	SET @RetCode = N'0'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_ISSUEDCORES	@sTracode		nvarchar(30),
										@sOrg			nvarchar(15),
										@sTrlstore		nvarchar(15),
										@sTrlpart		nvarchar(30),
										@sTrlpartorg	nvarchar(15),
										@sTrlrtype		nvarchar(4),
										@nTrlqty		numeric(24,6),
										@nTrlio			numeric(3),
										@sTrlevent		nvarchar(30),
										@nTrlact		numeric(8),
										@sRouterec		nvarchar(1)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @sEntity		nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sCode			nvarchar(50)
	DECLARE @sPk			nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @nCore			numeric(24,6)
	DECLARE @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sRouteparent	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sProject		nvarchar(20)
	DECLARE @sProjbud		nvarchar(20)
	DECLARE @sObject		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sObjectorg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sPerson		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @nReturn		int
	DECLARE @sChk			nvarchar(4)

BEGIN
	/* Determine entity and code. */
	IF @nTrlact IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			/* There is an activity, so this must be a real work order issue. */
			SET @sEntity = N'EVNT'
			SELECT @sProject = evt_project, 
					@sProjbud = evt_projbud, 
					@sObject = evt_object, 
					@sObjectorg = evt_object_org, 
					@sRouteparent = evt_routeparent
			FROM   r5events
			WHERE  evt_code = @sTrlevent
			IF @sRouteparent IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @sCode = @sRouteparent + N'#' + CAST( @nTrlact AS NVARCHAR )
					SET @sEvent = @sRouteparent
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sCode = @sTrlevent + N'#' + CAST( @nTrlact AS NVARCHAR )
					SET @sEvent = @sTrlevent
				END
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sProject = evt_project, 
				@sProjbud = evt_projbud, 
				@sObject = evt_object, 
				@sObjectorg = evt_object_org 
			FROM   r5events
			WHERE  evt_code = @sTrlevent
			SET @sEvent = @sTrlevent
			IF @sProject IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					/* The WO has a project, so this must be an issue against a project. */
					SET @sEntity = N'PROJ'
					SET @sCode   = @sProject+N'#'+@sProjbud
				END
			ELSE  
				BEGIN
					IF @sObject LIKE N'AUTO@E@%'
						BEGIN
							/* The object is auto created for an employee. */
							SELECT @sPerson = per_code
							FROM   r5personnel
							WHERE  per_object = @sObject
							IF @sPerson IS NULL
								BEGIN
									SET @sEntity = N'OBJ'
									SET @sCode   = @sObject + N'#' + @sObjectorg
								END
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									SET @sEntity = N'PERS'
									SET @sCode   = @sPerson
								END
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							/* Issue against an object. */
							SET @sEntity = N'OBJ'
							SET @sCode   = @sObject + N'#' + @sObjectorg
						END
				END
		END  

	/* Check whether a record already exists. */
	SELECT @sPk = isc_pk
	FROM   r5issuedcores
	WHERE  isc_org      = @sOrg
	AND    isc_rentity  = @sEntity
	AND    isc_code     = @sCode
	AND    isc_part     = @sTrlpart
	AND    isc_part_org = @sTrlpartorg

	IF @sPk IS NULL
		BEGIN
			IF @sTrlrtype = N'I' AND @nTrlqty < 0 AND @nTrlio = -1 
				/* Nothing to do if there is a normal return, but no record yet. */
				RETURN
			ELSE  
				BEGIN
					EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sPk OUTPUT, N'ISC', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
					INSERT INTO r5issuedcores( isc_pk, isc_org, isc_rentity, isc_code, isc_event, isc_part, isc_part_org )
					VALUES( @sPk, @sOrg, @sEntity, @sCode, @sEvent, @sTrlpart, @sTrlpartorg )
				END
		END

	/* Get core price. */
	SET @nCore = ISNULL( dbo.o7gtcore2( @sTrlstore, @sTrlpart, @sTrlpartorg, @sOrg, NULL, NULL ), 0 )

	IF ( ( @sTrlrtype = N'I' AND @nTrlqty > 0 AND @nTrlio = -1 ) OR      -- Normal issue
		( @sTrlrtype = N'RECV' AND @nTrlqty > 0 AND @nTrlio = 0  ) )      -- Direct issue
		BEGIN
			/* Issue. */  
			UPDATE r5issuedcores
			SET    isc_issuedqty   = ISNULL( isc_issuedqty, 0 ) + @nTrlqty,
				isc_origissuetrans = ISNULL( isc_origissuetrans, @sTracode ),
				isc_origissuedate  = ISNULL( isc_origissuedate, dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ) ),
                isc_lastissuedate  = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ),
				isc_unitcorevalue  = @nCore,
				isc_updated        = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
			WHERE  isc_pk = @sPk
		END
	ELSE IF @sTrlrtype = N'I' AND @nTrlqty < 0 AND @nTrlio = -1  -- Normal return
		BEGIN
			/* Normal return. */  
			UPDATE r5issuedcores
			SET    isc_issuedqty   = DBO.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( isc_issuedqty, 0 ) - ABS( @nTrlqty ), 0 ),
				isc_lastissuedate  = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ),
				isc_unitcorevalue  = @nCore,
				isc_updated        = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
			WHERE  isc_pk = @sPk       
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			/* Other Returns. */
			UPDATE r5issuedcores
			SET    isc_returnedqty  = ISNULL( isc_returnedqty, 0 ) + ABS( @nTrlqty ),
				isc_origreturntrans = ISNULL( isc_origreturntrans, @sTracode ),
				isc_origreturndate  = ISNULL( isc_origreturndate, dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ) ),
				isc_unitcorevalue   = @nCore,
				isc_updated         = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
			WHERE  isc_pk = @sPk
		END   
END
