CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_MOVE_OBJECT(	@RetCode			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@ctrartype			NVARCHAR(5),
										@ctrlio				NUMERIC(24,6),
										@cstore				NVARCHAR(15),
										@cpart				NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpartorg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@cobject			NVARCHAR(30),
										@cobjectorg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@cobtype			NVARCHAR(4),
										@ntrlscrapqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ctrlevent			NVARCHAR(30),
										@cotherstore		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlbin			NVARCHAR(15),
										@ctrllot			NVARCHAR(12),
										@cobjstatus			NVARCHAR(8),
										@ctrlfromrentity	NVARCHAR(4),
                                        @corlrtype          NVARCHAR(8),
                                        @sAttach            nvarchar(1),
                                        @sAttachto          nvarchar(30),
                                        @sAttachtoorg       nvarchar(15),
                                        @ctracode           nvarchar(30),
                                        @ntrlline           numeric )
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @nReturn	INTEGER
	DECLARE @GTTime		DATETIME
	DECLARE @nCount		INTEGER
	DECLARE @clot		NVARCHAR(12)--r5lots.lot_code%TYPE;
	DECLARE @cobstat	NVARCHAR(10)


	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @chk		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @cevent		NVARCHAR(30)	/* r5events.evt_code%TYPE := '';*/
	DECLARE @cevtrtype	NVARCHAR(4)		/* r5events.evt_rtype%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @corg		NVARCHAR(15)	/* r5events.evt_org%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @cnewvalue	NVARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @ctoolcheck	NVARCHAR(1)

	-- Cursor c_objecthierarchy Variables
	DECLARE @stc_child		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15)

    declare @sDummy nvarchar(1)

	SET @chk = N'0'
	SET @cevent = null
    SET @clot = @ctrllot






	IF @ctrartype = N'RECV'
		BEGIN
			SET @cevtrtype = N'RECV'
			IF @ctrlevent IS NOT NULL AND @ctrlfromrentity <> N'EVNT'
				SET @cnewvalue = @ctrlevent
			ELSE
				SET @cnewvalue = @cstore
		END
	ELSE
		IF @ctrartype = N'RETN'
			BEGIN
				IF coalesce( @corlrtype, N'x' ) <> N'RE'
					BEGIN
						SET @cevtrtype = N'RETN'
						SET @cnewvalue = null
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @cevtrtype = N'IR'
						SET @cnewvalue = @cstore
					END
			END
		ELSE
			IF @ctrartype = N'I' AND @ctrlio   <= 0
				BEGIN
					SET @cevtrtype = N'XSTO'
					SET @cnewvalue = @cstore
				END
			ELSE
				IF @ctrartype = N'I' AND @ctrlio   > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @cevtrtype = N'STO'
						SET @cnewvalue = @cstore
					END
				ELSE
					IF @ctrartype IN (N'RR', N'RREC' )
						BEGIN
							SET @cevtrtype = N'RR'
							SET @cnewvalue = @cstore
						END
					ELSE
						IF @ctrartype = N'SCRAP'
							BEGIN
								SET @sDummy = NULL
							END
						ELSE
							IF @ctrartype = N'IHI'
								BEGIN
									SET @cevtrtype = N'IHI'
									SET @cnewvalue = @cstore
								END
							ELSE	
								BEGIN
									SET @RetCode = N'7'
									RETURN
								END
	
	-- Update dependent children for issues/returns.
	-- #6850 trl_event passed
	-- #7396 otherstore passed
	-- #6936 ctrlbin, ctrllot and cobjectstatus passed

	-- Put some logic here to prevent status change of objects that reside in transit.

	IF NOT ((@ctrartype = N'RECV' AND @ctrlio = 0 AND @ctrlevent IS NOT NULL AND @cstore IS NOT NULL ) OR coalesce( @ntrlscrapqty, 0 ) = 1 )

		BEGIN
            IF @corlrtype = N'RE'
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @clot = coalesce( obj_lot, @clot )
                    FROM   r5objects
                    WHERE  obj_code = @cobject
                    AND    obj_org  = @cobjectorg
                    IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                        set @clot = @ctrllot
                END


			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7objects_update_children	@chk OUTPUT,
															@cobject,
															@cobjectorg,
															@cevtrtype,
															@cnewvalue,
															@ctrlevent,
															@cotherstore,
															@ctrlbin,
															@clot,
															@cobjstatus,
															@cpartorg,
															@sAttach,
															@sAttachto,
															@sAttachtoorg,
															@ctoolcheck OUTPUT,
															@ctracode,
															@ntrlline
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @chk <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = LEFT(@chk, 4)
					RETURN
				END
		END

	IF (@ctrartype = N'RR' AND @ctrlio = -1 and coalesce(@ntrlscrapqty, 0) = 0 ) OR ( @ctrartype = N'RREC' AND coalesce( @ntrlscrapqty, 0 ) = 0 )
		BEGIN
			-- No job if parts to be repaired moved.
			SET @RetCode = N'0'
			RETURN
		END

  -- Set object status to withdrawn if scrapped
	IF ISNULL(@ntrlscrapqty, 0) = 1
		BEGIN
            if @ctrartype = N'SCRAP'
                DELETE FROM r5structures
                WHERE  stc_child     = @cobject
                AND    stc_child_org = @cobjectorg

			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @GTTime OUTPUT, @cobjectorg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			UPDATE r5objects
				SET		obj_rstatus  = N'D',
						obj_status   = null,
						obj_withdraw = @GTTime
				WHERE	obj_code = @cobject
					AND	obj_org  = @cobjectorg

			EXECUTE r5o7_o7ucode @cobstat OUTPUT, N'D', N'OBSTP', @chk OUTPUT
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7objects_insert_event @chk OUTPUT , @cevent OUTPUT, @corg, @cobject, @cobjectorg, @cobtype,
					null, null, null, N'STAT', @cobstat, null, null, null, null

			UPDATE r5objects
				SET		obj_rstatus  = N'D',
						obj_status   = null,
						obj_withdraw = @GTTime
				FROM	dbo.O7TRANS_MOVE_OBJECT_GET_HIER(@cobject, @cobjectorg) i
				WHERE	obj_code = i.stc_child
					AND	obj_org  = i.stc_child_org

            DELETE FROM r5structures
            WHERE  stc_parent     = @cobject
            AND    stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg
            AND    stc_rolldown   = N'-'

            if @ctrartype = N'SCRAP'
                begin
                    DELETE FROM r5structures
                    WHERE  stc_child     = @cobject
                    AND    stc_child_org = @cobjectorg

                    RETURN N'0'
                end
		END

  -- Insert object history  (r5events).
	IF @cstore IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@nCount = COUNT(*)
			FROM	r5stores
			WHERE	str_code = @cstore
			IF @nCount > 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@corg = str_org
					FROM	r5stores
					WHERE	str_code = @cstore
				END
			ELSE
				SET @corg = @cobjectorg
		END
	ELSE
		SET @corg = @cobjectorg

	IF @ctoolcheck = N'-'  AND @cevtrtype <> N'IHI'
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7objects_insert_event @chk OUTPUT , @cevent OUTPUT, @corg, @cobject, @cobjectorg, @cobtype,
                               														null, null, null, @cevtrtype, @cnewvalue,
																					null, null, null, null
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @chk <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = N'15' + LEFT(@chk, 2)
					RETURN
				END

			-- Insert object history for hierarchical child object PVCS#18065
			IF @cevtrtype = N'STO' OR @cevtrtype = N'XSTO' OR @cevtrtype = N'RECV'
				BEGIN
					DECLARE c_objecthierarchy CURSOR FOR
						SELECT	stc_child,
								stc_child_org
						FROM	dbo.O7TRANS_MOVE_OBJECT_GET_HIER(@cobject, @cobjectorg)

					OPEN c_objecthierarchy

					FROM c_objecthierarchy

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

CREATE FUNCTION O7TRANS_MOVE_OBJECT_GET_HIER (	@cobject	NVARCHAR(30),
												@cobjectorg	NVARCHAR(15))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (stc_child		NVARCHAR(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel				INTEGER
	DECLARE @currentchild		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @currentchildorg	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @currentrolldown	NVARCHAR(1)

	DECLARE @tStack	TABLE ( stc_child		NVARCHAR(30), 
							stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15),
							stc_rolldown	NVARCHAR(1),
							LevelID 		INTEGER )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				stc_rolldown,
				@nLevel
		FROM	r5structures
		WHERE	stc_rolldown = N'+'
			AND	stc_parent     = @cobject
			AND	stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					IF @nLevel >= 1
						BEGIN
							SELECT	@currentchild		= stc_child,
									@currentchildorg	= stc_child_org,
									@currentrolldown	= stc_rolldown
							FROM	@tStack
							WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							INSERT INTO @tReturn
									VALUES ( @currentchild, @currentchildorg)
						END

					DELETE FROM @tStack
						WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							AND stc_child		= @currentchild
							AND stc_child_org	= @currentchildorg
							AND stc_rolldown	= N'+'

					INSERT INTO @tStack
						SELECT	stc_child,
								stc_child_org,
								stc_rolldown,
								@nLevel + 1
						FROM	r5structures
						WHERE	stc_parent		= @currentchild
							AND	stc_parent_org	= @currentchildorg
							AND stc_rolldown	= N'+'

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	RETURN 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_PUT_IN_TRANSIT(@RetCode			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@cpart				NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpartorg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@nqty				NUMERIC(24,6),
										@cbin				NVARCHAR(15),
										@clot				NVARCHAR(12),
										@cstore				NVARCHAR(15),
										@ctorentity			NVARCHAR(4),
										@ctoentity			NVARCHAR(4),
										@ctocode			NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctoact				NVARCHAR(8),
										@corder				NVARCHAR(30),
										@corderorg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@nordline			int,
										@creq				NVARCHAR(30),
										@nreqline			int,
										@ctrlobject			NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlobjectorg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@ctrlrtype			NVARCHAR(4),
										@ntrlprice			NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ctrlmanufacturer		NVARCHAR(24),
										@ctrlmanufactpart		NVARCHAR(50),
										@cgetpk				NVARCHAR(1),
										@npk				NUMERIC(20,0) OUTPUT,
										@ctrlsupplier			NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlsupplierorg		NVARCHAR(15) )
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @nCount		INTEGER
	DECLARE @nReturn	INTEGER

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @cobstatus	NVARCHAR(8) /*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @cobrstatus	NVARCHAR(8) /*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @vobrstatus	NVARCHAR(8) /*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @vobstatus	NVARCHAR(8) /*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @chk		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @x		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @pkey		INT

	IF @nQty = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @RetCode = N'0'
			RETURN
		END

	SET @x = NULL
	SELECT	@npk = tst_pk,
			@x = N'x'
	FROM	r5transtock
	WHERE	tst_part      = @cpart
		AND	tst_part_org  = @cpartorg
		AND	tst_store     = @cstore
		AND	tst_lot       = @clot
		AND	tst_torentity = @ctorentity
		AND	tst_tocode    = @ctocode
		AND	ISNULL(ISNULL(tst_act, @ctoact), N'*') = ISNULL(@ctoact, N'*')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_order, N'a') = ISNULL(@corder, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_order_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@corderorg, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_ordline, -1) = ISNULL(@nordline, -1)
		AND	ISNULL(tst_req, N'a') = ISNULL(@creq, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_reqline, -1) = ISNULL(@nreqline, -1)
		AND	ISNULL(tst_object, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobject, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_object_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobjectorg, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_bin, N'a') = ISNULL(@cbin, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_manufacturer, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufacturer, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_manufactpart, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufactpart, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_supplier, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplier, N'a')
		AND	ISNULL(tst_supplier_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplierorg, N'a')
		AND (( tst_qty > 0 AND @ctrlrtype <> N'RR' ) OR ( tst_repairqty > 0 AND @ctrlrtype = N'RR'  ))

	IF @x IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			IF @cgetpk = N'+'
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = N'0'
					RETURN
				END

			UPDATE r5transtock
				SET		tst_qty			= CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN tst_qty ELSE ISNULL(tst_qty, 0) + @nqty END,
						tst_repairqty 	= CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN ISNULL(tst_repairqty, 0) + @nqty ELSE tst_repairqty END,
						tst_price		= ( ( CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN tst_repairqty ELSE tst_qty END * tst_price ) + ( @nqty * @ntrlprice ) ) /
											( CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN tst_repairqty ELSE tst_qty END + @nqty )
				WHERE	tst_part      = @cpart
					AND	tst_part_org  = @cpartorg
					AND	tst_store     = @cstore
					AND	tst_lot       = @clot
					AND	tst_torentity = @ctorentity
					AND	tst_tocode    = @ctocode
					AND	ISNULL(ISNULL(tst_act, @ctoact), N'*') = ISNULL(@ctoact, N'*')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_order, N'a') = ISNULL(@corder, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_order_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@corderorg, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_ordline, -1) = ISNULL(@nordline, -1)
					AND	ISNULL(tst_req, N'a')  = ISNULL(@creq, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_reqline, -1) = ISNULL(@nreqline, -1)
					AND	ISNULL(tst_object, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobject, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_object_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlobjectorg, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_bin, N'a') = ISNULL(@cbin, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_manufacturer, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufacturer, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_manufactpart, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlmanufactpart, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_supplier, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplier, N'a')
					AND	ISNULL(tst_supplier_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@ctrlsupplierorg, N'a')
					AND (( tst_qty > 0 AND @ctrlrtype <> N'RR' ) OR ( tst_repairqty > 0 AND @ctrlrtype = N'RR'  ))
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @cgetpk = N'+'
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO SEQ_S5TRANSTOCK( seq_dummy ) VALUES( 0 )
					SET @npk = @@IDENTITY
					SET @RetCode = N'0'
					RETURN
				END
								
			INSERT INTO SEQ_S5TRANSTOCK( seq_dummy ) VALUES( 0 )
			SET @pkey = @@IDENTITY
			INSERT INTO r5transtock(tst_pk,
									tst_part,
									tst_part_org,
									tst_bin,
									tst_lot,
									tst_store,
									tst_qty,
									tst_repairqty,
									tst_torentity,
									tst_toentity,
									tst_tocode,
									tst_act,
									tst_order,
									tst_order_org,
									tst_ordline,
									tst_req,
									tst_reqline,
									tst_object,
									tst_object_org,
									tst_price,
									tst_manufacturer,
									tst_manufactpart,
									tst_supplier,
									tst_supplier_org,
									tst_pkey)
							VALUES (@npk,
									@cpart,
									@cpartorg,
									@cbin,
									@clot,
									@cstore,
									CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN 0 ELSE @nqty END,
									CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN @nqty ELSE 0 END,
									@ctorentity,
									@ctoentity,
									@ctocode,
									@ctoact,
									@corder,
									@corderorg,
									@nordline,
									@creq,
									@nreqline,
									@ctrlobject,
									@ctrlobjectorg,
									@ntrlprice,
									@ctrlmanufacturer,
									@ctrlmanufactpart,
									@ctrlsupplier,
									@ctrlsupplierorg,
									CAST( @pkey AS NVARCHAR ) )

			-- #6936 Thazul 20-may-2000 Fetch the object status
			IF @ctrlobject IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@cobstatus = obj_status,
							@cobrstatus =  obj_rstatus
					FROM	r5objects o
					WHERE	o.obj_code = @ctrlobject
					AND	o.obj_org  = @ctrlobjectorg

					--updating object status of r5objects
					SET @vobrstatus = N'T'
					EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @vobrstatus OUTPUT, @vobstatus OUTPUT, N'OBST', @chk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @chk <> N'0'
						BEGIN
							SET @RetCode = N'1'
							RETURN
						END

					UPDATE r5objects
						SET		obj_rstatus = @vobrstatus,
								obj_status  = @vobstatus,
								obj_lot     = @clot,
								obj_store   = null,
								obj_bin     = null
						WHERE	obj_code  = @ctrlobject
							AND	obj_org   = @ctrlobjectorg
					UPDATE r5objects
						SET		obj_rstatus = @vobrstatus,
								obj_status  = @vobstatus
						WHERE	( obj_code + N'#' +  obj_org ) IN (
								SELECT stc_object + N'#' + stc_object_org
								FROM   dbo.O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER( @ctrlobject, @ctrlobjectorg, N'+' )
								)							

					UPDATE r5transtock
						SET		tst_objstatus  = @cobstatus,
								tst_objrstatus = @cobrstatus
						WHERE	tst_part = @cpart
							AND	tst_part_org = @cpartorg
							AND	tst_store = @cstore
							AND	tst_lot = @clot
							AND	tst_torentity = @ctorentity
							AND	tst_tocode = @ctocode
							AND	ISNULL(ISNULL(tst_act, @ctoact), N'*') = ISNULL(@ctoact, N'*')
							AND	ISNULL(tst_order, N'a') = ISNULL(@corder, N'a' )
							AND	ISNULL(tst_order_org, N'a') = ISNULL(@corderorg, N'a' )
							AND	ISNULL(tst_ordline, -1) = ISNULL(@nordline, -1 )
							AND	ISNULL(tst_req, N'a') = ISNULL(@creq, N'a' )
							AND	ISNULL(tst_reqline, -1) = ISNULL(@nreqline, -1 )

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7TRANS_UPDATE_CATALOG(@RetCode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@cstore		NVARCHAR(15),
										@cpart		NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpartorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@corder		NVARCHAR(30),
										@corderorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@corlrtype	NVARCHAR(8),
										@nline		int,
										@nqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@nprice		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@cpricetype	NVARCHAR(200),
                                        @ctracode   NVARCHAR(30),
                                        @ntrlline   NUMERIC(24,6) )

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @cpricetime		NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @csupplier		NVARCHAR(30)	/*r5orderlines.orl_supplier%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @csupplierorg	NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5orderlines.orl_supplier_org%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @ccurr			NVARCHAR(3)		/*r5orderlines.orl_curr%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @ncatputprice	NUMERIC(24,6)	/*r5catalogue.cat_gross%TYPE;*/
	declare @nred_discperc	numeric(24,6),
			@nred_discount  numeric(24,6)
  	declare @nOrlmultiply    numeric(10,4),   /* r5orderlines.orl_multiply%TYPE; */
    		@nOrlexch       numeric(24,12)  /* r5orderlines.orl_exch%TYPE; */
	declare @nOrlprice		numeric(24,6)
    declare @nNewgross      numeric(24,6)
    declare @cOrlpuruom     nvarchar(30)
    declare @nrepairprice   numeric(24,6)


	/* Get price time */

	set @cpricetime = N'I'
    SELECT @cpricetime = isnull( i.ins_desc, N'I' )
    FROM   r5install  i
    WHERE  i.ins_code = N'PRICETIM'
    if @@ERROR <> 0
		set @cpricetime = N'I'
    IF @cpricetime = N'I' AND @corlrtype <> N'IR'
		begin
			SET @RetCode = N'0'
			return
		end

     SELECT @csupplier = orl_supplier,
            @csupplierorg = orl_supplier_org,
            @ccurr = orl_curr,
			@nOrlmultiply = orl_multiply,
            @nOrlexch = orl_exch,
			@nOrlprice = orl_price,
			@cOrlpuruom = orl_puruom
     FROM   r5orderlines
     WHERE  orl_order  = @corder
     AND    orl_order_org = @corderorg
     AND    orl_ordline = @nline

     IF @corlrtype = N'RE'
         SELECT @nrepairprice = dkl_repairprice
         FROM   r5docklines, r5translines
         WHERE  dkl_dckcode = trl_dckcode
         AND    dkl_line    = trl_dckline
         AND    trl_trans   = @ctracode
         AND    trl_line    = @ntrlline

    set @nNewgross = @nOrlprice

    declare c_reductions cursor local for SELECT   r.red_discperc,
                                                   r.red_discount
                                          FROM     r5reductions r
                                          WHERE    r.red_part         = @cpart
                                          AND      r.red_part_org     = @cpartorg
                                          AND      r.red_supplier     = @csupplier
                                          AND      r.red_supplier_org = @csupplierorg
                                          ORDER BY r.red_line DESC
    open c_reductions
    fetch next from c_reductions into @nred_discperc, @nred_discount
    while @@fetch_status = 0
        begin
            set @nNewgross = round( ( @nNewgross * 100 /
                          ( 100 - coalesce( @nred_discperc, 0 ) ) ) +
                            coalesce( @nred_discount, 0 ), 2 )
            fetch next from c_reductions into @nred_discperc, @nred_discount
        end
    close c_reductions
    deallocate c_reductions

    if @nNewgross < 0
        set @nNewgross = 0

	UPDATE r5catalogue
			SET	cat_gross  = CASE @corlrtype WHEN N'RE' THEN cat_gross ELSE @nNewgross END,
                cat_repprice  = CASE @corlrtype WHEN 'RE' THEN COALESCE( @nrepairprice, @nOrlprice ) ELSE cat_repprice END,
				cat_curr         = @ccurr
			WHERE  cat_part         = @cpart
				AND    cat_part_org     = @cpartorg
				AND    cat_supplier     = @csupplier
				AND    cat_supplier_org = @csupplierorg
				AND    cat_puruom       = @cOrlpuruom
                AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                 FROM   r5companies
                                 WHERE  com_code = cat_supplier
                                 AND    com_org  = cat_supplier_org
                                 AND    com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL )
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
		BEGIN
			SET @RetCode = N'18'
			RETURN
		END

	SET @RetCode = N'0'

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7TRANS_UPDATE_PRICES(@RetCode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@cstore		NVARCHAR(15),
										@cpart		NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpartorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@corder		NVARCHAR(30),
										@corderorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@corlrtype	NVARCHAR(8),
										@nline		int,
										@nqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@nprice		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@cpricetype	NVARCHAR(200),
										@ctracode   NVARCHAR(30),
										@ntrlline   int,
                                        @ctrlrtype  NVARCHAR(4))

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @countit		INTEGER
	DECLARE @sqty			NUMERIC(30,7)
	DECLARE @cpricetime		NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @cpricelevel	NVARCHAR(200)	/*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @storeorg		NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5stores.str_org%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @csupplier		NVARCHAR(30)	/*r5orderlines.orl_supplier%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @csupplierorg	NVARCHAR(15)	/*r5orderlines.orl_supplier_org%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @ccurr			NVARCHAR(3)		/*r5orderlines.orl_curr%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @ncatputprice	NUMERIC(30,7)	/*r5catalogue.cat_gross%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @ccontractdisc	NUMERIC(30,7)
	DECLARE @ctotextra		NUMERIC(30,7)
	DECLARE @ctottax		NUMERIC(30,7)
	DECLARE @chk			NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @x				NVARCHAR(1)

	DECLARE @RecCount		INTEGER
	DECLARE @nLastPriceCalc	NUMERIC(30,7)
	DECLARE @nQtyCalc 		NUMERIC(30,7)
	DECLARE @sRCPTCURR		nvarchar(400)	

	--Cursor c_reductions Variables
	DECLARE @nred_discperc	NUMERIC(18,0)
	DECLARE	@nred_discount	NUMERIC(30,7)
	declare @nTemp numeric(30,7)
	DECLARE @exchdate	DATETIME

	DECLARE @credit			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @avgprice		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @newavgprice	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @dprice			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @dcredit		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @creditstore	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @creditorg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @pk				NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @job			INT
	DECLARE @sql			NVARCHAR(2000)

	SET @credit  = 0
	SET @dcredit = 0

	-- Get price time
	SELECT	@RecCount = COUNT(*)
	FROM	r5install
	WHERE	ins_code = N'PRICETIM'
	IF @RecCount <> 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT 	@cpricetime = COALESCE(ins_desc, N'I')
			FROM	r5install
			WHERE	ins_code = N'PRICETIM'
			IF @@ERROR <> 0
				SET @cpricetime = N'I'
		END
	ELSE
		SET @cpricetime = N'I'

	IF @cpricetime = N'I' AND @corlrtype <> N'IR'
		BEGIN
			SET @RetCode = N'0'
			RETURN
		END

	SELECT @storeorg = str_org
	FROM   r5stores
	WHERE  str_code = @cstore

   -- Only if the price time equals 'R' for receiving, the part/stock prices
   -- should be updated.

   -- Get price level
	SELECT 	@RecCount = COUNT(*)
	FROM 	r5install
	WHERE	ins_code = N'PRICELEV'
	IF @RecCount = 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cpricelevel = COALESCE(ins_desc, N'P')
			FROM r5install
			WHERE ins_code = N'PRICELEV'
			IF @@ERROR <> 0
				SET @cpricelevel = N'P'
		END
	ELSE
		SET @cpricelevel = N'P'
		
	set @sRCPTCURR = UPPER( dbo.O7DFLT2( N'RCPTCURR') )	
	
	SELECT	@RecCount = COUNT(*)
	FROM	r5orderlines
	WHERE	orl_order  = @corder
		AND	orl_order_org = @corderorg
		AND	orl_ordline = @nline
	IF @RecCount > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @exchdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@corderorg), N'DD' )
			IF @ctrlrtype = 'RECV'
				SELECT @exchdate = max(tra_date)
				FROM r5transactions
				WHERE tra_code IN (SELECT trl_trans FROM r5translines WHERE trl_order=@corder AND trl_order_org=@corderorg AND trl_ordline=@nline AND trl_rtype='RECV' AND trl_io=1)
			SELECT	@ccontractdisc	= 1 - COALESCE(orl_discperc,0)/100,
					@ctotextra		= COALESCE( orl_totextra / COALESCE( CASE WHEN @sRCPTCURR = 'RCPT' THEN  dbo.o7gtexch2 ( orl_curr, orl_order_org, @exchdate  ) ELSE orl_exch END, 1 ) / orl_ordqty, 0 ),
					@ctottax		= COALESCE( orl_invcalctaxamount / COALESCE( CASE WHEN @sRCPTCURR = 'RCPT' THEN  dbo.o7gtexch2 ( orl_curr, orl_order_org, @exchdate  ) ELSE orl_exch END, 1 ) / orl_ordqty, 0 ),
					@csupplier		= orl_supplier,
					@csupplierorg	= orl_supplier_org,
					@ccurr			= orl_curr
			FROM	r5orderlines
			WHERE	orl_order  = @corder
				AND	orl_order_org = @corderorg
				AND	orl_ordline = @nline
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @ccontractdisc	= 1
			SET @ctotextra		= 0
			SET @ctottax		= 0
		END


	IF ISNULL( @ctotextra, 0 ) <> 0  OR ISNULL( @ctottax, 0 ) <> 0
		BEGIN
			update r5translines
			set    trl_poextracharges = ISNULL( @ctotextra, 0 ), 
			       trl_potaxamount = ISNULL( @ctottax, 0 ),
			       trl_priceupdate = N'+'
			where  trl_trans = @ctracode
			and    trl_line  = @ntrlline
		END


	SET @nLastPriceCalc = (@nprice * @ccontractdisc) + @ctotextra + @ctottax
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
		BEGIN
			SET @RetCode = N'18'
			RETURN
		END

	IF @cpricelevel = N'P'	/* If the level = 'P' for parts, then update part prices. */
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@sqty = COALESCE(SUM(sto_qty),0)
			FROM	r5stock
			WHERE	sto_part = @cpart
				AND	sto_part_org = @cpartorg
				AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
							FROM   r5stores
							WHERE  str_code = sto_store
							AND    str_org  = coalesce( case @corlrtype when N'IR' then @storeorg else @corderorg end, @storeorg ) 
 						   )
			IF @sqty > 0
				SET @nQtyCalc = @sqty
			ELSE
				SET @nQtyCalc = 0

			IF (@sqty + @nqty) > 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@RecCount = COUNT(*), 
					        @credit   = ISNULL( -ppr_credit, 0 )
					FROM	r5partprices
					WHERE	ppr_part = @cpart
					AND	ppr_part_org = @cpartorg
					AND	ppr_org = COALESCE( CASE @corlrtype
												WHEN N'IR' THEN @storeorg
												ELSE @corderorg
											END, @storeorg )
					GROUP BY ppr_credit
					IF @RecCount = 0
						-- Do insert of part price record
						INSERT INTO r5partprices (	ppr_part,
													ppr_part_org,
													ppr_org,
													ppr_avgprice,
													ppr_lastprice,
													ppr_pricetype )
										VALUES   (	@cpart,
													@cpartorg,
													COALESCE( 	CASE @corlrtype
																	WHEN N'IR' THEN @storeorg
																	ELSE @corderorg
																END, @storeorg ),
													@nLastPriceCalc,
													CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RETN' THEN NULL ELSE @nLastPriceCalc END,
													@cpricetype )
					ELSE
						begin	
							IF @ctrlrtype = N'RETN' 
								BEGIN
									SET @newavgprice = 0
									/* Calculate new avg price. */ 
									SELECT @newavgprice = ( ( ISNULL( p.ppr_avgprice, ISNULL( p.ppr_lastprice, @nLastPriceCalc ) ) *
										   @sqty + ISNULL( ( @nLastPriceCalc ) * @nqty, 0 ) ) ) /
										   ( @sqty + @nqty )
									FROM   r5partprices p
									WHERE  ppr_part     = @cpart
									AND    ppr_part_org = @cpartorg
									AND    ppr_org      = ISNULL( CASE @corlrtype WHEN N'IR' THEN @storeorg ELSE @corderorg END, @storeorg )
									IF @newavgprice < 0 
										BEGIN
											/* Create a correction transaction if the average price would have been negative. */
											INSERT INTO r5crcorrtemp( crc_rtype, crc_trans, crc_line, crc_price, crc_qty )
											VALUES( N'NPC', @ctracode, @ntrlline, -@newavgprice, @sqty + @nqty )
											/* Also, change the credit balance. */
											UPDATE r5partprices
											SET    ppr_credit   = ISNULL( ppr_credit, 0 ) - ( @newavgprice * ( @sqty + @nqty ) )
											WHERE  ppr_part     = @cpart
											AND    ppr_part_org = @cpartorg
											AND    ppr_org      = ISNULL( CASE @corlrtype WHEN N'IR' THEN @storeorg ELSE @corderorg END, @storeorg )
											/* Finally, create a change credit balance record. */
											EXECUTE r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'CBC', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
											INSERT INTO r5creditbalancechanges( 
													cbc_pk, cbc_type, cbc_date, cbc_value, cbc_part, cbc_part_org, cbc_org, cbc_trans, cbc_transline )
											VALUES( @pk, N'RETN', getdate(), ( -@newavgprice * ( @sqty + @nqty ) ), @cpart, @cpartorg, 
													ISNULL( CASE @corlrtype WHEN N'IR' THEN @storeorg ELSE @corderorg END, @storeorg ), @ctracode, @ntrlline )
										END
								END
							set @nTemp = @nLastPriceCalc * @

CREATE PROCEDURE O7TRANS_UPDATE_RCVQTY(	@RetCode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@ordorreq	NVARCHAR(4),
										@corder		NVARCHAR(30),
										@corderorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@cevent		NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpart		NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpartorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@cstore		NVARCHAR(15),
										@nline		int,
										@corlrtype	NVARCHAR(8),
										@cobject	NVARCHAR(30),
										@cobjectorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@nqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@nscrapqty	NUMERIC(24,6),
                                        @ctrllot    NVARCHAR(12),
										@ctrlbin	NVARCHAR(15),
                                        @nninout    NUMERIC(24,6) )
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @x				NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @cstatus		NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @crstatus		NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @intreq			NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @intreql		NUMERIC(8,0)
	DECLARE @schk			NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @nReturn		INT
	DECLARE @ntodo			numeric(38,12)
	DECLARE @sPrice_update	nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @nCountit		INT
	DECLARE @sX				NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @rstatus		NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @rrstatus		NVARCHAR(8)	

	-- c_rpb Cursor Variables
	DECLARE @rpb_qty   NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @rpb_store NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @rwid       INTEGER

    DECLARE @orlpart		NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @orlpartorg		NVARCHAR(15)

	SET @RetCode = N'0'
	SET @crstatus = N'C'
	SET @rrstatus = N'R'	
	SET @sX = null

	IF @ordorreq = N'PORD'
		BEGIN
			UPDATE r5orderlines
				SET	orl_recvqty   	= ISNULL(orl_recvqty, 0)  + @nqty,
					orl_scrapqty  	= ISNULL(orl_scrapqty, 0)+ ISNULL(@nscrapqty, 0),
					orl_recvvalue 	= (ISNULL(orl_recvqty, 0) + @nqty) * orl_price / ISNULL( orl_multiply,1 ),
					orl_active 		= CASE SIGN(orl_ordqty - ISNULL(orl_recvqty, 0) - ISNULL(orl_scrapqty, 0)- @nqty - ISNULL(@nscrapqty, 0))
											WHEN 1 THEN N'+'
											ELSE N'-'
									  END
				WHERE	orl_order     = @corder
					AND	orl_order_org = @corderorg
					AND	orl_ordline   = @nline
				IF @@ERROR <> 0
					BEGIN
						SET @RetCode = N'6'
						RETURN
					END

			IF @cevent IS NOT NULL
				-- Set event to 'C'.
				BEGIN
					EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @crstatus OUTPUT, @cstatus OUTPUT, N'EVST', @schk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					-- PVCS#14303 This is a workaround for the when others exception handler  - check o7exsitw and if rowcount = 0 then update.
					-- The preupd_evt trigger is failing and we can not capture the exception as Oracle does with a when others exception on the Update.
					-- Also, an @@ERROR check is of no value since the error in the trigger is fatal.

					execute @nReturn = O7EXISTW N'EVNT', N'*', N'*', N'4', @cevent, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @schk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return - 1
					if @nCountit = 0
                        IF ISNULL(@nninout, 0) = -1
                            BEGIN
                            	EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @rrstatus OUTPUT, @rstatus OUTPUT, N'EVST', @schk OUTPUT
          	                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
          	                      return -1
                                UPDATE r5events
                                SET evt_rstatus   = N'R',
                                    evt_status    = @rstatus,
                                    evt_completed = NULL
                                WHERE evt_code    = @cevent
                                AND   evt_rstatus = N'C'
                                AND   evt_jobtype = N'IS'
                                AND   EXISTS (  SELECT	N'x'
                                                FROM	r5orderlines
                                                WHERE	orl_order     = @corder
                                                AND	orl_order_org = @corderorg
                                                AND	orl_ordline   = @nline
                                                AND	orl_active    = N'+' )
                            END
                        ELSE
                            BEGIN					
								UPDATE r5events
									SET	evt_rstatus = N'C',
										evt_status  = @cstatus,
									    evt_completed = dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org )
										WHERE	evt_code    = @cevent
										AND	evt_rstatus <> N'C'
										AND	evt_jobtype = N'IS'
										AND	EXISTS (	SELECT	N'x'
														FROM	r5orderlines
														WHERE	orl_order     = @corder
															AND	orl_order_org = @corderorg
															AND	orl_ordline   = @nline
															AND	orl_active    = N'-' )
							END
				END
			IF @corlrtype <> N'PD'
			begin

				SELECT @orlpart = orl_part, 
					@orlpartorg = orl_part_org
				FROM   r5orderlines
				WHERE  orl_order = @corder
				AND    orl_order_org = @corderorg
				AND    orl_ordline = @nline
				SET @orlpart = ISNULL( @orlpart, @cpart )
				SET @orlpartorg = ISNULL( @orlpartorg, @cpartorg )

				UPDATE r5stock
				SET sto_forinv = ISNULL( sto_forinv, 0 ) + ISNULL( @nqty, 0 )
				WHERE	sto_part     = @orlpart
					AND	sto_part_org = @orlpartorg
					AND	sto_store    = @cstore
				if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					set @RetCode = N'9'
					return
				end

				set @RetCode = N'0'
				return
			end
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @ordorreq IN (N'REQ', N'EVNT' )
				BEGIN
					IF @ordorreq = N'REQ'
						BEGIN
							UPDATE r5requislines
								SET		rql_recvqty   = ISNULL(rql_recvqty, 0) + @nqty,
										rql_scrapqty  = ISNULL(rql_scrapqty, 0)+ ISNULL(@nscrapqty, 0),
										rql_recvvalue = (ISNULL(rql_recvqty, 0) + @nqty) * rql_price,
                                        rql_active = 
                				   CASE 
                    					WHEN N'-'=(
                        					SELECT orl_active
                        					FROM   r5orderlines
                        					WHERE  orl_req     = rql_req
                        					AND    orl_reqline = rql_reqline) 
                    					THEN N'-' 
                    					ELSE
                                        
                                                        	CASE SIGN(dbo.f_greatest_number( ISNULL( rql_qty, 0 ), ISNULL( rql_repairqty, 0 ) )  - ISNULL(rql_recvqty, 0) 
                                                            		- ISNULL(rql_scrapqty, 0) - @nqty - ISNULL(@nscrapqty, 0))
									WHEN 1 THEN N'+'
									ELSE N'-'
								END
						    END	
														
								WHERE	rql_req      = @corder
									AND	rql_reqline  = @nline
							IF @@ERROR <> 0
								BEGIN
									SET @RetCode = N'6'
									RETURN
								END

				END

					IF @corlrtype = N'RE' AND @nqty + ISNULL( @nscrapqty ,0 )> 0
						BEGIN
							-- Update r5repairbin records
							SELECT @orlpart = rql_part, 
								@orlpartorg = rql_part_org
							FROM   r5requislines
							WHERE  rql_req = @corder
							AND    rql_reqline = @nline
							SET @orlpart = ISNULL( @orlpart, @cpart )
							SET @orlpartorg = ISNULL( @orlpartorg, @cpartorg )

							DECLARE c_rpb CURSOR LOCAL FOR
								SELECT	rpb_qty,
										rpb_store,
										rpb_sqlidentity
								FROM	r5repairbins
								WHERE	ISNULL( rpb_req, N'%' )				LIKE ISNULL( @corder, N'%' )
									AND	ISNULL( STR( rpb_reqline ), N'%' )	LIKE ISNULL( STR( @nline ), N'%' )
									AND	ISNULL( rpb_event, N'%' )			LIKE ISNULL( @cevent, N'%' )
									AND	ISNULL( rpb_object, N'x' )			=	ISNULL( @cobject, N'x' )
									AND	ISNULL( rpb_object_org, N'x' )		=	ISNULL( @cobjectorg, N'x' )
									AND	rpb_part							=	@orlpart
									AND	rpb_part_org						=	@orlpartorg
                                ORDER BY case rpb_lot when @ctrllot then N'0' else N'1' + rpb_lot end,
								case rpb_store when @cstore then N'0' else N'1' + rpb_store end,
								case rpb_bin when @ctrlbin then N'0' else N'1' + rpb_bin end

							-- Update r5repairbin records
							SET @ntodo = @nqty + ISNULL( @nscrapqty, 0 )

							OPEN c_rpb
							WH

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7TRANS_UPDATE_RESERVED(	@RetCode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
											@cstore		NVARCHAR(15),
											@cpart		NVARCHAR(30),
											@cpartorg	NVARCHAR(15),
											@cevent		NVARCHAR(30),
											@nact		NVARCHAR(8),
											@nqty		NUMERIC(24,6))
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @resallqty		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @resqty			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @routeparent		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE	@remqty			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @sqlidentity		INT

	/* First try to find the reservation belonging to the actual WO. */
	SELECT @resqty      = res_qty, 
	       @sqlidentity = res_sqlidentity
	FROM   r5reservations
	WHERE  res_event    = @cevent
	AND    res_act      = @nact
	AND    res_store    = @cstore
	AND    res_part     = @cpart
	AND    res_part_org = @cpartorg
	AND    res_qty      > 0;

	IF @resqty > 0 
		BEGIN
			IF @nqty >= @resqty
				BEGIN
					DELETE FROM r5reservations 
					WHERE  res_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
					SET @remqty = @nqty - @resqty
				END
			ELSE 
				BEGIN
					UPDATE r5reservations 
					SET    res_allqty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( res_allqty, 0 ) - @nqty, 0 ),
					       res_qty    = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( res_qty, 0 )    - @nqty, 0 )
					WHERE  res_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
					SET @remqty = 0
				END
		END
	ELSE
		SET @remqty = @nqty

	IF @remqty > 0
		BEGIN
			-- Check for route parent.
			SELECT @routeparent = evt_routeparent
			FROM   r5events
			WHERE  evt_code = @cevent

			-- Delete records from r5reservations whose quantity falls
			-- Below/to zero after subtraction of the issue quantity
			DELETE FROM r5reservations
			WHERE  COALESCE( res_qty, 0 ) - COALESCE( @remqty, 0 ) <= 0
			AND    res_event    = @routeparent
			AND    res_act      = @nact
			AND    res_store    = @cstore
			AND    res_part     = @cpart
			AND    res_part_org = @cpartorg
			AND    res_woheaderequipment = '-'
			-- Update the reserved quantity
			UPDATE r5reservations
			SET    res_allqty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( res_allqty, 0 ) - @remqty, 0 ),
			       res_qty    = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( res_qty, 0 )    - @remqty, 0 )
			WHERE  res_part     = @cpart
			AND    res_part_org = @cpartorg
			AND    res_store    = @cstore
			AND    res_event    = @routeparent
			AND    res_act      = @nact
			AND    res_woheaderequipment = '-'
		END
	SET @RetCode = N'0'

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7TRANS_UPDATE_STOCK(	@RetCode		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@ctrlrtype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@corlrtype		NVARCHAR(8),
										@cstore			NVARCHAR(15),
										@cpart			NVARCHAR(30),
										@cpartorg		NVARCHAR(15),
										@cissuedpart	NVARCHAR(30),
										@cbin			NVARCHAR(15),
										@clot			NVARCHAR(12),
										@nqty			NUMERIC(24,6),
										@nscrapqty		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@ntrlprice		NUMERIC(24,6) OUTPUT,
										@ctrlevent		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ntrlact		NUMERIC(24,6),
										@cpricetype		NVARCHAR(200),
										@corg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@ctracode		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ntrlline		int,
										@ctrlorder		NVARCHAR(30),
										@ctrlorderorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@ntrlordline	int,
                                        @ctype			nvarchar(1),
                                        @cobject        nvarchar(30),
                                        @cobjectorg     nvarchar(15),
                                        @ntstpk         numeric(20,0),
                                        @cbintobintrans nvarchar(1) )


AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @nReturn		INTEGER
	DECLARE @sTempString	NVARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @GTTime			DATETIME

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @countit	INTEGER
	DECLARE @available	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @issprice	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @issqty		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @fifprice	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @fifqty		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @ccontdisc	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @ctotextra	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @ctottax	NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @chk	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @pricelev	NVARCHAR(200) /*r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := o7dflt( 'PRICELEV', chk );*/
	DECLARE @avgprice	NUMERIC(30,12)

	-- Cursor c_iss Variables
	DECLARE @iss_qty		NUMERIC(24, 6)
	DECLARE @iss_date		DATETIME
	DECLARE @iss_pk			NUMERIC(18, 0)
	DECLARE @iss_price		NUMERIC(24, 6)
	DECLARE @iss_fifodate	DATETIME
	DECLARE @iss_repaired	NVARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @sRCPTCURR		nvarchar(400)

	-- Cursor c_fif Variables
	DECLARE @fif_qty		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @fif_pk			NUMERIC(18,0)
	DECLARE @fif_price		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @fif_date		DATETIME
	DECLARE @fif_order		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @fif_order_org	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @fif_ordline	NUMERIC(8,0)

	DECLARE @trf_pk			NUMERIC(20,0)
	DECLARE @trf_qty		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @trf_price		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @trf_date		DATETIME
	DECLARE @trf_order		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @trf_order_org	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @trf_ordline	NUMERIC(8,0)

	DECLARE @sOrdStore		NVARCHAR(15)  /*r5orders.ord_store%TYPE;*/
	DECLARE @nCount			INTEGER
    DECLARE @repair			nvarchar(1) /*r5parts.par_repairable%TYPE;*/

    DECLARE @fif3price		NUMERIC(24,6)
    DECLARE @fif3qty		NUMERIC(24,6)
    DECLARE @fif3repaired	NVARCHAR(1)

    DECLARE @orlpart		NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @orlpartorg		NVARCHAR(15)
    DECLARE @baseprice      NUMERIC(24,6)
    
    --this variable is necessary to get the proper precision where it is being used
    declare @nSQLServerWorkaround   numeric(24,6)


	EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @pricelev OUTPUT, N'PRICELEV', @chk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	-- Check whether binstock record already exists
	SELECT	@countit = COUNT(*),
			@available = MAX( CASE @ctrlrtype WHEN N'RR' THEN b.bis_repairqty WHEN N'RREC' THEN b.bis_repairqty ELSE b.bis_qty END)
	FROM	r5binstock b
	WHERE	b.bis_store    = @cstore
		AND	b.bis_part     = @cpart
		AND	b.bis_part_org = @cpartorg
		AND	b.bis_bin      = ISNULL(@cbin, N'*')
		AND	b.bis_lot      = ISNULL(@clot, N'*')

	IF @countit > 1
		BEGIN
			SET @RetCode = N'1'
			RETURN
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @countit = 0
				BEGIN
					IF ISNULL( @nqty, 0 ) + ISNULL( @nscrapqty, 0 ) < 0
						BEGIN
							SET @RetCode = N'3'
							RETURN
						END

					-- Check if part is held in store
					SELECT	@countit = COUNT(*)
					FROM	r5stock s
					WHERE	s.sto_store    = @cstore
						AND	s.sto_part     = @cpart
						AND	s.sto_part_org = @cpartorg

					IF @countit = 0
						INSERT INTO r5stock( sto_part, sto_part_org, sto_store, sto_qty,sto_pricetype, sto_partcondition )
						SELECT @cpart, @cpartorg, @cstore, 0, str_pricetype, par_condition
						FROM   r5stores, r5parts
						WHERE  str_code = @cstore
						AND    par_code = @cpart
						AND    par_org  = @cpartorg
					-- Make sure bin exists
					SELECT	@countit = COUNT(*)
					FROM	r5bins
					WHERE	bin_store = @cstore
						AND	bin_code = ISNULL(@cbin, N'*')

					IF @countit = 0
						INSERT INTO r5bins(	bin_store, bin_code, bin_desc )
									VALUES(	@cstore, ISNULL( @cbin, N'*' ), ISNULL( @cbin, N'*' ) )

					INSERT INTO r5binstock	(	bis_store,
												bis_part,
												bis_part_org,
												bis_bin,
												bis_lot,
												bis_qty,
												bis_repairqty )
									VALUES	(	@cstore,
												@cpart,
												@cpartorg,
												ISNULL(@cbin, N'*'),
												ISNULL(@clot, N'*'),
												CASE @ctrlrtype
													WHEN N'RR' THEN 0
													WHEN N'RREC' THEN 0
													ELSE @nqty
												END,
												CASE @ctrlrtype
													WHEN N'RR' THEN @nqty
													WHEN N'RREC' THEN @nqty
													ELSE 0
												END )
					/* update r5objects to change the assoicated part to the actual returned part */
					UPDATE r5objects set obj_part = @cpart
					WHERE  obj_code = @cobject AND obj_org = @cobjectorg AND obj_part = @cissuedpart AND obj_part <> @cpart

				END
			ELSE /* countit = 0, binstock record exists.*/
				IF @available + @nqty < 0
					BEGIN
						SET @RetCode = N'4'
						RETURN
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						UPDATE r5binstock
							SET	bis_qty			=	CASE @ctrlrtype
														WHEN N'RR' THEN bis_qty
														WHEN N'RREC' THEN bis_qty
														ELSE ISNULL(bis_qty, 0)+ ISNULL(@nqty, 0)
													END,
								bis_repairqty	=	CASE @ctrlrtype
														WHEN N'RR' THEN ISNULL(bis_repairqty, 0)+ ISNULL(@nqty, 0)
														WHEN N'RREC' THEN ISNULL(bis_repairqty, 0)+ ISNULL(@nqty, 0)
														ELSE bis_repairqty
													END
							WHERE  bis_part     = @cpart
							AND    bis_part_org = @cpartorg
							AND    bis_lot      = ISNULL(@clot, N'*')
							AND    bis_bin      = ISNULL(@cbin, N'*')
							AND    bis_store    = @cstore
							
							/* update r5objects to change the assoicated part to the actual returned part */
							UPDATE r5objects set obj_part = @cpart
							WHERE  obj_code = @cobject AND obj_org = @cobjectorg AND obj_part = @cissuedpart AND obj_part <> @cpart
							
						IF @@ERROR <> 0
							BEGIN
								SET @RetCode = N'5'
								RETURN
							END
					END
		END


	IF @cbintobintrans = N'+'
		BEGIN
			/* Make sure the price is correct for a bin to bin transaction. */
			SET @baseprice = dbo.o7getprc ( @cstore, @cpart, @cpartorg, @corg, N'B', NULL, NULL )
			IF @baseprice <> @ntrlprice
				BEGIN
					UPDATE r5translines
					SET    trl_price = @baseprice, 
					       trl_priceupdate = N'+'
					WHERE  trl_trans = @ctracode
					AND    trl_line  = @ntrlline
				END
		END

	IF @cpricetype IN (N'LIFO', N'FIFO' ) AND @cbintobintrans = N'-'
		BEGIN
            SET @issprice = null
			SET @issqty = @nqty
			IF @ctrlrtype = N'I' AND @ctype = N'P' AND @nqty > 0 AND @ctrlevent IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					-- Retrieve r5issues records where either a complete job/act match exists or
					--   an object or project match ( when no act specified )
					DECLARE c_iss CURSOR LOCAL FOR
						SELECT	iss_qty,

						FROM	r5events e1,
								r5events e2,
								r5issues
						WHERE	iss_event    = e1.evt_code
							AND	e2.evt_code  = @ctrlevent
							AND	iss_store    = @cstore
							AND	iss_part     = COALESCE(@cissuedpart,@cpart)
							AND	iss_part_org = @cpartorg

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7TUIINT
                 @nTUITransId NUMERIC(18, 0)
                ,@nINTTransId NUMERIC(18, 0)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @nReturn          INT
       ,@sError           NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@nError           INT
       ,@sCheck           NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sOrg             NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sDefOrg          NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sMultiOrg        NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@nCount           INT
       ,@sDummy           NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sErrCheck        NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sErrSource       NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrType         NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrFunc         NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrParm1        NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrParm2        NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrMsg          NVARCHAR(240)
       ,@sUser            NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sEVTRStatus      NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@dEVTReported     DATETIME
       ,@dEVTCompleted    DATETIME
       ,@dClosedDate      DATETIME
       ,@nToolDays        INT
       ,@sToolDays        NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sTOUGLTransferFlag NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@dTUICreated      DATETIME
       ,@sTUISourceSystem NVARCHAR(45)
       ,@sTUISourceCode   NVARCHAR(45)
       ,@sTUIEvent        NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@nTUIAct          NUMERIC(8, 0)
       ,@sTUIMRC          NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sTUITool         NVARCHAR(12)
       ,@dTUIDateUsed     DATETIME
       ,@nTUIQty          NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nTUIHours        NUMERIC(12, 2)
       ,@nTUITariff       NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nTUICost         NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sTUITrans        NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@nTUISessionId    NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@nTUITransOrgId   NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@nTUITransGroup   NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@sTUITransType    NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sTUIUser         NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sTUIOrg          NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@nTUISQLIdentity  INT
       ,@bExists          bit
       ,@nAcdcode         bigint
       ,@sTUIAcdalias     nvarchar(45)

SELECT @sErrCheck  = N'0'
      ,@sErrSource = N'O7TUIINT'
      ,@sErrType   = N'PROC'
      ,@sErrFunc   = N'MAIN'
      ,@sErrParm1  = NULL
      ,@sErrParm2  = NULL
      ,@sErrMsg    = NULL
      ,@sDefOrg    = UPPER(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'DEFORG'))
      ,@sMultiOrg  = UPPER(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'MULTIORG'))

DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
 WHERE ine_transid = @nINTTransId
SET @nError = @@ERROR
IF @nError != 0
   GOTO EXCEPTION_HANDLER

SELECT @dTUICreated      = tui_created
      ,@sTUISourceSystem = tui_sourcesystem
      ,@sTUISourceCode   = tui_sourcecode
      ,@sTUIEvent        = tui_event
      ,@nTUIAct          = tui_act
      ,@sTUIMRC          = tui_mrc
      ,@sTUITool         = tui_tool
      ,@dTUIDateUsed     = tui_dateused
      ,@nTUIQty          = ISNULL(tui_qty, 1)
      ,@nTUIHours        = ISNULL(tui_hours, 1)
      ,@nTUITariff       = tui_tariff
      ,@nTUICost         = tui_cost
      ,@sTUITrans        = tui_trans
      ,@nTUISessionId    = tui_sessionid
      ,@nTUITransOrgId   = tui_transorgid
      ,@nTUITransGroup   = tui_transgroup
      ,@sTUITransType    = tui_transtype
      ,@sTUIUser         = tui_user
      ,@sTUIOrg          = tui_org
      ,@nTUISQLIdentity  = tui_sqlidentity
      ,@sTUIAcdalias     = tui_acdalias
  FROM r5toolusageinterface
 WHERE tui_transid = @nTUITransId
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
   RETURN

IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
   BEGIN
   IF  @sTUIUser IS NOT NULL
       SET @sUser =  @sTUIUser
   ELSE
      BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'14', @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
	  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
      RETURN
      END
   IF @sTUIOrg IS NULL
      BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'15', @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
      if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	  RETURN
      END
   ELSE
      SET @sOrg =  @sTUIOrg

   IF dbo.O7CHECKORG(@sTUIOrg, @sUser, N'-') != 1
      BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'16', @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
	  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
      RETURN
      END
   END
ELSE
   SET @sOrg = @sDefOrg

IF (@sTUIEvent IS NULL OR @nTUIAct IS NULL OR @sTUITool IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'1', @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5events WHERE evt_code = @sTUIEvent AND evt_org  = ISNULL(@sTUIOrg, @sOrg) AND evt_rstatus > N'B')
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'2', @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
   RETURN
   END

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7EXISTS N'EVNT', N'*', @sTUIEvent, N'ACTV', @sDummy, @nTUIAct, @sDummy, @sDummy, @nCount OUTPUT, @sErrCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   GOTO EXCEPTION_HANDLER
IF @nCount = 0
	BEGIN
	EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'3', @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	END
SET @sErrCheck = N'5'
IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
    begin
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                        FROM r5tools
                            ,r5userorganization
                       WHERE too_code = @sTUITool
                         AND too_org = uog_org
                         AND uog_user = @sUser
                         AND (uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sOrg))
          BEGIN
	      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, @sErrCheck, @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
	      if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    return -1
	      END
    end
ELSE
    begin
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5tools WHERE too_code = @sTUITool)
          BEGIN
	      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, @sErrCheck, @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
	      if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    return -1
	      END
    end

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5interfaceerrors WHERE ine_transid = @nINTTransId)
   RETURN

SET @sErrCheck = N'4'
IF @sTUIMRC IS NOT NULL
    begin
       IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
           begin
              IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM r5mrcs, r5userorganization
                              WHERE mrc_code = @sTUIMRC
                                AND mrc_org = uog_org
                                AND uog_user = @sUser
                                AND (uog_common = '+' OR uog_org = @sOrg)
								AND coalesce( mrc_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
                 BEGIN
		         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, @sErrCheck, @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
		         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		            return -1
		         END
           end
       ELSE
          begin
              IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM r5mrcs
                              WHERE mrc_code = @sTUIMRC
							  AND coalesce( mrc_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
                 BEGIN
		         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, @sErrCheck, @sErrSource, @sErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrMsg
		         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		           return -1
		         END
          end
    end
ELSE
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7GMORES N'EVNT', 1, @sTUIEvent, @sDummy, @sDummy, @sDummy, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sTUIMRC OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sErrCheck OUTPUT
   IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
      GOTO EXCEPTION_HANDLER
   END

SELECT @sEVTRStatus   = evt_rstatus
      ,@dEVTReported

create PROCEDURE O7UBCPBD @sFrombudget        nvarchar(17),
                       @sFromyear             nvarchar(8),
                       @sTobudget             nvarchar(17),
                       @sToyear               nvarchar(8),
                       @nPercentplusminus     numeric(36,2),
                       @sCopybudgetopt        nvarchar(1),
                       @sCreatetobudgetdetail nvarchar(1),
                       @sChk                  nvarchar(4) OUTPUT  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    /* Other variables required for the procedure */
    declare @sFrombudgetorg                 nvarchar(15)--r5organization.org_code%TYPE
    declare @sTobudgetorg                   nvarchar(15)--r5organization.org_code%TYPE
    declare @sFrombudgetcal                 nvarchar(2) --r5calendars.cal_code%TYPE

    declare @sFrombudgetstartperiod         nvarchar(4)--r5periods.acp_period%TYPE
    declare @sFrombudgetendperiod           nvarchar(4)--r5periods.acp_period%TYPE
    declare @sTobudgetstartperiod           nvarchar(4)--r5periods.acp_period%TYPE
    declare @sTobudgetendperiod             nvarchar(4)--r5periods.acp_period%TYPE
    declare @sCopyoption                    nvarchar(1) --= UPPER ( coalesce( @sCopybudgetopt,  N'B' )) 
    declare @bNewbudget_overwritedetail     bit
    declare @nBudyears                      INTEGER
    declare @nFromBudDetails                INTEGER
    declare @sRbudstatus                    nvarchar(8)--r5rcodes.rco_rcode%TYPE =    N'10'
    declare @sUbudstatus                    nvarchar(8)--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
    declare @nBuddetaillevel                numeric(38,0)
    declare @nVarpercent                    numeric(36,2)--   = coalesce( @nPercentplusminus, 0)

    declare @nFrom_level                    numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_level%TYPE
    declare @nFrom_peri                     numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_peri%TYPE

    declare @nFrom_mrc                      numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_mrc%TYPE
    declare @nFrom_obj                      numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_obj%TYPE
    declare @nFrom_jbtp                     numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_jbtp%TYPE
    declare @nFrom_cstp                     numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_cstp%TYPE
    declare @nFrom_proj                     numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_proj%TYPE
    declare @nFrom_cstc                     numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_cstc%TYPE

    declare @nTo_level                      numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_level%TYPE
    declare @nTo_peri                       numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_peri%TYPE
    declare @nTo_loc                        numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_loc%TYPE
    declare @nTo_mrc                        numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_mrc%TYPE
    declare @nTo_obj                        numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_obj%TYPE
    declare @nTo_jbtp                       numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_jbtp%TYPE
    declare @nTo_cstp                       numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_cstp%TYPE
    declare @nTo_proj                       numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_proj%TYPE
    declare @nTo_cstc                       numeric(1,0)--r5budgetstructure.bus_cstc%TYPE
    declare @nReturn                        integer
    declare @nCounter                       integer



  
    /*  Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
    set @sCopyoption = UPPER ( coalesce( @sCopybudgetopt,  N'B' )) 
    set @sRbudstatus = N'10'
    set @nVarpercent = coalesce( @nPercentplusminus, 0.00)

    /*  Check mandatory parameters  */

    /*  From Budget cannot be null  */
    IF ( @sFrombudget IS NULL OR @sFromyear IS NULL ) 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            RETURN
        end

    /*  To  Budget Id cannot be null */
    IF ( @sTobudget  IS NULL OR @sToyear IS NULL ) 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'2'
            RETURN
        end


    IF ( @sCopyoption NOT IN (N'Z', N'S', N'C',N'B')) 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'3'  
            RETURN
        end

    /*  check what are  the options for creating a  new budget or ovewriting details   */
    IF ( @sCreatetobudgetdetail IS NULL OR UPPER( @sCreatetobudgetdetail ) = N'Y' ) 
        set @bNewbudget_overwritedetail = 1
    ELSE
        set @bNewbudget_overwritedetail = 0

    /*  check if from Budget exists */
    If not exists (SELECT N'1'
                    FROM   r5budgets
                    WHERE  bud_code = @sFrombudget
                    AND    bud_year = @sFromyear ) 
        begin
            set @sChk =  N'4'
            RETURN
        end

    /* If no budget details exist for the from budget no budgets are created and existing details are not deleted*/
    SELECT @nFromBudDetails = COUNT(*) FROM   r5budgetdetails  WHERE  bdt_budget = @sFrombudget AND    bdt_year   = @sFromyear
    IF ( @nFromBudDetails = 0 ) 
        begin
            set @sChk =  N'26'
            RETURN
        end
    /*  validate  values of from  budgetstructure and to budget structure */

    SELECT @sFrombudgetorg = bus_org, @sFrombudgetcal = bus_cal, @nFrom_level = bus_level, 
            @nFrom_peri = bus_peri, @nFrom_loc = bus_loc, @nFrom_mrc = bus_mrc, @nFrom_obj = bus_obj, 
           @nFrom_jbtp = bus_jbtp, @nFrom_cstp = bus_cstp,  @nFrom_proj = bus_proj, @nFrom_cstc = bus_cstc

           @nTo_jbtp = bus_jbtp, @nTo_cstp = bus_cstp,  @nTo_proj = bus_proj, @nTo_cstc = bus_cstc
    FROM   r5budgetstructure
    WHERE  bus_code = @sTobudget
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        begin
            set @sChk =  N'6'

        end

    /*  check if  budget  structure calendars are same */
    IF ( coalesce( @sFrombudgetcal, N'*' ) <> coalesce( @sTobudgetcal, N'*' ) ) 
        begin
            set @sChk =  N'7'
            RETURN
        end

    /*  check if  budget  structure levels are same */
    IF ( coalesce( @nFrom_level, 0 ) <>  coalesce( @nTo_level, 0 )  OR

    coalesce(@nFrom_jbtp, 0 )   <>  coalesce( @nTo_jbtp, 0 )   OR

    /*  retrieve  values of to budget term */

create function O7UBUBAT_GET_HIERARCHY1 (	@sBuscode	nvarchar(17) )
returns @tReturn table( buscode	nvarchar(17)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						buslevel	numeric(1),
						busorg	nvarchar(15)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						nLevel		int )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(17)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(17)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nBuslevel			numeric(1)
		
	declare @tStack table ( buscode		nvarchar(17),
							buslevel	numeric(1),
							busorg		nvarchar(15),
							busparent	nvarchar(17),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	s.bus_code,
				s.bus_level,
				s.bus_org, 
				s.bus_parent,
				1 
		  from	r5budgetstructure s
		 where	s.bus_code		= @sBuscode	and 
				s.bus_code NOT IN ( SELECT bus_parent
                            FROM   r5budgetstructure s2
                            WHERE  s2.bus_parent = s.bus_code )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sParent	= busparent,
							@sCode	= buscode, 
							@sOrg = busorg, 
							@nBuslevel = buslevel
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @nBuslevel, @sOrg,  @nLevel)
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND buscode = @sCode
					insert into @tStack	select	s.bus_code,
												s.bus_level,
												s.bus_org, 
												s.bus_parent, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5budgetstructure s
										 where	s.bus_parent	= @sCode and
												s.bus_code NOT IN ( SELECT bus_parent
												FROM   r5budgetstructure s2
												WHERE  s2.bus_parent = s.bus_code )										 
										 		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UIPREF  
		@sUser    	nvarchar(255),
		@sCode       nvarchar(12),
        @sValue      nvarchar(1) 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @nCount integer
BEGIN


	select	@nCount = count(*) 
	FROM	r5userprefs
	WHERE	upf_pref = @sCode AND    
			upf_user = @sUser


	if @nCount = 0 
		INSERT INTO r5userprefs (upf_pref, upf_user, upf_value)
		VALUES (@sCode, @sUser, @sValue)

		UPDATE r5userprefs
		SET    upf_value = @sValue
		WHERE  upf_pref  = @sCode
		AND    upf_user  = @sUser

	COMMIT
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UNMATCHEDINVOICELINES
  @invoice    NVARCHAR( 45 ),
  @invoiceorg NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @line       NUMERIC,
  @eamuser    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @action     NVARCHAR( 1 ) = NULL
AS  
BEGIN
  DECLARE @iucdesc   NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @iuctype   NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @iuchours  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @iucrate   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @iucevent  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @iucact    NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @iuctool   NVARCHAR( 12 )
  DECLARE @evtmrc    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tdate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @chk       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE iuc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT iuc_desc, iuc_type, CASE ISNULL( @action, N'I' ) WHEN N'D' THEN -iuc_hours ELSE iuc_hours END, 
           iuc_rate + ( ISNULL( iuc_taxamount, 0 ) / iuc_hours ), 
           iuc_event, iuc_act, iuc_tool, evt_mrc, dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org )
    FROM   r5events, r5invoiceunmatchedlines
    WHERE  evt_code        = iuc_event
    AND    iuc_invoice     = @invoice
    AND    iuc_invoice_org = @invoiceorg
    AND    iuc_line        = COALESCE( @line, iuc_line )
    ORDER BY iuc_line
  OPEN iuc
  FETCH NEXT FROM iuc INTO @iucdesc, @iuctype, @iuchours, @iucrate, @iucevent, @iucact, @iuctool, @evtmrc, @tdate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Loop through all lines and for each line call o7mcosts. */
      IF @iuctype = N'TOOL' 
        INSERT INTO r5toolusage( tou_tool, tou_desc,  tou_mrc, tou_event, tou_act, tou_datebooked,
               tou_dateused, tou_qty, tou_tariff, tou_cost, tou_hours, tou_misc, tou_splitusage,
               tou_unmatchedinvoice, tou_unmatchedinvoice_org, tou_unmatchedinvoiceline )
        VALUES ( @iuctool, @iucdesc, @evtmrc, @iucevent, @iucact, @tdate, 
                 @tdate, @iuchours, @iucrate, @iuchours * @iucrate, 1, N'+', N'N',
                 @invoice, @invoiceorg, @line )
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @tdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @tdate, N'DD' )
          EXECUTE o7mcosts @iucevent, @iucact, @iuctype, @iucdesc, @iuchours, @iucrate, @tdate, N'N', @eamuser, @chk OUTPUT,
                           @invoice, @invoiceorg, @line
        END
      FETCH NEXT FROM iuc INTO @iucdesc, @iuctype, @iuchours, @iucrate, @iucevent, @iucact, @iuctool, @evtmrc, @tdate
    END
  CLOSE iuc
  DEALLOCATE iuc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPAC10 
	@sEventno        nvarchar(30),
	@sMrc            nvarchar(15),
	@sShift          nvarchar(4),
	@sProject        nvarchar(20),
	@sProjbud        nvarchar(20),
	@sDowhat         nvarchar(30),
	@sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sMrcflag   nvarchar(1) 
	declare @Shifflag  nvarchar(1) 
	declare @sProjflag  nvarchar(1) 
BEGIN

	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @sMrcflag = N'N'
	set @Shifflag = N'N'
	set @sProjflag = N'N'

	IF @sEventno IS NULL  OR @sDowhat  IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


   IF CHARINDEX(N'MRC', @sDowhat) > 0 
      set @sMrcflag  = N'Y'

   IF CHARINDEX(N'SHIF', @sDowhat) > 0 
      set @Shifflag = N'Y'

   IF CHARINDEX(N'PROJ', @sDowhat) > 0 
      set @sProjflag = N'Y'

   UPDATE r5activities
   SET    act_mrc     = CASE @sMrcflag WHEN N'Y' THEN @sMrc ELSE act_mrc END,
          act_shift   = CASE @Shifflag WHEN N'Y' THEN @sShift ELSE act_shift END, 
          act_project = CASE @sProjflag WHEN N'Y' THEN @sProject ELSE act_project END, 
          act_projbud = CASE @sProjflag WHEN N'Y' THEN @sProjbud ELSE act_projbud END
   WHERE  act_event   = @sEventno
END

create PROCEDURE O7UPAC11

                                                         a.act_start,     a.act_special,  a.act_rpc,      a.act_wap,      a.act_tpf,
                                                         a.act_manufact,  a.act_syslevel, a.act_asmlevel, a.act_uom,      a.act_minhours,
                                                         a.act_complevel, a.act_hire,     a.act_act,      a.act_note,     a.act_complocation
                                                    FROM   r5activities a, r5events e
                                                    WHERE  a.act_event       = e.evt_routeparent
                                                    AND    e.evt_routeparent = @sEvent
                                                    AND    a.act_act         = coalesce( @nAct, a.act_act )
                                                    AND EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                                                              FROM   r5activities a2
                                                              WHERE  a2.act_event = e.evt_code

            open c_activities

                                                @nAct_persons, @nAct_time, @dAct_start, @sAct_special, @sAct_rpc, @sAct_wap, @sAct_tpf, @sAct_manufact, @sAct_syslevel,
                                                @sAct_asmlevel, @sAct_uom, @sAct_minhours, @sAct_complevel,@sAct_hire, @nAct_act, @sAct_note, @sAct_complocation

            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    /* Do update of the activity columns for all route children. */
                    UPDATE r5activities
                    SET    act_trade        = @sAct_trade,
                            act_mrc          = @sAct_mrc,
                            act_supplier     = @sAct_supplier,
                            act_supplier_org = @sAct_supplier_org,
                            act_duration     = @nAct_duration,
                            act_task         = @sAct_task,
                            act_taskrev      = @nAct_taskrev,
                            act_persons      = @nAct_persons,
                            act_time         = @nAct_time,
                            act_start        = @dAct_start,
                            act_special      = @sAct_special,
                            act_rpc          = @sAct_rpc,
                            act_wap          = @sAct_wap,
                            act_tpf          = @sAct_tpf,
                            act_manufact     = @sAct_manufact,
                            act_syslevel     = @sAct_syslevel,

					fetch next from c_activities into @sEvt_code, @sAct_trade, @sAct_mrc, @sAct_supplier, @sAct_supplier_org, @nAct_duration, @sAct_task, @nAct_taskrev,
                                                @nAct_persons, @nAct_time, @dAct_start, @sAct_special, @sAct_rpc, @sAct_wap, @sAct_tpf, @sAct_manufact, @sAct_syslevel,
                                                @sAct_asmlevel, @sAct_uom, @sAct_minhours, @sAct_complevel,@sAct_hire, @nAct_act, @sAct_note, @sAct_complocation
				end
			close c_activities
			deallocate c_activities
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            IF @sAction = N'DEL'

                                begin

create procedure O7UPACT1
   @nHours    numeric(24,6),
   @nHoursold numeric(24,6),
   @sOcrtype  nvarchar(4),
   @nActCode  int,
   @sEvent    nvarchar(30),
   @sChk      nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nNthours			numeric(24,6)  /* Normal Time hours */
	declare @nOthours			numeric(24,6)  /* Over Time hours */
	declare @nNthoursold		numeric(24,6)  /* Normal Time hours old */
	declare @nOthoursold		numeric(24,6)  /* Over Time hours old */
	declare @sOrltype			nvarchar(30)--r5orderlines.orl_order%TYPE
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount				int

/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sOrltype = N'X'

/* no operation, calls to this contained preliminary check on existence
   of act/evt and ocrtype=N,O,CN,CO several times would also occur in WDBKEV:
*/
	if  @sEvent   IS NULL  AND @nActCode IS NULL 
		RETURN

	if @sOcrtype  NOT IN ( N'O', N'N', N'CN', N'CO' )  OR @sOcrtype  IS NULL 
		RETURN

/* Checking for Mandatory Input */
	if @nHours    IS NULL    OR @sEvent    IS NULL    OR @nActCode  IS NULL  
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	SELECT @sOrltype = orl_rtype
	FROM   r5orderlines  INNER JOIN r5orders ON ord_code = orl_order AND ord_org = orl_order_org
	WHERE  orl_event = @sEvent
	AND    orl_act   = @nActCode
    AND    ord_rstatus = 'A'
	AND    orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'J')
	AND    orl_rtype IN ( N'SF', N'ST' )
	AND    ( orl_rstatus <> 'C' OR ( orl_rstatus =  'C' AND isnull( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) <> 0 ) )


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 1
		begin
			set @sChk = N'10'
			RETURN
		end

	-- W0315 and W0333 Update of r5activities
	if @sOrltype <> N'SF' 
		begin
			if @sOcrtype IN ( N'O', N'CO' )			
				begin
					set @nOthours    = @nHours
					set @nNthours    = 0
					set @nOthoursold = @nHoursold
					set @nNthoursold = 0
				end
			else
				begin
					set @nNthours    = @nHours
					set @nOthours    = 0
					set @nNthoursold = @nHoursold
					set @nOthoursold = 0
				end

			UPDATE r5activities
			SET    act_rem   = CASE act_rem WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CASE WHEN act_rem - @nHours + @nHoursold > 0 THEN act_rem - @nHours + @nHoursold ELSE 0 END)  END,
				act_nt   = CASE WHEN Coalesce( act_nt, 0 ) + @nNthours - @nNthoursold < 0 THEN 0 ELSE Coalesce( act_nt, 0 ) + @nNthours - @nNthoursold END,
				act_ot   = CASE WHEN Coalesce( act_ot, 0 ) + @nOthours - @nOthoursold < 0 THEN 0 ELSE Coalesce( act_ot, 0 ) + @nOthours - @nOthoursold END
			WHERE  act_act   = @nActCode
			AND    act_event = @sEvent
			RETURN
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7UPACT4 
 @sNewActMatlist   nvarchar(20),
 @sMtlCode         nvarchar(20),
 @sChk             nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sMrcevent      nvarchar(15)	/*r5mrcs.mrc_code%TYPE    MRC of event for activity             */
	declare @sMrcstore      nvarchar(15)	/*r5stores.str_code%TYPE  Store Code of MRC of event            */
	declare @sNewActEvent   nvarchar(30)	/*r5activities.act_event%TYPE*/
	declare @nNewActAct     numeric(8)		/*r5activities.act_act%TYPE*/
	declare @sOldActMatlist nvarchar(20)	/*r5activities.act_matlist%TYPE*/
	declare @sIoActEvent    nvarchar(30)	/*r5activities.act_event%TYPE*/
	declare @nIoActAct      numeric(8)		/*r5activities.act_act%TYPE*/
	declare @sIoActMatlist  nvarchar(20)	/*r5activities.act_matlist%TYPE*/
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		integer

BEGIN
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sMrcevent   = NULL
	set @sMrcstore   = NULL

/* Check mandatory parameters */
	if @sMtlCode IS NULL   /* @sNewActMatlist is allowed to be NULL */
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	from   r5activities a
	where  a.act_matlist = @sMtlCode


	if @nCount > 0
		return		
	else 
		begin
			SELECT @sOldActMatlist = a.act_matlist,
				  @sNewActEvent = a.act_event,
				  @nNewActAct = a.act_act
			from   r5activities a
			where  a.act_matlist = @sMtlCode



			select @nCount = count(*) 
			from    r5events e
			where   e.evt_code = @sNewActEvent

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT  @sMrcevent = e.evt_mrc
				from    r5events e
				where   e.evt_code = @sNewActEvent
			else
				set @sX = null


			select @nCount = count(*)
			from    r5mrcs m
			where   m.mrc_code = @sMrcevent
			
			if @nCount > 0 
				begin
					SELECT  @sMrcstore = m.mrc_store
					from    r5mrcs m
					where   m.mrc_code = @sMrcevent
					if @sMrcstore IS NULL    
						set @sX = null
					else
						begin
							if @sNewActMatlist <> @sOldActMatlist  OR ( @sNewActMatlist IS NULL AND  @sOldActMatlist IS NOT NULL ) 
								begin
									set @sIoActEvent   = @sNewActEvent
									set @nIoActAct     = @nNewActAct
									set @sIoActMatlist = @sOldActMatlist
									execute @nReturn = o7deres1 @sIoActEvent, @nIoActAct, @sIoActMatlist, @sChk  OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return -1

									if @sChk <> N'0'  
										return
									if @sNewActMatlist IS NOT NULL 
										begin
											execute @nReturn = o7crres1 @sNewActEvent, @nNewActAct,  @sMrcevent, @sNewActMatlist, @sChk OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												return -1

											if @sChk <> N'0' AND @sChk <> N'3' 
												return
										end
								end
						end
				end
			else
				set @sX = null

		end
   return
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPACT6 
	@sEvent          nvarchar(30),
	@dOldtarget      DATETIME,
	@dNewtarget      DATETIME,
	@sPpm            nvarchar(64),
	@sStwo           nvarchar(20),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nRevision		numeric(3)	--r5ppmacts.ppa_revision%type
	declare @sNewPpm			nvarchar(20)	--r5ppmacts.ppa_ppm%type
	declare @nAct				numeric(8)
	declare @nPPAStart				numeric(3)
	declare @nWACStart				numeric(3)
	declare @sRevision				nvarchar(3)
	declare @sTemp						nvarchar(60)

BEGIN


	set @sRevision = SUBSTRING( @sPpm, CHARINDEX(  N'#',@sPpm ) + 1, len(@sPpm) - (CHARINDEX(  N'#',@sPpm )) )
	set @nRevision = cast(@sRevision as numeric(3))
	set @sNewPpm     = SUBSTRING( @sPpm, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sPpm ) -1 )
	set @sChk     = N'0'

	IF @sEvent IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	DECLARE cAct CURSOR local FOR SELECT a.act_act,
		  COALESCE( p.ppa_start, 1 ),
		  COALESCE( s.wac_start, 1 )
	FROM  r5standwacts s right outer join r5activities a on (a.act_act = s.wac_act AND @sStwo = s.wac_standwork )
						 left outer join r5ppmacts    p on (a.act_act = p.ppa_act AND @sNewPpm  = p.ppa_ppm AND @nRevision = p.ppa_revision )
	WHERE  a.act_event   = @sEvent
	AND    COALESCE ( a.act_ordered, N'-' ) = N'-'

	OPEN cAct
	FETCH NEXT FROM cAct INTO @nAct, @nPPAStart, @nWACStart
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			UPDATE r5activities
			SET    act_start =
				CASE  WHEN @dNewtarget IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ( CASE WHEN @dOldtarget  IS NULL THEN @dNewtarget + @nPPAStart - 1 + @nWACStart - 1 ELSE act_start + ( @dNewtarget - @dOldtarget) END ) END 
			WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
			AND    act_act   = @nAct
			AND    COALESCE( act_start, getdate() ) <> 
			                COALESCE( CASE @dNewtarget WHEN NULL THEN NULL ELSE 
			                          CASE @dOldtarget WHEN NULL THEN @dNewtarget + @nPPAStart - 1
			                                                              + @nWACStart - 1 ELSE
                                 act_start + ( @dNewtarget - @dOldtarget ) END END, getdate() )
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM cAct INTO @nAct, @nPPAStart, @nWACStart
		END
	CLOSE cAct
	DEALLOCATE cAct

END

create PROCEDURE O7UPACT9
  @sEvent      nvarchar(30),
  @nAct        numeric(8),
  @sProject    nvarchar(20),
  @sAction     nvarchar(4),
  @sChk        nvarchar(200) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @dLatestsched     datetime
  declare @nHours         numeric(24,6)
  declare @sSchstat       nvarchar(8)   /*r5install.ins_code%TYPE*/
  declare @nCountit       integer
  declare @sProjstat        nvarchar(4)   /*r5projects.prj_rstatus%TYPE*/
  declare @sChk2          nvarchar(3)
  declare @sTempSchstat     nvarchar(8)
  declare @nCount         integer
  declare @nReturn        integer
  declare @sX           nvarchar(1)
BEGIN

  set @dLatestsched = null
  set @nHours = null


  if @sEvent  IS NULL OR @nAct    IS NULL
    begin
      set @sChk = N'1'
      RETURN
    end


  SELECT @nHours = SUM( a.acs_hours ), @dLatestsched = MAX( a.acs_sched )
  FROM   r5actschedules a
  WHERE  a.acs_event    = @sEvent
  AND    a.acs_activity = @nAct
  AND    a.acs_shiftschedulesession is null

  UPDATE r5activities
  SET    act_latestsched = @dLatestsched,
     act_schedhrs = @nHours
  WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
  AND    act_act = @nAct
  AND  ( COALESCE( act_latestsched, getDate() - 5000 ) <> COALESCE( @dLatestsched, getDate() - 5000 ) OR
  COALESCE( act_schedhrs, -10 ) <> COALESCE( @nHours, -10 ) )
  
  if @@ERROR <> 0
    begin
      set @sChk = N'2 - ORA:'
      RETURN
    end

  if @sAction = N'DEL'
    RETURN


  if @sProject IS NOT NULL
    begin
      SELECT  @sProjstat = p.prj_rstatus
      FROM    r5projects p
      WHERE   p.prj_code = @sProject

      if @sProjstat IN ( N'B', N'C' )
        begin
          set @sChk = N'3'
          RETURN
        end
    end

  execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sTempSchstat OUTPUT, N'SCHSTAT', @sChk2 OUTPUT
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

   set @sSchstat = UPPER( SUBSTRING( @sTempSchstat, 1, 4 ) )

  if @sChk2 NOT IN ( N'0', N'2' )
    begin
      set @sChk = N'4 - '  +@sChk2
      RETURN
    end

  if @sSchstat IS NOT NULL
    begin
      execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'EVST', @sSchstat, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk2 OUTPUT
      if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
      return -1


      if @sChk2 <> N'0'
        begin
          set @sChk = N'5 - ' + @sChk2
          RETURN
        end

      if @nCountit = 1
        begin
          UPDATE r5events
          SET    evt_status = @sSchstat, evt_updatecount = evt_updatecount + 1
          WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent
          AND    evt_status <> @sSchstat
          if @@ERROR <> 0
            set @sChk = N'6 - ORA:'
        end
    end
END
