create PROCEDURE O7UPCAT1 
	@sSupplier    nvarchar(30),
	@sSupplierorg nvarchar(15) 

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nBatch  int;
	declare @sChk    nvarchar( 4 );
	declare @sCurCode nvarchar(3)
	declare @sCatCurr nvarchar(3)
	declare @nCurrDual numeric(24,12)
	declare @dDate	datetime
	declare @nReturn int

	DECLARE cCat CURSOR local FOR SELECT DISTINCT c.cat_curr, 
		c1.cur_dual,
		c2.cur_code
	FROM   r5currencies c1,
		r5install i,
		r5currencies c2,
		r5catalogue c
	WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
		AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		AND    i.ins_code         = N'DUALCURR'
		AND    i.ins_desc         = c2.cur_code
		AND    c1.cur_code        = c.cat_curr
		AND  ( c.cat_purprice  IS NOT NULL OR
		c.cat_quotprice IS NOT NULL OR
		c.cat_gross     IS NOT NULL )




	OPEN cCat
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCat INTO @sCatCurr, @nCurrDual, @sCurCode
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nBatch OUTPUT, N'DUALCONV', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cCat
					deallocate cCat
					RETURN -1
				end
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, @sSupplierorg 
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						close cCat
						deallocate cCat
						RETURN -1
					end

			INSERT INTO r5dualconvheader ( dch_batch, 
											dch_date, 
											dch_type, 
											dch_oldcurr,
											dch_newcurr, 
											dch_exch, 
											dch_supplier, 
											dch_supplier_org )
								VALUES	( @nBatch, 
										@dDate, 
										'C', 
										@sCatCurr,
										@sCurCode, 
										@nCurrDual, 
										@sSupplier, 
										@sSupplierorg )


			INSERT INTO r5dualconvlines (dcl_batch
										,dcl_table
										,dcl_pk
										,dcl_column1
										,dcl_value1
										,dcl_column2
										,dcl_value2
										,dcl_column3
										,dcl_value3 )
								SELECT     @nBatch
											,N'R5CATALOGUE'
											,cat_supplier + N'#' + cat_supplier_org + N'#' + cat_part + N'#' + cat_part_org
											,N'CAT_PURPRICE'
											,cat_purprice
											,N'CAT_QUOTPRICE'
											,cat_quotprice
											,N'CAT_GROSS'
											,cat_gross
								FROM   r5catalogue
								WHERE  cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
									AND    cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
									AND    cat_curr         = @sCatCurr

			UPDATE r5catalogue
			SET cat_purprice  = ROUND( cat_purprice / @nCurrDual, 2 ),
				cat_quotprice = ROUND( cat_quotprice / @nCurrDual, 2 ),
				cat_gross     = ROUND( cat_gross / @nCurrDual, 2 ),
				cat_curr      = @sCurCode
			WHERE  cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
				AND    cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
				AND    cat_curr         = @sCatCurr

			FETCH NEXT FROM cCat INTO @sCatCurr, @nCurrDual, @sCurCode
		END
	CLOSE cCat
	DEALLOCATE cCat

CREATE PROCEDURE o7updateequipmentsurvey
  @sRrvpk                  NVARCHAR(30),
  @sRrvOrg                 NVARCHAR(15),
  @sEquipment              NVARCHAR(30),
  @sEquipmentOrg           NVARCHAR(15),
  @sRankingCode            NVARCHAR(30),
  @sRankingOrg             NVARCHAR(15),
  @nRankingRev             NUMERIC( 4 )
AS
BEGIN
             
    DELETE FROM r5objectsurvey WHERE obs_type = 'O' AND obs_object = @sEquipment AND obs_object_org = @sEquipmentOrg AND obs_levelpk IN  
             (SELECT obs_levelpk FROM r5objectsurvey, r5reliabilityrankinglevels, r5equipmentrankings  
             WHERE obs_levelpk = rrl_pk  
             AND obs_object = eqr_objcode  
             AND obs_object_org = eqr_objorg  
             AND rrl_reliabilityranking = eqr_rankingcode  
             AND rrl_org = eqr_rankingorg  
             AND rrl_revision = eqr_rankingrevision  
             AND rrl_questionlevel = '+' 
             AND eqr_rankingcode = @sRankingCode  
             AND eqr_rankingorg = @sRankingOrg  
             AND eqr_rankingrevision = @nRankingRev  
             AND eqr_objcode = @sEquipment  
             AND eqr_objorg = @sEquipmentOrg) ;
    
    INSERT INTO    r5objectsurvey (obs_object, obs_object_org, obs_type, obs_levelpk, obs_answerpk, obs_value, obs_calculatedanswer, obs_calculatedvalue, obs_datelastcalculated)
           SELECT  @sEquipment, @sEquipmentOrg, 'O', obs_levelpk, obs_answerpk, obs_value, obs_calculatedanswer, obs_calculatedvalue, obs_datelastcalculated
           FROM    r5objectsurvey 
           WHERE   obs_object = @sRrvpk
             AND   obs_object_org = @sRrvOrg
             AND   obs_type = 'S';
   
   UPDATE r5objects
    SET    obj_rrsurveylastupdated = ( SELECT rrv_surveylastupdated FROM r5reliabilityrankingvalues WHERE rrv_pk = @sRrvpk )
    WHERE  obj_code = @sEquipment
    AND    obj_org  = @sEquipmentOrg
    AND    obj_reliabilityranking = @sRankingCode
    AND    obj_reliabilityranking_org = @sRankingOrg
    AND    obj_reliabilityrankingrev = @nRankingRev ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPDATENONCONFORMITY

AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @status    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @rstatus   NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @chk       NVARCHAR( 4 )

  SELECT @status = nsd_ncfstatus
  FROM   r5ncsetupstatusdep, r5nonconformities

  IF @status IS NOT NULL

      EXECUTE @r = r5o7_o7rcode @rstatus OUTPUT, @status, N'NCST', @chk OUTPUT
      UPDATE r5nonconformities
      SET    ncf_status  = @status,
             ncf_rstatus = @rstatus
      WHERE  ncf_code    = @code

END

						@dTempDate,
						@sR5user
						FROM   r5entities e,
						r5addetails a
						WHERE  e.ent_rentity = N'PORL'
						AND    a.add_code = @sReq + N'#' + @sReqline
						AND    a.add_rentity = N'REQL'


END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPDETC
	@sProject     nvarchar(20),
	@sProjbud     nvarchar(20),
	@sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nPrntetc		numeric(24,6)	
	declare @nTotpcletc		numeric(24,6)	
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(20)	
BEGIN
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sX            = NULL
	set @nCount      = 0

	if (@sProject  IS  NULL OR @sProjbud IS NULL) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	from   r5projbudclasses 
	where  pcl_project = @sProject and
	pcl_projbud = @sProjbud

	if @nCount > 0 
		select @nPrntetc = pcl_etc
		from   r5projbudclasses 
		where  pcl_project = @sProject and
		pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
	else
		begin
			set @sX = null
			return
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	from   r5projbudclasses p,
		 r5projects r
	where  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
	and    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
	and    r.prj_parent  = @sProject

	if @nCount > 0 
		select @nTotpcletc = sum( coalesce( p.pcl_etc, 0 ) )
		from   r5projbudclasses p,
			 r5projects r
		where  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
		and    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
		and    r.prj_parent  = @sProject
	else
		begin
			set @sX = null
			return
		end

	if @nTotpcletc > @nPrntetc 
		begin
			set	@sChk = N'4'
			RETURN
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)      
	from   r5projects 
    where  prj_code = @sProject

	if @nCount > 0 
		select @sParent = prj_parent
		from   r5projects 
		where  prj_code = @sProject

	else
		begin
			set @sX = null
			return
		end



	if @sParent IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)      
			from   r5projbudclasses 
			where  pcl_project = @sParent
			and    pcl_projbud = @sProjbud

			if @nCount > 0 
				select @nPrntetc = pcl_etc
				from   r5projbudclasses 
				where  pcl_project = @sParent
				and    pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
			else
				begin
					set @sX = null
					return
				end


			select @nCount = count(*)      
			from   r5projbudclasses p,
			r5projects r
			where  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
			and    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
			and    r.prj_parent  = @sParent

			if @nCount > 0 
				select @nTotpcletc = sum( coalesce( p.pcl_etc, 0 ) )
				from   r5projbudclasses p,
				r5projects r
				where  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
				and    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
				and    r.prj_parent  = @sParent
			else
				begin
					set @sX = null
					return
				end


			if @nTotpcletc > @nPrntetc 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end
		end

END

create procedure O7UPDEVT	@nSessionid	integer
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sWLWEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sWLWMrc			nvarchar(15)
	declare @dWLWnewtarget		datetime
	declare @dWLWtarget			datetime
	declare @nWLWduration		numeric(8)
	declare @sWLAEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nWLAAct			numeric(8)
	declare @dWLANewstart		datetime
	declare @sWLANewtrade		nvarchar(15)

	declare c_event cursor local for  SELECT wlw_event, wlw_mrc,wlw_newtarget, wlw_target, wlw_duration
	FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders
	WHERE  wlw_sessionid   = @nSessionid

	open c_event
	fetch next from c_event into	@sWLWEvent, @sWLWMrc, @dWLWnewtarget, @dWLWtarget, @nWLWduration

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			IF @dWLWnewtarget <> @dWLWtarget 
				UPDATE r5events
				SET    evt_target = @dWLWnewtarget,
				evt_schedend = @dWLWnewtarget + @nWLWduration -1,
				evt_mpproj = N'-',
				evt_mpprojtype = null
				WHERE  evt_code = @sWLWEvent
			else
				UPDATE r5events
				SET    evt_mpproj = N'-',
				evt_mpprojtype = null
				WHERE  evt_code = @sWLWEvent

			fetch next from c_event into	@sWLWEvent, @sWLWMrc, @dWLWnewtarget, @dWLWtarget, @nWLWduration
		end
	close c_event
	deallocate c_event

	declare c_act cursor local for     SELECT a.wla_event, a.wla_act, a.wla_newstart,a.wla_newtrade
	FROM   r5tempworkloadactivities a
	WHERE  a.wla_sessionid = @nSessionid
	AND    ((a.wla_start <> a.wla_newstart) OR (a.wla_trade <> a.wla_newtrade)) 

	open c_act
	fetch next from c_act into @sWLAEvent , @nWLAAct , @dWLANewstart , @sWLANewtrade
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			UPDATE r5activities 
			SET    act_start = @dWLANewstart, act_trade = @sWLANewtrade
			WHERE  act_event = @sWLAEvent
			AND    act_act   = @nWLAAct

			fetch next from c_act into	@sWLAEvent , @nWLAAct , @dWLANewstart , @sWLANewtrade
		end
	close c_act
	deallocate c_act

	DELETE FROM r5tempworkloadactivities
	WHERE  wla_sessionid = @nSessionid

	DELETE FROM r5tempworkloadworkorders
	WHERE  wlw_sessionid = @nSessionid

	DELETE FROM r5tempworkloadparameters
	WHERE  wlp_sessionid = @nSessionid

	DELETE FROM r5tempworkload
	WHERE  twl_sessionid = @nSessionid

create procedure O7UPDKRF
	@pObject	nvarchar(30),
	@pObjectOrg	nvarchar(15)

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @vObject		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @vObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @vMrc			nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @vSupplier		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @vSupplierOrg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @vServiceCategory	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @vServiceCategoryOrg	nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @vServiceProblem	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @vServiceProblemOrg	nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @vMrcCheck		nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @vSupplierCheck		nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @vServiceCategoryCheck	nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @vServiceProblemCheck	nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @nReturn		int

	DECLARE c_objectsdm CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT sdm_object, sdm_object_org, sdm_mrc,
			sdm_supplier, sdm_supplier_org, sdm_servicecategory,
			sdm_servicecategory_org, sdm_serviceproblem, sdm_serviceproblem_org,
			sdm_mrc_check, sdm_supplier_check, sdm_servicecategory_check,
			sdm_serviceproblem_check
		FROM r5objectsdm
		WHERE sdm_object = @pObject
		AND sdm_object_org = @pObjectOrg

	OPEN c_objectsdm
	FETCH next FROM c_objectsdm INTO @vObject, @vObjectOrg, @vMrc,
					@vSupplier, @vSupplierOrg, @vServiceCategory,
					@vServiceCategoryOrg, @vServiceProblem, @vServiceProblemOrg,
					@vMrcCheck, @vSupplierCheck, @vServiceCategoryCheck,
					@vServiceProblemCheck
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INSKRF @vObject, @vObjectOrg, @vMrc,
						@vSupplier, @vSupplierOrg, @vServiceCategory,
						@vServiceCategoryOrg, @vServiceProblem, @vServiceProblemOrg,
						@vMrcCheck, @vSupplierCheck, @vServiceCategoryCheck,
						@vServiceProblemCheck
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		BEGIN
			CLOSE c_objectsdm
			DEALLOCATE c_objectsdm
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			RETURN
		END
		FETCH next FROM c_objectsdm INTO @vObject, @vObjectOrg, @vMrc,
						@vSupplier, @vSupplierOrg, @vServiceCategory,
						@vServiceCategoryOrg, @vServiceProblem, @vServiceProblemOrg,
						@vMrcCheck, @vSupplierCheck, @vServiceCategoryCheck,
						@vServiceProblemCheck
	END
	CLOSE c_objectsdm
	DEALLOCATE c_objectsdm

create procedure dbo.O7UPDTANKQTY   @sFuel      nvarchar(30),
                                    @sDepot     nvarchar(30),
                                    @sDepotorg  nvarchar(15),
                                    @sPump      nvarchar(30),
                                    @nIssueqty  numeric(24,6)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sBlended       nvarchar(1)
    declare @sFuel1         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFuel2         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFuel3         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFuel4         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFuel5         nvarchar(30)
    declare @nPerc1         numeric(6,3)
    declare @nPerc2         numeric(6,3)
    declare @nPerc3         numeric(6,3)
    declare @nPerc4         numeric(6,3)
    declare @nPerc5         numeric(6,3)
    declare @nBlends        int
    declare @nBlendsdone    int            
    declare @nQtydone       numeric(24,6)  

    declare @nReturn        int

    set @nBlendsdone = 0
    set @nQtydone = 0

    SELECT @sBlended = fue_blended,
           @sFuel1 = fue_blendfuel1, @nPerc1 = fue_blendperc1,
           @sFuel2 = fue_blendfuel2, @nPerc2 = fue_blendperc2,
           @sFuel3 = fue_blendfuel3, @nPerc3 = fue_blendperc3,
           @sFuel4 = fue_blendfuel4, @nPerc4 = fue_blendperc4,
           @sFuel5 = fue_blendfuel5, @nPerc5 = fue_blendperc5,
           @nBlends = CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                      CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                      CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                      CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                      CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    FROM   r5fuels
    WHERE  fue_code = @sFuel

    if @sBlended = N'-'
        begin
            set @nBlends = 1
            execute @nReturn = O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK @sFuel, @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty,
                                                       @sFuel, 100, @nBlends, @nBlendsdone OUTPUT, @nQtydone OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
        end
    else
        begin
            if @sFuel1 is not null
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK @sFuel, @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty,
                                                               @sFuel1, @nPerc1, @nBlends, @nBlendsdone OUTPUT, @nQtydone OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                end
            if @sFuel2 is not null
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK @sFuel, @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty,
                                                               @sFuel2, @nPerc2, @nBlends, @nBlendsdone OUTPUT, @nQtydone OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                end
            if @sFuel3 is not null
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK @sFuel, @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty,
                                                               @sFuel3, @nPerc3, @nBlends, @nBlendsdone OUTPUT, @nQtydone OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                end
            if @sFuel4 is not null
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK @sFuel, @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty,
                                                               @sFuel4, @nPerc4, @nBlends, @nBlendsdone OUTPUT, @nQtydone OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                end
            if @sFuel5 is not null
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK @sFuel, @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty,
                                                               @sFuel5, @nPerc5, @nBlends, @nBlendsdone OUTPUT, @nQtydone OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                end
        end

name: dbo.O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK

create procedure dbo.O7UPDTANKQTY_UPDATETANK    @sFuel          nvarchar(30),
                                                @sDepot         nvarchar(30),
                                                @sDepotorg      nvarchar(15),
                                                @sPump          nvarchar(30),
                                                @nIssueqty      numeric(24,6),
                                                @sCurfuel       nvarchar(30),
                                                @nCurperc       numeric(24,6),
                                                @nBlends        int,
                                                @nBlendsdone    int             OUTPUT,
                                                @nQtydone       numeric(24,6)   OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare @sTank          nvarchar(30)
    declare @nCurrentqty    numeric(24,6)

    set @nBlendsdone = @nBlendsdone + 1
    if @nBlendsdone < @nBlends
        begin
            set @nCurrentqty = round( @nIssueqty * @nCurperc / 100.0, 6)
            set @nQtydone = @nQtydone + @nCurrentqty
        end
    else
        set @nCurrentqty = @nIssueqty - @nQtydone

    select @sTank = tan_code
    FROM   r5tanks, r5tankpumps
    WHERE  tan_depot     = tpu_depot
    AND    tan_depot_org = tpu_depot_org
    AND    tan_code      = tpu_tank
    AND    tpu_depot     = @sDepot
    AND    tpu_depot_org = @sDepotorg
    AND    tpu_pump      = @sPump
    AND    tpu_active    = N'+'
    AND    tan_fuel      = @sCurfuel

    if @sTank is not null
        UPDATE r5tanks
        SET    tan_qty       = coalesce( tan_qty, 0 ) - @nCurrentqty
        WHERE  tan_depot     = @sDepot
        AND    tan_depot_org = @sDepotorg
        AND    tan_code      = @sTank

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPEVT1 
   @sObtype				nvarchar(4),
   @sObrtype			nvarchar(4),
   @sOstatus			nvarchar(4),
   @sOrstatus			nvarchar(4),
   @sNewostatus			nvarchar(4),
   @sNeworstatus		nvarchar(4),
   @sObcode				nvarchar(30),
   @sObcodeorg			nvarchar(15),
   @dWithdraw			datetime,
   @sChk				nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sObtype1					nvarchar(4)		/* r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE    Object type                    */
	declare @sObrtype1					nvarchar(4)		/* r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE  Object rtype                   */
	declare @sOstatus1					nvarchar(4)		/* r5objects.obj_status%TYPE   Object status                  */
	declare @sOrstatus1					nvarchar(4)		/* r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE  Object rstatus                 */
	declare @sNewostatus1				nvarchar(4)		/* r5objects.obj_status%TYPE   Object status that is changed  */
	declare @sNewerstatus				nvarchar(4)		/* r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE   Event  rstatus that is changed */
	declare @sNewestatus				nvarchar(4)		/* r5events.evt_status%TYPE    Event  status that is changed  */
	declare @sNeworstatus1				nvarchar(4)		/* r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE  Object rstatus that is changed */
	declare @sObcode1					nvarchar(30)		/* r5objects.obj_code%TYPE     Object code                    */
	declare @sObcodeorg1				nvarchar(15)		/* r5objects.obj_org%TYPE      Object organization            */
	declare @sRstatobj					nvarchar(4)		/* r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE Object statent                 */
	declare @sRtypeobj					nvarchar(4)		/* r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE Object typent                  */
	declare @sX							nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn					integer
BEGIN

	set @sChk				= N'0'
	set @sObtype1			= @sObtype
	set @sObrtype1			= @sObrtype
	set @sOstatus1			= @sOstatus
	set @sOrstatus1			= @sOrstatus
	set @sNewostatus1		= @sNewostatus
	set @sNeworstatus1		= @sNeworstatus
	set @sObcode1			= @sObcode
	set @sObcodeorg1		= @sObcodeorg
	set @sX					= NULL
   
	if ( @sObtype1     IS NULL AND @sObrtype1  IS NULL )
	OR ( @sOstatus1    IS NULL AND @sOrstatus1 IS NULL )
	OR ( @sNewostatus1 IS NULL AND @sNeworstatus1 IS NULL )
	OR @sObcode1          IS NULL  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = o7cksttp N'OBJ', @sRstatobj OUTPUT, @sRtypeobj OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'8'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype1 OUTPUT, @sObtype1 OUTPUT,@sRtypeobj, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sOrstatus1 OUTPUT, @sOstatus1 OUTPUT,@sRstatobj, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sNeworstatus1 OUTPUT, @sNewostatus1 OUTPUT,@sRstatobj, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'6'
			return
		end

	if @sObrtype1 <> N'C' AND( @sOrstatus1 IN ( N'C', N'E', N'F' ) AND @sNeworstatus1 > N'F' ) OR ( @sOrstatus1 > N'F' AND @sNeworstatus1 IN ( N'A',N'B',N'C',N'E',N'F' ) ) 
	begin
		if @sNeworstatus1 IN ( N'C', N'E', N'F' ) 
			set @sNewerstatus = N'B'
		ELSE
			set @sNewerstatus = N'A'
		
		set @sNewestatus = @sX

		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sNewerstatus OUTPUT, @sNewestatus OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		if @sChk <> N'0' 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'7'
				return
			end

		UPDATE r5events
		SET evt_target = ( SELECT CASE @sNeworstatus1 WHEN N'C' THEN NULL WHEN N'E' THEN NULL WHEN N'F' THEN NULL ELSE evt_due + ( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ),  N'DD') - @dWithdraw ) END ),
			evt_due =  ( SELECT CASE @sNeworstatus1 WHEN N'C' THEN NULL WHEN N'E' THEN NULL WHEN N'F' THEN NULL ELSE evt_due + ( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ),  N'DD') - @dWithdraw ) END ) ,
			evt_rstatus = @sNewerstatus, 
			evt_status = @sNewestatus 
		WHERE evt_ppm IS NOT NULL
		AND   evt_obrtype    = @sObrtype1
		AND   evt_rstatus    < N'C'
		AND   evt_object     = @sObcode1
		AND   evt_object_org = @sObcodeorg1
	end

END

create PROCEDURE O7UPEVT3
   @nLast            numeric(24,6),
   @nReading        numeric(24,6),
   @sObject          nvarchar(30),
   @sObjectorg       nvarchar(15),
   @sMetuom          nvarchar(30),

	declare @sErtype1					nvarchar(4)  --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Event entity type      */

	declare @sPpm						nvarchar(100)

	declare @nCountit					int
	declare @sCheckresult				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPppmnested				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nEvtppmrev					numeric(4)
	declare @sEvtppm					nvarchar(20)
	declare @nEvtfreq					numeric(8)
	declare @sEvtperioduom				nvarchar(10)
	declare @sEvtobject					nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtobjectorg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtobtype					nvarchar(4)
	declare @dEvttarget					DATETIME
	declare @nPpmmeter					numeric(24,6)
	declare @sEvtmetuom					nvarchar(30)
	declare @nEvtmeterdue				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPpmmeter2					numeric(24,6)
	declare @sEvtmetuom2				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nEvtmeterdue2				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPpmnestedtolmin			numeric(5)
	declare @nPpmnestedtolmax			numeric(5)
	declare @nPpmnestedtolmetmin		numeric(5)
	declare @nPpmnestedtolmetmax		numeric(5)
	declare @nPpmnestedtolmet2min		numeric(5)
	declare @nPpmnestedtolmet2max		numeric(5)
	declare @sEvtOrg					nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPPMRev					nvarchar(25)
	declare @dTempDate					datetime
	declare @nReturn			int

	set @sChk     = N'0'
	if @nReading   IS NULL
	OR @nLast      IS NULL
	OR @sObject    IS NULL
	OR @sObjectorg IS NULL
	OR @sMetuom  IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'EVNT', @sErstat1 OUTPUT, @sErtype1 OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstatus OUTPUT, N'B', N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1



   /* Update job user status and rstatus to @sStatus and crstatus respectively */
	DECLARE cEvent CURSOR local STATIC FOR SELECT e.evt_code, e.evt_org, e.evt_ppm + N'#' + cast(e.evt_ppmrev as nvarchar(4)),
											e.evt_freq, e.evt_perioduom, e.evt_object,
											e.evt_object_org, e.evt_obtype, e.evt_target,
											e.evt_metuom, e.evt_meterdue, e.evt_metuom2,
											e.evt_meterdue2, e.evt_ppm, e.evt_ppmrev
										FROM    r5events e
										WHERE  ( ( e.evt_metuom     = @sMetuom AND
											dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( e.evt_meterdue, coalesce( e.evt_genwinbegval, e.evt_meterdue ) ) <= @nReading ) OR
											( e.evt_metuom2    = @sMetuom AND
											dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( e.evt_meterdue2, coalesce( e.evt_genwinbegval2, e.evt_meterdue2 ) ) <= @nReading ) )
											AND    e.evt_object     = @sObject
											AND    e.evt_object_org = @sObjectorg
											AND    e.evt_rstatus    = N'A'
										ORDER BY coalesce( e.evt_meterinterval, 0 ) DESC,
											coalesce( e.evt_meterinterval2, 0 ) DESC
	OPEN cEvent
	FETCH NEXT FROM cEvent INTO @sEvtCode, @sEvtOrg, @sPPMRev, @nEvtfreq, @sEvtperioduom, @sEvtobject, @sEvtobjectorg, @sEvtobtype, @dEvttarget, 
								@sEvtmetuom, @nEvtmeterdue, @sEvtmetuom2, @nEvtmeterdue2, @sEvtppm, @nEvtppmrev

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			if @sEvtppm IS NOT NULL
				/* Get PPM data.*/
				SELECT @sPppmnested = p.ppm_nested, 
					@nPpmmeter = p.ppm_meter, 
					@nPpmmeter2 = p.ppm_meter2, 
					@nPpmnestedtolmin = p.ppm_nestedtolmin, 
					@nPpmnestedtolmax = p.ppm_nestedtolmax,
					@nPpmnestedtolmetmin = p.ppm_nestedtolmetmin, 
					@nPpmnestedtolmetmax = p.ppm_nestedtolmetmax,
					@nPpmnestedtolmet2min = p.ppm_nestedtolmet2min, 
					@nPpmnestedtolmet2max = p.ppm_nestedtolmet2max
				FROM   r5ppms p
				WHERE  p.ppm_code = @sEvtppm
				AND    p.ppm_revision = @nEvtppmrev

			set @nCountit = 0
			if @sPppmnested IS NOT NULL 
					execute @nReturn = O7CKNEST @sPppmnested, @nEvtfreq, @sEvtperioduom, @sEvtobject, @sEvtobjectorg, @sEvtobtype, @dEvttarget, @nPpmmeter, 
												@sEvtmetuom, @nEvtmeterdue, @nPpmmeter2, @sEvtmetuom2, @nEvtmeterdue2, @nPpmnestedtolmin, @nPpmnestedtolmax, 
												@nPpmnestedtolmetmin, @nPpmnestedtolmetmax, @nPpmnestedtolmet2min, @nPpmnestedtolmet2max, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							CLOSE cEvent
							DEALLOCATE cEvent
							return -1
						end

					if @nCountit > 0 
						UPDATE r5events
						SET		evt_rstatus = N'B',
								evt_status  = @sUstatus
						WHERE  evt_code    = @sEvtCode
					else
                        begin
                            if @nCountit < 0
                                begin
                                    execute @nReturn = o7upevt8 @sEvtCode
								    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									    begin
										    close cEvent
										    deallocate cEvent
										    return -1
									    end
                                end
					        ELSE
								begin
								/* Add a new installation parameter N'WORKWOST', get the new job user status */
								EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getorgoption @sStatus OUTPUT, N'WORKWOST', @sEvtOrg, @sChk OUTPUT
								IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
									RETURN -1

								if @sChk > N'0' 
									begin
										set @sChk = N'5'
										RETURN
									end

								if @sStatus is null 
									set @sRstatus = 'R'
								else
									set @sRstatus = NULL

								execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sErstat1, @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									return -1

								if @sChk > N'0' 
									begin
										set @sChk = N'5'
										RETURN
									end

									UPDATE r5events
									SET    evt_rstatus  = @sRstatus,
									evt_status   = @sStatus,
									evt_target   = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ), N'DD' ),
									evt_schedend = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ), N'DD' ) + evt_duration - 1,
									evt_reported = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ), N'DD'  ),
									evt_updatecount = evt_updatecount + 1 /* Needed for mail trigger could fire before POSUPD_EVT */
									WHERE  evt_code     = @sEvtCode

									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sEvtOrg 
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												CLOSE cEvent
												DEALLOCATE cEvent
												return -1
											end
									set @dTempDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' )

									execute @nReturn = O7UPACT6 @sEvtCode, NULL, @dTempDate, @sPPMRev, null, @sChk 
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											CLOSE cEvent
											DEALLOCATE cEvent
											return -1
										end
								end
						end

			FETCH NEXT FROM cEvent INTO @sEvtCode, @sEvtOrg, @sPPMRev, @nEvtfreq, @sEvtperioduom, @sEvtobject, @sEvtobjectorg, @sEvtobtype, @dEvttarget, 
										@sEvtmetuom, @nEvtmeterdue, @sEvtmetuom2, @nEvtmeterdue2, @sEvtppm, @nEvtppmrev
		END
	CLOSE cEvent
	DEALLOCATE cEvent

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPEVT4
   @nLast            integer,
   @nReading         numeric(24,6),
   @sObject          nvarchar(30),
   @sObjectorg       nvarchar(15),
   @sMetuom          nvarchar(30),
   @sStatus          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sRstatus         nvarchar(4)	
	declare @sErstat1         nvarchar(4)	
	declare @sErtype1         nvarchar(4)	
	declare @nReturn			integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	IF @nReading   IS NULL
	OR @nLast      IS NULL
	OR @sMetuom    IS NULL
	OR @sObject    IS NULL
	OR @sObjectorg IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'EVNT', @sErstat1 OUTPUT, @sErtype1 OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sRstatus = N'B'
	set @sStatus   = NULL 

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sErstat1, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		return -1

	IF @sChk > N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end
   /* First Meter */
   UPDATE r5events
   SET    evt_rstatus = N'B',
          evt_status  = @sStatus
   WHERE  evt_code IN (
          SELECT e1.evt_code
          FROM   r5events       e1,
                 r5events       e2,
                 r5ppms         p1,
                 r5ppms         p2
          WHERE  e1.evt_ppm        = p1.ppm_code
          AND    e1.evt_ppmrev     = p1.ppm_revision
          AND    e2.evt_ppm        = p2.ppm_code
          AND    e2.evt_ppmrev     = p2.ppm_revision
          AND    p1.ppm_nested     = p2.ppm_nested
          AND  ( ( p2.ppm_meter      > p1.ppm_meter  AND
                   e1.evt_metuom     = @sMetuom       AND
                   e2.evt_metuom     = @sMetuom       AND
                   e1.evt_meterdue  <= @nReading ) OR
                 ( p2.ppm_meter2     > p1.ppm_meter2 AND
                   e1.evt_metuom2    = @sMetuom       AND
                   e2.evt_metuom2    = @sMetuom       AND
                   e1.evt_meterdue2 <= @nReading ) )
          AND    e1.evt_object     = @sObject
          AND    e1.evt_object_org = @sObjectorg
          AND    e2.evt_object     = @sObject
          AND    e2.evt_object_org = @sObjectorg
          AND    e2.evt_rstatus    = N'R'
          AND    e1.evt_rstatus    = N'A' )
	AND     evt_rstatus = N'A'  
END

create PROCEDURE O7UPEVT5 
   @sEvent           nvarchar(30),
   @sRstatus         nvarchar(4),
   @sStatus          nvarchar(4),
   @sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as   
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dTempdate				datetime
	declare @sEventOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEventCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventPPM				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventIsstype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEventPackage			nvarchar(24)
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @nCountit				int
	declare @dTarget				datetime
	declare @sPpmstat				nvarchar(50)
	declare @sNewcode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sNewstatus				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvt2Code				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvt2Route				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nEvt2Routerev			numeric(4)
	declare @sEvt2Nestedpmstatus	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvt2Nested			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nEvt2Freq				numeric(8)
	declare @sEvt2Perioduom			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sEvt2Object			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvt2Object_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvt2Obtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvt2Obrtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvt2Rtype				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvt2Ppm				nvarchar(20)
	declare @dEvt2Target			datetime
	declare @sEvt2Project			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sEvt2Projbud			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sEvt2Mrc				nvarchar(15)
	declare @nEvt2Meter				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sEvt2Metuom			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nEvt2Meterdue			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nEvt2Meter2			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sEvt2Metuom2			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nEvt2Meterdue2			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nEvt2Nestedtolmin		numeric(5)
	declare @nEvt2Nestedtolmax		numeric(5)
	declare @nEvt2Nestedtolmetmin	numeric(5)
	declare @nEvt2Nestedtolmetmax	numeric(5)
	declare @nEvt2Nestedtolmet2min	numeric(5)
	declare @nEvt2Nestedtolmet2max	numeric(5)

   	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	/* Mandatory parameter missing  */
	IF @sEvent   IS NULL   OR @sRstatus IS NULL    OR @sStatus  IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPpmstat OUTPUT, N'PPMSTAT', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	/* Update the status of all child work order to closed ('C') */
	declare @tEventItmes table(	 EventCode nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
	insert into @tEventItmes  execute o7upevt5_event_hierarchy  @sEvent

	declare cEvent cursor local for select evt_org, evt_code, evt_ppm, evt_isstype, evt_package from r5events where evt_code in (select  EventCode from @tEventItmes )

	OPEN cEvent
	FETCH NEXT FROM cEvent INTO @sEventOrg, @sEventCode, @sEventPPM, @sEventIsstype, @sEventPackage
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sEventOrg 
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						CLOSE cEvent
						DEALLOCATE cEvent
						RETURN -1
					end

				UPDATE r5events
				SET    evt_rstatus   = @sRstatus,
				       evt_status    = @sStatus,
				       evt_completed = (select coalesce( e2.evt_completed, @dTempdate ) from r5events e2 where e2.evt_code = @sEventCode )
				where evt_code = @sEventCode

				IF @sEventPPM IS NOT NULL AND @sEventIsstype <> 'D' AND @sEventPackage IS NULL
					begin
						/* Create new event in case of a PM ( not for duplicates or WPs ). */
						execute @nReturn = O7CREVT2 @sEventCode, null, null, null, @sPpmstat, @sNewcode OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							begin
								close cEvent
								deallocate cEvent
								return -1
							end
						if @sNewcode is not null
							begin
								declare c_evt2 cursor local for SELECT  evt_code, evt_route, evt_routerev, p.ppm_nestedpmstatus, p.ppm_nested, e.evt_freq,
								e.evt_perioduom, e.evt_object, e.evt_object_org, e.evt_obtype, e.evt_obrtype, e.evt_rtype, e.evt_ppm, e.evt_target,
								e.evt_project, e.evt_projbud, e.evt_mrc, p.ppm_meter, e.evt_metuom, e.evt_meterdue, p.ppm_meter2, e.evt_metuom2,
								e.evt_meterdue2, p.ppm_nestedtolmin, p.ppm_nestedtolmax, p.ppm_nestedtolmetmin, p.ppm_nestedtolmetmax, p.ppm_nestedtolmet2min, p.ppm_nestedtolmet2max
								FROM  r5ppms p, r5events e
								WHERE e.evt_ppm    = p.ppm_code
								AND   e.evt_ppmrev = p.ppm_revision
								AND   e.evt_code   = @sNewcode

								open c_evt2
								fetch next from c_evt2 into @sEvt2Code, @sEvt2Route, @nEvt2Routerev, @sEvt2Nestedpmstatus, @sEvt2Nested, @nEvt2Freq,
								@sEvt2Perioduom, @sEvt2Object, @sEvt2Object_org, @sEvt2Obtype, @sEvt2Obrtype, @sEvt2Rtype, @sEvt2Ppm, @dEvt2Target,   
								@sEvt2Project, @sEvt2Projbud, @sEvt2Mrc, @nEvt2Meter, @sEvt2Metuom, @nEvt2Meterdue, @nEvt2Meter2, @sEvt2Metuom2,  
								@nEvt2Meterdue2, @nEvt2Nestedtolmin, @nEvt2Nestedtolmax, @nEvt2Nestedtolmetmin, @nEvt2Nestedtolmetmax, @nEvt2Nestedtolmet2min, @nEvt2Nestedtolmet2max
								while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
									begin
										execute @nReturn = O7CKNEST @sEvt2Nested, @nEvt2Freq, @sEvt2Perioduom, @sEvt2Object, @sEvt2Object_org, @sEvt2Obtype, @dEvt2Target, @nEvt2Meter,
											@sEvt2Metuom, @nEvt2Meterdue, @nEvt2Meter2, @sEvt2Metuom2, @nEvt2Meterdue2, @nEvt2Nestedtolmin, @nEvt2Nestedtolmax, @nEvt2Nestedtolmetmin,
											@nEvt2Nestedtolmetmax,  @nEvt2Nestedtolmet2min, @nEvt2Nestedtolmet2max, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_evt2
												deallocate c_evt2
												close cEvent
												deallocate cEvent
												return -1
											end

										if @nCountit > 0 AND @sPpmstat = N'R'
											begin
												execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sNewstatus OUTPUT, N'B', N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
												if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
													begin
														close c_evt2
														deallocate c_evt2
														close cEvent
														deallocate cEvent
														return -1
													end
												UPDATE  r5events
												SET     evt_rstatus = 'B',
												        evt_status  = @sNewstatus
												WHERE   evt_code    = @sNewcode
											end
										else
											begin
												if @nCountit < 0  and @sPpmstat = N'R'
													begin
														execute @nReturn = o7upevt8 @sNewcode
														if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
															begin
																close c_evt2
																deallocate c_evt2
																close c_event
																deallocate c_event
																return -1
															end
													end                      
												else
													begin
														SELECT @dTarget = evt_target
														FROM   r5events
														WHERE  evt_code = @sNewcode

														if @sPpmstat = N'R'
															begin
																execute @nReturn = O7CREOB1 @sNewcode, @sEvt2Rtype, @sEvt2Object, @sEvt2Object_org, @sEvt2Obtype OUTPUT, @sEvt2Obrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
																if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
																	begin
																		close c_evt2
																		deallocate c_evt2
																		close c_event
																		deallocate c_event
																		return -1
																	end
															end
													end
											end
										execute @nReturn = O7CRACT1 @sNewcode, @sEvt2Ppm, null, null, null, 8, @dTarget, @sPpmstat, null, null, @sEvt2Project, @sEvt2Projbud, @sEvt2Mrc, @sChk OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_evt2
												deallocate c_evt2
												close c_event
												deallocate c_event
												return -1
											end

										fetch next from c_evt2 into @sEvt2Code, @sEvt2Route, @nEvt2Routerev, @sEvt2Nestedpmstatus, @sEvt2Nested, @nEvt2Freq,
										@sEvt2Perioduom, @sEvt2Object, @sEvt2Object_org, @sEvt2Obtype, @sEvt2Obrtype, @sEvt2Rtype, @sEvt2Ppm, @dEvt2Target,   
										@sEvt2Project, @sEvt2Projbud, @sEvt2Mrc, @nEvt2Meter, @sEvt2Metuom, @nEvt2Meterdue, @nEvt2Meter2, @sEvt2Metuom2,  
										@nEvt2Meterdue2, @nEvt2Nestedtolmin, @nEvt2Nestedtolmax, @nEvt2Nestedt

CREATE PROCEDURE o7upevt5_event_hierarchy @sCpar2 nvarchar(30)

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @nCurrentID		int
	DECLARE @sEventCode		nvarchar(30)
		
	CREATE TABLE #tRootItmes ( EventCode nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
	CREATE TABLE #tStack( EventCode nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO #tStack 
		SELECT  evt_code, 1
		FROM    r5events
		WHERE   evt_rstatus <> N'C'
		AND     evt_depend = N'+' 
		AND	evt_parent = @sCpar2

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sEventCode = EventCode from #tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into #tRootItmes  values ( @sEventCode)
					delete from #tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND EventCode = @sEventCode
					insert into #tStack select evt_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events 
										 where evt_parent = @sEventCode 
										 and   evt_rstatus <> N'C' and     evt_depend = N'+' 
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	DROP TABLE #tStack
	SELECT * FROM #tRootItmes

create PROCEDURE O7UPEVT6 (@sEvent    nvarchar(30)) 
  
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPpm				nvarchar(20) --r5ppms.ppm_code%TYPE
	declare @sRoute				nvarchar(20) --r5routes.rou_code%TYPE
	declare @sRevision			numeric(4)
	declare @nAct				numeric(8)
	declare @sTask				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sMatlist			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare	@sDeforg			nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRouteRevision			numeric(4)
	declare @nPPMRevision			numeric(4)
	declare @nMatlRevision			numeric(4)
	declare @nTaskRevision			numeric(4)

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'PMRVCTRL', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF COALESCE( UPPER( @sDeforg ), N'-' ) NOT IN ( N'+', N'ON', N'YES', N'Y' ) 
		/* PM revision control not installed, no action required. */
		RETURN

	SELECT @sPpm = evt_ppm,
	       @sRoute = evt_route,
	       @nPPMRevision = evt_ppmrev,
	       @nRouteRevision = evt_routerev
	FROM   r5events
	WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent

	IF @sPpm IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			/* Assign current revision of PPM.*/
			set @sRevision = null

			SELECT @sRevision = ppm_revision
			FROM   r5ppms
			WHERE  ppm_code = @sPpm
			AND    ppm_revrstatus = N'A'

			
			IF @sRevision <> @nPPMRevision
				UPDATE r5events
				SET    evt_ppmrev = @sRevision
				WHERE  evt_code   = @sEvent
		end

	IF @sRoute IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			/* Assign current revision of @sRoute. */
			set @sRevision = null

			SELECT @sRevision = rou_revision
			FROM   r5routes
			WHERE  rou_code = @sRoute
			AND    rou_revrstatus = N'A'

			IF @sRevision <> @nRouteRevision
				UPDATE r5events
				SET    evt_routerev = @sRevision
				WHERE  evt_code     = @sEvent
		end

   	DECLARE cAct CURSOR local FOR SELECT act_act, act_task, act_matlist,act_matlrev, act_taskrev
											FROM   r5activities
											WHERE  act_event = @sEvent

	OPEN cAct
	FETCH NEXT FROM cAct INTO @nAct, @sTask, @sMatlist,@nMatlRevision,@nTaskRevision
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @sTask IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					/* Assign current revision of task. */
					set @sRevision = null

					SELECT @sRevision = tsk_revision
					FROM   r5tasks
					WHERE  tsk_code = @sTask
					AND    tsk_revrstatus = N'A'

					IF @sRevision <> @nTaskRevision
						UPDATE r5activities
						SET    act_taskrev = @sRevision
						WHERE  act_event   = @sEvent
						AND    act_act     = @nAct
				end

		 IF @sMatlist IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				/* Assign current revision of material list. */
				set @sRevision = null

				SELECT @sRevision = mtl_revision
				FROM   r5matlists
				WHERE  mtl_code = @sMatlist
				AND    mtl_revrstatus = N'A'

				IF @sRevision <> @nMatlRevision
				   UPDATE r5activities
				   SET    act_matlrev = @sRevision
				   WHERE  act_event   = @sEvent
				   AND    act_act     = @nAct
			 end

			FETCH NEXT FROM cAct INTO @nAct, @sTask, @sMatlist,@nMatlRevision,@nTaskRevision
		END
	CLOSE cAct
	DEALLOCATE cAct

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPEVT7 
    @sObject     nvarchar(30),
    @sObjectorg  nvarchar(15),
    @nFreq       numeric(8),
    @sPerioduom  nvarchar(10),
    @sNested     nvarchar(20),
    @nMeter      numeric(24,6),
    @nMetlast    numeric(24,6),
    @nMetmax     numeric(24,6),
    @nMeter2     numeric(24,6),
    @nMetlast2   numeric(24,6),
    @nMetmax2    numeric(24,6),
    @dCompleted  datetime 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare  @sCheckresult     nvarchar(5)
    declare  @sNewstatus       nvarchar(4)	/* r5events.evt_status%TYPE */
    declare  @sNewrstatus      nvarchar(200)	/* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE  */
    declare  @dDdue            datetime
    declare  @dDdormstart      datetime
    declare  @dDdormend        datetime
	declare  @nReturn		   int
	declare	 @dTempDate		   datetime
    declare  @sPmcrpast        nvarchar(200)
    declare  @nCountit         int
    declare  @nMetdue          numeric(24,6)
    declare  @nMetdue2         numeric(24,6)
	declare  @sPmnest		   nvarchar(200)	
	declare  @sNestd		   nvarchar(1)	
	declare  @sNestm1		   nvarchar(1)	
	declare  @sNestm2		   nvarchar(1)	

	/* declare cursor variable */
	declare 	@sEvt_code 			nvarchar(30)
	declare		@dEvt_due			datetime
	declare		@nEvt_freq			numeric(8,0)
	declare		@sEvt_perioduom		nvarchar(10)
	declare		@sEvt_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare		@nEvt_meterdue		numeric(24,6)
	declare		@nEvt_meterdue2		numeric(24,6)
	declare		@sEvt_isstype		nvarchar(1)
	declare		@dPpo_dormstart		datetime
	declare		@dPpo_dormend		datetime
	declare		@sPpo_dormreuse		nvarchar(1)
	declare		@nPpo_sqlidentity	int
	declare		@sEvt_rstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare		@sEvtppm			nvarchar(20)
	declare		@nEvtppmrev			numeric(4)
    declare     @sEvtObtype         nvarchar(4)
    declare     @dEvtTarget         datetime
    declare     @nEvtPpmmeter       numeric(24,6)
    declare     @nEvtPpmmeter2      numeric(24,6)
    declare     @sEvtMetuom         nvarchar(30)
    declare     @sEvtMetuom2        nvarchar(30)
    declare     @nEvtNestedtolmin   numeric(5)
    declare     @nEvtNestedtolmax   numeric(5)
    declare     @nEvtNestedtolmetmin    numeric(5)
    declare     @nEvtNestedtolmetmax    numeric(5)
    declare     @nEvtNestedtolmet2min   numeric(5)
    declare     @nEvtNestedtolmet2max   numeric(5)
    declare     @nEvtGenwinbegval       numeric(24,6)
    declare     @nEvtGenwinbegval2      numeric(24,6)

   /* If any PPMS are in the same group as this PPM, but */
   /* with a lower frequency and the status has been set */
   /* to 'A' or 'B' then update these jobs.              */
   
    SELECT @sNewrstatus = isnull( ins_desc, N'A' )
    FROM   r5install
    WHERE  ins_code = N'PPMSTAT'
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
		set @sNewrstatus = N'A'

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sNewstatus OUTPUT, @sNewrstatus, N'EVST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	
    set @sPmcrpast = coalesce( upper( dbo.o7dflt2( N'PMCRPAST' )), N'NO')
	set @sPmnest = dbo.o7dflt2( N'PMNEST' )

	DECLARE cEvt CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT e.evt_code, e.evt_due, e.evt_freq, e.evt_perioduom, e.evt_org,
           e.evt_meterdue, e.evt_meterdue2, e.evt_isstype, o.ppo_dormstart,
           o.ppo_dormend, o.ppo_dormreuse, o.ppo_sqlidentity, e.evt_rstatus, e.evt_ppm,
           e.evt_ppmrev, e.evt_obtype, e.evt_target, p.ppm_meter, p.ppm_meter2,
           e.evt_metuom, e.evt_metuom2, p.ppm_nestedtolmin, p.ppm_nestedtolmax,
           p.ppm_nestedtolmetmin, p.ppm_nestedtolmetmax,
           p.ppm_nestedtolmet2min, p.ppm_nestedtolmet2max,
           e.evt_genwinbegval, e.evt_genwinbegval2
    FROM   r5ppmobjects o,
           r5events e, 
           r5ppms p
    WHERE  o.ppo_pk       = e.evt_ppopk
    AND    o.ppo_revision = e.evt_ppmrev
    AND    p.ppm_code     = e.evt_ppm
    AND    p.ppm_revision = e.evt_ppmrev
    AND    p.ppm_nested   = @sNested
	AND    e.evt_rstatus IN ( 'B', CASE UPPER(@sPmnest) WHEN N'NO' THEN N'B' ELSE N'A' END )
    AND    (    dbo.o7gtfreq( e.evt_freq, e.evt_perioduom, getdate() ) < dbo.o7gtfreq( @nFreq, @sPerioduom, getdate() )
             OR e.evt_meterinterval  < @nMeter 
             OR e.evt_meterinterval2 < @nMeter2 )
    AND    e.evt_object_org = @sObjectorg
    AND    e.evt_object     = @sObject
    AND    e.evt_isstype    <> N'D'
	OPEN cEvt
	FETCH NEXT FROM cEvt INTO @sEvt_code, @dEvt_due, @nEvt_freq, @sEvt_perioduom, @sEvt_org, @nEvt_meterdue, @nEvt_meterdue2,
							  @sEvt_isstype, @dPpo_dormstart, @dPpo_dormend, @sPpo_dormreuse, @nPpo_sqlidentity,
							  @sEvt_rstatus, @sEvtppm, @nEvtppmrev, @sEvtObtype, @dEvtTarget, @nEvtPpmmeter, 
                              @nEvtPpmmeter2, @sEvtMetuom, @sEvtMetuom2, @nEvtNestedtolmin, @nEvtNestedtolmax,
                              @nEvtNestedtolmetmin, @nEvtNestedtolmetmax, @nEvtNestedtolmet2min, @nEvtNestedtolmet2max,
                              @nEvtGenwinbegval, @nEvtGenwinbegval2
   
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
	    set @dDdue = @dEvt_due
        set @nMetdue = @nEvt_meterdue
        set @nMetdue2 = @nEvt_meterdue2
        set @sNestd = N'-'
        set @sNestm1 = N'-'
        set @sNestm2 = N'-'
        if @sEvt_isstype = N'V' or @sEvt_rstatus = N'B'
            begin
                set @sNestd  = N'+'
                set @sNestm1 = N'+'
                set @sNestm2 = N'+'
            end
        else if @sEvt_isstype = N'F'
            begin
                set @sCheckresult = N'WHICH'
                execute @nReturn = o7cknest @sNested, @nEvt_freq, @sEvt_perioduom, @sObject, 
                                            @sObjectorg, @sEvtObtype, @dEvtTarget, @nEvtPpmmeter, 
                                            @sEvtMetuom, @nEvt_meterdue, @nEvtPpmmeter2, @sEvtMetuom2, 
                                            @nEvt_meterdue2, @nEvtNestedtolmin, @nEvtNestedtolmax,
                                            @nEvtNestedtolmetmin, @nEvtNestedtolmetmax, 
                                            @nEvtNestedtolmet2min, @nEvtNestedtolmet2max,
                                            @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                    begin
	                    close cEvt
	                    deallocate cEvt
            		    return -1
                    end

                /* Split checkresult in three separate variables. */
                set @sNestd  = substring( @sCheckresult, 1, 1 )  /* Does the date  due   cause a bypass? */
                set @sNestm1 = substring( @sCheckresult, 2, 1 )  /* Does the meter due 1 cause a bypass? */
                set @sNestm2 = substring( @sCheckresult, 3, 1 )  /* Does the meter due 2 cause a bypass? */
            end

        if @nCountit <> 0 or @sEvt_isstype = N'V' or @sEvt_rstatus = N'B'
          begin     
            if @sNestd = N'+' and (@dDdue <= isnull ( @dCompleted, getdate() ) or @sEvt_rstatus = N'B')
               begin
                   /* Set new due date. */
                   IF @sEvt_isstype = N'F'
                      set @dDdue = @dDdue + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvt_freq, @sEvt_perioduom, @dDdue )
                   ELSE
                      set @dDdue = @dCompleted + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvt_freq, @sEvt_perioduom, @dCompleted )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPEVT8 @sEvent nvarchar(30)
AS
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
    declare @sNewstatus     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sNewrstatus    nvarchar(4)
    declare @dDue           datetime
    declare @dDormstart     datetime
    declare @dDormend       datetime
    declare @sChk           nvarchar(4)
    declare @dCompleted     datetime
    declare @nMetlast2      numeric(24,6)
    declare @nMetlast       numeric(24,6)

    declare @sEvtCode       nvarchar(30)
    declare @dEvtDue        datetime
    declare @nEvtFreq       numeric(8)
    declare @sEvtPerioduom  nvarchar(10)
    declare @sEvtOrg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @nEvtMeterdue   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nEvtMeterdue2  numeric(24,6)
    declare @sEvtIsstype    nvarchar(1)
    declare @dEvtDormstart  datetime
    declare @dEvtDormend    datetime
    declare @sEvtDormreuse  nvarchar(1)
    declare @nEvtIdentity   numeric(38)
    declare @sEvtRstatus    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEvtPpm        nvarchar(20)
    declare @nEvtPpmrev     numeric(4)
    declare @sEvtObject     nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtObject_org nvarchar(15)
    declare @sEvtNested     nvarchar(20)
    declare @sEvtMetuom     nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtMetuom2    nvarchar(30)
    declare @nEvtPpmmeter   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nEvtPpmmeter2  numeric(24,6)
    declare @nEvtInterval   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nEvtInterval2  numeric(24,6)    

    declare @sPmcrpast      nvarchar(200)
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @nMetdue        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nMetdue2       numeric(24,6)

    set @sNewrstatus = N'A'
    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sNewstatus OUTPUT, @sNewrstatus, N'EVST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @sPmcrpast = coalesce( upper( dbo.o7dflt2( N'PMCRPAST' )), N'NO')

    declare c_evt cursor local for SELECT  e.evt_code, e.evt_due, e.evt_freq, e.evt_perioduom, e.evt_org,
                                           e.evt_meterdue, e.evt_meterdue2, e.evt_isstype, o.ppo_dormstart,
                                           o.ppo_dormend, o.ppo_dormreuse, o.ppo_sqlidentity, e.evt_rstatus, e.evt_ppm, 
                                           e.evt_ppmrev, e.evt_object, e.evt_object_org, p.ppm_nested,
                                           e.evt_metuom, e.evt_metuom2, p.ppm_meter, p.ppm_meter2,
                                           e.evt_meterinterval, e.evt_meterinterval2
                                    FROM   r5ppmobjects o,
                                           r5ppms p,
                                           r5events e
                                    WHERE  o.ppo_pk       = e.evt_ppopk
                                    AND    o.ppo_revision = e.evt_ppmrev
                                    AND    e.evt_ppm      = p.ppm_code
                                    AND    e.evt_ppmrev   = p.ppm_revision
                                    AND    e.evt_code     = @sEvent
    open c_evt
    fetch next from c_evt into  @sEvtCode, @dEvtDue, @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, @sEvtOrg, 
                                @nEvtMeterdue, @nEvtMeterdue2, @sEvtIsstype, @dEvtDormstart, @dEvtDormend, 
                                @sEvtDormreuse, @nEvtIdentity, @sEvtRstatus, @sEvtPpm, @nEvtPpmrev, 
                                @sEvtObject, @sEvtObject_org, @sEvtNested, @sEvtMetuom, @sEvtMetuom2, 
                                @nEvtPpmmeter, @nEvtPpmmeter2, @nEvtInterval, @nEvtInterval2
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if @dEvtDue is not null
                begin
                    set @dDue = @dEvtDue

                    SELECT @dCompleted = max (evt_completed)
                    FROM   r5events,
                           r5ppms
                    WHERE  evt_ppm        = ppm_code
                    AND    evt_ppmrev     = ppm_revision
                    AND    evt_rstatus    = N'C'
                    AND    ppm_nested     = @sEvtNested
                    AND    dbo.o7gtfreq( evt_freq, evt_perioduom, evt_target ) > 
                           dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, evt_target )
                    AND    evt_object     = @sEvtObject
                    AND    evt_object_org = @sEvtObject_org

                    if @sEvtIsstype = N'F'
                        set @dDue = @dDue + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, @dDue )
                    else
                        set @dDue = @dCompleted + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, @dCompleted )

                    if @dDue <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sEvtOrg ), N'DD' )
                        begin
                            if @sEvtIsstype = N'F'
                                begin
                                    -- TNT: chk parameter is ignored which is why I used o7dflt2 instead in call below
                                    if coalesce( upper( dbo.o7dflt2( N'PMCRPAST') ), N'NO' ) in ( '-', 'OFF', 'NO', 'N' )  
                                        begin
                                            while @dDue <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sEvtOrg ), N'DD' )
                                                set @dDue = @dDue + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, @dDue )
                                        end
                                end
                            else
                                set @dDue = @dCompleted + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, @dDue )
                        end

                    set @dDormstart = @dEvtDormstart
                    set @dDormend   = @dEvtDormend

                    if @sEvtDormreuse = N'+'
                        begin
                            while @dDormend < @dDue
                                begin
                                    set @dDormstart = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDormstart, 12 )
                                    set @dDormend   = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDormend, 12 )
                                end
                        end

                    if @dDue between @dDormstart and @dDormend
                        begin
                            if @sEvtIsstype = N'F'
                                begin
                                    while @dDue <= @dDormend
                                        set @dDue = @dDue + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtFreq, @sEvtPerioduom, @dDue )
                                end
                            else
                                set @dDue = @dDormend + 1
                        end
                end

            if @sEvtMetuom is not null
                set @nMetdue = @nEvtMeterdue
                begin
                    SELECT @nMetlast = coalesce( oud_totalusage, 0 )
                    FROM   r5objusagedefs
                    WHERE  oud_object_org = @sEvtObject_org
                    AND    oud_object     = @sEvtObject
                    AND    oud_uom        = @sEvtMetuom

                    if @sEvtIsstype = N'F'
                        begin
                            set @nMetdue = @nMetdue + @nEvtPpmmeter
                            if @sPmcrpast in ( N'-', N'OFF', N'NO', N'N' )
                                begin
                                    while @nMetdue < isnull( @nMetlast, 0 )
                                        set @nMetdue = @nMetdue + @nEvtPpmmeter
                                end
                        end
                    else
                        begin
                            SELECT @dCompleted = max(evt_completed)
                            FROM   r5events,
                                   r5ppms
                            WHERE  evt_ppm        = ppm_code
                            AND    evt_ppmrev     = ppm_revision
                            AND    evt_rstatus    = 'C'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPFUN1
   @sFuncode        nvarchar(6),
   @sSelect         nvarchar(1),
   @sUpdate         nvarchar(1),
   @sInsert         nvarchar(1),
   @sDelete         nvarchar(1),
   @sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN

	set @sChk = N'0'

	IF ( @sFuncode  IS NULL )  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

   UPDATE r5permissions 
   SET    prm_select  = CASE WHEN @sSelect IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE prm_select END,
          prm_update  = CASE WHEN @sUpdate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE prm_update END,
          prm_insert  = CASE WHEN @sInsert IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE prm_insert END,
          prm_delete  = CASE WHEN @sDelete IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE prm_delete END
   WHERE  prm_function = @sFuncode
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPICAT 
   @sCatpart       nvarchar(30),
   @sCatpartorg    nvarchar(15),
   @sCatsup        nvarchar(30),
   @sCatsuporg     nvarchar(15),
   @sCatrefer      nvarchar(50),
   @sCatrepref     nvarchar(50),
   @sOrlpuruom     nvarchar(30),
   @nOrlprice      numeric(24,6),
   @nRepprice      numeric(24,6),
   @sOrlcurr       nvarchar(3),
   @nOrlexch       numeric(24,12),
   @dOrldue        DATETIME,
   @dOrddue        DATETIME,
   @nOrlmultiply   numeric(10,4),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount					integer
	declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX                     nvarchar(1)
	declare @dToday					datetime
	declare @nReturn 			integer
	declare @nLeadtime				numeric(4,1)

	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @sX            = NULL

	IF @sCatpart IS NULL OR @sCatsup  IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dToday OUTPUT, @sCatsuporg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		return -1

	UPDATE r5catalogue
	SET  cat_ref      = CASE @sCatrepref WHEN NULL THEN COALESCE( @sCatrefer, cat_ref ) ELSE cat_ref END,
		 cat_repref   = COALESCE( @sCatrepref, cat_repref ),
		 cat_date     = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dToday, N'DD' )
	WHERE  cat_part         = @sCatpart
	AND    cat_part_org     = @sCatpartorg
	AND    cat_supplier     = @sCatsup
	AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCatsuporg
	AND    ( COALESCE( cat_ref, N'!@#$%' ) <> COALESCE( CASE @sCatrepref WHEN NULL THEN COALESCE( @sCatrefer, cat_ref ) ELSE cat_ref END, N'!@#$%') OR
             COALESCE( cat_repref, N'!@#$%' ) <> COALESCE( COALESCE( @sCatrepref, cat_repref ), N'!@#$%' ) )
	if @@ERROR <> 0 
		set @sX = null 

	/* Initialise normal price. */
	UPDATE r5catalogue
	SET    cat_gross        = @nOrlprice
	WHERE  cat_part         = @sCatpart
	AND    cat_part_org     = @sCatpartorg
	AND    cat_supplier     = @sCatsup
	AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCatsuporg
	AND    cat_curr         = @sOrlcurr
	AND    cat_gross IS NULL
	AND    @nOrlprice IS NOT NULL
	if @@ERROR <> 0 
		set @sX = null 
	
	/* Initialise repair price. */
	UPDATE r5catalogue
	SET    cat_repprice     = @nRepprice
	WHERE  cat_part         = @sCatpart
	AND    cat_part_org     = @sCatpartorg
	AND    cat_supplier     = @sCatsup
	AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCatsuporg
	AND    cat_curr         = @sOrlcurr
	AND    cat_repprice IS NULL

	select @nCount = count(*)

             COALESCE( cat_repref, N'!@#$%' ) <> COALESCE( COALESCE( @sCatrepref, cat_repref ), N'!@#$%' ) )

create function O7UPINV1_GET_AVGPRICE(	
  @sInv     nvarchar(45), 
  @sInvorg  nvarchar(15), 
  @nInvqty  numeric(24,6),
  @sOrd     nvarchar(30),
  @sOrdorg  nvarchar(15),
  @nOrdline numeric(8,0))
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin

  declare @nPrevinvoiced                numeric(24,6)
  declare @totalreturnedinvoicedqty     numeric(24,6)
  declare @returnedqty                  numeric(24,6)
  declare @nTotalreceived               numeric(24,6)
  declare @nRuninvqty                   numeric(24,6)
  declare @nReceivedvalue               numeric(24,6)
  declare @nTrlprice                    numeric(24,6)
  declare @nTrlqty                      numeric(24,6)
  declare @nAvgprice                    numeric(24,6)
  declare @sEndloop                     nvarchar(1)

  SET @nTotalreceived           = 0
  SET @nRuninvqty               = @nInvqty
  SET @nReceivedvalue           = 0
  SET @totalreturnedinvoicedqty = 0
  SET @returnedqty              = 0

  IF @nInvqty > 0
    BEGIN  
      /* First get qty invoiced on other invoices. */
      SELECT @nPrevinvoiced = COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN inv_rtype IN ( N'C', N'D' ) THEN 
             CASE WHEN COALESCE( inv_return, '-' ) = N'+' THEN COALESCE( -ivl_returnqty, 0 ) ELSE COALESCE( ivl_returnqty, 0 ) END ELSE
             ivl_invqty END ),0 )
      FROM   r5invoices, r5invoicelines
      WHERE  inv_code      = ivl_invoice
      AND    inv_org       = ivl_invoice_org
      AND    inv_rstatus   = N'A'
      AND    ivl_order     = @sOrd
      AND    ivl_order_org = @sOrdorg
      AND    ivl_ordline   = @nOrdline
      AND    ISNULL( ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND  ( inv_code <> @sInv OR inv_org <> @sInvorg )

      /* Retrieve all receipts of current order line. */
      declare c_trl cursor local static for
        SELECT trl_avgprice, trl_qty 
		FROM   r5transactions, r5translines
		WHERE  tra_code      = trl_trans
		AND    trl_order     = @sOrd
		AND    trl_order_org = @sOrdorg
		AND    trl_ordline   = @nOrdline
		AND    tra_rstatus   = N'A'
		AND    trl_rtype IN ( N'RECV' )
		AND    trl_io <> 0
		ORDER BY trl_date

      /* Sum of returned qty for current order line. */
      SELECT @returnedqty = coalesce(sum(trl_qty),0)
      FROM   r5transactions, r5translines
      WHERE  tra_code      = trl_trans
      AND    trl_order     = @sOrd
      AND    trl_order_org = @sOrdorg
      AND    trl_ordline   = @nOrdline
      AND    tra_rstatus   = 'A'
      AND    trl_rtype IN ( N'RETN' )
      AND    trl_io <> 0
      /* Total of returned qty. and Previously invoiced  */
      SET @totalreturnedinvoicedqty = @returnedqty + @nPrevinvoiced
      /* From each received line subtract the total returned and total invoiced*/
	  open c_trl
	  fetch next from c_trl into @nTrlprice, @nTrlqty
	  while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
		begin
			/* Received is less than total returned there should be more received*/
			if @totalreturnedinvoicedqty >= @nTrlqty
				begin
					SET @totalreturnedinvoicedqty = @totalreturnedinvoicedqty - @nTrlqty
				end
			else
				begin
				/* All returns are accounted for and sufficient received qty left for invoiced*/
					if(@nTrlqty - @totalreturnedinvoicedqty) >=  @nRuninvqty
					begin
						SET @nReceivedvalue = @nReceivedvalue + (@nTrlprice * @nRuninvqty)
						break
					end
					else
					begin
					/* All returns are accounted for and not enough received qty on current line 
					to generate invoice, go to next received line*/
						SET @nReceivedvalue = @nReceivedvalue + (@nTrlprice * (@nTrlqty - @totalreturnedinvoicedqty))
						SET @nRuninvqty = @nRuninvqty - (@nTrlqty - @totalreturnedinvoicedqty)
						SET @totalreturnedinvoicedqty = 0
					end
				end
			fetch next from c_trl into @nTrlprice, @nTrlqty
		end
		close c_trl
		deallocate c_trl
		RETURN( ROUND( @nReceivedvalue / @nInvqty, 6 ) )
	  end
    else
      SELECT @nAvgprice = AVG( trl_avgprice )
      FROM   r5transactions, r5translines
      WHERE  tra_code      = trl_trans
      AND    trl_order     = @sOrd
      AND    trl_order_org = @sOrdorg
      AND    trl_ordline   = @nOrdline
      AND    tra_rstatus   = N'A'
      AND    trl_rtype IN ( N'RECV', N'RETN' )
      AND    trl_io <> 0
  RETURN @nAvgprice  
end

create PROCEDURE O7UPIRED
   @sInvcode       nvarchar(45),
   @sInvorg        nvarchar(15),
   @sInvrtype      nvarchar(4),
   @sInvrstatus    nvarchar(4),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit              int
	declare @sOldpart              nvarchar(30) /*r5reductions.red_part%TYPE         =''*/
	declare @sOldpartorg           nvarchar(15) /*r5reductions.red_part_org%TYPE     =''*/
	declare @sOldSupplier          nvarchar(30) /*r5reductions.red_supplier%TYPE     =''*/
	declare @sOldSupplierorg       nvarchar(15) /*r5reductions.red_supplier_org%TYPE =''*/
	declare @sType					nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype					nvarchar(4)
	declare @nDiscount				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nDiscperc				numeric(5,2)
	declare @sSupplier				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSupplier_org			nvarchar(15) 
	declare @sPart					nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sPart_org				nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sorderrtype			NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @norderline				NUMERIC(8)
	DECLARE @sorder					NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sorderorg				NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @scondition				NVARCHAR(20)
	DECLARE @cactualpart			NVARCHAR(30)
	declare @nRedLine             	int

BEGIN
	/* Initialise local variables */
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @nRedLine = 1
	set @sOldpart              = null
	set @sOldpartorg           = null
	set @sOldSupplier          = null
	set @sOldSupplierorg       = null

	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInvcode    IS NULL OR
		@sInvorg     IS NULL OR
		@sInvrtype   IS NULL OR
		@sInvrstatus IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	
	/* check invoice type is N'I' and status is N'A'*/
	IF @sInvrtype = N'I' 
		begin
			IF @sInvrstatus <> N'A' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3' 
					RETURN
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2' 
			RETURN
		end

	DECLARE cLocal CURSOR local STATIC FOR SELECT e.ech_type, e.ech_rtype, e.ech_discount/i.ivl_invqty, e.ech_discperc,
							 o.orl_supplier, o.orl_supplier_org, o.orl_part, o.orl_part_org,o.orl_order, 
							 o.orl_order_org, o.orl_ordline,o.orl_rtype, p.par_condition
					FROM   r5extcharges e, r5orderlines o, r5invoicelines i,r5parts p
					WHERE  e.ech_invord_code = @sInvcode
					AND    e.ech_invord_org  = @sInvorg
					AND    e.ech_parprice    ='+'
					AND    e.ech_invord      = N'I'
					AND    e.ech_invord_code = i.ivl_invoice
					AND    e.ech_invord_org  = i.ivl_invoice_org
					AND    e.ech_invord_line = i.ivl_invline
					AND    i.ivl_order       = o.orl_order
					AND    i.ivl_order_org   = o.orl_order_org
					AND    i.ivl_ordline     = o.orl_ordline
					AND    o.orl_part        = p.par_code
					AND    o.orl_part_org    = p.par_org
					AND    i.ivl_rtype NOT LIKE N'S%'
					ORDER BY o.orl_part, o.orl_part_org, o.orl_supplier, o.orl_supplier_org


	OPEN cLocal
	FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal INTO @sType, @sRtype, @nDiscount, @nDiscperc,
							 @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sPart, @sPart_org,
							 @sorder,@sorderorg,@norderline,@sorderrtype,@scondition
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cactualpart = NULL
			IF @sorderrtype = N'RE' AND @scondition IS NOT NULL
				/* In case of an external repair of a conditioned part, get the received part. */
				SELECT DISTINCT @cactualpart = trl_part
				FROM   r5transactions, r5translines
				WHERE  tra_code      = trl_trans
				AND    tra_rstatus   = N'A'
				AND    trl_order     = @sorder
				AND    trl_order_org = @sorderorg
				AND    trl_ordline   = @norderline
				AND    trl_rtype     = N'RECV'
			SET @cactualpart = ISNULL( @cactualpart, @sPart )
			
			IF   coalesce(@sOldpart, N'*&^%')            <> @cactualpart
			OR coalesce(@sOldpartorg, N'*&^%')      <> @sPart_org
			OR coalesce( @sOldSupplier, N'*&^%')    <> @sSupplier
			OR coalesce( @sOldSupplierorg, N'*&^%') <> @sSupplier_org
				begin
					set @sOldpart         = @cactualpart
					set @sOldpartorg      = @sPart_org 
					set @sOldSupplier     = @sSupplier  
					set @sOldSupplierorg  = @sSupplier_org

					DELETE r5reductions
					WHERE  red_part         = @cactualpart
					AND    red_part_org     = @sPart_org
					AND    red_supplier     = @sSupplier
					AND    red_supplier_org = @sSupplier_org
				end
			ELSE
				set @nRedLine = @nRedLine + 1 /* Increment nredline*/


			INSERT INTO r5reductions
			   (
				 red_line,
				 red_discperc ,
				 red_discount ,
				 red_part,
				 red_part_org ,
				 red_supplier ,
				 red_supplier_org ,
				 red_type ,
				 red_rtype )
			  VALUES
			   ( @nRedLine ,
				 @nDiscperc * (-1),
				 @nDiscount * (-1),
				 @cactualpart,
				 @sPart_org ,
				 @sSupplier,
				 @sSupplier_org ,
				 @sType ,
				 @sRtype
				)



			FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal INTO @sType, @sRtype, @nDiscount, @nDiscperc,
									    @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sPart, @sPart_org,
										@sorder,@sorderorg,@norderline,@sorderrtype,@scondition
		END
	CLOSE cLocal
	DEALLOCATE cLocal

END

  @eamuser       NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @chk           NVARCHAR( 4 )   OUTPUT,
  @message       NVARCHAR( 500 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN

  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

  DECLARE @cnt               INTEGER
  DECLARE @return            INTEGER
  DECLARE @pk                NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk2              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @temptable         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @statement         NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @orgcount          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @ddtablename       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ddfieldname       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  
  SET @chk = N'0'

  /* Check old object. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @oldobject
  AND    obj_org  = @oldobjorg
  IF @cnt = 0 
    BEGIN
      /* Old object does not exist, return. */
      SET @chk = N'1'
      IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
      RETURN
    END

  /* Check new object. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @newobject
  AND    obj_org  = @oldobjorg
  IF @cnt > 0 
    BEGIN
      /* New object already exists, return. */
      SET @chk = N'2'
      IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
      RETURN
    END

  BEGIN TRY

    /* Initialize session, so triggers will know the user too. */
    EXECUTE @return = dbo.O7SESS_INIT_SESS @eamuser, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL

    /* Set the 'inupdateobject' flag to true, so triggers can skip certain trigger code. */
    EXECUTE @return = O7SESS_CHANGE_INOBJECTUPDATE 'TRUE'

    /* Retrieve number of orgs the old code is used in. */
    SELECT @orgcount = COUNT(*)
    FROM   r5objects
    WHERE  obj_code = @oldobject

    /* Get new r5objectupdate pk. */
    EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'OUP', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT

    /* Create temp table. */
    SELECT *
    INTO   #tempobjects
    FROM   r5objects
    WHERE  obj_code = @oldobject
    AND    obj_org  = @oldobjorg

    ALTER TABLE #tempobjects 
    DROP COLUMN obj_sqlidentity

    UPDATE #tempobjects 
    SET obj_code = @newobject

    /* Remove the GIS object ID from the old object. */
    UPDATE r5objects
    SET    obj_gisobjid = NULL
    WHERE  obj_code = @oldobject
    AND    obj_org  = @oldobjorg
    AND    obj_gisobjid IS NOT NULL

    /* Insert the new object record. */
    INSERT INTO r5objects
    SELECT * FROM #tempobjects

    /* update obj_gis_updatecount when equipment number is changed */
    UPDATE r5objects
    SET    obj_gis_updatecount = obj_gis_updatecount + 1
    WHERE  obj_code = @newobject
    AND    obj_org  = @oldobjorg
    AND    obj_gisobjid IS NOT NULL
    AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 from r5gisdatamaps
                   WHERE gmp_assetattribute = N'-64'
                   AND   gmp_owner= N'D'
                   AND   gmp_action = N'C'
                   AND   UPPER(gmp_layername) = COALESCE(UPPER(obj_gislayer), UPPER(gmp_layername)))

    /* Insert the object update record. */
    INSERT INTO r5objectupdate( oup_pk, oup_oldcode, oup_org, oup_newcode, oup_user, oup_date )
    VALUES( @pk, @oldobject, @oldobjorg, @newobject, @eamuser, getdate() )

    SET    obj_updatedby = @eamuser,
           obj_updated   = getdate()
    WHERE  obj_code      = @newobject
    AND    obj_org       = @oldobjorg

    UPDATE r5objects
    SET    obj_primarysystem     = @newobject
    WHERE  obj_primarysystem     = @oldobject
    AND    obj_primarysystem_org = @oldobjorg

    UPDATE r5actchecklists                 
    SET    ack_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  ack_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    ack_object_org = @oldobjorg     
    
    UPDATE r5operatorchecklists                 
    SET    ock_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  ock_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    ock_object_org = @oldobjorg     
         
    UPDATE r5actschedules                  
    SET    acs_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  acs_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    acs_object_org = @oldobjorg     
     
    UPDATE r5actschedules_archive          
    SET    aas_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  aas_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    aas_object_org = @oldobjorg     
     
    UPDATE r5agreements                    
    SET    agr_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  agr_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    agr_object_org = @oldobjorg     
     
    UPDATE r5agreements_archive            
    SET    aag_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  aag_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    aag_object_org = @oldobjorg     
     
    UPDATE r5alertdataobj                  
    SET    ado_obj = @newobject         
    WHERE  ado_obj = @oldobject         
    AND    ado_org = @oldobjorg        
     
    UPDATE r5arcevents                     
    SET    ave_object     = @newobject      
    WHERE  ave_object     = @oldobject      
    AND    ave_object_org = @oldobjorg     
     
    INSERT INTO r5points( 
           poi_object, poi_obrtype, poi_obtype, poi_point, poi_desc, poi_pointtype, poi_object_org, poi_updatecount, poi_created, poi_updated,
           poi_udfchar01, poi_udfchar02, poi_udfchar03, poi_udfchar04, poi_udfchar05,  
           poi_udfchar06, poi_udfchar07, poi_udfchar08, poi_udfchar09, poi_udfchar10,  
           poi_udfchar11, poi_udfchar12, poi_udfchar13, poi_udfchar14, poi_udfchar15,  
           poi_udfchar16, poi_udfchar17, poi_udfchar18, poi_udfchar19, poi_udfchar20,  
           poi_udfchar21, poi_udfchar22, poi_udfchar23, poi_udfchar24, poi_udfchar25,  
           poi_udfchar26, poi_udfchar27, poi_udfchar28, poi_udfchar29, poi_udfchar30,  
           poi_udfnum01, poi_udfnum02, poi_udfnum03, poi_udfnum04, poi_udfnum05,   
           poi_udfdate01, poi_udfdate02, poi_udfdate03, poi_udfdate04, poi_udfdate05,  
           poi_udfchkbox01, poi_udfchkbox02, poi_udfchkbox03, poi_udfchkbox04, poi_udfchkbox05 )
    SELECT @newobject, poi_obrtype, poi_obtype, poi_point, poi_desc, poi_pointtype, poi_object_org, poi_updatecount, poi_created, poi_updated,
           poi_udfchar01, poi_udfchar02, poi_udfchar03, poi_udfchar04, poi_udfchar05,

           poi_udfchar16, poi_udfchar17, poi_udfchar18, poi_udfchar19, poi_udfchar20,  
           poi_udfchar21, poi_udfchar22, poi_udfchar23, poi_udfchar24, poi_udfchar25,

    FROM   r5points
