CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPOBJ3
   @sInsupddel		nvarchar(4),
   @sChildtype		nvarchar(4),
   @sChild			nvarchar(30),
   @sChildorg		nvarchar(15),
   @sParenttype		nvarchar(4),
   @sParent			nvarchar(30),
   @sParentorg		nvarchar(15),
   @sOldrolldown	nvarchar(1),
   @sNewrolldown	nvarchar(1),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sParloc        nvarchar(30)	/*r5objects.obj_code%TYPE    Location of Parent      */
	declare @sParlocorg     nvarchar(15)	/*r5objects.obj_org%TYPE     Location org            */
	declare @sParltype      nvarchar(4)		/*r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE  Location Type of Parent */
	declare @sParentrtype   nvarchar(4)		/*r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE rType  of Parent        */
	declare @sChildrtype    nvarchar(4)		/*r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE rType  of Child         */
	declare @sPartype       nvarchar(4)		/*r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE  Type  of Parent         */
	declare @sChldtype      nvarchar(4)		/*r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE  Type  of Child          */
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount		integer

BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sPartype  = @sParenttype
	set @sChldtype = @sChildtype
   
	if @sInsupddel  IS NULL OR @sChildtype  IS NULL OR @sChild      IS NULL OR @sChildorg   IS NULL
	OR @sParenttype IS NULL OR @sParent     IS NULL OR @sParentorg  IS NULL 
	OR @sInsupddel  IN (N'INS', N'UPD') AND @sNewrolldown IS NULL
	OR @sInsupddel  IN (N'DEL', N'UPD') AND @sOldrolldown IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sParentrtype OUTPUT, @sPartype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sChildrtype OUTPUT, @sChldtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			return
		end

	if @sInsupddel = N'INS' AND @sNewrolldown = N'+' OR @sInsupddel = N'UPD' AND @sNewrolldown = N'+' AND @sOldrolldown = N'-'
		begin

			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5objects    o
			WHERE  o.obj_code   = @sParent
			AND    o.obj_org    = @sParentorg

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sParloc =	CASE @sParentrtype WHEN 'L' THEN @sParent ELSE o.obj_location END,
					@sParlocorg =	CASE @sParentrtype WHEN 'L' THEN @sParentorg ELSE o.obj_location_org END,
					@sParltype =	CASE @sParentrtype WHEN 'L' THEN @sParenttype ELSE o.obj_ltype END
				FROM   r5objects    o
				WHERE  o.obj_code   = @sParent
				AND    o.obj_org    = @sParentorg
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					return
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sInsupddel = N'UPD' AND @sOldrolldown = N'+' AND @sNewrolldown = N'-' OR    @sInsupddel = N'DEL' AND @sOldrolldown = N'+'
				begin
					set @sParloc    = NULL
					set @sParlocorg = NULL
					set @sParltype  = NULL
				end
			else
				return
		end

	if @sNewrolldown = N'+' 
		DELETE from r5structures
		WHERE  stc_child       = @sChild
		AND    stc_child_org   = @sChildorg
		AND    (   stc_parent     <> @sParent
			 OR  stc_parent_org <> @sParentorg)
		AND    stc_rolldown    = N'+'

	if @sChildrtype <> N'L' 
		UPDATE r5objects
		SET    obj_location     = @sParloc,
			 obj_location_org = @sParlocorg,
			 obj_ltype        = @sParltype
		WHERE (obj_code + N'#' + obj_org ) IN
								(SELECT  child + N'#' + child_org 
								FROM dbo.o7upobj3_get_hierarchy (@sChild, @sChildorg))

END

create function O7UPOBJ3_GET_HIERARCHY (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		and
				stc_rolldown		= N'+'

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg 
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		and
												stc_rolldown		= N'+'
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

        OR @cparent     IS NULL
        OR @cparentorg  IS NULL

        WHERE  obj_code = @cchild

            AND    obj_gisobjid IS NOT NULL

	@sObtype                nvarchar(4),

	@sOmrc                  nvarchar(15),
	@sChk                    nvarchar(4)   OUTPUT  
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	declare @sObtype1			nvarchar(4)            
	declare @sObrtype1			nvarchar(4)           
	declare @sObcode1			nvarchar(30)          
	declare @sObcodeorg1		nvarchar(15)          
	declare @sOmrc1				nvarchar(15)          
	declare @nReturn			int

	set @sChk         = N'0' 
	set @sObtype1    = @sObtype 
	set @sObrtype1   = @sObrtype 
	set @sObcode1    = @sObcode 
	set @sObcodeorg1 = @sObcodeorg 
	set @sOmrc1      = @sOmrc 
	set @nReturn     = 0

	if (   @sObrtype1 IS NULL AND @sObtype1  IS NULL ) OR @sOmrc1  IS NULL 
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'1' 
			return
		end 

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype1 OUTPUT, @sObtype1 OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2' 
			return 
		end

		 
	if @sObrtype1 = N'C'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'6' 
			return 
		end 


	UPDATE r5objects
	set  obj_mrc      = @sOmrc1
	WHERE( obj_code + N'#' +  obj_org ) IN  (SELECT  child + N'#' + child_org

create function O7UPOBJM_GET_HIERARCHY (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),

returns @tReturn table( childtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,

as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObdpcasc		nvarchar(100)

	set @sObdpcasc = dbo.O7DFLT2(N'OBDPCASC')
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_childrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				stc_childtype,
				stc_childrtype,
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent	= @sCode
		   and	stc_parent_org	= @sOrg
		   and	stc_rolldown	= CASE @sObdpcasc WHEN N'AA' THEN stc_rolldown WHEN N'AT' THEN stc_rolldown ELSE N'+' END

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org,
							@sCurrentType	= stc_childtype,
							@sCurrentRtype	= stc_childrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentType, @sCurrentRtype, @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												stc_childtype,
												stc_childrtype,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent	= @sCode
										   and	stc_parent_org	= @sOrg
										   and	stc_rolldown	= CASE @sObdpcasc WHEN N'AA' THEN stc_rolldown WHEN N'AT' THEN stc_rolldown ELSE N'+' END
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	DELETE FROM @tReturn
	WHERE  @sObdpcasc IN ( N'AT', N'DT' )
	AND    childrtype <> @sObrType

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPOBJS
	@sCobtype        nvarchar(4),
	@sCobrtype       nvarchar(4),
	@sCobcode        nvarchar(30),
	@sCobcodeorg     nvarchar(15),
	@sCostatus       nvarchar(4),
	@sCorstatus      nvarchar(4),
	@dDocommiss      datetime,
	@dDowithdraw     datetime,
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCobtype1			nvarchar(4)        /*  r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE  Object type      */
	declare @sCobrtype1			nvarchar(4)        /*  r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE  Object rtype  */
	declare @sCobcode1			nvarchar(30)       /*  r5objects.obj_code%TYPE    Object code      */
	declare @sCobcodeorg1		nvarchar(15)       /*  r5objects.obj_org%TYPE    Object org.       */
	declare @sCostatus1			nvarchar(4)        /*  r5objects.obj_status%TYPE   Object status   */
	declare @sCorstatus1		nvarchar(4)        /*  r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE  Object rstatus  */
	declare @dDocommiss1		datetime
	declare @dDowithdraw1		datetime
	declare @nReturn			integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCobtype1    = @sCobtype
	set @sCobrtype1   = @sCobrtype
	set @sCobcode1    = @sCobcode
	set @sCobcodeorg1 = @sCobcodeorg
	set @sCostatus1   = @sCostatus
	set @sCorstatus1  = @sCorstatus
	set @dDocommiss1  = @dDocommiss
	set @dDowithdraw1 = @dDowithdraw

	IF ( @sCobrtype1   IS NULL AND @sCobtype1  IS NULL )
	OR ( @sCorstatus1  IS NULL AND @sCostatus1 IS NULL ) 
	begin
		set @sChk = N'1'
		return
	end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCobrtype1 OUTPUT, @sCobtype1 OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	IF @sCobrtype1 IN ( N'C', N'L' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'6'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCorstatus1 OUTPUT, @sCostatus1 OUTPUT, N'OBST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			return
		end

	UPDATE r5objects
	set  obj_status   = @sCostatus1,
          obj_rstatus  = @sCorstatus1,
          obj_withdraw = @dDowithdraw1
	WHERE ( obj_code + N'#' +  obj_org ) IN  (SELECT  child + N'#' + child_org 
								FROM dbo.o7upobjs_get_hierarchy (@sCobcode1, @sCobcodeorg1, @sCobrtype1))


END

create PROCEDURE O7UPORD1
   @sOrdcode       nvarchar(30),
   @sOrdorg        nvarchar(15),
   @sOrdstore      nvarchar(15),
   @sOrdrstatus    nvarchar(4),
   @sOldrstatus    nvarchar(4),
   @sOrdrtype      nvarchar(4),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
   
SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sRpbreq			nvarchar(30) 
	declare @nRpbreqline		numeric(8)
	declare @sRpbstore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRpbpart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRpbpartorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRpbbin			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRpblot			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sRpbobject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRpbobjectorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nRpbqty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQty 				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sX 				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			int
    declare @nRate              numeric(30,6)

    declare @sActEvent          nvarchar(30)
    declare @nActAct            numeric(8)
    declare @sActMrc            nvarchar(15)
    declare @sActTrade          nvarchar(15)
    declare @dActStart          datetime
    declare @nID                int
    declare @sActReq            nvarchar(30)
    declare @nActReqline        numeric(8)
    declare @sActRtype          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sActType           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sActActive         nvarchar(1)
    declare @nActPrice          numeric(30,7)
    declare @nCountit           int

BEGIN

	set @sChk     = N'0'

	IF @sOrdcode    IS NULL
	OR @sOrdorg     IS NULL
	OR @sOrdrstatus IS NULL
	OR @sOrdrtype   IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end


	IF @sOrdrstatus = N'C' 
		BEGIN
			/*NOTE Issue: #13239 - Had to add a check of a package variable to have a work around for the mutating trigger exception handler in Oracle.
								 While the trigger can not mutate in SQLServer, the Oracle code has an exception handler that ignores the mutation and allows the processing to continue.  
								 A call was made to not call this block of code if the posupd_ord.trg initiates the call to 07upord1.prc which in turn
								 calls the preupd_act.trg.   

								 The package variable is initialized to TRUE so that the code preup_act trigger will run if not inititated by this call.  In this case 
								 the package variable will be set to FALSE.  After the update statement, the package variable is reset to TRUE.
						*/

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'R5ACTIVITIES', N'Preupdact_checkflag', N'FALSE'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

            declare c_act cursor local for SELECT act_event, act_act, act_mrc, act_trade, act_start, act_sqlidentity,
                                                  rql_req, rql_reqline, rql_rtype, rql_type, rql_active, 
                                                  coalesce( rql_price, 0) / coalesce( rql_exch, 1) price
                                           FROM   r5activities a LEFT OUTER JOIN r5requislines on ( a.act_req       = rql_req 
                                                                                                and a.act_reqline   = rql_reqline ) 
                                           WHERE  act_order     = @sOrdcode
                                           AND    act_order_org = @sOrdorg
            open c_act
            fetch next from c_act into @sActEvent, @nActAct, @sActMrc, @sActTrade, @dActStart, @nID, @sActReq, @nActReqline, @sActRtype, @sActType, @sActActive, @nActPrice
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if coalesce( @sActActive, N'-' ) = N'-'
                        begin
                            set @dActStart = coalesce( @dActStart, GetDate())
                            execute @nReturn = o7boora1 @nRate OUTPUT, @sActMrc, @sActTrade, null, N'N', @dActStart, @sOrdorg, null, @sChk OUTPUT
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				                RETURN -1
                        end
                    else
                        set @nRate = @nActPrice

                    SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
	                FROM   r5bookedhours 
	                WHERE  boo_event     = @sActEvent
	                AND    boo_act       = @nActAct

                    if @nCountit = 0 
	                    begin
					        UPDATE r5activities
						        SET    act_order     = null,
					               act_order_org = null,
					               act_ordered   = N'-',
					               act_ordline   = null, 
		                           act_ntrate    = @nRate,
		                           act_req       = CASE coalesce( @sActActive, N'-' ) WHEN N'+' THEN @sActReq ELSE null END,
		                           act_reqline   = CASE coalesce( @sActActive, N'-' ) WHEN N'+' THEN @nActReqline ELSE null END
					        WHERE  act_sqlidentity = @nID
						end
                    fetch next from c_act into @sActEvent, @nActAct, @sActMrc, @sActTrade, @dActStart, @nID, @sActReq, @nActReqline, @sActRtype, @sActType, @sActActive, @nActPrice
                end
            close c_act
            deallocate c_act


			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'R5ACTIVITIES', N'Preupdact_checkflag', N'TRUE'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
		END

	IF @sOrdrstatus  = N'A' AND @sOldrstatus <> N'A'
		EXECUTE o7activaterepairline N'ACT', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @sOrdcode, @sOrdorg, NULL, NULL
		
	IF @sOrdrstatus <> N'A' AND @sOldrstatus  = N'A'
		EXECUTE o7activaterepairline N'DEACT', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @sOrdcode, @sOrdorg, NULL, NULL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPORD2
    @sCordcode       nvarchar(30),
    @sCorg           nvarchar(15),
    @sCordcontract   nvarchar(30),
    @nNordexch       numeric(24,12),
    @nNordprice      numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
    @nNorddiscount   numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
    @nNorddiscperc   numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
    @sCdoupdate      nvarchar(5),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5) OUTPUT  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare  @nCountit  int
	declare  @invccurr	NVARCHAR(3)		-- INVCCURR 
BEGIN
	/* Initialise local variables */
    set @sChk       = N'0'
	set @invccurr   = N'OFF'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCordcode     IS NULL
    OR @sCdoupdate    IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/* Check whether all exchange rates are the same */
    SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
    FROM   r5orderlines
    WHERE  orl_order     = @sCordcode
    AND    orl_order_org = @sCorg
    AND    orl_exch     <> @nNordexch
    AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'

	SELECT @invccurr = ISNULL(ins_desc, N'OFF')
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'INVCCURR'	
	
	/* Retrieve total order price */
    IF @nCountit > 0 AND @invccurr <> N'ON'
	begin

	/* If different exchange rates and INVCCURR is not set to ON, then use cursor with exchange rates */
    	 SELECT  @nNordprice = isnull(SUM( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( isnull(CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END ELSE orl_price END, 0 ) /
                   isnull( orl_exch, 1 ) *
                 ( isnull( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN 1 ELSE CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END END, 0 ) /
                   isnull( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) *                   
                 ( 1 - 0.01 * isnull( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (isnull(CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0) *  (COALESCE(orl_recvqty, 0) / COALESCE(orl_ordqty, 0)) ELSE orl_tottaxamount END,0) + isnull(CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) *  (COALESCE(orl_recvqty, 0) / COALESCE(orl_ordqty, 0)) ELSE orl_totextra END,0))/isnull( orl_exch, 1 ) , 0 ) ), 0)
    	FROM   r5orderlines
    	WHERE  orl_order     = @sCordcode
    	AND    orl_order_org = @sCorg
    	AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'

        set @nNordprice = @nNordprice * isnull( @nNordexch, 1 )
	end
    ELSE
   	begin
	/* Otherwise use cursor without exchange rates */
    	SELECT @nNordprice = isnull(SUM( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( isnull( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END ELSE orl_price END, 0 ) *
                ( isnull(CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN 1 ELSE CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END END , 0 ) /
                  isnull( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) *
                ( 1 - 0.01 * isnull( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + isnull(CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0) *  (COALESCE(orl_recvqty, 0) / COALESCE(orl_ordqty, 0)) ELSE orl_tottaxamount END,0) + isnull(CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) *  (COALESCE(orl_recvqty, 0) / COALESCE(orl_ordqty, 0)) ELSE orl_totextra END,0) , 0 ) ), 0)
    	FROM   r5orderlines
    	WHERE  orl_order     = @sCordcode
    	AND    orl_order_org = @sCorg
    	AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'
    end
    IF @nNordprice < 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'2'
        RETURN
    end
    IF @sCordcontract IS NOT NULL 
	begin
    	SELECT @nNorddiscperc = isnull(MAX(cdi_disperc), 0)
    	FROM   r5condiscounts
    	WHERE  cdi_contract = @sCordcontract
    	AND    cdi_rtype    = N'O'
    	AND    cdi_value   <= @nNordprice

        set @nNorddiscount = @nNordprice * @nNorddiscperc / 100
	end
    ELSE
	begin
        set @nNorddiscount = NULL
        set @nNorddiscperc = NULL
    end
    set @nNordprice = ROUND( @nNordprice - isnull( @nNorddiscount, 0 ), 2 )
    IF @sCdoupdate = N'Y' 
    begin
        UPDATE r5orders
        SET    ord_price     = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( @nNordprice, 999999999999999999.99 ),
               ord_discount  = @nNorddiscount,
               ord_discperc  = @nNorddiscperc
        WHERE  ord_code      = @sCordcode
        AND    ord_org       = @sCorg
    end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPORL2
    @sCevent         nvarchar(30),
    @nNact           numeric(8,0),
    @nNrecqtynow     numeric(24,6),
    @nNrecvalnow     numeric(24,6),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5) OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCorder     nvarchar(30)  /* r5orders.ord_code%TYPE */
    declare @sCorderorg  nvarchar(15)  /* r5orders.ord_org%TYPE  */
    declare @sCorlrtype  nvarchar(4)   /* r5orderlines.orl_rtype%TYPE */
    declare @nNordline   numeric(8,0)
    declare @sCreq       nvarchar(30)  /* r5requisitions.req_code%TYPE */
    declare @nNreqline   numeric(8,0)
    declare @nNrecvalreq numeric(24,6)
    declare @nNrecqtyreq numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn	 int
	declare @nCount		 int
	DECLARE @nError_var int, @nRowcount_var int
BEGIN
	/* Initialise local variables */
    set @sChk     = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters: when booking hours ill etc. no operation */
    IF @sCevent IS NULL
    OR @nNact   IS NULL
        RETURN
    IF  @nNrecqtynow IS NULL
        RETURN
	/* Get related order and requisition */
    
	SELECT @sCorder = orl_order,
	       @sCorderorg = orl_order_org,
	       @nNordline = orl_ordline,
	       @sCreq = orl_req,
	       @nNreqline = orl_reqline,
	       @sCorlrtype = orl_rtype,
	       @nNrecvalreq = CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'ST'
												THEN ROUND( @nNrecvalnow / orl_exch * rql_exch, 2 )
												ELSE @nNrecvalnow END,
	       @nNrecqtyreq = CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF'
												 THEN ROUND( @nNrecqtynow / orl_exch * rql_exch, 2 )
												 ELSE @nNrecqtynow END
	FROM   r5requislines RIGHT OUTER JOIN
	       r5orderlines ON  orl_req     = rql_req
	    				   AND orl_reqline = rql_reqline 
	WHERE  orl_event   = @sCevent
	AND    orl_act     = @nNact
	AND    ( orl_rstatus not in ( N'J', N'C' ) OR 
            ( orl_rstatus = N'C' AND @nNrecqtynow < 0 and coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) + coalesce(orl_recvvalue,0) > 0) )
	AND    orl_rtype LIKE N'S%'

		SELECT @nError_var = @@ERROR, @nRowcount_var = @@ROWCOUNT
		if @nError_var <> 0 OR @nRowcount_var <> 1
			RETURN
    /* W0312B1, W0312B2 */
    UPDATE r5orderlines 
    SET    orl_recvvalue = CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' 
												  THEN isnull( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) + isnull( @nNrecqtynow, 0 )
												  ELSE isnull( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) + isnull( @nNrecvalnow, 0 ) END,
           orl_recvqty = CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' 
												  THEN orl_recvqty
												  ELSE isnull( orl_recvqty, 0 )  + isnull( @nNrecqtynow, 0 ) END
    WHERE  orl_order     = @sCorder
    AND    orl_order_org = @sCorderorg
    AND    orl_ordline   = @nNordline
    /* Make line inactive if necessary */
    IF @sCorlrtype IN ( N'ST', N'SH' )
	begin
        UPDATE r5orderlines
        SET    orl_active = CASE SIGN( orl_ordqty - orl_recvqty ) WHEN N'1' THEN CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN N'-' WHEN N'J' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+'  END ELSE N'-' END
        WHERE  orl_order     = @sCorder
        AND    orl_order_org = @sCorderorg
        AND    orl_ordline   = @nNordline
	end
    ELSE IF @sCorlrtype = N'SF'
	begin
        UPDATE r5orderlines 
        SET    orl_active  = CASE SIGN( orl_price - orl_recvvalue ) WHEN N'1' THEN
																          CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN N'-' WHEN N'J' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
																          ELSE N'-' END,
               orl_recvqty = CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( isnull( orl_recvvalue, 0 ), 0 ) WHEN 0
																							THEN 0
																							ELSE 1 END
        WHERE  orl_order     = @sCorder
        AND    orl_order_org = @sCorderorg
        AND    orl_ordline   = @nNordline
    end
    /* Check for pre-matched invoices */
    IF isnull( @nNrecvalnow, 0 ) > 0 OR
       isnull( @nNrecqtynow, 0 ) > 0
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7PRMTCH @sCorder, @sCorderorg, 	@nNordline 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn  <> 0
			return -1
    end
	/* Also update related requisition */
    IF @sCreq IS NOT NULL
	begin
         UPDATE r5requislines
         SET    rql_recvvalue = CASE rql_rtype WHEN N'SF'
													THEN isnull( rql_recvvalue, 0 ) + isnull( @nNrecqtyreq, 0 )
													ELSE isnull( rql_recvvalue, 0 ) + isnull( @nNrecvalreq, 0 ) END,
                rql_recvqty = CASE rql_rtype WHEN N'SF'
												  THEN rql_recvqty
												  ELSE isnull( rql_recvqty, 0 )  + isnull( @nNrecqtyreq, 0 ) END
         WHERE  rql_req     = @sCreq
         AND    rql_reqline = @nNreqline
		 AND    rql_rtype   = @sCorlrtype

         /* Make line inactive if necessary */
         IF @sCorlrtype IN ( N'ST', N'SH' )
		 begin	
             UPDATE r5requislines
             SET    rql_active  =  CASE SIGN( rql_qty - rql_recvqty ) WHEN N'1'
																		THEN N'+'
																		ELSE N'-' END
             WHERE  rql_req     = @sCreq
             AND    rql_reqline = @nNreqline
		 end
         ELSE
		 begin
             UPDATE r5requislines
             SET    rql_active  = CASE SIGN( rql_price - rql_recvvalue ) WHEN N'1'
																				THEN N'+'
																				ELSE N'-' END,
                  rql_recvqty = CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( isnull( rql_recvvalue, 0 ), 0 )  WHEN 0
																								THEN 0
																								ELSE 1 END
             WHERE  rql_req     = @sCreq
             AND    rql_reqline = @nNreqline
         end

         UPDATE r5requislines 
         SET    rql_active   = N'-'
         WHERE  rql_req      = @sCreq
         AND    rql_reqline  = @nNreqline
         AND    rql_active   = N'+'
         AND    EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                         FROM   r5orderlines 
                         WHERE  orl_req     = rql_req
                         AND    orl_reqline = rql_reqline
                         AND    orl_active  = N'-' )



    end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPPAR2 
	@sOrder  nvarchar(30),
	@sOrdorg nvarchar(15)   
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare	@sPricelevel		nvarchar(45)
	declare	@sPricetype			nvarchar(4) --r5partprices.ppr_pricetype%TYPE /* 09-AUG-2000 sangeeta  #6934 */
	declare	@sChk				nvarchar(3)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nPrice				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sPart				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStore				nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn 			int

BEGIN
	IF @sOrder IS NULL 
		RETURN


	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5install  i
	WHERE  i.ins_code = N'PRICELEV'

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @sPricelevel = coalesce (i.ins_desc, N'P' )
		FROM   r5install  i
		WHERE  i.ins_code = N'PRICELEV'
	else
		set @sPricelevel = N'P'


	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPricetype OUTPUT, N'PRICETYP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	IF @sPricelevel = N'P' 
		begin
			DECLARE cLocal1 CURSOR local FOR SELECT orl_part     cpart,
													 orl_part_org cpartorg,
													 orl_price / coalesce(orl_multiply, 1) / coalesce(orl_exch, 1) 
												FROM r5orderlines ol
												WHERE orl_order     = @sOrder
												AND   orl_order_org = @sOrdorg
												AND   NOT EXISTS (SELECT NULL
																FROM   r5partprices p
																WHERE  p.ppr_part     = ol.orl_part
																AND    p.ppr_part_org = ol.orl_part_org
																AND    p.ppr_org      = @sOrdorg
																AND    p.ppr_baseprice IS NOT NULL)
												AND   ol.orl_part IS NOT NULL

			OPEN cLocal1
			FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal1 INTO @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nPrice
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
						SELECT @nCount = count(*)
						FROM   r5partprices
						WHERE  ppr_part     = @sPart
						AND    ppr_part_org = @sPartOrg
						AND    ppr_org      = @sOrdorg			

						IF @nCount = 0  
							INSERT INTO r5partprices ( ppr_part, ppr_part_org,
														 ppr_org, ppr_baseprice, ppr_pricetype,
														 ppr_avgprice, ppr_stdprice, ppr_lastprice  )
							VALUES ( @sPart,   @sPartOrg,
									@sOrdorg, @nPrice, @sPricetype,
									case @sPricetype when N'A' then @nPrice else NULL end,
									case @sPricetype when N'S' then @nPrice else NULL end,
									case @sPricetype when N'L' then @nPrice else NULL end      )
						ELSE
							UPDATE r5partprices
							SET		ppr_baseprice = @nPrice,
									ppr_avgprice  = case @sPricetype when N'A' then @nPrice else ppr_avgprice end,
									ppr_stdprice  = case @sPricetype when N'S' then @nPrice else ppr_stdprice end,
									ppr_lastprice = case @sPricetype when N'L' then @nPrice else ppr_lastprice end
							WHERE  ppr_part      = @sPart
							AND    ppr_part_org  = @sPartOrg
							AND    ppr_org       = @sOrdorg

					FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal1 INTO @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nPrice
				END
			CLOSE cLocal1
			DEALLOCATE cLocal1
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			DECLARE cLocal2 CURSOR local FOR SELECT orl_part     cpart,
														 orl_part_org cpartorg,
														 orl_store    cstore,
														 orl_price / coalesce(orl_multiply, 1) / coalesce(orl_exch, 1) nprice
													FROM r5orderlines ol
													WHERE orl_order     = @sOrder
													AND   orl_order_org = @sOrdorg
													AND   NOT EXISTS (SELECT NULL
																	FROM  r5stock s
																	WHERE s.sto_part     = ol.orl_part
																	AND   s.sto_part_org = ol.orl_part_org
																	AND   s.sto_store    = ol.orl_store
																	AND   s.sto_baseprice IS NOT NULL)
													AND   ol.orl_part IS NOT NULL

			OPEN cLocal2
			FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal2 INTO @sPart, @sPartOrg, @sStore, @nPrice
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					 UPDATE r5stock
					 SET    sto_baseprice = @nPrice,
							sto_avgprice  = case @sPricetype when N'A' then @nPrice else sto_avgprice end,
							sto_stdprice  = case @sPricetype when N'S' then @nPrice else sto_stdprice end,
							sto_lastprice = case @sPricetype when N'L' then @nPrice else sto_lastprice end
					 WHERE  sto_part      = @sPart
					 AND    sto_part_org  = @sPartOrg
					 AND    sto_store     = @sStore
					FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal2 INTO @sPart, @sPartOrg, @sStore,  @nPrice
				END
			CLOSE cLocal2
			DEALLOCATE cLocal2
		end
END

create PROCEDURE O7UPPARTPRICE
   @sPricetype  nvarchar(4),
   @sPart       nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg    nvarchar(15),
   @sStpriceorg nvarchar(60),
   @sOldprice   numeric(24,6),
   @sUser       nvarchar(255),
   @sChk        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
 
 AS SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @Checkresult       nvarchar(4)
   declare @sSession          nvarchar(12)		/*r5temppricedif.tmp_session%TYPE*/
   declare @sTransrtype       nvarchar(4)		/*r5transactions.tra_rtype%TYPE*/
   declare @sFunction         nvarchar(20) 
   declare @sPriceOrg         nvarchar(60)		/*r5partprices.ppr_org%TYPE*/
   declare @sStore            nvarchar(15)		/*r5stores.str_code%TYPE*/
   declare @sPriceLevel       nvarchar(1)
   declare @nPricediff        numeric(24,6)
   declare @sNewpricetype     nvarchar(4)
   declare @nNewprice         numeric(24,6)
   declare @nPos              integer
   declare @nReturn		integer

BEGIN
/* Initialise local variables */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @Checkresult  = N'0'
	set @sFunction = N'SNREVP'

	set @sSession = @@SPID 


	set @nPos = charindex(N'#', @sStpriceorg )

	IF @nPos > 0 
		begin
			set @sStore    = Substring (@sStpriceorg, 1, @nPos-1)
			set @sPriceOrg = Substring(@sStpriceorg, @nPos+1, len(@sStpriceorg) - @nPos+1)
		end
	ELSE
		set @sPriceOrg = @sStpriceorg
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPriceLevel OUTPUT, N'PRICELEV', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sPriceLevel = N'P' 
		SELECT   @sNewpricetype = ppr_pricetype,
			  @nNewprice = ppr_baseprice
		FROM     r5partprices
		WHERE    ppr_part_org = @sPartorg
		AND      ppr_part     = @sPart
		AND      ppr_org      = @sPriceOrg
	ELSE
		SELECT   @sNewpricetype = sto_pricetype,
				 @nNewprice = sto_baseprice
		FROM     r5stock
		WHERE    sto_part_org = @sPartorg
		AND      sto_part     = @sPart
		AND      sto_store    = @sStore



	IF @sNewpricetype is not null and @sPricetype is not null   
		begin
			set @nPricediff =  coalesce(@nNewprice, 0 ) - coalesce(@sOldprice, 0 )
			IF @nPricediff <> 0 
				begin
					IF @sPricetype <> @sNewpricetype 
						set @sTransrtype = N'MPTC'
					ELSE
						begin
							IF @sPricetype = @sNewpricetype    
								set @sTransrtype = N'CORR'
						end
				end
			ELSE
				return
		end
    ELSE
       return


	INSERT INTO r5temppricedif
		(   tmp_session,
		tmp_store,
		tmp_part,
		tmp_part_org,
		tmp_pricediff,
		tmp_newprice,
		tmp_transrtype,
		tmp_org  )
	VALUES
		(   @sSession,
		@sStore,
		@sPart,
		@sPartorg,
		@nPricediff,
		@nNewprice,
		@sTransrtype,
		@sPriceOrg  )

	execute @nReturn = o7crtra2 @sSession, @sUser, @sFunction, @Checkresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	set @sChk = @Checkresult
END

create procedure O7UPPORQ   @sTrans     nvarchar(30),
                            @sPo        nvarchar(30),
                            @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
                            @sReq       nvarchar(30)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sCode      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChk       nvarchar(4)

    declare @sRqstallr  nvarchar(200)
    declare @sRqstrecv  nvarchar(200)
    declare @sPostallr  nvarchar(200)
    declare @sPostrecv  nvarchar(200)

    set @sRqstallr = dbo.o7dflt2(N'RQSTALLR')
    set @sRqstrecv = dbo.o7dflt2(N'RQSTRECV')
    set @sPostallr = dbo.o7dflt2(N'POSTALLR')
    set @sPostrecv = dbo.o7dflt2(N'POSTRECV')

    if @sPostrecv is not null
        UPDATE r5orders
        SET    ord_status = @sPostrecv
        WHERE  ord_code = @sPo
        AND    ord_org = @sOrg
        AND    ord_rstatus = N'A'
        AND    ord_status <> @sPostrecv
        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5orderlines
                    WHERE  orl_order = ord_code
                    AND    orl_order_org = ord_org
                    AND    orl_active = N'+'
                    AND    orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' ) )
        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5orderlines
                    WHERE  orl_order = ord_code
                    AND    orl_order_org = ord_org
                    AND    COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ) + COALESCE( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) + COALESCE( orl_scrapqty, 0 ) > 0 )
        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5ucodes WHERE uco_rentity = N'DOST' and uco_code = @sPostrecv )

    if @sPostallr is not null
        UPDATE r5orders
        SET    ord_status = @sPostallr
        WHERE  ord_code = @sPo
        AND    ord_org = @sOrg
        AND    ord_rstatus = N'A'
        AND    ord_status <> @sPostallr
        AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5orderlines
                        WHERE  orl_order = ord_code
                        AND    orl_order_org = ord_org
                        AND    orl_active = N'+'
                        AND    orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' ) )
        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5orderlines
                    WHERE  orl_order = ord_code
                    AND    orl_order_org = ord_org
                    AND    COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ) + COALESCE( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) + COALESCE( orl_scrapqty, 0 ) > 0 )
        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5ucodes WHERE uco_rentity = N'DOST' and uco_code = @sPostallr )

    if @sRqstrecv is not null or @sRqstallr is not null
        begin
            declare c_req cursor local for SELECT DISTINCT( trl_req )
                                           FROM   r5translines
                                           WHERE  trl_trans = @sTrans
                                           UNION
                                           SELECT @sReq
            open c_req
            fetch next from c_req into @sCode
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if @sRqstrecv is not null
                        UPDATE r5requisitions
                        SET    req_status = @sRqstrecv
                        WHERE  req_code = @sCode
                        AND    req_rstatus = N'A'
                        AND    req_status <> @sRqstrecv
                        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                    FROM   r5requislines
                                    WHERE  rql_req = req_code
                                    AND    rql_active = N'+'
                                    AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' ) )
                        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                    FROM   r5requislines
                                    WHERE  rql_req = req_code
                                    AND    COALESCE( rql_recvqty, 0 ) + COALESCE( rql_recvvalue, 0 ) + 
                                           COALESCE( rql_scrapqty, 0 ) > 0 )
                        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5ucodes WHERE uco_rentity = N'RQST' and uco_code = @sRqstrecv )

                    if @sRqstallr is not null
                        UPDATE r5requisitions
                        SET    req_status = @sRqstallr
                        WHERE  req_code = @sCode
                        AND    req_rstatus = N'A'
                        AND    req_status <> @sRqstallr
                        AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                        FROM   r5requislines
                                        WHERE  rql_req = req_code
                                        AND    rql_active = N'+'
                                        AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' ) )
                        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                    FROM   r5requislines
                                    WHERE  rql_req = req_code
                                    AND    COALESCE( rql_recvqty, 0 ) + COALESCE( rql_recvvalue, 0 ) + 
                                           COALESCE( rql_scrapqty, 0 ) > 0 )
                        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5ucodes WHERE uco_rentity = N'RQST' and uco_code = @sRqstallr )
                        
                    fetch next from c_req into @sCode
                end
            close c_req
            deallocate c_req
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPQUL1
   @sQuotation     nvarchar(30),
   @sSeqno         nvarchar(2),
   @nOldqty        numeric(24,6),
   @nOldprice      numeric(24,6),
   @nNewqty        numeric(24,6),
   @nNewprice      numeric(24,6),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @nSubtotal   numeric(24,6) /* Subtotal of quotation line */
   declare @nCount		integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @nSubtotal = 0

	IF @sQuotation IS NULL OR @sSeqno     IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk  = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	set @nSubtotal = ( coalesce( @nNewqty,0 ) * coalesce( @nNewprice,0 )) - ( coalesce( @nOldqty,0 )* coalesce( @nOldprice,0 ) )

	select @nCount = count(*) 
	from r5quotations 
	where	quo_code  = @sQuotation AND
			quo_seqno = @sSeqno

	if @nCount > 0 
		UPDATE r5quotations
		SET    quo_total = CASE coalesce( quo_total,0 ) + @nSubtotal WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE coalesce( quo_total,0 ) + @nSubtotal  END
		WHERE  quo_code  = @sQuotation
		AND    quo_seqno = @sSeqno
	else
		begin
		    set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE o7upred1
    @sCsupplier      nvarchar(30),
    @sCsupplierorg   nvarchar(15),
    @sCpart          nvarchar(30),
    @sCpartorg       nvarchar(15),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5)  OUTPUT
as
begin
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nNgross            numeric(24,6)  /* Gross price of catalogue */
    declare @nNpurprice         numeric(24,6)  /* Purchase price of cat.   */
 	declare @nPercentage		numeric(18,0)
	declare @nDiscount			numeric(24,6)
	/* Declare variables used in error checking. */
	declare @nError_var int, @nRowcount_var int

	/* Initialise local variables */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
   	IF @sCsupplier    IS NULL
   	OR @sCsupplierorg IS NULL
   	OR @sCpart        IS NULL
   	OR @sCpartorg     IS NULL 
	begin
      set @sChk = N'1'
      return
    end
	/* -----Beginning of Purchase Price Calculation */
	/* Get Gross price from r5catalogue */
    SELECT @nNgross  = c.cat_gross
    FROM   r5catalogue    c
    WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sCsupplier
    AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sCsupplierorg
    AND    c.cat_part         = @sCpart
    AND    c.cat_part_org     = @sCpartorg 
	SELECT @nError_var = @@ERROR, @nRowcount_var = @@ROWCOUNT
    if @nRowcount_var = 0
    begin
        set @sChk = N'2'
        return
    end
	if @nRowcount_var > 1 OR @nError_var <> 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'3'
        return
    end
	/* Purchase price is same as Gross price if there is no discount */
    set @nNpurprice = isnull( @nNgross, 0 )
	/* Apply discount on Gross price to get purchase price */
	/* Get discount from r5reductions                             */
    DECLARE cCalcpurprice  CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
	SELECT   isnull( r.red_discperc,
                   0 )              percentage,
              isnull( r.red_discount,
                   0 )              discount
    FROM     r5reductions   r
    WHERE    r.red_supplier     = @sCsupplier
    AND      r.red_supplier_org = @sCsupplierorg
    AND      r.red_part         = @sCpart
    AND      r.red_part_org     = @sCpartorg
    ORDER BY r.red_line

	OPEN cCalcpurprice
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCalcpurprice INTO @nPercentage, @nDiscount
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN 
        set @nNpurprice = ROUND( @nNpurprice 
                             * ( 1 - @nPercentage / 100 )
                             - @nDiscount,
                      2 )
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCalcpurprice INTO @nPercentage, @nDiscount
	END
	CLOSE cCalcpurprice
	DEALLOCATE cCalcpurprice 
	/* ---------End of Purchase Price Calculation */
	/* P1414, P1432: Update catalogue date and purchase price      */

    UPDATE r5catalogue
    SET    cat_date     = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sCsupplierorg), N'DD' ),
             cat_purprice = @nNpurprice 
    WHERE  cat_supplier     = @sCsupplier
    AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCsupplierorg
    AND    cat_part         = @sCpart
    AND    cat_part_org     = @sCpartorg
		
	SELECT @nError_var = @@ERROR, @nRowcount_var = @@ROWCOUNT
    if @nRowcount_var = 0
    begin
        set @sChk = N'2'
        return
    end
	if @nRowcount_var > 1 OR @nError_var <> 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'3'
        return
    end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE o7uprfqt
                @cRFQuotid     NVARCHAR(30),
                @cRFQuotorg    NVARCHAR(15),
                @cRFQuotCurr   NVARCHAR(3)  OUTPUT,
                @cpartcount    INT  OUTPUT,
                @cservicecount INT  OUTPUT,
                @cpartval      NUMERIC(24,6)  OUTPUT,
                @cserviceval   NUMERIC(24,6)  OUTPUT,
                @ctotaltax     NUMERIC(24,6)  OUTPUT,
                @cupdatecount  INT  OUTPUT,
                @ccurrtime     DATETIME  OUTPUT,
                @cChk          NVARCHAR(4)  OUTPUT
AS
  DECLARE  @sValid INT
  DECLARE  @cCurr NVARCHAR(3)
  DECLARE  @cPurQty NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE  @cPrice NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE  @cRType NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE  @cExchRate NUMERIC(24,12)
  DECLARE  @cHdrExchRate NUMERIC(24,12)
  DECLARE  @cAwardedDate DATETIME
  DECLARE  @ctemptax NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE  @ctax NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE  @ctax2 NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE  @cparttax NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE  @cRLRTax NVARCHAR(20)
  DECLARE  @cRLRTax2 NVARCHAR(20)
  BEGIN
    /* init. */
    SET nocount on
    SET @cChk = N'0'
    SET @sValid = 0
    SET @cpartcount = 0
    SET @cservicecount = 0
    SET @cpartval = 0
    SET @cserviceval = 0
    SET @ctotaltax = 0
    SET @cupdatecount = 0
    SET @ctemptax = 0
    DECLARE c_checkexchrate CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT rlr_curr,
           rlr_rfq_org,
           rfq_awardeddate,
           rfq_curr,
           rlr_rtype,
           rlr_purqty,
           rlr_price,
           rlr_tax,
           rlr_tax2
    FROM R5RFQLINERESPONSES,  R5RFQUOTATIONS
    WHERE  rlr_rfq =  rfq_code
           AND rlr_rfq_org = rfq_org
           AND rlr_notoffered = N'-'
           AND rlr_price IS NOT NULL
           AND rlr_rstatus = N'A'
           AND rfq_code = @cRFQuotid
           AND rfq_org = @cRFQuotorg
    
    BEGIN
      /* Check mandatory parameters: lists */
      IF (@cRFQuotid IS NULL
           OR @cRFQuotorg IS NULL)
        BEGIN
          SET @cChk = N'1'
          
          RETURN
        END
      
      OPEN c_checkexchrate
      
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_checkexchrate
      INTO @cCurr,
           @cRFQuotorg,
           @cAwardedDate,
           @cRFQuotCurr,
           @cRType,
           @cPurQty,
           @cPrice,
           @cRLRTax,
           @cRLRTax2
      
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF (@sValid = 0)
            BEGIN
              SET @sValid = 1
              SET @ccurrtime = dbo.o7gttime2 (@cRFQuotorg);
              SET @cHdrExchRate = dbo.O7gtexch2(@cRFQuotCurr,@cRFQuotorg,@cAwardedDate)
            END
          
          SET @cExchRate = dbo.O7gtexch2(@cCurr,@cRFQuotorg,@cAwardedDate)
          IF (@cHdrExchRate IS NULL or @cExchRate IS NULL )
            BEGIN
              SET @cChk = N'2'
              CLOSE c_checkexchrate
              DEALLOCATE c_checkexchrate
              RETURN;
            END
          
          
          /* tax totals */
          IF @cRType NOT IN (N'SF',N'SH',N'ST')
            BEGIN
              IF @cRLRTax IS NULL
                SET @ctemptax = 0;
              ELSE
                BEGIN
                  SET @ctax = dbo.O7gettax(@cRLRTax,@ccurrtime)
                  
                  IF @cRLRTax2 IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                      SET @ctax2 = dbo.O7gettax(@cRLRTax2,@ccurrtime)
                      
                      SET @ctemptax = (@ctax / 100) + (@ctax2 / 100)
                    END
                  ELSE
                    SET @ctemptax = @ctax / 100
                END
                SET @cparttax = round((@ctemptax * (@cPurQty * @cPrice / @cExchRate * @cHdrExchRate)),2)
                SET @ctotaltax = @ctotaltax + @cparttax
            END

          /*  Part Line */
          IF Coalesce(@cRType,N'PD') IN (N'PD',N'PS',N'RE')
            BEGIN
              SET @cpartcount = @cpartcount + 1
              
              SET @cpartval = @cpartval + round((@cPurQty * @cPrice / @cExchRate * @cHdrExchRate),2) + @cparttax
            END
          
          /*  Service Line */
          IF @cRType IN (N'SF',N'SH',N'ST')
            BEGIN
              SET @cservicecount = @cservicecount + 1
              
              SET @cserviceval = @cserviceval + round((@cPurQty * @cPrice / @cExchRate  * @cHdrExchRate),2)
            END
          
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_checkexchrate
          INTO @cCurr,
               @cRFQuotorg,
               @cAwardedDate,
               @cRFQuotCurr,
               @cRType,
               @cPurQty,
               @cPrice,
               @cRLRTax,
               @cRLRTax2
        END
      
      CLOSE c_checkexchrate
      
      DEALLOCATE c_checkexchrate
      
      IF (@sValid = 0)
        BEGIN
          SET @cChk = N'3'
          
          RETURN
        END
      
      /*update r5rfquotations*/
      UPDATE r5rfquotations
      SET    rfq_totalvalue = (@cpartval + @cserviceval),
             rfq_lasttotaled = @ccurrtime
      WHERE  rfq_code = @cRFQuotid
             AND rfq_org = @cRFQuotorg
      
      SELECT @cupdatecount = rfq_updatecount
      FROM   r5rfquotations
      WHERE  rfq_code = @cRFQuotid
             AND rfq_org = @cRFQuotorg
    END
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPSCA1
   @sScatrade		nvarchar(15),
   @sScamrc			nvarchar(15),
   @dScadate		DATETIME,
   @nScanormal		numeric(24,6),
   @nScanormalold	numeric(24,6),
   @nScahire		numeric(24,6),
   @nScahireold		numeric(24,6),
   @sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount		integer

	set @sChk = N'0'

	IF @dScadate      IS NULL
	OR @sScatrade     IS NULL
	OR @sScamrc       IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	select @nCount = count(*) 
	from r5availability
	WHERE  avl_date     = @dScadate
	AND    avl_trade    = @sScatrade
	AND    avl_mrc      = @sScamrc


	if @nCount > 0 
		UPDATE r5availability
		SET		avl_nethours = CASE WHEN coalesce( avl_nethours,0 ) + coalesce( @nScanormalold,0 ) - coalesce( @nScanormal,0 ) < avl_ownhours THEN coalesce( avl_nethours,0 ) + coalesce( @nScanormalold,0 ) - coalesce( @nScanormal,0 ) ELSE avl_ownhours END,
				avl_nethired = CASE WHEN coalesce( avl_nethired,0 )+ coalesce( @nScahireold,0 )	- coalesce( @nScahire,0 ) < avl_hirhours THEN coalesce( avl_nethired,0 ) + coalesce( @nScahireold,0 ) - coalesce( @nScahire,0 ) ELSE avl_hirhours END
		WHERE  avl_date     = @dScadate
		AND    avl_trade    = @sScatrade
		AND    avl_mrc      = @sScamrc
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'0'
			RETURN
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE  o7upscat
	@cQuotid		nvarchar(30),
	@cQuotline		integer ,
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	declare @sExists	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPart		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sService	nvarchar(20)
	declare @sRev		integer
	declare @sSupplierRef	nvarchar(50)
	declare @sSupplier	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSupplierOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPrice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sCurrency	nvarchar(3)
	declare @sUOP		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sConFact	numeric(10,4)
	declare @sLeadTime	numeric(4,1)
	declare @sGrossPrice	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCatRef	nvarchar(50)
	declare @sDupCatRefExists nvarchar(4)
	declare @sTempRepairPrice	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sTempGrossPrice	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sValid		integer
	declare @sTax		nvarchar(20)
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sValid = 0
	set @sDupCatRefExists = N'0'
declare c_lineinfo cursor local for
	SELECT
		rli_part part, rli_part_org partorg, rli_task task , rli_taskrev rev,
		RLR_REF supplierref, rfr_supplier supplier, rfr_supplier_org supplierorg,
		RLR_PRICE price, RLR_CURR currency, RLR_PURUOM uop, rlr_multiply confact,
		rlr_leadtime leadtime, rlr_price grossprice,  rlr_rtype rtype, rlr_tax tax
	FROM
		R5RFQLINERESPONSES, R5RFQRESPONSES, R5RFQLINES
	WHERE
		RFR_CODE = RLI_RFQ 
		AND  RFR_ORG = RLI_ORG 
		AND RFR_QUOTID	= RLR_QUOTID
		AND RLR_RFQ = RLI_RFQ
		AND RLR_RFQ_ORG	= RLI_ORG
		AND RLR_RFQLINE	= RLI_RFQLINE
		AND RLR_QUOTID = @cQuotid
		AND RLR_QUOTLINE = @cQuotline;
	begin
		/* Check mandatory parameters: lists */
		IF (@cQuotid IS NULL or @cQuotline IS NULL )
			begin
				set @sChk = N'1'
				RETURN
			end
		open c_lineinfo
			fetch next from c_lineinfo into 
				@sPart, @sPartOrg, @sService, @sRev, 
				@sSupplierRef, @sSupplier, @sSupplierOrg,
				@sPrice, @sCurrency, @sUOP, @sConFact,
				@sLeadTime, @sGrossPrice,  @sRType, @sTax
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin 
				if ( @sValid = 0)
				begin
					set @sValid = 1
				end
				/* check if Part line or Service line and update accordingly*/
				if (@sRType = N'PD' or @sRType = N'PS' or @sRType = N'RE' or @sRType is null)
				begin
					/* if part type is External Repair */
					IF(@sRType  = 'RE')
					begin
						Set @sTempRepairPrice = @sGrossPrice
						Set @sTempGrossPrice =  NULL
					end
					ELSE
					begin
						Set @sTempRepairPrice = NULL
						Set @sTempGrossPrice =  @sGrossPrice
					END
					SELECT	@sExists = N'1', 
							@sOldCatRef = CAT_REF
					FROM R5CATALOGUE
					WHERE
						CAT_PART = @sPart
						AND CAT_PART_ORG = @sPartOrg
						AND CAT_SUPPLIER	= @sSupplier
						AND CAT_SUPPLIER_ORG =	@sSupplierOrg
					IF ( @sExists =	N'1')
					begin
						IF ( @sOldCatRef IS NOT NULL )
							begin
								/* check if catalogreference record already Exists*/
								SELECT @sDupCatRefExists = N'1'	
								FROM R5CATALOGREFERENCES
								WHERE crf_reference = @sOldCatRef
								AND crf_part = @sPart  
								AND crf_part_org = @sPartOrg
								AND crf_supplier =  @sSupplier
								AND crf_supplier_org =	@sSupplierOrg
								IF(  @sDupCatRefExists = N'0' )
								begin
									/* insert alternate catalogreference record */
									INSERT INTO R5CATALOGREFERENCES	(
										crf_reference, crf_part, crf_part_org, 
										crf_supplier , crf_supplier_org, crf_notes)
									VALUES (
										@sOldCatRef, @sPart ,	 @sPartOrg,
										@sSupplier,  @sSupplierOrg, '-'
									)
								end
							end
							UPDATE r5catalogue
								SET
									CAT_REF		=	@sSupplierRef, 
									CAT_LEADTIME	=	@sLeadTime, 
									CAT_GROSS	=	@sTempGrossPrice, 
									CAT_CURR	=	@sCurrency, 
									CAT_PURUOM	=	@sUOP, 
									CAT_MULTIPLY	=	@sConFact,
									CAT_REPPRICE	=	@sTempRepairPrice,
									CAT_TAX		=	@sTax
								WHERE
									CAT_PART	=	@sPart
									AND	CAT_PART_ORG	=	@sPartOrg
									AND	CAT_SUPPLIER	=	@sSupplier
									AND	CAT_SUPPLIER_ORG =	@sSupplierOrg
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							INSERT INTO  r5catalogue ( 
									CAT_PART, CAT_PART_ORG, CAT_SUPPLIER, 	CAT_SUPPLIER_ORG,
									CAT_REF, CAT_LEADTIME, CAT_GROSS, CAT_CURR, 
									CAT_PURUOM, CAT_MULTIPLY, CAT_REPPRICE, CAT_TAX)
							VALUES (
									@sPart, @sPartOrg, @sSupplier, @sSupplierOrg,
									@sSupplierRef, @sLeadTime, @sTempGrossPrice, @sCurrency, 
									@sUOP, @sConFact, @sTempRepairPrice, @sTax
								)
						end
				end
				else 
				begin	
					if(@sRType = N'SH' or @sRType = N'SF' or @sRType = N'ST')
					begin
						set @sChk = N'3'
					end
				end
			end
		close c_lineinfo
		deallocate c_lineinfo 
		if ( @sValid = 0)
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end
	end
END

create procedure O7UPTACT	@nSessionid	integer
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sWLWEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sWLWMrc			nvarchar(15)
	declare @dWLWnewtarget		datetime
	declare @dWLWtarget			datetime

	declare @sWLAEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nWLAAct			numeric(8)
	declare @dWLANewstart			datetime
	declare @sWLANewtrade			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn			integer

	declare c_event cursor local for     SELECT wlw_event, wlw_mrc,wlw_newtarget, wlw_target
	FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders
	WHERE  wlw_sessionid   = @nSessionid
	AND    wlw_modified    = N'+'


	open c_event
	fetch next from c_event into	@sWLWEvent, @sWLWMrc, @dWLWnewtarget, @dWLWtarget

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			declare c_act cursor local for  SELECT a.wla_act
											FROM   r5tempworkloadactivities a
											WHERE  a.wla_event     = @sWLWEvent
											AND    a.wla_sessionid = @nSessionid
			open c_act
			fetch next from c_act into	@nWLAAct

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					UPDATE r5tempworkloadactivities 
					SET    wla_newstart = isnull(wla_actstart, wla_start) + ( @dWLWnewtarget - @dWLWtarget )
					WHERE  wla_event = @sWLWEvent
					AND    wla_act   = @nWLAAct

					fetch next from c_act into	@nWLAAct
				end
			close c_act
			deallocate c_act

			fetch next from c_event into	@sWLWEvent, @sWLWMrc, @dWLWnewtarget, @dWLWtarget
		end
	close c_event
	deallocate c_event

	-- re-create temp work load
	execute @nReturn = O7CRTWLD @nSessionid
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

CREATE PROCEDURE O7UPTBIX
 @sUsergroup nvarchar(12),
 @sPagename nvarchar(40),
 @sEdition nvarchar(1)

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

declare @nTabindex INTEGER
declare @nSQLIdentity BIGINT
declare @vMultipleEditions nvarchar(5);

BEGIN
 set @nTabindex = 10
 set @vMultipleEditions = N'FALSE'

 IF( @sUsergroup IN ( N'*', N'R5', N'CUSTOMCREATE' ) )
   BEGIN
     set @vMultipleEditions = N'TRUE'
   END

 DECLARE cLocal CURSOR local FOR SELECT plo_sqlidentity
 FROM   r5pagelayout
 WHERE  plo_usergroup=@sUsergroup
 AND    plo_pagename=@sPagename
 AND    plo_elementtype='F'
 AND    CASE @vMultipleEditions WHEN N'TRUE' THEN COALESCE(plo_meflag,N'E') ELSE N'NONE' END = CASE @vMultipleEditions WHEN N'TRUE' THEN COALESCE( @sEdition, N'E' ) ELSE N'NONE' END
 ORDER BY isnull(cast( replace (SUBSTRING( plo_fieldcontainer, charindex( '_',plo_fieldcontainer ) + 1, len(plo_fieldcontainer )- charindex( '_',plo_fieldcontainer ) + 1), N',', N'.') as numeric(24,10)),9999),
    isnull(plo_fieldgroup,9999),
    isnull(plo_positioningroup,9999),
    plo_elementid


 OPEN cLocal
 FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal INTO @nSQLIdentity
 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
   UPDATE r5pagelayout
   SET    plo_tabindex = @nTabindex
   WHERE  plo_sqlidentity = @nSQLIdentity
   set @nTabindex = @nTabindex + 10
   FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal INTO @nSQLIdentity
  END
 CLOSE cLocal
 DEALLOCATE cLocal

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7USERDEFINEDVIEW
  @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @action     NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @chk        NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @dropviewsql   NVARCHAR( 4000 )
  DECLARE @createviewsql NVARCHAR( 4000 )
  DECLARE @viewname      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sqlstmt       NVARCHAR( 4000 )

  SET @dropviewsql = N'DROP VIEW '
  SET @createviewsql = N'CREATE VIEW '
  SET @chk = N'0'
 
  /* Get view name */
  SELECT @viewname = uvw_name, 
         @sqlstmt   = uvw_stmt
  FROM   r5userviews
  WHERE  uvw_code   = @pk
  
  IF @viewname IS NULL
    RETURN
  
  SET @dropviewsql = @dropviewsql + @viewname
  SET @createviewsql = @createviewsql + @viewname + N' AS ' + @sqlstmt
  
  /* Inactivate User Defined View */
  IF @action = N'I' 
    BEGIN
      /* drop the view */
      EXEC (@dropviewsql)
    END

  /* Generate User Defined View*/  
  IF @action = N'G' 
    BEGIN
      /* create the view */
      EXEC (@createviewsql)
    
      /* set active flag */
      UPDATE r5userviews
      SET    uvw_active = N'+'
      WHERE  uvw_code  = @pk;
    END

END

CREATE function O7UZBUCL ()
returns  @tReturn table( bus_parent  nvarchar(17)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                         bus_code    nvarchar(17)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                         bus_node    nvarchar(3000) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                         bus_org     nvarchar(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                         bus_cal     nvarchar(2)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                         LevelID     int )
as
begin
    declare @nLevel     int
    declare @sCode      nvarchar(17)
    declare @sParent    nvarchar(17)
    declare @sNode      nvarchar(3000)
    declare @sOrg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCal       nvarchar(2)

    declare @tStack table ( bus_parent  nvarchar(17)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                            bus_code    nvarchar(17)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                            bus_node    nvarchar(3000) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                            bus_org     nvarchar(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                            bus_cal     nvarchar(2)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                            LevelID     int  )

/*NOTE:  SQL Server does not have an equivilant to SIBLING SORT.  So we need to keep
a string that has the hierarchy nodes.  This will allow us to sort on this string.
Only limitation is that the sort could fail if the heirarchy is extremely 
deep due to the limit on the string. */

    INSERT INTO @tStack 
    select  isnull(bus_parent,''),
            bus_code,
            case when bus_parent is null then '' else '1#' + bus_parent end,
            bus_org,
            bus_cal,
            1 
    from  R5BUDGETSTRUCTURE
    where bus_parent IS NULL

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        begin
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                begin
                    select  @sParent  = bus_parent,
                            @sCode    = bus_code,
                            @sNode    = bus_node,
                            @sOrg     = bus_org,
                            @sCal     = bus_cal
                    from  @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                    insert into @tReturn values ( @sParent, @sCode, case when @sNode = '' then '1#' + @sCode ELSE @sNode  + '#' + cast(@nLevel as nvarchar(38)) + '#' + @sCode END, @sOrg, @sCal, @nLevel )
                    delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND bus_code = @sCode
                    insert into @tStack select isnull(bus_parent, ''),
                                               bus_code,
                                               case when @sNode = '' then '1#' + @sCode else @sNode  + '#' + cast(@nLevel as nvarchar(38)) + '#' + @sCode end,
                                               bus_org,
                                               bus_cal,
                                               @nLevel + 1
                                        from  R5BUDGETSTRUCTURE
                                        where bus_parent = @sCode 
                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                end
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        end

    return
end

create procedure O7VALVALID @sReturn        nvarchar(5)     OUTPUT,
                            @sValue         nvarchar(64)    OUTPUT,
                            @sDatatype      nvarchar(8),
                            @sDateformat    nvarchar(64) = null
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @dValue         datetime
    declare @sDatestring    nvarchar(64)

    set @sReturn = N'FALSE'

    if @sDatatype in ( N'CODE', N'RENT', N'CHAR' )
        begin
            set @sReturn = N'TRUE'
            return
        end

    if @sDatatype = N'NUM'
        begin
            if isnumeric( @sValue ) = 1
                set @sReturn = N'TRUE'
            return
        end

    if @sDatatype in ( N'DATE', N'DATI' ) and @sDateformat is not null
        begin
            set @dValue = dbo.to_date( @sValue, @sDateformat )
            if @@ERROR <> 0  --I don't think SQL Server will trap this error but we will try
                return

            set @sDatestring = dbo.f_date_to_char( @dValue, @sDateformat )
            if @@ERROR <> 0  --I don't think SQL Server will trap this error but we will try
                return

            set @sValue = @sDatestring

            --Not sure what Oracle is trying to do here but we will do it as well.
            if len( @sDatestring ) <> len( @sValue )
                return

            set @sReturn = N'TRUE'
        end

CREATE FUNCTION o7vmrsclasses(@pvmrscode nvarchar(30)) RETURNS INT AS 
BEGIN
    DECLARE @recordcount    INT

  SELECT @recordcount = COUNT(*) 
  FROM   r5codestructureclasses  cs
  WHERE EXISTS  (SELECT 1 FROM 
         ( SELECT csl_code,csl_rentity,csl_class,csl_class_org
         FROM   r5codestructureclasses
         WHERE  csl_code = @pvmrscode  
         UNION
         SELECT csl_code,csl_rentity,csl_class,csl_class_org
         FROM   r5codestructureclasses l, r5codestructure p, r5codestructure c
         WHERE  csl_code            = p.csr_code
         AND    p.csr_rentity       = c.csr_rentity
         AND    p.csr_structure     = SUBSTRING( c.csr_structure, 1, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure) = 0 THEN LEN(c.csr_structure) ELSE CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure)- 1  END)
         AND    csl_applytochildren = '+'
         AND    c.csr_code          = @pvmrscode  
         AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
                             FROM   r5codestructureclasses l2 
                             WHERE  l2.csl_rentity   = l.csl_rentity
                             AND    l2.csl_class     = l.csl_class
                             AND    l2.csl_class_org = l.csl_class_org
                             AND    l2.csl_code      = @pvmrscode ) 
         UNION
         SELECT csl_code,csl_rentity,csl_class,csl_class_org 
         FROM   r5codestructureclasses l, r5codestructure p, r5codestructure c
         WHERE  csl_code            = p.csr_code
         AND    p.csr_rentity       = c.csr_rentity
         AND    p.csr_structure     = SUBSTRING( c.csr_structure, 1,CASE WHEN CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure) = 0  THEN LEN(c.csr_structure) ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure, CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure)+1)-1 > 0 THEN CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure, CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure)+1)-1 ELSE CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure)- 1  END  END)
         AND    csl_applytochildren = '+'
         AND    c.csr_code          = @pvmrscode  
         AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
                             FROM   r5codestructureclasses l2 
                             WHERE  l2.csl_rentity   = l.csl_rentity
                             AND    l2.csl_class     = l.csl_class
                             AND    l2.csl_class_org = l.csl_class_org
                             AND    l2.csl_code      = @pvmrscode  
                             UNION
                             SELECT 1
                             FROM   r5codestructureclasses l3, r5codestructure p, r5codestructure c
                             WHERE  csl_code            = p.csr_code
                             AND    p.csr_rentity       = c.csr_rentity
                             AND    p.csr_structure     = SUBSTRING( c.csr_structure, 1, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure) = 0 THEN LEN(c.csr_structure) ELSE CHARINDEX ( '.',c.csr_structure)- 1  END)
                             AND    csl_applytochildren = '+'
                             AND    l3.csl_rentity      = l.csl_rentity
                             AND    l3.csl_class        = l.csl_class
                             AND    l3.csl_class_org    = l.csl_class_org
                             AND    c.csr_code          = @pvmrscode ) ) s  WHERE  s.csl_code+'#'+s.csl_rentity+'#'+s.csl_class+'#'+s.csl_class_org = cs.csl_code+'#'+cs.csl_rentity+'#'+cs.csl_class+'#'+cs.csl_class_org )

  DECLARE @docmaxstockamount        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  DECLARE @actcode                  NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @actact                   NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @actmat                   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actlab                   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @acthir                   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actdma                   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actfix                   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @acttool                  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actmisc                  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @hours                    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @exchrate                 NUMERIC( 24, 12 ) 
  DECLARE @x                        NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @return                   INT
  
  SET @exchrate = 1
  
  /* Retrieve warranty data. */
  SELECT @wclwarranty         = wcl_warranty, 
         @wclevent            = wcl_event, 
         @wclorg              = wcl_org, 
         @claimcurr           = o1.org_curr, 
         @warrantycurr        = o2.org_curr,
         @doclabcharge        = doc_labcharge,
         @docmatcharge        = doc_matcharge,
         @dochircharge        = doc_hircharge,
         @docdmacharge        = doc_dmacharge,
         @docservicecharge    = doc_servicecharge,
         @doctoolcharge       = doc_toolcharge,
         @docfixedlaborrate   = doc_fixedlaborrate,
         @docfixedlaboramount = doc_fixedlaboramount,
         @docfixedstockamount = doc_fixedstockamount,
         @docmaxlaboramount   = doc_maxlaboramount,
         @docmaxstockamount   = doc_maxstockamount
  FROM   r5organization o1,
         r5warclaims 
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5documents 
                         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization o2 ON ( o2.org_code = doc_org ) ON ( doc_code = wcl_warranty )
  WHERE  o1.org_code = wcl_org
  AND    wcl_code    = @claim
  AND    wcl_rstatus = N'U'
  
  IF @wclevent IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN

      IF @recalc = N'-'
        /* Delete old data first. */
        DELETE FROM r5warclaimactivities
        WHERE  wca_claim = @claim

      IF @claimcurr <> @warrantycurr
        /* Retrieve exchange rate. */
        SET @exchrate = dbo.o7gtexch2( @warrantycurr, @wclorg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) )

      DECLARE act CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR   
        SELECT act_act
        FROM   r5activities
        WHERE  act_event    = @wclevent
        AND    act_warranty = N'+'
        AND    act_act      = ISNULL( @activity, act_act )
        AND    @recalc      = N'-'
        AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                           FROM   r5warclaims, r5warclaimactivities
                           WHERE  wcl_code     = wca_claim
                           AND    wcl_event    = act_event
                           AND    wca_act      = act_act
                           AND    wcl_rstatus <> N'J' )
        UNION
        SELECT wca_act
        FROM   r5warclaimactivities
        WHERE  wca_claim = @claim
        AND    @recalc   = N'+'
      OPEN act
      FETCH NEXT FROM act INTO @actact
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @actcode = @wclevent + N'#' + CAST( @actact AS NVARCHAR )
          SET @actmat  = NULL
          SET @actlab  = NULL
          SET @acthir  = NULL
          SET @actdma  = NULL
          SET @actfix  = NULL 
          SET @acttool = NULL
          /* Attach activity to claim, if not done so yet. */ 
          INSERT INTO r5warclaimactivities( wca_claim, wca_act )
          SELECT @claim, @actact 
          FROM   dual
          WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
                            FROM   r5warclaimactivities
                            WHERE  wca_claim = @claim
                            AND    wca_act   = @actact )
          /* Get labor costs. */
          IF @docfixedlaboramount IS NOT NULL AND @exchrate IS NOT NULL
            /* Use fixed labor amount, if specified. */
            SET @actlab = @docfixedlaboramount / @exchrate
          ELSE
            BEGIN
              IF @docfixedlaborrate IS NOT NULL AND @exchrate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  /* Retrieve number of hours worked, own labor. */
                  SELECT @hours = SUM( boo_hours )
                  FROM   r5activities, r5bookedhours
                  WHERE  act_event = boo_event
                  AND    act_act   = boo_act
                  AND    boo_event = @wclevent
                  AND    boo_act   = @actact
                  AND    NOT ( boo_misc = '+' and boo_ocrtype = N'O' )
                  AND    NOT ( boo_misc = '+' and boo_ocrtype = N'X' )
                  AND    ( act_order IS NULL OR boo_misc = N'I')
                  SET @actlab = @hours * ( @docfixedlaborrate / @exchrate )

                  /* Retrieve number of hours worked, hired labor. */
                  SELECT @hours = SUM( boo_hours )
                  FROM   r5activities, r5bookedhours
                  WHERE  act_event = boo_event
                  AND    act_act   = boo_act
                  AND    boo_event = @wclevent
                  AND    boo_act   = @actact
                  AND    (( boo_misc  = N'+' AND boo_ocrtype = N'O') OR 
                          (boo_misc  = N'-'
                           AND    act_order IS NOT NULL
                           AND    boo_order IS NULL
                           AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                                              FROM   r5orderlines
                                              WHERE  orl_event    = boo_event
                                              AND    orl_act      = boo_act
                                              AND    orl_rtype    = N'SF'
                                              AND    orl_rstatus <> N'R' )))
                  SET @acthir = @hours * ( @docfixedlaborrate / @exchrate )
                END  
              ELSE  
                BEGIN
                  /* Use actual costs. */      
                  EXECUTE @return = o7actlab N'ACT', @actcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @actlab OUTPUT, @x OUTPUT
                  EXECUTE @return = o7acthir N'ACT', @actcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @acthir OUTPUT, @x OUTPUT
                END 

              EXECUTE @return = o7actfix N'ACT', @actcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @actfix OUTPUT, @x OUTPUT

              IF @doclabcharge IS NOT NULL
                /* Apply labor percentage. */
                SET @actlab = @actlab * @doclabcharge / 100
              IF @dochircharge IS NOT NULL
                /* Apply hired percentage. */
                SET @acthir = @acthir * @dochircharge / 100
              IF @docservicecharge IS NOT NULL
                /* Apply service percentage. */
                SET @actfix = @actfix * @docservicecharge / 100
              IF @docmaxlaboramount IS NOT NULL AND @exchrate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  /* Apply maximum labor amount. */
                  SET @actlab = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( @actlab, @docmaxlaboramount / @exchrate )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WARCLAIMS_LINESRECORDS(
  @claim    NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @act      NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @linetype NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @value    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @pk     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @pkchar NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return INT
  DECLARE @chk    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  IF ISNULL( @value, 0 ) > 0
    BEGIN
      /* Check whether line record already exists. */
      SELECT @pk = wln_pk
      FROM   r5warclaimlines
      WHERE  wln_claim  = @claim
      AND    wln_act    = @act
      AND    wln_type   = @linetype
      AND    wln_system = N'+'
      IF @pk IS NOT NULL
        UPDATE r5warclaimlines
        SET    wln_amount = @value
        WHERE  wln_pk     = @pk
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @pkchar OUTPUT, N'WLN', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
          SET @pk = CAST( @pkchar AS NUMERIC )
          INSERT INTO r5warclaimlines( wln_pk, wln_claim, wln_act, wln_type, wln_amount, wln_include, wln_system )
          VALUES( @pk, @claim, @act, @linetype, @value, N'+', N'+' )
        END  
    END
  ELSE
    DELETE FROM r5warclaimlines
    WHERE  wln_claim  = @claim
    AND    wln_act    = @act
    AND    wln_type   = @linetype
    AND    wln_system = N'+'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WARPC2
	@sProject		nvarchar(20),
	@sProjbud		nvarchar(20),
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nPrntamt		numeric(24,6)		
	declare @nTotpclamt		numeric(24,6)    
	declare @nPrjactbud		numeric(24,6)    
BEGIN
	set @sChk			= N'0'
	set @nTotpclamt		= 0.00

   /* Check mandatory parameters */
	if @sProject  IS  NULL OR @sProjbud  IS  NULL  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5projbudclasses p
	WHERE  p.pcl_project = @sProject
	AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nPrntamt = p.pcl_amount
		FROM   r5projbudclasses p
		WHERE  p.pcl_project = @sProject
		AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
	else
		return


	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5projbudclasses p,
		 r5projects r
	WHERE  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
	AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
	AND    r.prj_parent  = @sProject

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nTotpclamt = SUM( coalesce( p.pcl_amount, 0 ) )
		FROM   r5projbudclasses p,
		r5projects r
		WHERE  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
		AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
		AND    r.prj_parent  = @sProject
	else
		return

	if @nTotpclamt > @nPrntamt 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

   /* - If Sum of Budget Amounts of all Project Budget Classes >  */
   /*   Project Budget Issue a Warning                            */

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5projbudclasses p
	WHERE  p.pcl_project = @sProject

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nTotpclamt = SUM( coalesce( p.pcl_amount,  0 ) )
		FROM   r5projbudclasses p
		WHERE  p.pcl_project = @sProject
	else
		return

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5projects p
	WHERE  p.prj_code = @sProject

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nPrjactbud = coalesce( p.prj_actbud,  0 )
		FROM   r5projects p
		WHERE  p.prj_code = @sProject
	else
		return

	if @nTotpclamt > @nPrjactbud 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			return
		end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WARPCL
	@sInsupd		nvarchar(4),
	@sProject		nvarchar(20),
	@sProjbud		nvarchar(20),
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT  
AS SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sParent			nvarchar(20)			
	declare @nPrntamt		numeric(24,6)		
	declare @nPclamount		numeric(24,6)		
	declare @nTotpclamt		numeric(24,6)    
	declare @nPrjactbud		numeric(24,6)    
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
BEGIN
	set @sChk			= N'0'
	set @sCheckresult	= N'0'
	set @nTotpclamt		= 0.00
	set @sX				= NULL
	set @nCount			= 0

	if ( @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) )
	OR @sInsupd    IS  NULL
	OR @sProject  IS  NULL
	OR @sProjbud  IS  NULL  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	if @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			SELECT @nCount = count(*) 
			FROM   r5projects r
			WHERE  r.prj_code = @sProject

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sParent = r.prj_parent
				FROM   r5projects r
				WHERE  r.prj_code = @sProject
			else
				return

			if @sParent IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @nCount = count(*) 
					FROM   r5projbudclasses p
					WHERE  p.pcl_project = @sParent
					AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud

					if @nCount > 0 
						SELECT @nPrntamt= p.pcl_amount
						FROM   r5projbudclasses p
						WHERE  p.pcl_project = @sParent
						AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
					else
						return
					

					SELECT @nCount = count(*) 
					FROM   r5projbudclasses p,
					r5projects r
					WHERE  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
					AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
					AND    r.prj_parent  = @sParent

					if @nCount > 0 
						SELECT @nTotpclamt = SUM( coalesce( p.pcl_amount, 0 ) )
						FROM   r5projbudclasses p,
						r5projects r
						WHERE  p.pcl_project = r.prj_code
						AND    p.pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
						AND    r.prj_parent  = @sParent
					else
						return


					if @nTotpclamt > @nPrntamt 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'4'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end
end

create procedure O7WDACTJ_GETRATES @sPAct_hire         nvarchar(3),
                    @sPAct_mrc          nvarchar(15),
                    @nPAct_ntrate       numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                    @sPAct_order        nvarchar(30),
                    @nPAct_otrate       numeric(24,6)OUTPUT,
                    @dPAct_start        datetime,
                    @sPAct_supplier     nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
                    @sPAct_supplier_org nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
                    @sPAct_trade        nvarchar(15),
                    @sPEvt_org          nvarchar(15),
                    @sSupplier         nvarchar(30),
                    @sSupplier_org     nvarchar(15)  
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

begin

	if @sPAct_hire = N'+' AND @sPAct_order IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sPAct_supplier = coalesce( @sSupplier, N'*' )
			set @sPAct_supplier_org = coalesce( @sSupplier_org, N'*' )
		end


		SELECT @nPAct_ntrate = t.trr_ntrate
		FROM   r5traderates t
		WHERE  t.trr_mrc      IN ( N'*', @sPAct_mrc )
		AND    t.trr_trade     = @sPAct_trade
		AND    t.trr_supplier_org IN ( N'*', @sPAct_supplier_org )
		AND    t.trr_supplier IN ( N'*', @sPAct_supplier )
		AND    t.trr_org       = @sPEvt_org
		AND    t.trr_start    <= @dPAct_start
		AND    t.trr_end      >= @dPAct_start
		AND    t.trr_octype   IN (SELECT uco_code
								  FROM r5ucodes
								  WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
								  AND   uco_rcode   = N'N'
								  AND   uco_system  = N'+')
		ORDER BY CASE t.trr_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN  N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC,
					CASE t.trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN  N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC

		If @@ROWCOUNT < 1
			set @nPAct_ntrate = 0



		SELECT @nPAct_otrate = t.trr_ntrate
		FROM   r5traderates t
		WHERE  t.trr_mrc      IN ( N'*', @sPAct_mrc )
		AND    t.trr_trade     = @sPAct_trade
		AND    t.trr_supplier_org IN ( N'*', @sPAct_supplier_org )
		AND    t.trr_supplier IN ( N'*', @sPAct_supplier )
		AND    t.trr_org       = @sPEvt_org
		AND    t.trr_start    <= @dPAct_start
		AND    t.trr_end      >= @dPAct_start
		AND    t.trr_octype   IN (SELECT uco_code
								  FROM r5ucodes
								  WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
								  AND   uco_rcode   = N'O'
								  AND   uco_system  = N'+')
		ORDER BY CASE t.trr_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN  N'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ' ELSE t.trr_supplier END,
					CASE t.trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN  N'ZZZZ' ELSE t.trr_mrc END

		If @@ROWCOUNT < 1
			set @nPAct_otrate = 0
end
