create procedure O7WDACTJ_GETTASKPRICE @dAct_start           datetime,
                        @sCtrl2_supplier      nvarchar(30),
                        @sCtrl2_supplier_org  nvarchar(15),
                        @nCtrl2_exch          numeric(24,6),
                        @sCtrl2_currency      nvarchar(3),
                        @sCtrl3_task          nvarchar(20),
                        @sCtrl3_type          nvarchar(4),
                        @sCtrl3_taskrev       numeric(24,6),
                        @sEvt_org             nvarchar(15),
                        @sEvt_mrc             nvarchar(15),
                        @nCtrl3_actqty        numeric(24,6),
                        @nCtrl3_hours         numeric(24,6),
                        @nCtrl3_exch          numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                        @sCtrl3_currency      nvarchar(3) OUTPUT,
                        @nCtrl3_price         numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                        @nCtrl3_ntrate        numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                        @sCtrl3_trade         nvarchar(15),
                        @sGlobal_basecurr     nvarchar(37)  
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nActqty    numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRate      numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPrice     numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTaskprice numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours     numeric(24,6)
	declare @nExch      numeric(24,6)
	declare @nConv      numeric(24,6)
	declare @sCurr      nvarchar(3)	--r5currencies.cur_code%TYPE
	declare	@nReturn	integer
	declare @nBaseCurr	numeric(24,12)

	set @nActqty = coalesce( @nCtrl3_actqty, 1 )

	if @nCtrl3_price IS NOT NULL 
		RETURN

	SELECT @nTaskprice = p.tpr_price,
		 @nHours = coalesce( t.tsk_hours, 1 )
	FROM   r5taskprices p left outer join r5tasks t on t.tsk_code  = p.tpr_task and t.tsk_revision = p.tpr_revision and @sCtrl2_supplier_org = p.tpr_org
	WHERE  t.tsk_code             = @sCtrl3_task
	AND    t.tsk_revision         = @sCtrl3_taskrev

	if coalesce( @sCtrl2_supplier, N'*' ) <> N'*' 
		begin
			set @nBaseCurr = Convert(numeric(24,12), @sGlobal_basecurr)
			SELECT @nPrice = sca_price,
				 @sCurr = sca_curr,
				 @nExch = coalesce ( dbo.o7gtexch2 ( @nBaseCurr, @sEvt_org, coalesce ( @dAct_start, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sEvt_org), N'DD' ) ) ), 1),
				 @nConv = coalesce( sca_multiply, 1 ) 
			FROM   r5servicecatalogue
			WHERE  sca_task         = @sCtrl3_task
			AND    sca_supplier     = @sCtrl2_supplier
			AND    sca_supplier_org = @sCtrl2_supplier_org


			if coalesce( @sCtrl3_type, N'ST' ) = N'ST' 
				set @nRate = ROUND( @nPrice / @nConv / @nHours, 2 )
			else
				set @nRate = ROUND( @nPrice / @nConv * @nActqty, 2 )

			set @nCtrl3_exch     = @nExch
			set @sCtrl3_currency = @sCurr
		end

	if @nRate IS NULL 
		begin
			if coalesce( @sCtrl3_type, N'ST' ) = N'ST' 
				set @nRate = ROUND( @nTaskprice / @nHours, 2 )
			else
				set @nRate = ROUND( @nTaskprice * @nActqty, 2 )

			set @nCtrl3_exch     = @nCtrl2_exch
			set @sCtrl3_currency = @sCtrl2_currency
		end


	if @nRate IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7WDACTJ_GETRATES2 @dAct_start,    @sCtrl2_supplier, @sCtrl2_supplier_org , @nCtrl3_ntrate OUTPUT, @sCtrl3_trade, @sEvt_mrc, @sEvt_org 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

	set @nCtrl3_price = coalesce( coalesce( @nRate, ROUND( @nCtrl3_ntrate * coalesce( @nCtrl2_exch, 1 ), 2 ) ), 0 )

                       @sMlp_part      nvarchar(30),
                       @sMlp_part_org  nvarchar(15),
                       @sPart          nvarchar(255) OUTPUT,
                       @sUom           nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,

                       @sMlp_req       nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
                       @sMlp_direct    nvarchar(4),
                       @sEvt_code      nvarchar(30),
                       @sAct_act       nvarchar(8),
                       @sPic_code      nvarchar(30) OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nReturn		integer

	set @sPart = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'PART', @sMlp_part + N'#' + @sMlp_part_org, null, null )

	execute @nReturn = O7WDACTJ_GETUOM @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @sUom OUTPUT, @sCommodity OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	if @sMlp_direct = N'+' 
		SELECT @sMlp_req = rql_req
		FROM   r5requislines
		WHERE  rql_event = @sEvt_code
		AND    rql_act   = @sAct_act

	FROM   r5picklists l,r5picklistparts p
	WHERE  l.pic_event = @sEvt_code
	AND    l.pic_act   = @sAct_act
	AND    p.pip_part_org = @sMlp_part_org

create procedure O7WDACTJ_UPPRICEANDDDISC 
						@sOrdorg      nvarchar(15),
						@sOrd_code     nvarchar(30),
						@sOrd_contract nvarchar(30),
						@sOrd_exch     nvarchar(37),
						@sCom_curr     nvarchar(3),
						@sOrd_curr     nvarchar(3),
						@sCom_minord   numeric(24,6),
						@sCom_maxord   numeric(24,6)  
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nDiscount       numeric(24,6) --r5orders.ord_discount%TYPE   = 0
	declare @nOrdprice       numeric(24,6) --r5orders.ord_price%TYPE      = 0
	declare @nDiscperc       numeric(24,6) --r5orders.ord_discperc%TYPE   = 0
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReturn		integer
begin
	
	set @nDiscount = 0
	set @nOrdprice = 0
	set @nDiscperc = 0

	SELECT @nOrdprice = ROUND( SUM( coalesce(orl_price,0 ) / coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) *
			  ( coalesce( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN  1 ELSE orl_ordqty END, 0 ) / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) * 
			  ( 1 - 0.01 * coalesce( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) ), 2),
		 @nDiscount = ROUND( SUM( ( coalesce( orl_price, 0 ) /
				coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) *
			  ( coalesce( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN  1 ELSE orl_ordqty END, 0 ) /
				coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) ) -
				coalesce( orl_price, 0 ) /
				coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) *
			  ( coalesce( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN  1 ELSE orl_ordqty END,0 ) /
				coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) *
			  ( 1 - 0.01 * coalesce( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) ), 2)
	FROM   r5orderlines
	WHERE  orl_order_org = @sOrdorg
	AND    orl_order = @sOrd_code

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
		begin
			set @nOrdprice = @nOrdprice * coalesce( convert(numeric(24,12),@sOrd_exch) , 1 )
			set @nDiscount = @nDiscount * coalesce( convert(numeric(24,12),@sOrd_exch), 1 )

			execute @nReturn = R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF @sTemp OUTPUT, N'MODULE', N'C'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			if @sTemp = N'+' 
				SELECT @nDiscperc = MAX(cdi_disperc)
				FROM   r5condiscounts
				WHERE  cdi_contract = @sOrd_contract
				AND    cdi_rtype    = N'O'
				AND    cdi_value   <= @nOrdprice
		end


	if  @sCom_curr = @sOrd_curr AND @nOrdprice NOT BETWEEN @sCom_minord AND @sCom_maxord 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PDPORP', N'FORM', 14
			return -1
		end

	UPDATE r5orders
	SET    ord_price    = @nOrdprice,
		 ord_discount = @nDiscount,
		 ord_discperc = @nDiscperc
	WHERE  ord_org      = @sOrdorg
	AND    ord_code     = @sOrd_code
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7WLSPREV_GET_EQUIP_CHILD_HIERARCHY ( @sParent nvarchar(30), @sParentorg nvarchar(15) )
RETURNS @tReturn TABLE( stc_child  nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_child_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_parent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_parent_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  )
AS
BEGIN
   DECLARE @nLevel         int
   DECLARE @sChild         nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @sChildorg      nvarchar(15)

   DECLARE @tStack TABLE ( stc_child nvarchar(30),
                           stc_child_org nvarchar(15),
                           stc_parent nvarchar(30),
                           stc_parent_org nvarchar(15),
                           LevelID int )

   INSERT INTO @tStack
      SELECT stc_child,
             stc_child_org,
             stc_parent,
             stc_parent_org,
             1
         FROM r5structures
         WHERE	stc_parent = @sParent
         AND   stc_parent_org = @sParentorg

   SET @nLevel = 1

   WHILE( @nLevel > 0 )
      BEGIN
         IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
            BEGIN
               SELECT @sChild = stc_child,
                       @sChildorg = stc_child_org,
                       @sParent = stc_parent,
                       @sParentorg = stc_parent_org
                  FROM	@tStack
                  WHERE LevelID = @nLevel
               INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES ( @sChild, @sChildorg, @sParent, @sParentorg )
               DELETE FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sChild AND stc_child_org = @sChildorg
               INSERT INTO @tStack	SELECT stc_child,
                                           stc_child_org,
                                           stc_parent,
                                           stc_parent_org,
                                           @nLevel + 1
                                       FROM r5structures
                                       WHERE	stc_parent = @sChild
                                       AND   stc_parent_org = @sChildorg
               IF( @@ROWCOUNT > 0 )
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            END
         ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END

   RETURN
END

body:
create PROCEDURE O7WMBWOG_O7WORKPACKAGE
  @sSessionId   nvarchar(20),
  @sMrc         nvarchar(15),
  @sJobstatus   nvarchar(1),
  @nPeriod      numeric(8,0),
  @sJobtype     nvarchar(8),
  @sObject      nvarchar(30),
  @sWorkpackage nvarchar(24),
  @dEnddate     datetime,
  @sOrg         nvarchar(15),
  @sR5user      nvarchar(255),
  @sSelinkit    nvarchar(4) = N'+',
  @sR5role      nvarchar(30) = N'*'
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
  declare @sJob               nvarchar(30)  --r5events.evt_code%TYPE
  declare @sCertype           nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_rtype%TYPE
  declare @sEtype             nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_type%TYPE
  declare @sUstatus           nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_status%TYPE
  declare @sRstatus           nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE
  declare @nWorkday           numeric(24,0)
  declare @dDuedate           datetime
  declare @dDormstart         datetime
  declare @dDormend           datetime
  declare @dDormstart_obj     datetime
  declare @dDormend_obj       datetime
  declare @sDormreuse_obj     nvarchar(1)

  declare @nReturn            integer
  declare @sCode_wpk          nvarchar(24)
  declare @sDesc_wpk          nvarchar(80)
  declare @sOrg_wpk           nvarchar(15)
  declare @sJobtype_wpk       nvarchar(8)
  declare @sStatus_wpk        nvarchar(4)
  declare @sMrc_wpk           nvarchar(15)
  declare @sPpmtype_wpk       nvarchar(1)
  declare @sObject_wpk        nvarchar(30)
  declare @sObject_org_wpk    nvarchar(15)
  declare @dDuedate_wpk       datetime
  declare @nFreq_wpk          numeric(8,0)
  declare @nDuration_wpk      numeric(8,0)
  declare @sPerioduom_wpk     nvarchar(10)
  declare @sPerformonweek_wpk	  nvarchar(1)
  declare @nPerformonday_wpk      numeric(1,0)
  declare @dV_due                 datetime
  declare @nCnt       numeric
  declare @sSyskit1           nvarchar(200)

  execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sSyskit1 OUTPUT, N'SYSKIT1', @sChk OUTPUT
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

  execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @nWorkday OUTPUT, N'WORKDAY', @sChk OUTPUT
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

    set @nWorkday = coalesce( @nWorkday, 8 )

  if @sJobstatus <> N'%'
    begin
      set @sChk = N'0'
      execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sJobstatus, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
      if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

      if @sRstatus <> N'R' OR @sChk <> N'0'
        set @sUstatus = N'%'
      else
        set @sUstatus = @sJobstatus
    end
  else
    set @sUstatus = N'%'

  SELECT @nCnt = ISNULL( MAX(CAST(substring(tev_code, 4,30) AS NUMERIC)),0)
  FROM r5tempwmbwog
  WHERE tev_sessionid = @sSessionId
  AND   tev_code LIKE N'WOG%';

  set @sCertype = N'PPM'
  execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCertype OUTPUT, @sEtype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

  --Fix the outer join syntax here....
  declare c_wpkl cursor local for SELECT wpk_code, wpk_desc, wpk_org, wpk_jobtype, wpk_status,
                         wpk_mrc, wpk_ppmtype, wpk_object,
                         wpk_object_org, wpk_duedate, wpk_freq,wpk_perioduom, wpk_performonweek, wpk_performonday,
                         obj_dormstart, obj_dormend, obj_dormreuse
                      FROM   r5objects,
                         r5workpackages Left outer join r5events on wpk_lastevent = evt_code
                      WHERE  obj_code      = wpk_object
                      AND    obj_org       = wpk_object_org
                      AND    wpk_mrc      LIKE @sMrc
                      AND    wpk_freq   = CASE @nPeriod WHEN 0 THEN wpk_freq ELSE @nPeriod END
                      AND    wpk_jobtype  LIKE @sJobtype
                      AND    wpk_object   LIKE @sObject
                      AND    wpk_code     LIKE @sWorkpackage
                      AND    wpk_org      LIKE @sOrg
                      AND  ( wpk_ppmtype  = N'D' OR coalesce( evt_rstatus, N'C' ) = N'C' )
                      AND    wpk_duedate <= @dEnddate
                      AND  ( obj_rstatus <> N'D' OR ( @sSelinkit = N'+' AND obj_status = @sSyskit1 ) )
                      AND EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                             FROM   r5userorganization
                             WHERE  uog_org  = wpk_org
                             AND    uog_user = @sR5user 
                             AND    uog_role = @sR5role )
                      AND EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                             FROM   r5ppms p, r5ppmobjects o
                             WHERE  ppo_package      = wpk_code
                             AND    p.ppm_code       = o.ppo_ppm
                             AND    p.ppm_revision   = o.ppo_revision
                             AND    p.ppm_package    = N'+'
                             AND    p.ppm_revrstatus = N'A' )
  open c_wpkl -- (i)
  fetch next from c_wpkl into @sCode_wpk, @sDesc_wpk, @sOrg_wpk, @sJobtype_wpk, @sStatus_wpk, @sMrc_wpk,
                @sPpmtype_wpk, @sObject_wpk, @sObject_org_wpk, @dDuedate_wpk,
                @nFreq_wpk, @sPerioduom_wpk, @sPerformonweek_wpk, @nPerformonday_wpk, @dDormstart_obj, @dDormend_obj, @sDormreuse_obj
  while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
      set @dDuedate = @dDuedate_wpk

      /* Loop for duplication */
      while @dDuedate <= @dEnddate
        begin
          /* Calculate dormant @nPeriod. */
          set @dDormstart = coalesce( @dDormstart_obj, @dDuedate + 100 )
          set @dDormend   = coalesce( @dDormend_obj,   @dDuedate + 100 )
          if @sDormreuse_obj = N'+'
            begin
              WHILE @dDormend < @dDuedate
                begin
                  set @dDormstart = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDormstart, 12 )
                  set @dDormend   = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDormend, 12 )
                end
            end

          if @sPerformonweek_wpk is not null
            set @dV_due = dbo.o7gtdate(@dDuedate, @sPerformonweek_wpk, @nPerformonday_wpk)
          else
            set @dV_due = @dDuedate

          if @dV_due NOT BETWEEN @dDormstart AND @dDormend
            begin
              /* Get next @sJob number. */
              SET @nCnt = @nCnt + 1
              SET @sJob = N'WOG' + CAST(@nCnt AS nvarchar)

              /* Do insert of parent event. */
              INSERT INTO r5tempwmbwog
                ( tev_code,
                tev_desc,
                tev_target,
                tev_object,
                tev_object_org,
                tev_isstype  ,
                tev_sessionid,
                tev_freq,
                tev_status,
                tev_package,
                tev_org,
                tev_mrc,
                tev_inkit)
              VALUES(
                @sJob,
                @sDesc_wpk,
                @dV_due,
                @sObject_wpk,
                @sObject_org_wpk,
                @sPpmtype_wpk,
                @sSessionId,
                @nFreq_wpk,
                @sStatus_wpk,
                @sCode_wpk,
                @sOrg_wpk,
                @sMrc_wpk,
                @sSelinkit)

            end  -- @dDuedate NOT BETWEEN @dDormstart AND @dDormend

            if @sPpmtype_wpk = N'D'
              set @dDuedate = @dDuedate + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nFreq_wpk, @sPerioduom_wpk, @dDuedate )
            else
              /* Exit duplication loop */
              BREAK
        end  -- @dDuedate <= @dEnddate
      fetch next from c_wpkl into @sCode_wpk, @sDesc_wpk, @sOrg_wpk, @sJobtype_wpk, @sStatus_wpk, @sMrc_wpk,
              @sPpmtype_wpk,@sObject_wpk, @sObject_org_wpk, @dDuedate_wpk, @nFreq_wpk, @sPerioduom_wpk, @sPerformonweek_wpk, @nPerformonday_wpk,
              @dDormstart_obj, @dDormend_obj, @sDormreuse_obj

    end --c_wpkl
  close c_wpkl
  deallocate c_wpkl


-- ========================================

name: O7WMBWOG_X5CRTEVT

create procedure O7WMBWOG_X5CRTEVT
  @sP_neweventno    nvarchar(27),
  @sP_ppmcode       nvarchar(30),
  @nP_revision      numeric(4),
  @nP_ppo_pk        numeric(18,0),
  @dP_due           datetime,
  @sP_ppopk         nvarchar(18),
  @nP_sessionid     numeric(18),
  @sP_selinkit      nvarchar(4),
  @sP_chk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @nV_ppmrev          numeric(4)  --r5events.evt_ppmrev%type    /* Approved PPM rev          */
  declare @nV_ppopk           numeric(38,0) --r5events.evt_ppopk%type     /* PPO primary key           */
  declare @sV_object          nvarchar(30)  --r5events.evt_object%type    /* Object                    */
  declare @sV_objectorg       nvarchar(15)  --r5events.evt_object_org%type  /* Object org.               */
  declare @nV_dcompleted      datetime    --r5events.evt_completed%type   /* Date completed            */
  declare @nV_freq            numeric(8)  --r5events.evt_freq%type      /* Frequenty                 */
  declare @sV_org             nvarchar(15)  --r5organization.org_code%TYPE  /* Org of event or ppm       */
  declare @sV_status          nvarchar(4) --r5objects.obj_status%TYPE    /* User Status of the object      */
  declare @sV_rstatus         nvarchar(4) --r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE    /* System Status of the object      */
  declare @dV_ppodeactive     datetime    /* PO deactivation date      */
  declare @nV_revision        numeric(4)  --r5ppms.ppm_revision%TYPE    /* PM approved revision      */
  declare @nReturn            integer
  declare @sSyskit1           nvarchar(200)
begin
  set @sP_chk     = N'0'

    SELECT @sV_object = p.ppo_object,
           @sV_objectorg = p.ppo_object_org,
           @nV_ppopk = p.ppo_pk,
           @dV_ppodeactive = p.ppo_deactive,
           @sV_org = p.ppo_org
    FROM   r5ppmobjects p
    WHERE  p.ppo_pk       = @nP_ppo_pk
    AND    p.ppo_ppm      = @sP_ppmcode
    AND    p.ppo_revision = @nP_revision

  if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
    begin
      set @sP_chk = N'15'
      RETURN
    end

  execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sSyskit1 OUTPUT, N'SYSKIT1', @sP_chk OUTPUT
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

  SELECT @sV_rstatus = obj_rstatus, @sV_status = obj_status
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @sV_object
  AND    obj_org  = @sV_objectorg

  if @sV_rstatus = N'D'
    begin
      if @sP_selinkit = N'-' or @sSyskit1  <> @sV_status
        RETURN
    end

  if coalesce( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dV_ppodeactive, N'DD' ), dbo.o7gttime2( @sV_org) + 1 ) <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sV_org), N'DD' )
  begin
    set @sP_chk = N'0'
    RETURN
  end

  /* Get approved PM revision number */

    SELECT @nV_revision = ppm_revision
    FROM   r5ppms
    WHERE  ppm_code       = @sP_ppmcode
    AND    ppm_revrstatus = N'A'


  INSERT INTO r5tempwmbwog
    ( tev_code,
    tev_ppm,
    tev_desc,
    tev_target,
    tev_object,
    tev_object_org,
    tev_isstype  ,
    tev_ppopk,
    tev_sessionid,
    tev_freq )
      SELECT
        N'WOG' +  @sP_neweventno,
        p.ppm_code,
        p.ppm_desc,
        @dP_due,
        m.ppo_object,
        m.ppo_object_org,
        m.ppo_isstype,
        convert(numeric(18,0), @sP_ppopk),
        @nP_sessionid,
        dbo.o7gtfreq( m.ppo_freq, m.ppo_perioduom, GetDate() )
      FROM   r5ppms           p,
        r5ppmobjects     m,
        r5objects        a
      WHERE  p.ppm_code          = @sP_ppmcode
        AND    p.ppm_revision      = @nP_revision
        AND    m.ppo_pk            = @sP_ppopk
        AND    p.ppm_code          = m.ppo_ppm
        AND    p.ppm_revision      = m.ppo_revision
        AND    a.obj_code          = m.ppo_object
        AND    a.obj_org           = m.ppo_object_org

  RETURN

end

create procedure O7WMBWOG_X5POPDUPJOBS
  @sP_selppm          nvarchar(20),
  @sP_selpmclass      nvarchar(8),
  @sP_seljobtype      nvarchar(8),
  @sP_selobj          nvarchar(30),
  @sP_selloc          nvarchar(30),
  @sP_selmrc          nvarchar(15),
  @dP_selend          datetime,
  @sP_selorg          nvarchar(15),
  @sP_r5user          nvarchar(255),
  @sP_r5group         nvarchar(12),
  @sP_r5selsupervisor nvarchar(30),
  @sP_selperson       nvarchar(15),
  @sP_selcostcode     nvarchar(30),
  @sP_selchildequip   nvarchar(4) ,
  @nP_sessionid       nvarchar(18),
  @sP_selrelmps       nvarchar(1) = NULL,
  @sP_selmp           nvarchar(30) = N'%',
  @nP_selmpseq        numeric(4) = NULL,
  @sP_selmpclass      nvarchar(8) = N'%',
  @sP_selinkit        nvarchar(4) = N'+',
  @sP_r5role          nvarchar(30) = N'*'
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @sPpm           nvarchar(20)
  declare @nRevision      numeric(4,0)
  declare @nPk            numeric(18,0)
  declare @sObject        nvarchar(30)
  declare @sObject_org    nvarchar(15)
  declare @sRoute         nvarchar(20)
  declare @dDue           datetime
  declare @sObtype        nvarchar(4)
  declare @sObrtype       nvarchar(4)
  declare @sMrc           nvarchar(15)
  declare @nDuration    numeric(18,0)
  declare @nFreq          numeric(8,0)
  declare @sNested    nvarchar(20)
  declare @sPerioduom     nvarchar(10)
  declare @nNestedtolmin  numeric(5,0)
  declare @nNestedtolmax  numeric(5,0)
  declare @dDormstart     datetime
  declare @dDormend       datetime
  declare @sDormreuse     nvarchar(1)
  declare @dDeactive      datetime
  declare @sMtpcode       nvarchar(30)
  declare @sMtporg        nvarchar(15)
  declare @nMtprevision   numeric(4)
  declare @sMtpmptype     nvarchar(4)
  declare @nMpsequence    numeric(4)
  declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
  declare @nCurseq        numeric(4)
  declare @nNextseq       numeric(4)
  declare @sWodesc        nvarchar(80)

  declare @sV_newjob      nvarchar(30)  --r5events.evt_code%TYPE
  declare @sV_newrstatus  nvarchar(1)
  declare @sV_chk         nvarchar(1)
  declare @sV_inspflag    nvarchar(1)
  declare @sV_template    nvarchar(1)
  declare @sV_inspoint    nvarchar(1)
  declare @dV_due         datetime
  declare @dV_dormstart   datetime
  declare @dV_dormend     datetime
  declare @nV_cnt         integer
  declare @nV_jobno       integer
  declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
  declare @nReturn    integer
  declare @sX           nvarchar(1)
  declare @nCountit2      integer
    declare @dPpmcal        datetime
    declare @sPerformonweek nvarchar(1)
    declare @nPerformonday  numeric(1)

  set @sX = null
  execute @nReturn = R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF @sV_inspflag OUTPUT, N'MODULE', N'I'
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

  execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sV_newrstatus OUTPUT, N'PPMSTAT', @sV_chk OUTPUT
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1
  set @sV_newrstatus = coalesce( @sV_newrstatus, N'A' )

  set @nV_jobno      = 0

  --declare cursor and loop on it...

    --TNT 03-01-05:  This is a performance tweak for databases with a large number of locations.
    --      This part of the original where clause causes a problem when the r5locations table
    --      contains many rows:
  --    AND  (   @sP_selloc                   = N'%' OR    o.ppo_location             IN
  --            ( SELECT  loc_code FROM dbo.o7wmbwogx5popdupjobs_get_hierarchy1 (@sP_selloc) ) )
    --
    --  Notice that is @sP_selloc is N'%' then there is no need to run the hierarchy function.  When
    --  r5locations has lots of data, the hierarchical function builds the ENTIRE r5locations tree,
    --  which is not necessary.  So we are going to check for this ahead of time and not add this
    --  part of the WHERE clause if it is not necessary ( when @sP_selloc is N'%' )

    if @sP_selloc = N'%'
      declare c_obj cursor local for SELECT   o.ppo_ppm,
                          p.ppm_revision,
                          o.ppo_pk,
                          o.ppo_object,
                          o.ppo_object_org,
                          o.ppo_route,
                          dbo.o7gtdate( o.ppo_due, o.ppo_performonweek, o.ppo_performonday ),
                          o.ppo_obtype,
                          o.ppo_obrtype,
                          COALESCE( o.ppo_mrc, b.obj_pmwodept, b.obj_mrc ),

create procedure O7WOARCHIVE_CREATEEVENTSTANDARDSARCHIVE        @sESigner nvarchar(255),
                                                                @sESignatureType nvarchar(8),
                                                                @sCertnum nvarchar(20),
                                                                @sCerttype nvarchar(8),
                                                                @sWorkOrder nvarchar (30),
                                                                @sOrg nvarchar (15),
                                                                @sParentCode nvarchar (30)
                                                
as
        declare @sSeqno                 nvarchar(30)
        declare @sChk1                  nvarchar(6)
        declare @dGtTime                datetime
        declare @nReturn                int
        declare @nPk_est                integer
        declare @sEvent_est             nvarchar(30)
        declare @sPart_est              nvarchar(30)
        declare @sPart_org_est          nvarchar(15)
        declare @sObject_est            nvarchar(30)
        declare @sObject_org_est        nvarchar(15)
        declare @sLot_est               nvarchar(12)
        declare @dNextcaldate_est       datetime
        declare @nUpdatecount_est       numeric(38,0)
        declare @dUpdated_est           datetime
        declare @nSqlidentity_est       integer
        declare @dLastsaved_est         datetime
        declare @sRplcdept_est          nvarchar(30)
        declare c_est cursor local for select   EST_PK, EST_EVENT,      EST_PART,       EST_PART_ORG,   EST_OBJECT,
                                                EST_OBJECT_ORG, EST_LOT,        EST_NEXTCALDATE,        EST_UPDATECOUNT,        EST_UPDATED,
                                                EST_SQLIDENTITY, EST_LASTSAVED, EST_REPLDEPT
                                        FROM r5evtstandards
                                        WHERE  est_event = @sWorkOrder
        open c_est
        fetch next from c_est into      @nPk_est,       @sEvent_est,    @sPart_est,     @sPart_org_est, @sObject_est,
                                        @sObject_org_est,       @sLot_est,      @dNextcaldate_est,      @nUpdatecount_est,      @dUpdated_est,
                                        @nSqlidentity_est, @dLastsaved_est, @sRplcdept_est
        
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                        close c_est
                                        deallocate c_est
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                                end
                        execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                        close c_est
                                        deallocate c_est
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                        end
                        INSERT  INTO r5elecarchive (
                                                        ELA_CODE,            ELA_USER,             ELA_DATE,            ELA_SIGNTYPE,
                                                        ELA_CERTIFYNUM,      ELA_CERTIFYTYPE,      ELA_SCODE,           ELA_ENTITY,
                                                        ELA_ENTCODE,         ELA_ENTORG,           ELA_STATUS,          ELA_PARENT,
                                                        ELA_FLD1,            ELA_FLD2,             ELA_FLD3,            ELA_FLD4,
                                                        ELA_FLD5,            ELA_FLD6,             ELA_FLD7,            ELA_FLD8,
                                                        ELA_FLD9,            ELA_FLD10,            ELA_FLD11,           ELA_FLD12 )
                        VALUES( @sSeqno,             @sESigner,      @dGtTime, @sESignatureType,
                                @sCertnum, @sCerttype, null,             N'EST',
                                @nPk_est,            @sOrg,         null,                  @sParentCode,
                                @nPk_est,       @sEvent_est,    @sPart_est,          @sPart_org_est,
                                @sObject_est,        @sObject_org_est,     @sLot_est,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( @dNextcaldate_est, N'DD-MON-YYYY' ),
                                @nUpdatecount_est,
                                dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( @dUpdated_est, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS' ), 
                                dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( @dLastsaved_est, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS' ), @sRplcdept_est)

                        fetch next from c_est into      @nPk_est,       @sEvent_est,    @sPart_est,     @sPart_org_est, @sObject_est,
                                                        @sObject_org_est,       @sLot_est,      @dNextcaldate_est,      @nUpdatecount_est,      @dUpdated_est,
                                                        @nSqlidentity_est, @dLastsaved_est, @sRplcdept_est
                end
        close c_est
        deallocate c_est

        open c_etp

                                @nStandard_etp,      @sStandarduom_etp,    @nOutput_etp,        @sOutputuom_etp,
                                @nDevicereading_etp, @nDeviation_etp,      @sStatus_etp,        @nDevicetolfromal_etp,
                                @nDevicetoltoal_etp, @nStandardal_etp,     @sStandarduomal_etp, @nOutputal_etp,
                                @sOutputuomal_etp,   @nDevicereadingal_etp,@nDeviational_etp,   @sStatusal_etp,

create procedure O7WOARCHIVE_CREATEWORKORDERPERMITARCHIVE    @sESigner nvarchar(255),
                                                        @sESignatureType nvarchar(8),
                                                        @sCertnum nvarchar(20),
                                                        @sCerttype nvarchar(8),
                                                        @sWorkOrder nvarchar (30),
                                                        @sOrg nvarchar (15),
                                                        @sParentCode nvarchar (30)
                                                
as
  declare @sSeqno                 nvarchar(30)
  declare @sChk1                  nvarchar(6)
  declare @dGtTime                datetime
  declare @nReturn                int
  declare @pevcode                nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @daerentity             nvarchar( 4 )
  declare @daecode                nvarchar( 50 )
  declare @daedocument            nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @addrentity             nvarchar( 4 )
  declare @addcode                nvarchar( 100 )
  declare @addtype                nvarchar( 4 )
  declare @addlang                nvarchar( 2 )
  declare @addline                numeric( 12 )

  execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
   
  /* Archive permit records. */
  DECLARE pev CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT pev_code
    FROM   r5permevents
    WHERE  pev_event = @sWorkOrder;
  OPEN pev
  FETCH NEXT FROM pev INTO @pevcode
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
  INSERT INTO r5elecarchive( 
        ela_code, ela_user, ela_date, ela_signtype, ela_certifynum, ela_certifytype, 
        ela_scode, ela_entity, ela_entcode, ela_entorg, ela_status, ela_parent,
        ela_fld1,  ela_fld2,   ela_fld3,   ela_fld4,
        ela_fld5,  ela_fld6,   ela_fld7,   ela_fld8,
        ela_fld9,  ela_fld10,  ela_fld11,  ela_fld12,
        ela_fld13, ela_fld14,  ela_fld15,  ela_fld16,
        ela_fld17, ela_fld18,  ela_fld19,  ela_fld20,
        ela_fld21, ela_fld22,  ela_fld23,  ela_fld24,
        ela_fld25, ela_fld26,  ela_fld27,  ela_fld28,
        ela_fld29, ela_fld30,  ela_fld31,  ela_fld32,
        ela_fld33, ela_fld34,  ela_fld35,  ela_fld36,
        ela_fld37, ela_fld38,  ela_fld39,  ela_fld40,
        ela_fld41, ela_fld42,  ela_fld43,  ela_fld44,
        ela_fld45, ela_fld46,  ela_fld47,  ela_fld48,
        ela_fld49, ela_fld50,  ela_fld51,  ela_fld52,
        ela_fld53, ela_fld54,  ela_fld55,  ela_fld56,
        ela_fld57, ela_fld58,  ela_fld59,  ela_fld60,
        ela_fld61, ela_fld62,  ela_fld63,  ela_fld64,
        ela_fld65, ela_fld66,  ela_fld67,  ela_fld68,
        ela_fld69, ela_fld70,  ela_fld71,  ela_fld72,
        ela_fld73, ela_fld74,  ela_fld75,  ela_fld76,
        ela_fld77, ela_fld78,  ela_fld79,  ela_fld80 )
  SELECT @sSeqno, @sESigner, @dGtTime, @sESignatureType, @sCertnum, @sCerttype,
        NULL, N'PRME', pev_code, @sOrg, NULL, @sParentCode, 
        pev_code,  pev_event,  pev_permit,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_date, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  
        pev_active,  pev_updatecount, pev_permit_org,  pev_permitrev,  pev_autocreateptw,  
        pev_lotorequired,  pev_activity,  pev_ptw,  pev_ptwtype,  
        pev_typeofwork,  pev_priority,  pev_risk,  pev_isolationtype,  
        dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_validuntil, N'DD-MON-YYYY'),  pev_deletepending, pev_mand, dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_created, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), pev_createdby,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_updated, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 
        pev_updatedby,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_reviewed,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  pev_reviewedby,  pev_reviewedname,  
        pev_reviewedtype,  pev_sourcerentity,  pev_sourcecode,  pev_sourceorg,  
        dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_sourceupdated,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  pev_sourceupdatedby,  pev_relatedwo, pev_udfchar01,  pev_udfchar02,  
        pev_udfchar03,  pev_udfchar04,  pev_udfchar05,  pev_udfchar06,  
        pev_udfchar07,  pev_udfchar08,  pev_udfchar09,  pev_udfchar10,  
        pev_udfchar11,  pev_udfchar12,  pev_udfchar13,  pev_udfchar14,  
        pev_udfchar15,  pev_udfchar16,  pev_udfchar17,  pev_udfchar18,  
        pev_udfchar19,  pev_udfchar20,  pev_udfchar21,  pev_udfchar22,  
        pev_udfchar23,  pev_udfchar24,  pev_udfchar25,  pev_udfchar26,  
        pev_udfchar27,  pev_udfchar28,  pev_udfchar29,  pev_udfchar30,  
        pev_udfnum01,  pev_udfnum02,  pev_udfnum03,  pev_udfnum04,  
        pev_udfnum05,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_udfdate01,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_udfdate02, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_udfdate03,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  
        dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_udfdate04,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(pev_udfdate05,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  pev_udfchkbox01,  pev_udfchkbox02,  
        pev_udfchkbox03,  pev_udfchkbox04,  pev_udfchkbox05,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( pev_lastsaved, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS' )	  
  FROM   r5permevents
  WHERE  pev_code = @pevcode

  /* Archive permit documents. */
  DECLARE dae CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT dae_rentity, dae_code, dae_document
    FROM   r5documents, r5docentities e
    WHERE  doc_code    = dae_document
    AND    dae_rentity = N'PRME'
    AND    dae_code    = @pevcode
    OPEN dae
      FETCH NEXT FROM dae INTO @daerentity, @daecode, @daedocument
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN 
          EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
          INSERT INTO r5elecarchive(
                 ela_code, ela_user, ela_date, ela_signtype, ela_certifynum, ela_certifytype, 
                 ela_scode, ela_entity, ela_entcode, ela_entorg, ela_status, ela_parent,
                 ela_fld1,  ela_fld2,  ela_fld3,  ela_fld4,  ela_fld5,  
                 ela_fld6,  ela_fld7,  ela_fld8,  ela_fld9,  ela_fld10,  
                 ela_fld11, ela_fld12, ela_fld13 )
          SELECT @sSeqno, @sESigner, @dGtTime, @sESignatureType,@sCertnum, @sCerttype,
                 NULL, N'DOCP', dae_document, doc_org, NULL, @sParentCode, 
                 dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type, dae_rtype,

          AND    dae_rentity  = @daerentity
          AND    dae_code     = @daecode
          AND    dae_document = @daedocument
          FETCH NEXT FROM dae INTO @daerentity, @daecode, @daedocument
        END
      CLOSE dae
      DEALLOCATE dae

      /* Archive permit comments. */
      DECLARE cadd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT add_rentity, add_code, add_type, add_lang, add_line
        FROM   r5addetails
        WHERE  add_rentity = N'PRME'
        AND    add_code    = @pevcode
      OPEN cadd
      FETCH NEXT FROM cadd INTO @addrentity, @addcode, @addtype, @addlang, @addline
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN 
          EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
          INSERT INTO r5elecarchive(      
                 ela_code, ela_user, ela_date, ela_signtype, ela_certifynum, ela_certifytype, 
                 ela_scode, ela_entity, ela_entcode, ela_entorg, ela_status, ela_parent,
                 ela_fld1,  ela_fld2,  ela_fld3,  ela_fld4,  ela_fld5,  
                 ela_fld6,  ela_fld7,  ela_fld8,  ela_fld9,  ela_fld10,  
                 ela_fld11, ela_fld12, ela_fld13, ela_fld14, ela_fld15, 
                 ela_long, ela_lcode ) 
          SELECT @sSeqno, @sESigner, @dGtTime, @sESignatureType, @sCertnum, @sCerttype,
                 NULL, N'ADDP', add_line, @sOrg, NULL, @sParentCode, 
                 add_entity, add_rentity,

        ksf_udfchar23,  ksf_udfchar24,  ksf_udfchar25,  ksf_udfchar26,  
        ksf_udfchar27,  ksf_udfchar28,  ksf_udfchar29,  ksf_udfchar30,

        ksf_udfnum05,  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(ksf_udfdate01,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(ksf_udfdate02, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(ksf_udfdate03,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),

  FROM   r5worksafety
  WHERE  ksf_pk = @ksfpk

  /* Archive safety documents. */
  DECLARE dae CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT dae_rentity, dae_code, dae_document
    FROM   r5documents, r5docentities e

    AND    dae_rentity = N'SFWO'
    AND    dae_code    = @ksfpk

      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

          EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT

                 ela_code, ela_user, ela_date, ela_signtype, ela_certifynum, ela_certifytype, 
                 ela_scode, ela_entity, ela_entcode, ela_entorg, ela_status, ela_parent,

          SELECT @sSeqno, @sESigner, @dGtTime, @sESignatureType,@sCertnum, @sCerttype,

                 dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo, 
                 dae_updatecount, dae_createcopytowo, dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( dae_lastsaved, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS' )
          FROM   r5documents, r5docentities e
          WHERE  doc_code     = dae_document
          AND    dae_rentity  = @daerentity
          AND    dae_code     = @daecode
          AND    dae_document = @daedocument
          FETCH NEXT FROM dae INTO @daerentity, @daecode, @daedocument
        END
      CLOSE dae
      DEALLOCATE dae

      /* Archive safety comments. */
      DECLARE cadd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT add_rentity, add_code, add_type, add_lang, add_line
        FROM   r5addetails
        WHERE  add_rentity = N'SFWO'
        AND    add_code    = @ksfpk
      OPEN cadd
      FETCH NEXT FROM cadd INTO @addrentity, @addcode, @addtype, @addlang, @addline
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN 
          EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
          INSERT INTO r5elecarchive(      
                 ela_code, ela_user, ela_date, ela_signtype, ela_certifynum, ela_certifytype, 
                 ela_scode, ela_entity, ela_entcode, ela_entorg, ela_status, ela_parent,
                 ela_fld1,  ela_fld2,  ela_fld3,  ela_fld4,  ela_fld5,  
                 ela_fld6,  ela_fld7,  ela_fld8,  ela_fld9,  ela_fld10,  
                 ela_fld11, ela_fld12, ela_fld13, ela_fld14, ela_fld15,
                 ela_long,  ela_lcode ) 
          SELECT @sSeqno, @sESigner, @dGtTime, @sESignatureType,@sCertnum, @sCerttype,
                 NULL, N'ADDS', add_line, @sOrg, NULL, @sParentCode, 
                 add_entity, add_rentity, add_type, add_rtype, add_code,
                 add_

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7WOCOST
                  @sEvtCode   nvarchar(30),
                  @nActdma    numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nActfix    numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nActhir    numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nActlab    numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nActmat    numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nActtool   numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nActtot    numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_dma    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_fix    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_hir    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_lab    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_mat    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_tool   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nEst_tot    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_dma   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_fix   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_hir   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_lab   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_mat   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_tool  numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nOpen_tot   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nPno_dma    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nPno_fix    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nPno_hir    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nPno_tot    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_dma    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_fix    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_hir    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_lab    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_mat    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_tool   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nRem_tot    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nPid_dma    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT, 
                  @nPid_fix    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT, 
                  @nPid_hir    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT, 
                  @nPid_lab    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nPid_tot    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT, 
                  @nTot_dma    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nTot_fix    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nTot_hir    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nTot_lab    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nTot_mat    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nTot_tool   numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nTot_tot    numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT,
                  @nCore       numeric(30,6)    OUTPUT
  
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sStatement		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)
BEGIN

	SELECT @sRstatus = evt_rstatus
	FROM   r5events
	WHERE  evt_code = @sEvtCode
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
		set @sRstatus = N'R'

	execute @nReturn = o7estlab N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nEst_lab OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1 
	execute @nReturn = o7remlab N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nRem_lab OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7actlab N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nActlab OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nEst_lab  = coalesce( @nEst_lab, 0 )
	set @nRem_lab  = coalesce( @nRem_lab, 0 )
	set @nActlab  = coalesce( @nActlab, 0 )
	set @nTot_lab  = coalesce( @nRem_lab, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nActlab, 0 ) 
	set @nOpen_lab = coalesce( @nEst_lab, 0 ) -
		coalesce( @nTot_lab, 0 )


	execute @nReturn = o7estmat N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nEst_mat OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7remmat N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nRem_mat OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7actmat N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nActmat OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
			
	set @nActmat  = coalesce( @nActmat, 0 )
	set @nTot_mat  = coalesce( @nRem_mat, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nActmat, 0 )
	set @nOpen_mat = coalesce( @nEst_mat, 0 ) -
		coalesce( @nTot_mat, 0 )

	execute @nReturn = o7estdma N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nEst_dma OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7pnodma N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nPno_dma OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7remdma N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nRem_dma OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7actdma N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nActdma OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = o7piddma N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nPid_dma OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nEst_dma  = coalesce( @nEst_dma, 0 )
	set @nRem_dma  = coalesce( @nRem_dma, 0 )
	set @nActdma  = coalesce( @nActdma, 0 )
	set @nPno_dma  = coalesce( @nPno_dma, 0 )
	set @nPid_dma  = coalesce( @nPid_dma, 0 )
	set @nTot_dma  = coalesce( @nPno_dma, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nRem_dma, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nActdma, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nPid_dma, 0 )
	set @nOpen_dma = coalesce( @nEst_dma, 0 ) -
		coalesce( @nTot_dma, 0 )

	execute @nReturn = o7esthir N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nEst_hir OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7pnohir N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nPno_hir OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7remhir N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nRem_hir OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7acthir N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nActhir OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7pidhir N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nPid_hir OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nEst_hir  = coalesce( @nEst_hir, 0 )
	set @nRem_hir  = coalesce( @nRem_hir, 0 )
	set @nActhir  = coalesce( @nActhir, 0 )
	set @nPno_hir  = coalesce( @nPno_hir, 0 )
	set @nPid_hir  = coalesce( @nPid_hir, 0 )
	set @nTot_hir  = coalesce( @nPno_hir, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nRem_hir, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nActhir, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nPid_hir, 0 )
	set @nOpen_hir = coalesce( @nEst_hir, 0 ) -
		coalesce( @nTot_hir, 0 )

	execute @nReturn = o7estfix N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nEst_fix OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7pnofix N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nPno_fix OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7remfix N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nRem_fix OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7actfix N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nActfix OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7pidfix N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nPid_fix OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nEst_fix  = coalesce( @nEst_fix, 0 )
	set @nRem_fix  = coalesce( @nRem_fix, 0 )
	set @nActfix  = coalesce( @nActfix, 0 )
	set @nPno_fix  = coalesce( @nPno_fix, 0 )
	set @nPid_fix  = coalesce( @nPid_fix, 0 )
	set @nTot_fix  = coalesce( @nPno_fix, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nRem_fix, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nActfix, 0 ) +
		coalesce( @nPid_fix, 0 )
	set @nOpen_fix = coalesce( @nEst_fix, 0 ) -
		coalesce( @nTot_fix, 0 )

	execute @nReturn = o7esttool N'EVT', @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nEst_tool OUTPUT, @sStatement OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = o7acttool N'EVT', @sEvtCode

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOGENALERTS
        @sSessionid  numeric(30),
        @sWotype     nvarchar(6),
        @sCode       nvarchar(30),
        @nRevision   numeric(4),
        @dGenthrough datetime,
        @sOrg         nvarchar(15),
        @sWonum      numeric(30) OUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    DECLARE  @sChk                      nvarchar( 3 )
    DECLARE  @sCancstat                 nvarchar( 8 )
    DECLARE  @sPmcrpast                 nvarchar( 8 )
    DECLARE  @sDeptsec                  nvarchar( 100 )
    DECLARE  @sJtauth                   nvarchar( 100 )
    DECLARE  @sDeflang                  nvarchar( 100 )
    DECLARE  @sWorkwost                 nvarchar( 100 )
    DECLARE  @sPpmStat                  nvarchar( 100 )
    DECLARE  @sProcessed                nvarchar( 1 )
    DECLARE  @sError                    nvarchar( 2000 )
    DECLARE  @dDue                      datetime
    DECLARE  @nCnt                      integer
    DECLARE  @dDormstart                datetime
    DECLARE  @dDormend                  datetime
    DECLARE  @nSeq                      numeric(30)
    DECLARE  @nNextseq                  numeric(30)
    DECLARE  @sPpoppm                   nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @sPpoorg                   nvarchar( 15) 
    DECLARE  @dPpodue                   datetime
    DECLARE  @sPpoperformonweek         nvarchar( 1 )
    DECLARE  @sPpoperformonday          nvarchar( 1 )
    DECLARE  @sPpoperioduom             nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @dPpodormstart             datetime
    DECLARE  @dPpodormend               datetime
    DECLARE  @sPpodormreuse             nvarchar( 1 )
    DECLARE  @dPpodeactive              datetime
    DECLARE  @sPpoobject                nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @sPpoobjectorg             nvarchar( 80 )
    DECLARE  @nPpofreq                  numeric(8)
    DECLARE  @sPpomrc                   nvarchar( 15 )
    DECLARE  @sPpmdesc                  nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @sPpmjobtype               nvarchar( 8 )
    DECLARE  @dEvtdue                   datetime
    DECLARE  @sEvtmp                    nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @sEvtmporg                 nvarchar( 15 )
    DECLARE  @nEvtmprev                 numeric(4)
    DECLARE  @nEvtmpseq                 numeric(3)
    DECLARE  @sEvtobject                nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @sEvtobjectorg             nvarchar( 15 )
    DECLARE  @sEvtjobtype               nvarchar( 8 )
    DECLARE  @sEvtmrc                   nvarchar( 15 )
    DECLARE  @sEvtstatus                nvarchar( 8 )
    DECLARE  @sMtpmptype                nvarchar( 8 )
    DECLARE  @dPeqdormstart             datetime
    DECLARE  @dPeqdormend               datetime
    DECLARE  @dPeqdeactive              datetime
    DECLARE  @sPeqdormreuse             nvarchar( 1 )
    DECLARE  @sPeqorg                   nvarchar( 15 )
    DECLARE  @nPsqfreq                  numeric(8)
    DECLARE  @sPsqperioduom             nvarchar( 30 )
    DECLARE  @sPsqwodesc                nvarchar( 80 )
    DECLARE  @nReturn                   int
    DECLARE  @nStatusAuthCount          int
    DECLARE  @sOldStatus                nvarchar( 1 )
BEGIN
    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sCancstat OUTPUT, N'CANCSTAT', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1
    
    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPmcrpast OUTPUT, N'PMCRPAST', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeptsec OUTPUT, N'DEPTSEC', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sJtauth OUTPUT, N'JTAUTH', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeflang OUTPUT, N'DEFLANG', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

    execute @nReturn = o7getorgoption @sWorkwost OUTPUT, N'WORKWOST', @sOrg, @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1
    
    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPpmStat OUTPUT, N'PPMSTAT', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

    SET @sPmcrpast = COALESCE( UPPER( @sPmcrpast ), N'NO' )
    SET @sDeptsec  = COALESCE( UPPER( @sDeptsec ), N'OFF' )
    SET @sJtauth   = COALESCE( UPPER( @sJtauth ), N'NO' )
    SET @sDeflang  = COALESCE( UPPER( @sDeflang ), N'EN' )
    SET @sWorkwost = UPPER( @sWorkwost )

    IF @sWotype IN ( N'PM', N'MP' )
      BEGIN
        IF @sDeptsec = N'ON' OR @sJtauth = N'YES'
          BEGIN
            SELECT @sEvtmrc     = evt_mrc,
                   @sEvtjobtype = evt_jobtype
            FROM   r5events
            WHERE  evt_code = @sCode
          END
        IF @sDeptsec = N'ON'
          BEGIN
            /* Check Department Security */
            SELECT @nCnt = COUNT(*)
            FROM   r5departmentsecurity 
            WHERE  dse_mrc      = @sEvtmrc
            AND    dse_user     = N'R5'
            AND    dse_readonly = N'-'
            IF @nCnt = 0 
              BEGIN
                /* No Department Security. */
                SET @sProcessed = N'+'
                SELECT @sError = ert_text
                FROM   r5errtexts, r5errsource
                WHERE  ers_code   = ert_code
                AND    ers_source = N'O7WOGENALERTS'
                AND    ers_type   = N'PROC'
                AND    ers_number = 1
                AND    ert_lang   = @sDeflang
              END
          END
        IF @sJtauth = N'YES' AND @sProcessed IS NULL
          BEGIN
            /* Check Job Type Authorization. */
            SELECT @nCnt = COUNT(*)
            FROM   r5jobtypeauth j  
            WHERE  (     jta_jobtype = @sEvtjobtype 
                     AND jta_status  = N'ALLSTATS' 
                     AND jta_update  = N'+' 
                     AND ( jta_group= N'*' OR jta_group = N'R5' ) 
                     AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1
                                     FROM   r5jobtypeauth j2
                                     WHERE  j2.jta_jobtype = @sEvtjobtype 
                                     AND    j2.jta_status  = @sEvtstatus 
                                     AND    ( j2.jta_group= N'*' OR j2.jta_group = N'R5' ) ) )
            OR     (     jta_jobtype = @sEvtjobtype 
                     AND jta_status  = @sEvtstatus 
                     AND jta_update  = N'+' 
                     AND ( jta_group= N'*' OR jta_group = N'R5' ) )
            IF @nCnt = 0 
              BEGIN
                /* No Job Type Authorization. */
                SET @sProcessed = N'+'
                SELECT @sError = ert_text
                FROM   r5errtexts, r5errsource
                WHERE  ers_code   = ert_code
                AND    ers_source = N'O7WOGENALERTS'
                AND    ers_type   = N'PROC'
                AND    ers_number = 2
                AND    ert_lang   = @sDeflang
              END
          END
         /* Check status Authorization. */
        SET @sOldStatus = @sPpmStat
        SELECT @nStatusAuthCount = 1 
        FROM r5auth 
        WHERE aut_status  = @sOldStatus  
        AND aut_statnew = @sWorkwost
        AND aut_rentity = N'EVNT' 
        AND (aut_user= N'*' OR aut_user = N'*' )
        AND (aut_group = N'R5' OR aut_group = N'*' )
        IF  @nStatusAuthCount is null
        BEGIN
          /* no status authorization. */
          SET @sProcessed = N'+'
          SELECT @sError = ert_text
          FROM   r5errtexts, r5errsource
          WHERE  ers_code   = ert_code
          AND    ers_source = N'O7WOGENALERTS'
          AND    ers_type   = N'PROC'
          AND    ers_number = 3
          AND    ert_lang   = @sDeflang
        END 
        /* For Fixed/Variable PMs and non-Duplicate MPs, right away create a record in the temp table. */
        INSERT INTO r5tempwmbwog( tev_sessionid, tev_code, tev_status, tev_desc, tev_object, tev_object_org, tev_ppm, tev_mp, tev_mp

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WONONCONFORMITY
  @event NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @usr   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @rent  NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @code  NVARCHAR( 100 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @object         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @route          NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @routerev       NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @due            DATETIME
  DECLARE @frompoint      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @topoint        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @dueonly        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @nccode         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ncfobject      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ncfobjectorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @offset         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ncffrompoint   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ncftopoint     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @olength        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @odirection     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @olengthuom     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @olinearrefuom  NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @oslength       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @osdirection    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @oslengthuom    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @oslinearrefuom NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @newpk          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cnt            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @inrange        NVARCHAR( 1 )

  /* Check whether nonconformities should be included. */
  SELECT @object    = evt_object, 
         @objectorg = evt_object_org, 
         @route     = evt_route, 
         @routerev  = evt_routerev, 
         @due       = evt_due,
         @frompoint = evt_frompoint, 
         @topoint   = evt_topoint,
         @dueonly   = COALESCE( ppo_duenonconformitiesonly, peq_duenonconformitiesonly, alw_duenonconformitiesonly )
  FROM   r5events
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppmobjects ON ( ppo_pk = evt_ppopk AND ppo_revision = evt_ppmrev AND ppo_includenonconformities = N'+' )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5patternequipment ON ( peq_mp = evt_mp AND peq_mp_org = evt_mp_org AND peq_revision = evt_mp_rev 
                                                 AND peq_includenonconformities = N'+' )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5alertwo ON ( alw_alert = evt_alert AND alw_includenonconformities = '+' )
  WHERE  evt_code = @event

  IF @dueonly IS NULL
    /* Nonconformities are not included, so exit. */
    RETURN

  /* Find number of non conformity selection criteria records. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
  FROM   r5nonconformityselcriteria
  WHERE  ncs_rentity = @rent
  AND    ncs_code    = @code

  /* Loop through all nonconformities belonging to the equipment of the WO. */
  DECLARE ncf CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ncf_code, ncf_object, ncf_object_org, dbo.o7getpointoffset( @object, @objectorg, ncf_object, ncf_object_org, o.obj_linearrefuom, N'-' ),
           COALESCE( ncf_frompoint, 0 ), COALESCE( ncf_topoint, os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ), 
           o.obj_length, o.obj_direction, o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom, 
           os.obj_length, o.obj_direction, os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom 
    FROM   r5objects o, r5nonconformities n
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5nonconformitytypes ON ( nct_code = ncf_ncttype AND nct_org = ncf_ncttype_org )
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects os ON ( os.obj_code = ncf_object AND os.obj_org = ncf_object_org )
    WHERE  ncf_rstatus = N'O'
    AND    o.obj_code = @object
    AND    o.obj_org  = @objectorg
    AND    (    @dueonly = N'-' 
             OR COALESCE( ncf_nextinspectdateoverride, ncf_nextinspectdate ) <= COALESCE( @due, getdate() ) )
    AND    ncf_object + N'#' +  ncf_object_org IN 
           ( SELECT @object + N'#' +  @objectorg 
             FROM   dual
             UNION
             SELECT evt_object + N'#' +  evt_object_org
             FROM   r5events
             WHERE  evt_routeparent = @event
             UNION
             SELECT rob_object + N'#' +  rob_object_org
             FROM   r5routobjects
             WHERE  rob_route    = @route
             AND    rob_revision = @routerev
             UNION
             SELECT child + N'#' + childorg
             FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildrens( @object, @objectorg )
             UNION
             SELECT lrf_re_objcode + N'#' + lrf_re_objorg
             FROM   r5objlinearref
             WHERE  lrf_objcode = @object
             AND    lrf_objorg  = @objectorg
             AND    lrf_linear_reftype IN ( N'S', N'R' )
             UNION
             SELECT l2.lrf_re_objcode + N'#' + l2.lrf_re_objorg
             FROM   r5objlinearref l2, r5objlinearref l1
             WHERE  l2.lrf_objcode        = l1.lrf_re_objcode
             AND    l2.lrf_objorg         = l1.lrf_re_objorg
             AND    l2.lrf_linear_reftype = N'S'
             AND    l1.lrf_objcode        = @object
             AND    l1.lrf_objorg         = @objectorg
             AND    l1.lrf_linear_reftype = N'R' )
    AND    (    ( @cnt = 0 ) 
             OR 
                EXISTS(
                  SELECT N'x'
                  FROM   r5nonconformityselcriteria 
                  WHERE  ncs_rentity = @rent
                  AND    ncs_code    = @code
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_class, ncf_class, N'x' )              = COALESCE( ncf_class, N'x' ) 
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_class_org, ncf_class_org, N'x' )      = COALESCE( ncf_class_org, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_objclass, os.obj_class, N'x' )        = COALESCE( os.obj_class, N'x' ) 
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_objclass_org, os.obj_class_org, N'x' )= COALESCE( os.obj_class_org, N'x' ) 
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_nctclass, nct_class, N'x' )           = COALESCE( nct_class, N'x' ) 
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_nctclass_org, nct_class_org, N'x' )   = COALESCE( nct_class_org, N'x' ) 
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_ncttype, ncf_ncttype, N'x' )          = COALESCE( ncf_ncttype, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_ncttype_org, ncf_ncttype_org, N'x' )  = COALESCE( ncf_ncttype_org, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_syslevel, ncf_syslevel, N'x' )        = COALESCE( ncf_syslevel, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_asmlevel, ncf_asmlevel, N'x' )        = COALESCE( ncf_asmlevel, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_complevel, ncf_complevel, N'x' )      = COALESCE( ncf_complevel, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_part, ncf_part, N'x' )                = COALESCE( ncf_part, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_part_org, ncf_part_org, N'x' )        = COALESCE( ncf_part_org, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_matltype, ncf_matltype, N'x' )        = COALESCE( ncf_matltype, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_severity, ncf_severity, N'x' )        = COALESCE( ncf_severity, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_intensity, ncf_intensity, N'x' )      = COALESCE( ncf_intensity, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_sizefrom, ncf_size, -2 )             <= COALESCE( ncf_size, -1 )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_sizeto, ncf_size, -1 )               >= COALESCE( ncf_size, -2 )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_importance, ncf_importance, N'x' )    = COALESCE( ncf_importance, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_priority, ncf_priority, N'x' )        = COALESCE( ncf_priority, N'x' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_mrc, ncf_mrc, N'x' )                  = COALESCE( ncf_mrc, N'x' ) 
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_udfchar01, ncf_udfchar01,  N'xQ#7!' ) = COALESCE( ncf_udfchar01,  N'xQ#7!' )
                  AND    COALESCE( ncs_udfchar02, ncf_udfchar02,  N'xQ#7!' ) = COALESCE( ncf_udfchar02,  N'xQ#7!' )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WORKSPACEMOVE
  @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @action     NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @oldstatus  NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @chk        NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @fromworkspace NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @toworkspace   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @rstatus       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @oldrstatus    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @wsselect      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @changesmade   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @toepapk       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @entity        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @code          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org           NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @qty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @epaqty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @epapk         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @select        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @return        INT
  DECLARE @chk2          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @newpk         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @wmcpk         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @partqtychanged    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipmentmove     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @singlemovestatus  NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @primaryuom        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @physicalmeter     NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @initialmileage    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @finalmileage      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @diff              NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @now               DATETIME
  DECLARE @obtype            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @obrtype           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @updown            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @meter             NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @meter_uom         NVARCHAR( 30 )

  SET @changesmade = N'-'
  SET @chk = N'0'
  SET @partqtychanged = N'-'
  SET @equipmentmove = N'-'
  /* Get some work space move data. */
  SELECT @fromworkspace = wkm_from_workspacepk, 
         @toworkspace   = wkm_to_workspacepk, 
         @rstatus       = wkm_rstatus, 
         @wsselect      = CASE opa_desc WHEN N'YES' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,
         @equipmentmove = wkm_equipmentmove
  FROM   r5organizationoptions, r5workspacemoves
  WHERE  opa_org  = wkm_org 
  AND    opa_code = N'WSSELECT'
  AND    wkm_pk   = @pk
  IF @fromworkspace IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* get single move status */
  IF @equipmentmove = N'+' AND @wsselect = '+'
    EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @singlemovestatus OUTPUT, N'O', N'SMST', @chk2 OUTPUT
  IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
      return -1

  /* Get Associated Part Quantity changed. */
  SELECT @partqtychanged = N'+'
  FROM   r5entityparts , r5workspacemovechildren
    WHERE  epa_rentity       = N'WKSP'
    AND    epa_code          = @fromworkspace
    AND    wmc_workspacemove = @pk
    AND    wmc_rentity       = N'PART'
    AND    wmc_qty           <> epa_qty
    AND    wmc_epapk         = epa_pk 

  
  IF @action = N'I' 
    BEGIN
      /* Initialize work space move. */
      DELETE FROM r5workspacemovechildren
      WHERE  wmc_workspacemove = @pk
        IF @equipmentmove = N'+'
            BEGIN
              DECLARE chl CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
                SELECT 'OBJ', obj_code, obj_org, NULL, NULL, @wsselect, oud_meter, obj_primaryuom, CASE WHEN oud_meter IS NULL THEN oud_totalusage ELSE met_last END
                FROM   r5objects LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs ON(obj_code = oud_object AND obj_org = oud_object_org AND obj_primaryuom = oud_uom)
                                 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5meters ON (oud_meter = met_code)
                WHERE  obj_workspace = @fromworkspace
              OPEN chl
              FETCH NEXT FROM chl INTO @entity, @code, @org, @qty, @epapk, @select, @physicalmeter, @primaryuom, @initialmileage
              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                BEGIN
                  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'WMC', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT
                  INSERT INTO r5workspacemovechildren( wmc_pk, wmc_workspacemove, wmc_rentity, wmc_code, wmc_org, wmc_qty, wmc_epapk, wmc_select, wmc_meter, wmc_meter_uom, wmc_singlemovestatus, wmc_singlemoverstatus, wmc_initial_mileage, wmc_movestarttime )
                  VALUES( @newpk, @pk, @entity, @code, @org, @qty, @epapk, @select, @physicalmeter, @primaryuom, @singlemovestatus, CASE WHEN @wsselect = '+' THEN N'O' ELSE NULL END, @initialmileage, dbo.o7gttime2(@org))
                  FETCH NEXT FROM chl INTO @entity, @code, @org, @qty, @epapk, @select, @physicalmeter, @primaryuom, @initialmileage
                END
              CLOSE chl
              DEALLOCATE chl
            END
        ELSE
            BEGIN
              DECLARE chl CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
                SELECT 'OBJ', obj_code, obj_org, NULL, NULL, @wsselect
                FROM   r5objects
                WHERE  obj_workspace = @fromworkspace
                UNION
                SELECT 'PERS', wke_person, NULL, NULL, NULL, @wsselect
                FROM   r5workspaceemployees
                WHERE  wke_workspace_number = @fromworkspace
                UNION
                SELECT 'PART', epa_part, epa_part_org, epa_qty, epa_pk, @wsselect
                FROM   r5entityparts
                WHERE  epa_rentity = N'WKSP'
                AND    epa_code    = @fromworkspace
              OPEN chl
              FETCH NEXT FROM chl INTO @entity, @code, @org, @qty, @epapk, @select
              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                BEGIN
                  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'WMC', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT
                  INSERT INTO r5workspacemovechildren( wmc_pk, wmc_workspacemove, wmc_rentity, wmc_code, wmc_org, wmc_qty, wmc_epapk, wmc_select )
                  VALUES( @newpk, @pk, @entity, @code, @org, @qty, @epapk, @select )
                  FETCH NEXT FROM chl INTO @entity, @code, @org, @qty, @epapk, @select
                END
              CLOSE chl
              DEALLOCATE chl
            END
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7rcode @oldrstatus OUTPUT, @oldstatus, N'WMST', @chk2 OUTPUT
      IF @oldrstatus IN ( N'C', N'CA' ) 
        BEGIN
          /* The move was already closed or cancelled, so exit. */
          RETURN
        END
      /* Check whether changes have been made. */
      /* Added objects. */
      DECLARE obj CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT obj_code, obj_org, oud_meter, obj_primaryuom, CASE WHEN oud_meter IS NULL THEN oud_totalusage ELSE met_last END 
        FROM   r5objects LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs ON(obj_code = oud_object AND obj_org = oud_object_org AND obj_primaryuom = oud_uom)
                         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5meters ON (oud_meter = met_code)
        WHERE  obj_workspace = @fromworkspace
        AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                           FROM   r5workspacemovechildren
                           WHERE  wmc_workspacemove = @pk
                           AND    wmc_rentity       = 'OBJ'
                           AND    wmc_code          = obj_code
                           AND    wmc_org           = obj_org )
      OPEN obj
      FETCH NEXT FROM obj INTO @code, @org, @physicalmeter, @primaryuom, @initialmileage
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'WMC', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT
          INSERT INTO r5workspacemovechildren( wmc_pk, wmc_workspacemove, wmc_rentity, wmc_code, wmc_org, wmc_qty, wmc_epapk, wmc_select, wmc_meter, wmc_meter_uom, wmc_singlemovestatus, wmc_singlemoverstatus, wmc_initial_mileage, wmc_movestarttime )
          VALUES( @newpk, @pk, N'OBJ', @code, @org, NULL, NULL, @wsselect, CASE WHEN @equipmentmove = N'+' THEN @physicalmeter ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN @equipmentmove = N'+' THEN @primaryuom ELSE NULL END, @singlemovestatus, 
          CASE WHEN @equipmentmove = N'+' AND @wsselect = '+' THEN N'O' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN @equipmentmove = N'+' THEN @initialmileage ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN @equipmentmove = N'+' THEN dbo.o7gttime2(@org) ELSE NULL END )
          SET @changesmade = N'+'
          FETCH NEXT FROM obj INTO @code, @org, @physicalmeter, @primaryuom, @initialmileage

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_DELOLDPERMIT
  @destcode  NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @rentity   NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @ccode     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @corg      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @permclea  NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @parents   NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @code   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE stc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH parents ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org ) AS 
    ( SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org
      FROM   r5structures
      WHERE  stc_child = @ccode
      AND    stc_child_org = @corg
      UNION ALL   
      SELECT np.stc_parent, np.stc_parent_org 
      FROM   r5structures AS np JOIN parents ON np.stc_child = parents.stc_parent AND np.stc_child_org = parents.stc_parent_org )
    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org
    FROM   parents
    WHERE  @parents = N'+'
    UNION
    SELECT @ccode, @corg
  OPEN stc
  FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @code, @org
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      IF @permclea = N'DEACT'
        /* Deactivate @old object permits. */
        UPDATE r5permevents
        SET    pev_active = '-'
        WHERE  pev_event         = @destcode
        AND    pev_sourcerentity = @rentity
        AND    pev_sourcecode    = @code
        AND    ISNULL( pev_sourceorg, N'x' ) = ISNULL( @org, CASE @rentity WHEN N'STWO' THEN pev_sourceorg ELSE N'x' END )
        AND    pev_active        = N'+'
        AND    pev_ptw IS NULL
      ELSE
        /* Delete @old object permits. */
        DELETE FROM r5permevents
        WHERE  pev_event         = @destcode
        AND    pev_sourcerentity = @rentity
        AND    pev_sourcecode    = @code
        AND    ISNULL( pev_sourceorg, N'x' ) = ISNULL( @org, CASE @rentity WHEN N'STWO' THEN pev_sourceorg ELSE N'x' END )
        AND    pev_ptw IS NULL
      FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @code, @org
    END
  CLOSE stc
  DEALLOCATE stc
END
