CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_DOMATRIX
  @xorg      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @xevent    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @xobj      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @xobjorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @xloc      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @xlocorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @xclass    NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @xclassorg NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @xcategory NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @xppm      NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @xstwo     NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @xtask     NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @r5user    NVARCHAR( 255 )
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @pk NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @hrev NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @prev NUMERIC( 4 )
  IF @xtask IS NULL
    BEGIN
      DECLARE sfm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT sfm_pk, haz_revision, pca_revision
        FROM   r5organization, r5precautions, r5hazards, r5safetymatrix
        WHERE  haz_code    = sfm_hazard
        AND    haz_org     = sfm_hazard_org
        AND    haz_rstatus = N'A'
        AND    haz_notused = N'-'
        AND    pca_code    = sfm_precaution
        AND    pca_org     = sfm_precaution_org
        AND    pca_rstatus = N'A'
        AND    pca_notused = N'-'
        AND    org_code    = sfm_org
        AND    ( sfm_org = @xorg OR org_common = N'+' )
        AND    (    sfm_object IS NULL 
                 OR (     sfm_object     = @xobj
                      AND sfm_object_org = @xobjorg )
                 OR (     sfm_applytochildren = N'+'
                      AND sfm_object + N'#' + sfm_object_org IN 
                          ( SELECT parent
                            FROM   dbo.o7getequipparents( @xobj, @xobjorg ) ) )
                 OR (     sfm_object     = @xloc
                      AND sfm_object_org = @xlocorg )
                 OR (     sfm_applytochildren = N'+'
                      AND sfm_object + N'#' + sfm_object_org IN 
                          ( SELECT parent
                            FROM   dbo.o7getequipparents( @xloc, @xlocorg ) ) ) )
        AND    (     sfm_objclass IS NULL
                 OR (     sfm_objclass     = N'*' 
                      AND sfm_objclass_org = N'*' )
                 OR (     sfm_objclass     = @xclass
                      AND sfm_objclass_org = @xclassorg ) )
        AND    (     sfm_category IS NULL 
                 OR  sfm_category = @xcategory )
        AND    (     sfm_ppm IS NULL 
                 OR  sfm_ppm = @xppm )
        AND    (     sfm_standardwo IS NULL 
                 OR  sfm_standardwo = @xstwo )
        AND    (     COALESCE( sfm_task, sfm_jobplan ) IS NULL
                 OR  EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM   r5activities
                              WHERE  act_event = @xevent
                              AND    act_task  = COALESCE( sfm_task, sfm_jobplan ) ) )
        AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                            FROM   r5worksafety
                            WHERE  ksf_rentity       = N'EVNT'
                            AND    ksf_code          = @xevent
                            AND    ksf_sourcerentity = N'SFMX'
                            AND    ksf_sourcecode    = sfm_pk )
      OPEN sfm
      FETCH NEXT FROM sfm INTO @pk, @hrev, @prev
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_INSFROMMATRIX @pk, @xevent, @xorg, @hrev, @prev, @r5user
          FETCH NEXT FROM sfm INTO @pk, @hrev, @prev
        END 
      CLOSE sfm
      DEALLOCATE sfm
    END    
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      DECLARE sfm2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT sfm_pk, haz_revision, pca_revision
        FROM   r5organization, r5precautions, r5hazards, r5safetymatrix
        WHERE  haz_code    = sfm_hazard
        AND    haz_org     = sfm_hazard_org
        AND    haz_rstatus = N'A'
        AND    haz_notused = N'-'
        AND    pca_code    = sfm_precaution
        AND    pca_org     = sfm_precaution_org
        AND    pca_rstatus = N'A'
        AND    pca_notused = N'-'
        AND    org_code    = sfm_org
        AND    ( sfm_org = @xorg OR org_common = N'+' )
        AND    (    sfm_object IS NULL 
                 OR (     sfm_object     = @xobj
                      AND sfm_object_org = @xobjorg )
                 OR (     sfm_applytochildren = N'+'
                      AND sfm_object + N'#' + sfm_object_org IN 
                          ( SELECT parent
                            FROM   dbo.o7getequipparents( @xobj, @xobjorg ) ) )
                 OR (     sfm_object     = @xloc
                      AND sfm_object_org = @xlocorg )
                 OR (     sfm_applytochildren = N'+'
                      AND sfm_object + N'#' + sfm_object_org IN 
                          ( SELECT parent
                            FROM   dbo.o7getequipparents( @xloc, @xlocorg ) ) ) )
        AND    (     sfm_objclass IS NULL
                 OR (     sfm_objclass     = N'*' 
                      AND sfm_objclass_org = N'*' )
                 OR (     sfm_objclass     = @xclass
                      AND sfm_objclass_org = @xclassorg ) )
        AND    (     sfm_category IS NULL 
                 OR  sfm_category = @xcategory )
        AND    (     sfm_ppm IS NULL 
                 OR  sfm_ppm = @xppm )
        AND    (     sfm_standardwo IS NULL 
                 OR  sfm_standardwo = @xstwo )
        AND    COALESCE( sfm_task, sfm_jobplan ) = @xtask
        AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                            FROM   r5worksafety
                            WHERE  ksf_rentity       = N'EVNT'
                            AND    ksf_code          = @xevent
                            AND    ksf_sourcerentity = N'SFMX'
                            AND    ksf_sourcecode    = sfm_pk )
      OPEN sfm2
      FETCH NEXT FROM sfm2 INTO @pk, @hrev, @prev
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_INSFROMMATRIX @pk, @xevent, @xorg, @hrev, @prev, @r5user
          FETCH NEXT FROM sfm2 INTO @pk, @hrev, @prev
        END 
      CLOSE sfm2
      DEALLOCATE sfm2
    END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_INSCOMDOC
  @rentity     NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @newrent     NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @sourcepk    NVARCHAR( 100 ), 
  @pk          NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @extra       NUMERIC,
  @copydocs    NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @addcode         NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @newdoccode      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @filename        NVARCHAR( 150 )
  DECLARE @text            NVARCHAR( 4000 )
  DECLARE @ent             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @rent            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @lang            NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @line            NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @prnt            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @created         DATETIME
  DECLARE @usr             NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @updated         DATETIME
  DECLARE @updusr          NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @docfilename     NVARCHAR( 150 )
  DECLARE @docrtype        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @doctype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @docfiletype     NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @docfilesize     NUMERIC( 12 )
  DECLARE @docorg          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @daetype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @daertype        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @daecopytowo     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @daeprintonwo    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @daecopytopo     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @daeprintonpo    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @daedocument     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return          INT
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 )
   
  /* Copy comments. */
  DECLARE c_add CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT add_entity, 
           add_rentity,
           add_lang,   
           add_line,   
           add_print,  
           add_text,                                                                        
           add_created,
           add_user,
           add_updated,
           add_upduser
    FROM   r5addetails
    WHERE  add_code    = @sourcepk                                                         
    AND    add_rentity = @rentity
  OPEN c_add
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_add INTO @ent, @rent, @lang, @line, @prnt, @text, @created, @usr, @updated, @updusr
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO r5addetails ( add_entity, add_rentity, add_type, add_rtype, add_code, add_lang,
             add_line, add_print, add_text, add_created, add_user, add_updated, add_upduser ) 
      SELECT ent_entity, ent_rentity, '*', '*', @pk, @lang, @line + @extra, @prnt, @text, @created, @usr, @updated, @updusr 
      FROM   r5entities
      WHERE  ent_rentity = @newrent
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_add INTO @ent, @rent, @lang, @line, @prnt, @text, @created, @usr, @updated, @updusr
    END
  CLOSE c_add
  DEALLOCATE c_add

  IF @copydocs = N'-'
    /* Return if docs don't need to be copied. */
    RETURN

  /* Copy non-dynamic documents. */
  INSERT INTO r5docentities( dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type, 
         dae_rtype, dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo )
  SELECT d.dae_document, t.ent_entity, t.ent_rentity, d.dae_type, d.dae_rtype, 
         @pk, d.dae_copytowo, d.dae_printonwo, d.dae_copytopo, d.dae_printonpo
  FROM   r5entities t, r5docentities d, r5documents e
  WHERE  d.dae_code     = @sourcepk
  AND    d.dae_rentity  = @rentity 
  AND    t.ent_rentity  = @newrent
  AND    d.dae_document = e.doc_code
  AND    e.doc_notused  = N'-'
  AND    e.doc_rtype IN ( N'F', N'S', N'U' )
  
  /* Copy dynamic documents. */
  DECLARE c_doc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT e.doc_filename,
           e.doc_rtype,
           e.doc_type,
           e.doc_filetype,
           e.doc_filesize,
           e.doc_org,
           d.dae_type,
           d.dae_rtype,
           d.dae_copytowo,
           d.dae_printonwo,
           d.dae_copytopo,
           d.dae_printonpo,
           d.dae_document
    FROM   r5docentities d, r5documents e
    WHERE  d.dae_code     = @sourcepk 
    AND    d.dae_rentity  = @rentity 
    AND    d.dae_document = e.doc_code 
    AND    e.doc_rtype    = N'D'
    AND    e.doc_notused  = N'-'
  OPEN c_doc
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_doc INTO @docfilename, @docrtype, @doctype, @docfiletype, @docfilesize, @docorg,  
                             @daetype, @daertype, @daecopytowo, @daeprintonwo, @daecopytopo, @daeprintonpo, @daedocument
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newdoccode OUTPUT, N'DOCS', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
      SET @filename = @newdoccode + N'-' + @docfilename
      
      INSERT INTO r5documents( doc_code, doc_desc, doc_rtype, doc_type, doc_filetype, doc_filename, doc_filesize, doc_org )
      VALUES ( @newdoccode, @newrent+N' '+@pk, @docrtype, @doctype, @docfiletype, @filename, @docfilesize, @docorg )
      
      EXECUTE @return = o7dupbody @daedocument, @newdoccode 
    
      INSERT INTO r5docentities( dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type, 
             dae_rtype, dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo )
      SELECT @newdoccode, ent_entity, @rentity, @daetype, @daertype, 
             @pk, @daecopytowo, @daeprintonwo, @daecopytopo, @daeprintonpo
      FROM   r5entities
      WHERE  ent_rentity = @newrent

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_doc INTO @docfilename, @docrtype, @doctype, @docfiletype, @docfilesize, @docorg,  
                                 @daetype, @daertype, @daecopytowo, @daeprintonwo, @daecopytopo, @daeprintonpo, @daedocument
    END
  CLOSE c_doc
  DEALLOCATE c_doc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_INSFROMMATRIX
  @xpk      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @xevent   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @xorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @hrev     NUMERIC( 4 ),
  @prev     NUMERIC( 4 ),
  @r5user   NVARCHAR( 255 )
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @pk       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return   INT
  DECLARE @chk      NVARCHAR( 4 )

  /* Get next pk. */
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'SFTY', N'1', @chk OUTPUT

  /* Insert actual safety record. */

         ksf_precaution, ksf_precaution_org, ksf_precautionrev, ksf_deletepending, ksf_timing, ksf_sequence,
         ksf_healthhazard, ksf_flammability, ksf_instability, ksf_specialhazards, ksf_validuntil,
         ksf_created, ksf_createdby, ksf_updated, ksf_updatedby, ksf_reviewed, ksf_reviewedby,
         ksf_reviewedname, ksf_reviewedtype, ksf_sourcerentity, ksf_sourcecode, ksf_sourceorg,
         ksf_sourceupdated, ksf_sourceupdatedby,
         ksf_udfchar01, ksf_udfchar02, ksf_udfchar03, ksf_udfchar04, ksf_udfchar05,
         ksf_udfchar06, ksf_udfchar07, ksf_udfchar08, ksf_udfchar09, ksf_udfchar10,
         ksf_udfchar11, ksf_udfchar12, ksf_udfchar13, ksf_udfchar14, ksf_udfchar15,
         ksf_udfchar16, ksf_udfchar17, ksf_udfchar18, ksf_udfchar19, ksf_udfchar20,
         ksf_udfchar21, ksf_udfchar22, ksf_udfchar23, ksf_udfchar24, ksf_udfchar25,
         ksf_udfchar26, ksf_udfchar27, ksf_udfchar28, ksf_udfchar29, ksf_udfchar30,
         ksf_udfnum01, ksf_udfnum02, ksf_udfnum03, ksf_udfnum04, ksf_udfnum05,
         ksf_udfdate01, ksf_udfdate02, ksf_udfdate03, ksf_udfdate04, ksf_udfdate05,
         ksf_udfchkbox01, ksf_udfchkbox02, ksf_udfchkbox03, ksf_udfchkbox04, ksf_udfchkbox05,
         ksf_responsibility )
  SELECT @pk, N'EVNT', @xevent, sfm_hazard, sfm_hazard_org, @hrev,
         sfm_precaution, sfm_precaution_org, @prev, NULL, sfm_timing, sfm_sequence,
         sfm_healthhazard, sfm_flammability, sfm_instability, sfm_specialhazards, sfm_safetyreviewrequired,
         dbo.o7gttime2( @xorg ), @r5user, NULL, NULL, sfm_reviewed, sfm_reviewedby,
         sfm_reviewedname, sfm_reviewedtype, N'SFMX', sfm_pk, sfm_org,
         ISNULL( sfm_updated, sfm_created ), ISNULL( sfm_updatedby, sfm_createdby ),
         sfm_udfchar01, sfm_udfchar02, sfm_udfchar03, sfm_udfchar04, sfm_udfchar05,
         sfm_udfchar06, sfm_udfchar07, sfm_udfchar08, sfm_udfchar09, sfm_udfchar10,
         sfm_udfchar11, sfm_udfchar12, sfm_udfchar13, sfm_udfchar14, sfm_udfchar15,
         sfm_udfchar16, sfm_udfchar17, sfm_udfchar18, sfm_udfchar19, sfm_udfchar20,
         sfm_udfchar21, sfm_udfchar22, sfm_udfchar23, sfm_udfchar24, sfm_udfchar25,
         sfm_udfchar26, sfm_udfchar27, sfm_udfchar28, sfm_udfchar29, sfm_udfchar30,
         sfm_udfnum01, sfm_udfnum02, sfm_udfnum03, sfm_udfnum04, sfm_udfnum05,
         sfm_udfdate01, sfm_udfdate02, sfm_udfdate03, sfm_udfdate04, sfm_udfdate05,
         sfm_udfchkbox01, sfm_udfchkbox02, sfm_udfchkbox03, sfm_udfchkbox04, sfm_udfchkbox05,
         pca_responsibility 
  FROM   r5safetymatrix, r5precautions
  WHERE  sfm_pk                 = @xpk
  AND    sfm_precaution         = pca_code
  AND    sfm_precaution_org     = pca_org
  AND    pca_revision      = @prev ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_INSPERMIT
  @destorg           NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @destrentity       NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @destcode          NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sourcerentity     NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @sourceprecode     NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @sourcecode        NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @sourceorg         NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @validuntil        DATETIME,
  @r5user            NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @applytochildren   NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @ptwauto           NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @ptwmec            NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @ptwlimit          NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @routeparent       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @wotype            NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @sourcesqlid   INT
  DECLARE @permit        NVARCHAR( 12 )
  DECLARE @permitorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sourcepk      NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @pk            NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return        INT
  DECLARE @chk           NVARCHAR( 4 )  
  DECLARE @maxpermit     NUMERIC

  DECLARE pre CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT pre_sqlidentity, pre_permit, pre_permit_org
    FROM   r5organization, r5permentities
    WHERE  org_code    = pre_permit_org
    AND    pre_rentity = @sourcerentity      
    AND    pre_code    = @sourceprecode
    AND    pre_applytochildren LIKE @applytochildren
    AND    ( org_common = N'+' OR pre_permit_org = @destorg )
  OPEN pre
  FETCH NEXT FROM pre INTO @sourcesqlid, @permit, @permitorg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Delete old deacivated permits first, which will be re-inserted. */
      DELETE FROM r5permevents
      WHERE  pev_event         = @destcode
      AND    pev_active        = N'-'
      AND    pev_sourcerentity = @sourcerentity
      AND    pev_sourcecode    = @sourcecode
      AND    ISNULL( pev_sourceorg, N'x' ) = ISNULL( @sourceorg, N'x' )
      AND    pev_permit + N'#' + pev_permit_org + N'#' + CAST( pev_permitrev AS NVARCHAR ) IN 
             ( SELECT pre_permit + N'#' + pre_permit_org + N'#' + CAST( prt_revision AS NVARCHAR )
               FROM   r5permits, r5permentities e
               WHERE  prt_code        = pre_permit
               AND    prt_org         = pre_permit_org
               AND    prt_rstatus     = N'A'
               AND    pre_sqlidentity = @sourcesqlid )

      /* Insert actual permit event record, get next code first. */
      SELECT @maxpermit = MAX( CAST( SUBSTRING( pev_code, LEN( pev_event ) + 1, 100 ) AS NUMERIC ) )
      FROM   r5permevents
      WHERE  pev_event = @destcode
   
      SET @sourcepk = @sourcerentity + N'#' + @permit + N'#' + @permitorg + N'#' + @sourceprecode
      SET @pk = @destcode+CAST( ISNULL( @maxpermit, 0 ) + 1 AS NVARCHAR )
      INSERT INTO r5permevents( pev_code, pev_event, pev_permit, pev_permit_org, pev_permitrev, pev_date, pev_active,
             pev_autocreateptw, pev_lotorequired, pev_activity, pev_ptwtype, pev_typeofwork, pev_priority, 
             pev_risk, pev_isolationtype, pev_created, pev_createdby, pev_updated, pev_updatedby, pev_reviewed, pev_reviewedby, 
             pev_reviewedname, pev_reviewedtype, pev_sourcerentity, pev_sourcecode, pev_sourceorg, pev_sourceupdated, pev_sourceupdatedby,
             pev_validuntil, pev_deletepending, pev_mand,
             pev_udfchar01, pev_udfchar02, pev_udfchar03, pev_udfchar04, pev_udfchar05,
             pev_udfchar06, pev_udfchar07, pev_udfchar08, pev_udfchar09, pev_udfchar10,
             pev_udfchar11, pev_udfchar12, pev_udfchar13, pev_udfchar14, pev_udfchar15,
             pev_udfchar16, pev_udfchar17, pev_udfchar18, pev_udfchar19, pev_udfchar20,
             pev_udfchar21, pev_udfchar22, pev_udfchar23, pev_udfchar24, pev_udfchar25,
             pev_udfchar26, pev_udfchar27, pev_udfchar28, pev_udfchar29, pev_udfchar30,
             pev_udfnum01, pev_udfnum02, pev_udfnum03, pev_udfnum04, pev_udfnum05,
             pev_udfdate01, pev_udfdate02, pev_udfdate03, pev_udfdate04, pev_udfdate05,
             pev_udfchkbox01, pev_udfchkbox02, pev_udfchkbox03, pev_udfchkbox04, pev_udfchkbox05 )
      SELECT @pk, @destcode, pre_permit, pre_permit_org, prt_revision, NULL, N'X',
             pre_autocreateptw, pre_lotorequired, pre_activity, pre_ptwtype, pre_typeofwork, pre_priority, 
             pre_risk, pre_isolationtype, dbo.o7gttime2(@destorg), @r5user, NULL, NULL, pre_reviewed, pre_reviewedby, 
             pre_reviewedname, pre_reviewedtype, @sourcerentity, @sourcecode, @sourceorg, 
             ISNULL( pre_updated, pre_created ), ISNULL( pre_updatedby, pre_createdby ),
             @validuntil, pre_deletepending, pre_mand,
             pre_udfchar01, pre_udfchar02, pre_udfchar03, pre_udfchar04, pre_udfchar05,
             pre_udfchar06, pre_udfchar07, pre_udfchar08, pre_udfchar09, pre_udfchar10,
             pre_udfchar11, pre_udfchar12, pre_udfchar13, pre_udfchar14, pre_udfchar15,
             pre_udfchar16, pre_udfchar17, pre_udfchar18, pre_udfchar19, pre_udfchar20,
             pre_udfchar21, pre_udfchar22, pre_udfchar23, pre_udfchar24, pre_udfchar25,
             pre_udfchar26, pre_udfchar27, pre_udfchar28, pre_udfchar29, pre_udfchar30,
             pre_udfnum01, pre_udfnum02, pre_udfnum03, pre_udfnum04, pre_udfnum05,
             pre_udfdate01, pre_udfdate02, pre_udfdate03, pre_udfdate04, pre_udfdate05,
             pre_udfchkbox01, pre_udfchkbox02, pre_udfchkbox03, pre_udfchkbox04, pre_udfchkbox05
      FROM   r5permits, r5permentities
      WHERE  prt_code        = pre_permit
      AND    prt_org         = pre_permit_org
      AND    prt_rstatus     = N'A'
      AND    pre_sqlidentity = @sourcesqlid
      AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                         FROM   r5permevents 
                         WHERE  pev_event         = @destcode
                         AND    pev_permit        = pre_permit
                         AND    pev_permit_org    = pre_permit_org
                         AND    pev_permitrev     = prt_revision
                         AND    pev_sourcerentity = @sourcerentity
                         AND    pev_sourcecode    = @sourcecode
                         AND    ISNULL( pev_sourceorg, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sourceorg, 'x' ) 
                         AND    ISNULL( pev_activity, 0 ) = ISNULL( pre_activity, 0 ) )

      IF @@RowCount > 0
        EXECUTE @return = o7wosafetypermit_inscomdoc N'PERM', N'PRME', @sourcepk, @pk, 0, N'+' 
      FETCH NEXT FROM pre INTO @sourcesqlid, @permit, @permitorg
    END  
  CLOSE pre
  DEALLOCATE pre
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WOSAFETYPERMIT_INSSAFETY
  @destorg          NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @destrentity      NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @destcode         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sourcerentity    NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @sourceesfcode    NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @sourcecode       NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @sourceorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @safetyreviewreq  DATETIME,
  @r5user           NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @applytochildren  NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @sourcepk         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @hazard           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @hazardorg        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @precaution       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @precautionorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @pk               NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return           INT
  DECLARE @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 )

  DECLARE esf CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT esf_pk, esf_hazard, esf_hazard_org, esf_precaution, esf_precaution_org
    FROM   r5organization o1, r5organization o2, r5entitysafety
    WHERE  o1.org_code = esf_hazard_org
    AND    o2.org_code = esf_precaution_org
    AND    esf_rentity = @sourcerentity      
    AND    esf_code    = @sourceesfcode
    AND    esf_applytochildren LIKE @applytochildren
    AND    ( o1.org_common = N'+' OR esf_hazard_org = @destorg )
    AND    ( o2.org_common = N'+' OR esf_precaution_org = @destorg )
  OPEN esf
  FETCH NEXT FROM esf INTO @sourcepk, @hazard, @hazardorg, @precaution, @precautionorg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Check if record already exists. */
      SET @pk = NULL
      SELECT @pk = ksf_pk
      FROM   r5worksafety
      WHERE  ksf_rentity        = @destrentity      
      AND    ksf_code           = @destcode
      AND    ksf_hazard         = @hazard
      AND    ksf_hazard_org     = @hazardorg
      AND    ksf_precaution     = @precaution
      AND    ksf_precaution_org = @precautionorg
      AND    ksf_sourcerentity  = @sourcerentity
      AND    ksf_sourcecode     = @sourcecode
      AND    ISNULL( ksf_sourceorg, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sourceorg, 'x' )

      IF @pk IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Record already exists, don't copy, go to next */
          FETCH NEXT FROM esf INTO @sourcepk, @hazard, @hazardorg, @precaution, @precautionorg
          CONTINUE
        END  
    
      /* Get next pk. */
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'SFTY', N'1', @chk OUTPUT

      /* Insert actual safety record. */
      INSERT INTO r5worksafety( ksf_pk, ksf_rentity, ksf_code, ksf_hazard, ksf_hazard_org, ksf_hazardrev, 
             ksf_precaution, ksf_precaution_org, ksf_precautionrev, ksf_deletepending, ksf_timing, ksf_sequence, 
             ksf_healthhazard, ksf_flammability, ksf_instability, ksf_specialhazards, ksf_validuntil,
             ksf_created, ksf_createdby, ksf_updated, ksf_updatedby, ksf_reviewed, ksf_reviewedby, 
             ksf_reviewedname, ksf_reviewedtype, ksf_sourcerentity, ksf_sourcecode, ksf_sourceorg, 
             ksf_sourceupdated, ksf_sourceupdatedby,

    END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7WRCALA 
    @sSess     nvarchar(30),
    @sUsr      nvarchar(255),
    @sMrc      nvarchar(15),
    @sSystem   nvarchar(30),
    @sObject   nvarchar(30),
    @sClass    nvarchar(15),
    @sCat      nvarchar(30),
    @sCrit     nvarchar(8),
    @nCal      numeric(30,0),
    @sPass     nvarchar(100),
    @sNoncon   nvarchar(100),
    @sIncPF    nvarchar(100),
    @sIncPR    nvarchar(100),
    @sIncI     nvarchar(100),
    @sOrg      nvarchar(15),
    @dSdate    datetime,
    @dEdate    datetime,
    @sRole     nvarchar(30)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	/* cursor variables */
	declare @sObj_code  	nvarchar(30),
			@sObj_org   	nvarchar(15),
			@sObj_mrc		nvarchar(15),
			@sEvt_code  	nvarchar(30),
			@sEvt_calstatus nvarchar(2)

    declare @nRecno   numeric(30,0)       -- Record number within object
    declare @nHits    numeric(30,0)        -- Number of total hits
    declare @nConhits numeric(30,0)       -- Number of consecutive hits
    declare @nGoal    numeric(30,0)        -- Number of hits needed
    declare @sOldstat nvarchar(1)  -- Previous status

    IF @nCal <> cast( @nCal as int)
        set @nGoal = 1
    ELSE
        set @nGoal = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @nCal, 1 )
    -- Loop through all equipment.
	declare cObj cursor local for
    SELECT DISTINCT obj_code,
         			obj_org,
         			obj_mrc
    FROM   r5objects,
           r5userorganization,
           r5events
    WHERE  evt_object     = obj_code
    AND    evt_object_org = obj_org
    AND    obj_org        = uog_org
    AND    uog_user       = @sUsr
    AND    uog_role       = @sRole
    AND    obj_mrc        LIKE @sMrc
    AND    obj_code       LIKE @sObject
    AND    obj_org        LIKE @sOrg
    AND    isnull( obj_class, N'%' )       LIKE @sClass
    AND    isnull( obj_category, N'%' )    LIKE @sCat
    AND    isnull( obj_criticality, N'%' ) LIKE @sCrit
    AND    evt_calstatus IS NOT NULL
    AND    evt_calstatus IN ( @sPass,
                            CASE @sIncPF WHEN N'+' THEN N'PF' END,
                            CASE @sIncPR WHEN N'+' THEN N'PR' END,
                            CASE @sIncI WHEN  N'+' THEN N'I' END )
    AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
    AND    evt_completed BETWEEN @dSdate AND @dEdate + .9999
    AND  ( @sSystem = N'%' OR
         EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                  FROM   r5structures
                  WHERE  stc_parent LIKE @sSystem
                  AND    stc_parentrtype = N'S'
                  AND 	 stc_child     = obj_code
                  AND    stc_child_org = obj_org ) )
    ORDER BY obj_mrc, obj_code, obj_org
	open cObj
	fetch next from cObj into @sObj_code, @sObj_org, @sObj_mrc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
	    set @nRecno   = 0
	    set @nHits    = 0
	    set @nConhits = 0
	    set @sOldstat = N'x'
	    -- Loop through all work orders related to the current equipment.
		declare cEvt cursor static local for
  		SELECT evt_code,
         	   CASE evt_calstatus
               WHEN N'P' THEN CASE @sPass WHEN N'P' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END
               WHEN N'F' THEN CASE @sPass WHEN N'F' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END
               WHEN N'I' THEN  @sIncI
               WHEN N'PF' THEN @sIncPF
               WHEN N'PR' THEN @sIncPR END calstatus
        FROM   r5events
  		WHERE  evt_object     = @sObj_code
  		AND    evt_object_org = @sObj_org
  		AND    evt_calstatus IS NOT NULL
  		AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
  		AND    evt_completed BETWEEN @dSdate AND @dEdate + .9999
  		ORDER BY evt_completed DESC
		OPEN cEvt
		fetch next from cEvt into @sEvt_code, @sEvt_calstatus
		while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
	        set @nRecno  = @nRecno + 1
		    IF @sEvt_calstatus = N'+'
			begin
		        IF @sEvt_calstatus = @sOldstat
		            set @nConhits = @nConhits + 1
		        ELSE
				begin
		            IF @sNoncon = N'-'
					begin
			            -- Consecutives only!
			            IF @nConhits >= @nGoal
			                -- Keep all inserts for current object.
							begin	
								if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
									COMMIT
							end
			            ELSE
			                -- Remove all inserts for current object ( that weren't committed before ).
			                begin	
								if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
									ROLLBACK
							end
		            end
		            set @nConhits = 1
		        end
		        INSERT INTO r5wrcala ( wrc_session,    wrc_mrc,   wrc_object,
		                               wrc_object_org, wrc_recno, wrc_event  )
		        VALUES( @sSess, @sObj_mrc, @sObj_code, @sObj_org, @nRecno, @sEvt_code )
		        set @nHits = @nHits + 1
			end
		    ELSE
			begin
		        IF @sNoncon = N'-' 
				begin
		            -- Consecutives only!
		            IF @nConhits >= @nGoal
		                -- Keep all inserts for current object.
		            	begin	
							if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
								COMMIT
						end
		            ELSE
		                -- Remove all inserts for current object ( that weren't committed before ).
			            begin	
							if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
								ROLLBACK
						end
		        end
		        set @nConhits = 0
		    end
		    set @sOldstat = @sEvt_calstatus
			fetch next from cEvt into @sEvt_code, @sEvt_calstatus
		end-- end of while
		close cEvt
		deallocate cEvt
	    IF @sNoncon = N'+'
		begin
	      -- Non consecutives!
	      IF @nHits >= @nGoal
	          -- Keep all inserts for current object.
		    begin	
				if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					COMMIT
			end
	      ELSE
	          -- Remove all inserts for current object.
			begin	
				if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					ROLLBACK
			end
		end
	    ELSE
		begin
	        -- Consecutives only!
	        IF @nConhits >= @nGoal
	            -- Keep all inserts for current object.
		        begin	
					if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
						COMMIT
				end
	        ELSE
	            -- Remove all inserts for current object ( that weren't committed before ).
				begin	
					if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
						ROLLBACK
				end
	    end
		fetch next from cObj into @sObj_code, @sObj_org, @sObj_mrc
	end --end of while
	close cObj
	deallocate cObj

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7WSPLAYOUT
				@sWspCode NVARCHAR(6)
				,@sPageName NVARCHAR(40)
				,@sIsUserDefScreen NVARCHAR(5)
				,@sUserGroupCode NVARCHAR(12)
				,@chk NVARCHAR(1) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nCount				integer
	declare @nDivide			integer
	declare @ngrp				integer
	declare @sContName			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sGroup_extc		nvarchar(12)
	declare @sUserGroup			nvarchar(12)
	declare @nFldCount			integer
	declare @nWspGroup			integer
	declare @sFieldId			nvarchar(40)
	declare @sFieldAttr			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @sysFieldType		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCustomFieldId		nvarchar(40)
	declare @sWsPFieldId		nvarchar(40)
	declare @sSqlString			nvarchar(max)
	declare @sCondition			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sFieldsNotToBeDeleted			nvarchar(max)
	declare @iFirstTimeFieldsRunThrough		integer

	declare @vEntity nvarchar(4);
	declare @vUOM nvarchar(30);
	declare @vCURR nvarchar(3);
	declare @vTempFieldId nvarchar(40);
	declare @vFuncName nvarchar(6);
	declare @vTabName nvarchar(6);
	declare @vUOMAndCURRFieldsInserted integer;

	declare @vFinalContainerName nvarchar(20);
	declare @vContType nvarchar(1);
	declare @vFieldType nvarchar(4);
	declare @vMaxLength integer;
	declare @vBlockVisibilityAttribute nvarchar(1);
	declare @vLastLeftBlockNum nvarchar(2);
	declare @vElementsInBottomBlock integer;
	declare @vPageLayoutMEFlag nvarchar(1);
	declare @vHasDocuments nvarchar(1);
	declare @vDocTabName nvarchar(10);
begin

	set @iFirstTimeFieldsRunThrough = 1
	set @vUOMAndCURRFieldsInserted = 0
	set @sFieldsNotToBeDeleted = ''

	-- Detemine if the UD screen needs documents tab layout created.
	if @sIsUserDefScreen = 'true' and @sPageName not like '%[_]U%'
		begin
			select @vHasDocuments = case when usc_entity is not null then '+' else '-' end from R5UDFSCREENS where usc_screenname = '' + @sWSPCode;
			set @vDocTabName = @sWSPCode + '_DOC';
		end

	declare cUserGroup cursor local for  select ugr_code from r5groups
	where ugr_login=N'+' and ugr_requestor=N'-' and ugr_code=coalesce(@sUserGroupCode, ugr_code)

	open cUserGroup
	fetch next from cUserGroup into @sUserGroup
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			set @vPageLayoutMEFlag = null
			if @sUserGroup = 'R5' or @sUserGroup = '*' or @sUserGroup = 'CUSTOMCREATE'
				set @vPageLayoutMEFlag = N'E'

			-- Insert documents tab layout
			if @vHasDocuments = '+'
				begin
					if not exists (select plo_pagename
									from r5pagelayout
									where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
									and plo_pagename = @vDocTabName
									and plo_elementid = 'addnew'
									and plo_elementtype = 'LB')
							insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
									plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
									values (@sUserGroup,@vDocTabName,'addnew','LB',
									'Y','O','O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);

					if not exists (select plo_pagename from r5pagelayout
									where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
									and plo_pagename  = @vDocTabName
									and plo_elementid = 'block_1'
									and plo_elementtype = 'B')
							insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
									plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
									values (@sUserGroup,@vDocTabName,'block_1','B',
									'Y','O','O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);

					if not exists (select plo_pagename from r5pagelayout
									where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
									and plo_pagename  = @vDocTabName
									and plo_elementid = 'createoruploaddocument'
									and plo_elementtype = 'LB')
					insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
									plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
									values (@sUserGroup,@vDocTabName,'createoruploaddocument','LB',
									'Y','O','O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);
				end

			declare cFldCount cursor local for
			select COUNT(WSF_LINE) FCOUNT, wsf_processgroup from r5wspromptfields where wsf_wspmTcode=@sWspCode
			 and wsf_line>0 group by wsf_processgroup
			 order by wsf_processgroup

			open cFldCount
			fetch next from cFldCount into @nFldCount, @nWspGroup
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				set @nDivide = ceiling(@nFldCount/2)
				set @nCount =0

				set @sContName = CASE WHEN @sIsUserDefScreen = 'false' THEN 'cont_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'.2' ELSE 'cont_2' END;
				set @ngrp =0

				-- insert the blocks
				if not exists (select plo_pagename
								from r5pagelayout
								where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
								and plo_pagename = @sPageName
								and plo_elementid = 'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_1'
								and plo_elementtype = 'B')
						insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
								plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
							values (@sUserGroup,@sPageName,'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_1','B',
								'Y','H','O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);

				if not exists (select plo_pagename from r5pagelayout
								where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
								and plo_pagename  = @sPageName
								and plo_elementid = 'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_2'
								and plo_elementtype = 'B')
						insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
								plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
								values (@sUserGroup,@sPageName,'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_2','B',
								'Y','O','O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);

				-- Don't insert the CF block for UDS List Detail tabs.
				if  @sIsUserDefScreen='false' OR @sIsUserDefScreen='true' AND @sPageName not like '%[_]U%'
					if not exists (select plo_pagename from r5pagelayout
									where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
									and plo_pagename  = @sPageName
									and plo_elementid = 'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_CF'
									and plo_elementtype = 'B')
					insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
									plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
									values (@sUserGroup,@sPageName,'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_CF','B',
									'Y',CASE @sIsUserDefScreen WHEN 'true' THEN 'H' ELSE 'O' END,'O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);

				-- Add four additional blocks for User Defined Screens
				if @sIsUserDefScreen = 'true'
					begin
						if not exists (select plo_pagename
										from r5pagelayout
										where plo_usergroup = @sUserGroup
										and plo_pagename = @sPageName
										and plo_elementid = 'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_3'
										and plo_elementtype = 'B')
								insert into r5pagelayout (plo_usergroup, plo_pagename,plo_elementid,plo_elementtype,
										plo_presentinjsp,plo_attribute, plo_systemattribute,plo_mekey,plo_meflag )
									values (@sUserGroup,@sPageName,'block_'+cast(@nWspGroup as nvarchar)+'_3','B',
										'Y','H','O','YY',@vPageLayoutMEFlag);

						if not exists (select plo_pagename from r5pagelayout

										and plo_pagename  = @sPageName

CREATE function O7WZWOSHCOST ( @sCtype      nvarchar(16),
                               @sIncode     nvarchar(30) )
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin

        declare @nHours    numeric(24,6)

        declare @nAct_lab  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nAct_mat  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nAct_dma  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nAct_hir  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nAct_fix  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nAct_tool numeric(30,6)

        declare @nEst_lab  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nEst_mat  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nEst_dma  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nEst_hir  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nEst_fix  numeric(30,6)
        declare @nEst_tool numeric(30,6)

        declare @sStat     NVARCHAR(4000)

        declare @nReturn   int
        declare @sDatabase varchar(128)

        set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )

        if @sCtype = N'PLHRS' 
           begin
               set @nHours = 0.0
               SELECT @nHours   = SUM( act_est )
               FROM   r5activities
               WHERE  act_event = @sIncode
               return (@nHours)
           end

        if @sCtype = N'ACTUAL'
           begin
               set @nAct_lab = 0.0
               set @nAct_mat = 0.0
               set @nAct_dma = 0.0
               set @nAct_hir = 0.0
               set @nAct_fix = 0.0
               set @nAct_tool = 0.0
               set @sStat = ''

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_O7ACTLAB', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nAct_lab OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_O7ACTMAT', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nAct_mat OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_O7ACTDMA', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nAct_dma OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_O7ACTHIR', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nAct_hir OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_O7ACTFIX', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nAct_fix OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ O7ACTTOOL', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nAct_tool OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                       return -1

               return ( isnull(@nAct_lab, 0.0) + isnull(@nAct_mat, 0.0) + isnull(@nAct_dma, 0.0) + isnull(@nAct_hir, 0.0) + isnull(@nAct_fix, 0.0) + isnull(@nAct_tool, 0.0) )
           end

        if @sCtype = N'ESTIMATED'
           begin
               set @nEst_lab = 0.0
               set @nEst_mat = 0.0
               set @nEst_dma = 0.0
               set @nEst_hir = 0.0
               set @nEst_fix = 0.0
               set @nEst_tool = 0.0
               set @sStat = ''

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ESTLAB', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nEst_lab OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ESTMAT', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nEst_mat OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ESTDMA', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nEst_dma OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ESTHIR', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nEst_hir OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ESTFIX', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nEst_fix OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      return -1

               execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7WZWOSH_ESTTOOL', 'EVT', @sIncode, @nEst_tool OUTPUT, @sStat OUTPUT
                   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      return -1 

               return ( isnull(@nEst_lab, 0.0) + isnull(@nEst_mat, 0.0) + isnull(@nEst_dma, 0.0) + isnull(@nEst_hir, 0.0) + isnull(@nEst_fix, 0.0) + isnull(@nEst_tool, 0.0) )
           end

        return 0.0
end

create PROCEDURE O7XLSDEP
  @sAction				nvarchar(24),
  @sSess					nvarchar(30),
  @sWhereclause		nvarchar(3000),
  @nCount				integer OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare	@sTempCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sTempOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare	@nReturn		integer
	declare	@sSQL			nvarchar(4000)

	IF @sAction = N'COUNT' 
		begin
			set @sSQL = 'SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*) FROM R5OBJECTS ' + @sWhereclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCount integer OUTPUT, ', @nCount OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			if @sAction = N'DELETE' 
				begin
					DELETE FROM r5depexcel
					WHERE  dex_session = @sSess
					COMMIT
				end
			else
				begin
					DELETE FROM r5depexcel
					WHERE  dex_session = @sSess

					set @sSQL =    N'insert into #tCode SELECT obj_code, obj_org FROM r5objects ' + @sWhereclause

					CREATE TABLE #tCode(code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN null, 
										org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN null)

					EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL
					IF @@ERROR <> 0
						begin
							drop table #tCode
							return -1
						end

					-- create a cursor to loop on the temp table records 
					declare c_Code cursor local for select code, org
													FROM #tCode
					open c_Code
					fetch next from c_Code into @sTempCode, @sTempOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							INSERT INTO r5depexcel( dex_session, dex_object, dex_object_org )
							VALUES( @sSess, @sTempCode, @sTempOrg )
							if @@ERROR <> 0 
								begin
									drop table #tCode
									close c_Code
									deallocate c_Code
									return -1
								end
							fetch next from c_Code into @sTempCode
						end
					drop table #tCode
					close c_Code
					deallocate c_Code
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.PADDETAIL
                 @sErrorText NVARCHAR(255)
                ,@sEvent     NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nIncrement NUMERIC(4, 0)
                ,@nAddLine   NUMERIC(12) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sCheck    NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sEntity   NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sLanguage NVARCHAR(2)
       ,@nReturn   INT
	   ,@sCurruser			nvarchar(255)

       

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7UCODE @sEntity OUTPUT, N'CEV', N'ENTP', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
   RETURN -1

execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCurruser OUTPUT
if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
	RETURN -1

SELECT @sLanguage = usr_lang
FROM   r5users
WHERE  usr_code = @sCurruser

IF @sLanguage IS NULL 
	begin
		EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7DFLT @sLanguage OUTPUT, N'DEFLANG', @sCheck OUTPUT
		IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		   RETURN -1
	end

SET @nAddLine = @nAddLine + 1
INSERT INTO r5addetails
           (add_entity
           ,add_rentity
           ,add_code
           ,add_lang
           ,add_line
           ,add_print
           ,add_text)
    VALUES (@sEntity
           ,N'CEV'
           ,@sEvent + N'#' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nIncrement)
           ,@sLanguage
           ,@nAddLine
           ,N'+'
           ,@sErrorText)
END

create trigger POSDEL_ACC
on R5ACTIONCODES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select ACC_CODE from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							/* W1343 Delete all associated data of the record  */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'PERM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_ACK
ON R5ACTCHECKLISTS
FOR DELETE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
	DECLARE @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sX				nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @nReturn		int
	DECLARE @sCode			nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sAct           numeric(8)
	declare @sLoto          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCasetask      nvarchar(30)

	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ack_code, ack_event, ack_act, ack_loto, ack_casetask FROM deleted
			SET @sX = NULL
			SET @sCheckresult = N'0'
			SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
				BEGIN
					OPEN c_deleted 
					FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sCode, @sEvent, @sAct, @sLoto, @sCasetask
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'TCLI', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @sAct = 0
								begin
									/* Reset Permit To Work esignature information. */
									UPDATE r5permittowork SET ptw_reviewed = null, ptw_reviewedby = null, ptw_reviewedtype = null WHERE ptw_code = @sEvent AND @sLoto IS NOT NULL;
									/* Reset Case Management esignature information. */
                                    UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sEvent AND @sCasetask IS NOT NULL;                            
								end
							IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_deleted
									DEALLOCATE c_deleted
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END

							IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_deleted
									DEALLOCATE c_deleted
									EXECUTE O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END
							FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sCode, @sEvent, @sAct, @sLoto, @sCasetask
						END
					CLOSE c_deleted
				END
			DEALLOCATE c_deleted
		END

	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCompositecode nvarchar(100) --r5descriptions.des_code%TYPE;
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nACT			numeric(8)
	declare @dToday			datetime
	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dInterface		datetime
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sKey			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sValue			nvarchar(400)	
	declare @nFirstact		numeric(8)
	declare @nNewfirst      numeric(8)
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select ACT_EVENT, ACT_ACT from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @dToday = getdate()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent, @nACT
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							DELETE FROM r5activities
							WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
							AND    act_parent = @nACT

                            --new cascading delete FK takes care of this now.
							--DELETE FROM r5actqualifications
							--WHERE  aqu_event    = @sEvent
							--AND    aqu_activity = @nACT

							set @sCompositecode = @sEvent + N'#' + cast(@nACT as nvarchar(8))

							DELETE FROM r5addetails
							WHERE  add_rentity  = N'EVNT'
							AND    add_code     = @sCompositecode

							/* W01350 - Delete associated data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'ACT', @sX, N'*', @sCompositecode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							/*****************************************************************************
							This trigger code is absorbing the following package calls:
								O7EVENTTEMP_ADDEVENT
								O7EVENTTEMP_CLEARTEMPTABLE
							*****************************************************************************/
							set @dToday = getdate()

							if exists (	SELECT 'X' FROM r5events
										WHERE  evt_code    	= @sEvent
										AND    evt_rstatus 	> N'C'
										AND    ISNULL( evt_updated, evt_created ) NOT BETWEEN @dToday - .00005 AND @dToday + .00005)
							begin
								UPDATE r5events
								SET    evt_updated = @dToday
								WHERE  evt_code    = @sEvent
							end

							-- mobile changes
							select @sKey = 'ACT_ACT' + CHAR(13) + 'ACT_EVENT'
							select @sValue = str(@nACT) + CHAR(13) + @sEvent
							execute o7mobile_sync_event N'R5ACTIVITIES', N'DELETE', @sKey, @sValue, NULL

							/**************************************************************************
							
							The following code is for Databridge work order outbound event
							
							**************************************************************************/						
							select	@sRstatus = evt_rstatus,
								@sRtype = evt_rtype,
								@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
								@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
								@sEventOrg = evt_org,
								@dInterface = evt_interface
							from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

							if (@sRtype = N'JOB' or @sRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sRstatus = N'C' or @sRstatus = N'R') 
							begin

								select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
								from r5install
								where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

								if @sFlag = N'Y' or @sFlag = N'A'
								begin
								    select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
								    from r5ucodes
								    where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
								    if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin

										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sFlag = N'A' and @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end
							
							-- reset work order esignature
							DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sEvent and ets_updatecount <> -999

							/* Delete check list items. */
							DELETE FROM r5actchecklists
							WHERE  ack_event = @sEvent
							AND    ack_act   = @nACT

							-- Maintain table r5firstact
							SELECT @nFirstact = act_act
							FROM   r5firstact
							WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
							IF @nFirstact = @nACT
								BEGIN
									/* Delete and recreate (if necessary). */
									DELETE FROM r5firstact
									WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
									SELECT @nNewfirst = MIN( act_act )
									FROM   r5activities
									WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
									AND    act_act > 0
									IF @nNewfirst IS NOT NULL
										/* Do insert into r5firstact. */
										INSERT INTO r5firstact( act_event, act_act, act_start, act_trade, act_persons, act_duration, act_est, act_rem, act_task, act_matlist, act_multipletrades 
																, act_rpc, act_wap, act_tpf, act_manufact, act_syslevel, act_asmlevel, act_complevel, act_complocation) 
										SELECT act_event, act_act, act_start, act_trade, act_persons, act_duration, act_est, act_rem, act_task, act_matlist, act_multipletrades 
											, act_rpc, act_wap, act_tpf, act_manufact, act_syslevel, act_asmlevel, act_complevel, act_complocation
										FROM   r5activities 
										WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
										AND    act_act   = @nNewfirst
								END

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent, @nACT
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSDEL_ADD
on R5ADDETAILS
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser     	nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sREntity     	nvarchar(30)

						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSDEL_AGR
on R5AGREEMENTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sStatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sDebtor     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sArrangement	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dStart      	datetime            
	declare @dEnd        	datetime            
	declare @sObject     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sProject    	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sObject_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(50)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	AGR_CODE,	AGR_DESC,	AGR_STATUS,	AGR_RSTATUS,	AGR_CLASS,
													  	AGR_DEBTOR,	AGR_ARRANGEMENT,	AGR_START,	AGR_END,	AGR_OBJECT,
													  	AGR_PROJECT,	AGR_EVENT,	AGR_ORG,	AGR_CLASS_ORG,	AGR_OBJECT_ORG,
													  	AGR_UPDATECOUNT,	AGR_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
												   	@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
												   	@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--pre_agr portion
							IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
							FROM   r5agreements_archive
							WHERE  aag_code = @sCode) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7PREAGR N'DEL', @sCode, @sStatus, @sRstatus, @sArrangement, @sClass, 
																@sClass_org, @sDebtor, @sDesc, @dEnd, @sObject, @sProject,
																@sEvent, @dStart, null, null, null, null, null, 
																null, null, null, null, null, null,	null, null
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							--posdel_agr portion
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', null, N'AGR', null, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, null, @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sConcat = @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg
							execute @nReturn = O7DELPRV N'DEL', N'AGR', @sConcat, @sClass, null, @sClass_org, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
														   	@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
														   	@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
														   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSDEL_AOR
on R5ARCORDERS
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)

create trigger POSDEL_AQU
on R5ACTQUALIFICATIONS
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser 			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent       		nvarchar(30)

	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nReturn		integer

	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype			nvarchar(4)
	
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent	nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dInterface		datetime

	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select AQU_EVENT from deleted
			
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/**************************************************************************
							
							The following code is for Databridge work order outbound event
							
							**************************************************************************/						
							select	@sRstatus = evt_rstatus,
								@sRtype = evt_rtype,
								@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
								@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
								@sEventOrg = evt_org,
								@dInterface = evt_interface
							from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

							if (@sRtype = N'JOB' or @sRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sRstatus = N'C' or @sRstatus = N'R') 
							begin

								select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
								from r5install
								where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

								if @sFlag = N'A'
								begin
								    select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
								    from r5ucodes
								    where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
								    if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin

										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sFlag = N'A' and @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end
							
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)

	declare @sDesc         	nvarchar(80)

	declare @sMat_specific 	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nLab_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nMat_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nHir_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nDma_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nFix_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nAdd_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTime_roundup 	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nMin_time     	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nTol_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @sOrg          	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org    	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount  	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity  	integer             

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(50)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	ARR_CODE,	ARR_DESC,	ARR_CLASS,	ARR_CUSTOM_TARIFF,	ARR_MAT_SPECIFIC,
													  	ARR_LAB_CHARGE,	ARR_MAT_CHARGE,	ARR_HIR_CHARGE,	ARR_DMA_CHARGE,	ARR_FIX_CHARGE,
													  	ARR_ADD_PRICE,	ARR_TIME_ROUNDUP,	ARR_MIN_TIME,	ARR_TOL_CHARGE,	ARR_ORG,
													  	ARR_CLASS_ORG,	ARR_UPDATECOUNT,	ARR_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sCustom_tariff,	@sMat_specific,
												   	@nLab_charge,	@nMat_charge,	@nHir_charge,	@nDma_charge,	@nFix_charge,
												   	@nAdd_price,	@nTime_roundup,	@nMin_time,	@nTol_charge,	@sOrg,
												   	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

														@sDesc, @nDma_charge, @nFix_charge, @nHir_charge, @nLab_charge,

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									return

							execute @nReturn = O7DELPRV N'DEL', N'ARR', @sConcat, @sClass, null, @sClass_org, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sCustom_tariff,	@sMat_specific,
														   	@nLab_charge,	@nMat_charge,	@nHir_charge,	@nDma_charge,	@nFix_charge,
														   	@nAdd_price,	@nTime_roundup,	@nMin_time,	@nTol_charge,	@sOrg,
														   	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end
